## [Understanding Smart Workplace Engagement among Women Returning from Maternity Leave: Technology Adoption as a Mediator and Work\-Life Balance as a Moderator](../publications/0717a9406cbed0f477eb.md)

Shilpa Kulkarni; M\.M\. Munshi

This study looks at the factors influencing women IT employees who choose to work from the office after maternity leave in the context of Smart Workplace Engagement \(SWE\)\. Analysis of the influence of ATT, TA, SE, PBC, SN, and WLB is undertaken\. Based on the Theory of Planned Behavior, the study examined direct, indirect, and moderating effects of work\-life balance\. Three hundred and fifty women working in IT had their data analyzed using SmartPLS to check for validity, reliability, and structural connection\. Results reveal that subjective norms and environmental self\-efficacy are the most significant variables driving technology adoption, with selfefficacy partially mediating the link between SWE and technology adoption\. While perceived behavioral control does not predict engagement, attitude and work\-life balance do\. The need of balancing work and personal responsibilities is supported by moderation analysis, which also confirms that work\-life balance improves the attitude\-engagement connection\. The Importance–Performance Map Analysis suggests that increasing social support, self\-efficacy, and work\-life balance can optimize engagement outcomes\. These results provide IT organizations with practical implications for developing interventions that promote technology adoption, employee confidence, and the integration of work and life, finally leading to increased productivity, innovation, and employee satisfaction in smart workplace settings\.

## [Post\-Śodhana Rasāyana and Pratimarśa Nasya for Sustained Management of Akāla Palitya: A Case Report](../publications/072346f43c55f81903e6.md)

G D Sudarshana Rao; Arhanth Kumar A; Dhanashri B Patil; K Vidyalakshmi

Background: Akāla Palitya refers to premature greying of hair and is described in Ayurveda with predominant involvement of Pitta associated with Vāta\. The condition is also discussed in relation to Rasa Dhātu Duṣṭi and may require a comprehensive approach rather than local management alone\. Case Report: A 10\-year\-old female presented with premature greying of hair, progressing from the center towards the periphery, along with scalp itching for four years\. Examination revealed predominantly black, straight hair with approximately 10–15 grey hairs and a dry, flaky scalp\. A similar history of premature greying was present in her elder brother\. Based on Śukla Keśa, Kandu and Sphuṭana of Śiraḥ Kapāla, the case was diagnosed as Akāla Palitya\. Intervention: Treatment was planned sequentially with Pittahara Cikitsā and Rasa\-Rakta Dhātu\-oriented management, followed by Śodhana and Rasāyana\-Keśya therapy\. Initial management included Śamanauṣadhi and Pratimarśa Nasya as a dinacaryā was started\. Later, Śodhana followed by Rasāyana, Pratimarśa Nasya and Śiroabhyaṅga was administered\. Result: Gradual improvement was observed, with reduction in the progression of premature greying and improvement in presenting complaints during follow\-up visits\. Conclusion: An individualized and sequential therapeutic approach incorporating Śodhana followed by Rasāyana and Nasya showed clinical improvement in this case; however, controlled clinical studies are required to establish therapeutic efficacy\. Keywords: Akāla Palitya, Premature Greying, Śodhana, Rasāyana, Pratimarśa Nasya

## [A Data\-Driven Spatio\-Temporal Expert System for EV Charging Demand Profiling: The Complex T\-Spherical Fuzzy C\-Means Clustering Algorithm](../publications/07282dacdaec08022a1d.md)

Subramanian Petchimuthu; M\. Jeyalakshmi Saravanakumar; Fathima Banu M\.; Meena Somasundaram; Dragan Pamucar

Optimizing Electric Vehicle \(EV\) charging infrastructure is a critical urban planning challenge characterized by high\-dimensional uncertainty and periodic traffic flows\. Traditional decision models often suffer from &quot;temporal blindness,&quot; failing to recognize the cyclical nature of urban movement \(e\.g\., the proximity of late\-night and early\-morning hours\)\. This paper introduces the Complex T\-Spherical Fuzzy C\-Means \(CTSF\-CM\) expert system, a novel unsupervised machine learning framework designed for spatio\-temporal demand profiling\. The system utilizes a complex phase term to mathematically represent temporal periodicity and a T\-spherical fuzzy structure to filter environmental noise from meteorological sensors\. Validated on 2,747 hourly instances from the I\-94 Interstate Highway, the CTSF\-CM system achieves a Peak Separation Accuracy of 87\.21%, significantly outperforming standard K\-Means and Intuitionistic Fuzzy models\. Beyond numerical precision, the system provides geometrically interpretable decision boundaries that allow urban planners to distinguish between morning and evening service zones, ensuring grid stability and infrastructure efficiency in smart city environments\.

## [Development of Fiqihub: Integrated Interactive Fiqh Learning Media for Synchronous and Asynchronous Learning at Madrasah Ibtidaiyah](../publications/072a214b222e6fc331eb.md)

Laili Azkiya Putri; Abdus Syakur

This study aims to develop FIQIHUB \(Integrated Interactive Fiqh Learning Media\), an interactive learning medium designed to support synchronous and asynchronous fiqh learning at the elementary madrasah level, and to assess its feasibility, practicality, and completeness of learning outcomes\. The study employed a research and development \(R&amp;D\) approach adapted from the Borg and Gall model through seven stages and involved 17 students at Madrasah Riyadlatul Muta&\#x27;allimin Pakong\. Data were collected through expert validation, practicality observations, and assessments of student learning outcomes\. The results showed that FIQIHUB achieved a feasibility score of 90% from the material expert and 88% from the media expert, while the practicality assessment reached 85\.71%\. In addition, 15 of the 17 students achieved the minimum mastery criterion of 75, resulting in a classical mastery rate of 88\.24%\. These findings indicate that FIQIHUB is a feasible and practical alternative for integrating interactive presentations, quizzes, and instructional videos into fiqh learning\. The study contributes a learning media development model that connects synchronous and asynchronous learning activities, while providing preliminary evidence to inform further research using larger samples and more rigorous designs to examine its impact on learning outcomes\.

## [Dendrobium as Food Medicine Homology: Ornamental, Edible, and Neuroprotective Values](../publications/0731f7247685045cf533.md)

Nanqu Huang; Wendi Huang; Mei Wang; Nanyu Kuang; Shujun Li; Yong Luo; Wei Zhang; Juan Huang

Abstract Dendrobium, one of the largest genera in the Orchidaceae, represents a distinctive plant resource with ornamental, edible and medicinal value\. Owing to its rich floral diversity and long history of dietary and medicinal use in East and Southeast Asia, Dendrobium has attracted sustained attention from horticulture, food science and pharmacological research\. Ornamentally, this genus is characterized by diverse floral morphology, color variation, abundant germplasm resources, and well\-established cultivation systems that support its widespread use\. In terms of edible value, only certain species, especially Dendrobium officinale, have been formally incorporated into food use in China, with stems, flowers and leaves approved as food materials\. These edible parts contain polysaccharides, flavonoids, alkaloids and phenolic compounds, providing a chemical basis for functional food development\. Accumulating preclinical studies indicate that Dendrobium\-derived constituents exert neuroprotective effects in experimental models of Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, aging, ischemic stroke and spinal cord injury\. Reported mechanisms involve oxidative stress regulation, neuroinflammatory modulation, autophagy\-lysosome pathways and gut\-brain axis signaling\. This review examines the ornamental, edible and neuroprotective value of Dendrobium from a food medicine homology, with emphasis on species\-specific uses, edible\-part composition, translational limits and future directions for rational development and application\.

## [Institutional setting and vaccine sector capabilities\. The cases of Japan, Indonesia, and Vietnam](../publications/07346942ab562d5ebd66.md)

Michiko Iizuka; Rahmi Lestari Helmi; Bertha Vallejo; K\. Mita; Tran Son Tung

The COVID\-19 pandemic exposed the urgent need for stable vaccine provision worldwide\. This paper examines how three Asian countries developed technological, regulatory, market\-enabling, and coordination capabilities for vaccine provision during the COVID\-19 crisis, with particular attention to the catalytic role of institutional capacity in reshaping vaccine\-sector incentive mechanisms\. Using a comparative institutional analysis, the study compares Japan, Indonesia, and Vietnam before, during, and after the COVID\-19 pandemic\. Drawing on semi\-structured interviews and secondary sources, the analysis shows that while COVID\-19 acted as a catalyst, outcomes varied significantly across the selected countries because of differences in pre\-existing capabilities\. The study argues that even during a crisis, institutional transformation remains strongly path\-dependent and incremental: crisis arrangements reverted once pressure receded, while those bound by contract or market instruments remained\.

## [How emotional financial narratives amplify herd behaviour and create asset bubbles? \(The Blockbuster Economics\)](../publications/074623129bd473089a2b.md)

Alexandra Kim

This article looks at the parallelism of financial market narratives with classical blockbuster emotional story arcs, which is based on a “winner takes it all” perspective, and how the structural similarity of these narratives increases herd behaviour and the risk of forming asset bubbles in global markets\. This article, built on the interdisciplinary concepts of behavioural finance, economic sociology and narrative theory, posits that, in this context \(when financial information is delivered through the vehicle of emotionally powerful storytelling forms\) the rational, analytical process designed for information is inhibited and the affective process designed for feeling is activated, thereby eliciting responses that are not necessarily in line with the fundamental valuation metric\. This study highlights the importance of understanding the euphoria phase of asset bubbles as a narrative manipulation, based on analysis of recent cases such as the Labubu phenomenon, the AI market, and market speculation, during which investors are led towards the &quot;triumphant ending&quot; that is rarely achieved\. Empirical research on informational segregation, homophily of individuals within social networks, and drama marketing methods is used to build a theory to explain why boom\-bust cycles occur in speculative markets despite the fact that they are well\-documented to be harmful\.

## [What is gratitude research missing? Bridging the gap between conceptualization, measurement, and intervention](../publications/0746deaef23a71836071.md)

David del Rosario\-Gilabert; Mamen Regalado\-Reyes; Neus Vila\-Brunet

Does contemporary gratitude research investigate the full phenomenon described by current gratitude theories? Gratitude has become a prominent construct in positive psychology, with research linking it to well\-being, resilience, prosociality, and mental health\. As theoretical perspectives have expanded, however, empirical approaches appear not to have broadened to the same extent\. This purposive Mini review examines gratitude research across conceptualization, measurement, intervention, physiology, and neuroscience\. Contemporary theories and measures increasingly represent gratitude as a multidimensional phenomenon encompassing interpersonal, existential, contemplative, embodied, and ecological dimensions\. By contrast, dominant and influential intervention paradigms continue to emphasize reflection on benefits and benefactors, while much of the neuroscience literature reviewed here operationalizes gratitude through interpersonal, appraisal\-based, and reciprocity\-related scenarios\. These differences suggest a conceptual–operational mismatch: relatively broad understandings of gratitude are often investigated through more narrowly focused empirical approaches\. Consequently, existing findings may illuminate interpersonal and benefit\-focused gratitude more fully than broader forms of grateful experience\. We conclude by proposing directions for developing ecologically valid, embodied, and relational methodologies capable of investigating a wider range of gratitude experiences\.

## [Implementasi Optical Mark Recognition dengan Pendekatan Template\-Based untuk Koreksi Otomatis Lembar Jawaban Pilihan Ganda](../publications/075bb6b6188c180cbf6d.md)

Novi Tristanti; Oki Derajat Sudarmojo; Anang Susilo; Anny Muthmainah

Manual checking of multiple\-choice answer sheets is time\-consuming and labor\-intensive, particularly when a large number of answer sheets need to be examined\. Optical Mark Recognition \(OMR\) can be used to automate the image\-based reading and correction of answer sheets\. This study implements a computer vision\-based OMR system that utilizes a blank answer sheet template as a reference for identifying mark changes in answer\-choice areas\. The system was developed using the Python programming language and the OpenCV library through several stages, including preprocessing, grayscale conversion, adaptive thresholding, contour detection, perspective correction, image alignment with the template, answer\-area segmentation, answer identification, answer correction based on the answer key, and score calculation\. The system was designed to recognize six output classes: A, B, C, D, E, and BLANK\. Evaluation was conducted using 50 answer\-sheet images, each containing 60 questions with five answer alternatives, resulting in 3,000 answer decisions and 15,000 answer\-choice areas being analyzed\. All 50 answer sheets were successfully processed during the validation stage\. The evaluation results showed that 2,863 predictions were correctly identified and 137 predictions were incorrect, yielding an accuracy of 95\.43%, macro precision of 95\.62%, macro recall of 94\.53%, and macro F1\-score of 94\.92%\. Specific evaluation of the BLANK class achieved a precision of 100%, recall of 85\.71%, and F1\-score of 92\.31%\. These results indicate that the computer vision\- and template\-based OMR approach can be used to automatically read and correct answer sheets with good performance\. Nevertheless, 18 answers that were actually blank were identified as one of the A–E options\. This condition indicates that visual variations in answer areas can still affect the identification process; therefore, optimization of the template\-comparison mechanism and testing under more diverse image conditions are required to improve the robustness of the system\.

## [Real\-time assessment of temperature sensitivity, pain processing, and pain behavior across the lifespan: Integrating stimulus data, contact force, and subjective ratings](../publications/077f249aa1fef0b6a3b3.md)

Heinz\-Jürgen Steinhoff; Besim Prenaj; Sebastian L\. Kübel; Annekatrin Steinhoff

Assessments of temperature sensitivity and pain processing play an important role in psychological and psychiatry research, including with adolescent participants and across the lifespan\. To ensure the validity and comparability of findings, experimental settings must be well tolerated and easily manageable for participants of all age groups and reliably monitored by the experimenter\. These settings should promote reproducible procedures and support computer\-assisted data acquisition and analysis to enable robust, efficient scientific evaluation\. We present CAREST \(Controlling and Recording Experiments in Sensitivity to Temperature\), a PsychoPy\-based tool for real\-time assessment of temperature sensitivity, pain sensation, and pain response behavior via thermal induction\. CAREST controls and communicates with a cold/hot plate and provides a touchscreen slider to assess pain sensation on a visual analog scale \(VAS\)\. The plate is placed on a platform with load cells to measure hand\-plate contact force, providing an objective assessment of thermal contact between hand and plate surface during the experiment and participants&\#x27; approach versus avoidance tendencies in response to pain\. CAREST continuously and synchronously records timestamped values of plate surface temperature, participants&\#x27; VAS ratings, and hand\-plate contact force, enabling computation of several established and novel measures of pain sensitivity and related behavioral factors within a single experimental setting\. In a pilot study with 94 participants, we examined heat and cold pain thresholds, intensities, tolerances, and hand\-plate contact forces\. The results highlight substantial heterogeneity in pain response behavior, with one out of five participants differing markedly from the modest average tendency toward pain avoidance\.

## [Propuestas novedosas para incrementar y depurar el repertorio dramático de Luis Vélez de Guevara](../publications/078d56f6865cfcc5b2ab.md)

Álvaro Cuéllar; Javier J\. González Martínez; Germán Vega García\-Luengos

El repertorio dramático de Luis Vélez de Guevara nos ha llegado casi en su totalidad tras las correspondientes adaptaciones escénicas e impresas y sin control de la transmisión por parte del poeta\. A través de métodos estilométricos ofrecemos propuestas de inclusión y exclusión de obras teatrales al corpus velecista\. Se ofrece información sobre 58 piezas que nos han llegado con atribuciones a distintos autores, entre los que figura Luis Vélez, y en las que la estilometría ha detectado su huella, o su ausencia, cuando las fuentes primarias no generaban dudas\. Lo más interesante son las 15 atribuciones, muy seguras desde la estilometría, que se relacionan con el dramaturgo, algunas ya señaladas con anterioridad por otros métodos y pistas, lo cual da mucha solidez a lo que aquí se propone\. También son relevantes las 29 obras que son rechazadas por esta técnica\. Con estas sumas y restas finales, Luis Vélez sigue siendo uno de los dramaturgos con mayor número de obras dramáticas conservadas, en torno al centenar, solo superado por Lope y Calderón\.

## [Machine Learning Quantifies Within\-Subject Facial Change in Acromegaly](../publications/079103065e073b81a622.md)

Ali Ammar; Hana Hadley; Saif Rjaibi; Adam Z\. Levitan; Chris Brogly; Alireza Sadeghian; Michael D\. Cusimano; BEAGLE International Study Group; Mihaly Kis; JEANNETTE GOGUEN; Shereen Ezzat; Michael Chicoine; Domenico Solari; Stephanie Cheok; Garni Barkhoudarian; Ian McCutcheon; Joao Paulo Almeida; Donato Pacione; Gabriel Zada; Hani Marcus; Adam Mamelak; James Liu; Michael Catalino; Tomas Garzon Muvdi; Nelson Oyesiku; Jill Sisco; Pat McBride; Muriël Marks; Miranda Day; Kesava Reddy; Karan Singh; Olli Saarela; Ashirbani Saha; Fahad Alkherayf; Euihyun Kimx

OBJECTIVE: Machine\-learning models can distinguish acromegaly from controls in single photographs, but whether gradual facial change can be measured within the same person from ordinary photographs is unknown\. We tested whether a person&\#x27;s face shifts measurably toward an acromegaly\-associated pattern over time\. DESIGN: Multicenter, international, cross\-sectional cohort study with within\-subject longitudinal analysis\. METHODS: People with acromegaly and other pituitary tumors contributed retrospective photographs\. Two timepoints per person were paired by self\-reported disease stage when available, with chronological pairing otherwise\. A face\-recognition model and a general\-image model described each image, and leave\-one\-patient\-out scoring quantified within\-person movement toward the acromegaly\-associated pattern\. RESULTS: Of 582 participants, 110 contributed usable frontal photographs and 69 had two timepoints \(50 acromegaly, 19 tumor controls\)\. The facial score separated held\-out advanced\-disease from control faces \(AUC 0\.858\)\. In acromegaly, the median within\-person shift was 0\.59 and 76\.0% moved in the predicted direction \(p=0\.0003\); 81\.5% of clean untreated pairs moved as predicted \(p=0\.0008\)\. The three contrast strata ordered directionally, although the trend was not significant \(p=0\.15\)\. The 15 non\-Cushing aging controls showed no significant shift \(p=0\.72\), and the between\-group difference remained after adjustment for photograph interval \(p=0\.029\)\. Pre\-diagnosis untreated baselines showed modest separation from all control baselines \(AUC 0\.65, one\-sided p=0\.033\)\. The general\-image model showed no within\-person change \(p=0\.32\)\. CONCLUSIONS: Acromegaly\-associated facial change is measurable within individuals from ordinary photographs, supporting further evaluation of longitudinal photograph\-based monitoring and earlier recognition\.

## [Use of generative artificial intelligence in medical libraries: A scoping review](../publications/0799977b28e96650503d.md)

Antônio Carlos Picalho; Mateus Rebouças Nascimento; Luciane Maria Fadel

Purpose\. This study aims to map how health and medical libraries have used GenAI to support library services\. Methods\. Scoping review following PRISMA\-ScR\. Searches covered publications from 2020 to 2025 in PubMed, Embase, CINAHL, LISTA, Academic Search Premier, MEDLINE via Ovid, Scopus, Web of Science, ProQuest Dissertations &amp; Theses, and Google Scholar\. After deduplication, 106 of 250 records were screened in Rayyan by two independent blinded reviewers\. Findings\. Eleven studies were included: seven primary studies and four secondary or methodological papers\. Among primaries, five directly used GPT\-family models \(GPT\-4/ChatGPT/GPT\-4o or Perplexity layered on GPT\-4\) to answer clinical questions, support search\-strategy design, trial library tasks, and integrate source\-linked answers in a national portal\. One survey assessed intention to adopt generative chatbots; one case described a rule\-based chatbot\. GenAI accelerates workflows and extends services but requires human verification, transparency about limitations, privacy policies, and staff training \(including prompt engineering\)\. LLM\-generated search strategies exhibited variability and underperformed compared with human designs\. Implications\. In its current state, GenAI works best as a copilot useful for drafting, triage, and initial sense\-making, while librarians remain essential for high\-precision tasks \(performance\), quality control \(reliability\), and governance\. This suggests that its academic value lies not in automation alone, but in the mediated integration of AI into evidence\-informed services, where professional judgment, methodological transparency, and ethical accountability determine whether GenAI strengthens or weakens health information practices\.

## [MACHINE LEARNING BASED PREDICTION OF HYDROGEOLOGICAL PARAMETERS AND GROUNDWATER POTENTIAL INDEX USING GEOSPATIAL AND BOREHOLE DATA](../publications/079d31d31644411abd1c.md)

Prof\. I Pandu Ranga Reddy Dr\. Hari Ramavath

Abstract: Groundwater is a critical natural resource for domestic consumption, agricultural production, industrial development, and ecological sustainability\. Accurate prediction of hydrogeological parameters and groundwater potential is essential for sustainable groundwater management, particularly in regions experiencing irregular rainfall, increasing water demand, and declining groundwater levels\. This research paper presents a machine learning\-based framework for predicting hydrogeological parameters and developing a Groundwater Potential Index \(GWPI\) by integrating geospatial datasets with borehole records\. The proposed approach combines terrain characteristics, geological formations, soil properties, land use and land cover, drainage density, rainfall, slope, and remotely sensed indices with borehole\-derived information, including water\-table depth, aquifer thickness, lithology, and well yield\. Machine learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Support Vector Regression, Gradient Boosting, and Artificial Neural Networks can be employed to estimate hydrogeological variables and identify areas with different groundwater potential levels\. The predicted parameters are integrated within a geospatial framework to generate a spatially distributed groundwater potential index\. Model performance can be assessed using the coefficient of determination \(\\\(R^2\\\)\), root mean square error \(RMSE\), and mean absolute error \(MAE\)\. The proposed framework offers a reproducible and scalable approach for groundwater exploration, borehole siting, and regional water\-resource planning\. Since no study\-area dataset or model outputs have been provided, the paper presents a methodological framework rather than claiming experimentally validated results\. Keywords: Machine Learning, Groundwater Potential Index, Hydrogeological Parameters, Geospatial Analysis, Borehole Data, Random Forest, Remote Sensing, Groundwater Management\.

## [Unveiling Cation‐Selective Evolution at Perovskite Step Edges for Boosted Anaerobic Methane Oxidation](../publications/07a0e3e357a172cdb720.md)

Jiaoyan Shi; Jinzhe Zhang; Yue Hu; Chuande Huang; Zhen Wang; Haidong Liu; Xiaoli Pan; Yanyan Zhu; Qian Yang; RuiKai Xu; Zhe Song; Lingchao Xu; Wenli Kang; Baolin Hou; Xiang‐Kui Gu; Xiaodong Wang

ABSTRACT Precisely tuning the catalytic behavior of perovskite oxides \(ABO 3 \) remains challenging in catalysis, owing to the uncontrollable redistribution of metal cations at the surface\. Herein, taking La 0\.5 Sr 0\.5 FeO 3‐δ as a model system, we demonstrate that high‐temperature annealing can induce a selective metal cation enrichment at surface step edges, transforming the dominant edge cations from Sr to Fe\. This reconfiguration greatly enhances the intrinsic activity \(normalized by specific surface area\) by 57‐fold for selective anaerobic oxidation of methane\. Mechanism studies reveal that Sr cations exhibit a higher segregation tendency than La and Fe below 900°C due to their relatively weaker bonding with lattice oxygen\. Upon annealing at 1200°C, surface‐enriched Sr cations undergo segregation and volatilization, which would thereby expose adjacent Fe sites as highly undercoordinated and active centers for methane conversion\. Our findings provide the direct experimental evidence for cation‐selective occupation at perovskite step edges, offering valuable guidance for the rational design of advanced perovskite‐based catalysts\.

## [$Stakeholder perspectives on the future of trucking in an automated world](../publications/07adf3e36a598e0fe843.md)

Isabelle C\. Wandenkolk; Jaji Pamarthi; Intisar Becic; Honon Lee; Robin Riessman; Shannon C\. Roberts

As artificial intelligence \(AI\) becomes embedded into vehicle automation and fleet operations, the U\.S\. trucking industry faces opportunities and challenges\. These technologies promise safety and efficiency gains, but also raise underexplored questions regarding workforce transitions, training, and regulatory frameworks\. This study investigated how stakeholders across the U\.S\. trucking industry perceive the integration of AI systems, including advanced driver assistance systems \(ADAS\) and automated commercial motor vehicles \(ACMVs\), and the implications for safety, operational practices, and workforce adaptation\. Semi\-structured interviews were conducted with 33 U\.S\.\-based participants representing five stakeholder groups: truck drivers, trucking companies, truck driving schools, technology developers, and policymakers\. Data were thematically analyzed and mapped onto the sociotechnical systems framework \(environment, organizations, workers, tasks, and tools &amp; technologies\)\. Six themes emerged: \(1\) Feasibility of AI\-Enabled Systems, spanning regulation, training and licensing, infrastructure, and human–technology teaming; \(2\) Benefits such as increased safety, efficiency, workload balance, and industry appeal; \(3\) Workforce Impacts related to job availability, role transitions, and satisfaction; \(4\) Technology Perceptions characterized by trust and skepticism; \(5\) Industry Practices including recruitment, training, and fleet management; and \(6\) Innovation involving automation progress, and deployment\. Most subthemes were shared across all five groups, while others were raised by a subset or a single group, revealing both convergence and divergence in how stakeholders understand AI integration\. Stakeholders identified AI’s potential to improve safety and efficiency, but raised concerns about job displacement, regulatory gaps, and human oversight\. This study provides insights for system design, human\-technology interaction, training, workforce adaptation and regulatory frameworks\.

## [Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy for Nervous System Diseases: Quality of Life, Safety, and Life Expectancy \(Part 1 – Multiple Sclerosis\)](../publications/07b549ced1bf668ae8aa.md)

Наталія Мацко; Nataliia Pokhmurska\-Hudym; Solomiya Tolopko; Mariia Ferko; Zoryana Ambrozevych; Vitalii Ambrozevych

This article examines current aspects of multiple sclerosis as a chronic demyelinating disease of the central nervous system associated with diverse neurological impairments that may lead to persistent disability and a reduced quality of life\. Current approaches to early diagnosis are analyzed, including magnetic resonance imaging, clinical assessment, and the McDonald diagnostic criteria, together with the classification of demyelinating diseases according to the International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision\. Data on the prevalence of multiple sclerosis worldwide and in Ukraine, its main clinical manifestations, risk factors, immunopathogenetic mechanisms, and current approaches to pharmacotherapy are summarized\. Particular attention is paid to the importance of timely medical consultation, interdisciplinary collaboration among healthcare professionals, physical therapy, and occupational therapy in restoring and maintaining patients’ functional abilities\. The prospects for using digital technologies and artificial intelligence to monitor patients’ condition and improve rehabilitation interventions are considered\. The importance of a comprehensive approach to the care of people with multiple sclerosis is emphasized, with a focus on maintaining functional independence, improving quality of life, and reducing the risk of disability progression\.

## [Konuşma Sinyallerinden Duygu Tanıma İçin Makine Öğrenmesi ve Derin Öğrenme Modellerinin Karşılaştırmalı Analizi](../publications/07ceb398050ed6f06939.md)

Fatih ŞAHİN

Konuşma tabanlı duygu tanıma \(Speech Emotion Recognition — SER\), insan\-bilgisayar etkileşimi, sağlık izleme ve müşteri hizmetleri gibi alanlarda kritik öneme sahip bir araştırma konusudur\. Bu çalışmada dört referans veri seti \(RAVDESS, CREMA\-D, TESS, SAVEE\) birleştirilerek 121 konuşmacıya ait 12\.162 ses kaydı üzerinde yedi makine öğrenmesi ve derin öğrenme modeli karşılaştırmalı olarak değerlendirilmiştir\. Değerlendirme, konuşmacıya göre gruplanmış katmanlı çapraz doğrulama \(5 kat × 3 tekrar\) ile konuşmacı\-bağımsız olarak yürütülmüş; ayrıca her veri setinin sırayla test kümesi olarak kullanıldığı veri setleri arası protokol uygulanmıştır\. Çalışmanın temel bulgusu, değerlendirme protokolünün model mimarisinden daha belirleyici olmasıdır: konuşmacı bağımlılığına izin veren rastgele bölme, yedi modelin tamamında ortalama 14,61 puanlık iyimser bir yanlılık üretmektedir ve bu, en iyi ile en kötü model arasındaki farktan \(11,24 puan\) büyüktür\. Konuşmacı\-bağımsız protokolde en yüksek dengeli doğruluğu MLP \(%52,39\) göstermiş, CNN\-BiLSTM\-Attention ile arasında anlamlı fark bulunmamıştır; geleneksel makine öğrenmesi ile derin öğrenme modellerinin başarım aralıkları örtüştüğünden model ailesi düzeyinde bir üstünlük iddiası desteklenmemektedir\. Veri setleri arası değerlendirmede en iyi model altı sınıflı problemde %29,3 dengeli doğrulukta kalmış, iki veri seti için başarım şans düzeyine \(%16,67\) yaklaşmıştır\. Hesaplama maliyeti özellik çıkarma süresi dâhil edilerek uçtan uca ölçüldüğünde sıralama tersine dönmekte, Random Forest en yavaş \(211,6 ms/kayıt\), 1D\-CNN ise en hızlı \(37,0 ms/kayıt\) model olmaktadır\. Bulgular, SER çalışmalarında protokol seçiminin ve uçtan uca maliyet ölçümünün açıkça raporlanması gerektiğini göstermektedir\.

## [The Effect of Visual Information Chunking\-Based Marketing on Customer Engagement With Kompas One](../publications/07cf923024b724a6703f.md)

Anggun Aulia Putri; Achmad Fadillah

Background: Kompas One, a premium content bundle by KG Media anchored on Kompas\.id, faced a wide engagement gap in its email marketing: open rates well above the media\-industry average were not followed by comparable click\-through activity\. Purpose: This study identifies the root causes of low interaction with text\-heavy email design and empirically tests whether a Visual Information Chunking \(VIC\) layout improves customer engagement\. Design/methodology/approach: A mixed\-methods sequential exploratory design was applied\. Fishbone Diagram and 5 Whys analysis, validated through interviews with three Growth and UI/UX informants, identified root causes\. Thirty baseline text\-heavy email campaigns \(September–October 2025\) and 30 treatment Visual Information Chunking email campaigns \(November–December 2025\), representing a four\-month dataset across randomized, non\-overlapping cohorts of prospective, at\-risk, and churned subscribers, were compared using descriptive statistics, Shapiro\-Wilk normality tests, and Mann\-Whitney U tests on Open Rate, Click\-Through Rate \(CTR\), and Click\-to\-Open Rate \(CTOR\)\. Findings/Results: Root causes centered on a mismatch between dense narrative layouts and audiences&\#x27; need for scannable content, compounded by clipped\-message risk\. VIC significantly increased CTR \(\+71\.43%, p = 0\.007, effect size r = 0\.347\) and CTOR \(\+61\.54%, p = 0\.008, effect size r = 0\.345\), while Open Rate showed no statistically significant change \(p = 0\.802, r = 0\.032\)\. Conclusion: Reducing text density and strengthening visual hierarchy lowers cognitive load and drives post\-open engagement\. Originality/value \(State of the art\): The study extends Cognitive Load Theory and the Stimulus\-Organism\-Response framework to bundled\-product email marketing within the Southeast Asian digital news sector\. Keywords: cognitive load, customer engagement, email marketing, product bundling, visual hierarchy

## [PERFIS VOCACIONAIS RIASEC DE ESTUDANTES DO CURSO TÉCNICO EM ADMINISTRAÇÃO: PREDOMINÂNCIA DAS DIMENSÕES SOCIAL E CONVENCIONAL](../publications/07e638b32e62ec37c8eb.md)

Reginaldo Vasconcelos Sena

A identificação dos interesses profissionais pode apoiar a orientação de carreira e o planejamento pedagógico na Educação Profissional e Tecnológica\. Este estudo teve como objetivo analisar os perfis vocacionais RIASEC de estudantes concluintes do Curso Técnico em Administração Integrado ao Ensino Médio, identificar as dimensões predominantes e discutir sua compatibilidade teórica com a formação administrativa\. Realizou\-se pesquisa quantitativa, descritiva e analítica com 56 estudantes\. Os dados foram obtidos por questionário estruturado, composto por 24 atividades distribuídas entre os seis tipos de Holland, e analisados por meio do alfa de Cronbach, do teste de Friedman e de três comparações pareadas focalizadas pelo teste de Wilcoxon, com correção de Bonferroni\. As subescalas apresentaram consistência interna de baixa a limítrofe \(α = 0,322–0,698\), recomendando cautela interpretativa\. Houve diferença global entre os perfis, χ²\(5, N = 56\) = 24,198, p &lt; 0,001, com tamanho de efeito pequeno \(W = 0,086\)\. Social e Convencional obtiveram os maiores postos médios e não diferiram entre si \(p ajustado = 0,513\); ambos superaram o perfil Empreendedor nas comparações focalizadas \(p ajustado = 0,006 e 0,033, respectivamente\), com efeitos moderados\. Conclui\-se que a turma apresenta predominância grupal Social–Convencional\. Os achados podem subsidiar ações de orientação profissional e experiências formativas de liderança, iniciativa e inovação, sem confundir o tipo RIASEC Empreendedor com o construto amplo de empreendedorismo\.

## [Structure\-guided design of a brain\-penetrant covalent inhibitor of human butyrylcholinesterase with in vivo procognitive efficacy](../publications/080b69bf1a5e2d5832b7.md)

Peter Mastnak\-Sokolov; Urban Košak; A\. Meden; Damijan Knez; Simon Žakelj; Selena Horvat; Anja Hafner Pišlar; Jakob Kljun; Stanislav Gobec

Butyrylcholinesterase \(BChE\) has emerged as a validated therapeutic target for the management of Alzheimer’s disease symptoms, particularly in advanced stages when acetylcholinesterase activity declines\. Despite the numerous BChE inhibitors reported, only the cymserine derivative bisnorcymserine has progressed to clinical evaluation\. Here, we report the design and characterization of a novel selective human BChE \(hBChE\) inhibitor, N\-benzylpyrrolidine carbamate \(S\)\-\(\+\)\-14\. Kinetic analyses and X\-ray crystallography of the hBChE−inhibitor complex confirm a covalent mechanism of inhibition\. Compound \(S\)\-\(\+\)\-14 demonstrates favorable metabolic stability and achieves brain exposure following intraperitoneal administration in mice\. In a scopolamine\-induced cognitive impairment model, \(S\)\-\(\+\)\-14 improves cognitive performance without causing cholinergic adverse effects or motor deficits\. Collectively, these findings identify \(S\)\-\(\+\)\-14 as a structurally validated, brain\-penetrant covalent hBChE inhibitor and highlight its promise as a lead compound for the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease\.

## [Integrated Computational and Experimental Analysis of Recombinant Trastuzumab in ExpiCHO\-S™ Cells](../publications/082ae28c4d7c659dbcd5.md)

Saranraj Sankar; Priya Rajan

In this work, a computational and experimental methodology for the design, expression, purification, and first biochemical characterization of recombinant trastuzumab is described\. HADDOCK was used for molecular docking in order to examine the interaction between trastuzumab and the HER2 target\. The anticipated binding orientation, interface interactions, and energetic contributions within the antibody\-antigen complex were all revealed by the docking analysis\. Stable complex formation was indicated by the top\-ranked docking clusters&\#x27; constant electrostatic and van der Waals contacts, good HADDOCK scores, and low intermolecular RMSD values\. These results support the formation and propagation of a mammalian expression construct expressing trastuzumab in Escherichia coli\. Plasmid isolation and colony screening were used to find positive transformants\. The verified construct was subsequently transiently transfected into ExpiCHO\-S™ cells for antibody expression, with maintained cell viability reported during the expression period\. Protein A affinity chromatography was used to purify secreted trastuzumab, and size\-exclusion high\-performance liquid chromatography \(SEC\-HPLC\) was used to evaluate its purity profile\. A prominent monomeric signal with little discernible aggregation was shown by the chromatographic analysis\. SDS\-PAGE was used to further investigate the fractions that corresponded to the primary SEC peak in both reducing and non\-reducing conditions\. Bands compatible with intact IgG and the anticipated heavy and light chains following reduction were shown by electrophoretic analysis\. Overall, the study shows that it is possible to produce and assess recombinant trastuzumab by combining computational modeling with mammalian expression and biochemical characterization techniques\.

## [The Importance of Electronic Communication in the Use of Artificial Intelligence Programs and Applications in the Field of Smart Agriculture from the Point of View of Agricultural Extension Workers in Nineveh Governorate, Iraq](../publications/082de3fb3bec43b81e54.md)

Luma Monther Adress

The study aimed to identify the level of importance of electronic communication among agricultural extension workers in using artificial intelligence \(AI\) programs and applications in the field of smart agriculture\. It also aimed to identify the most frequently used electronic communication means by extension workers in employing AI programs and applications and rank them according to their relative importance; measure the contribution of electronic communication to improving extension workers&\#x27; efficiency in using AI programs and applications in smart agriculture; identify individual differences in the importance of electronic communication and the use of AI applications according to selected independent variables, namely gender, educational qualification, years of service, training courses, level of Internet use, and willingness to use social networking sites concerning smart\-agriculture technologies; and identify the obstacles facing extension workers in using AI applications in smart agriculture\. To obtain the study data, a questionnaire consisting of five parts was used\. The first part concerned the respondents&\#x27; personal and occupational information\. The second part included a scale measuring the importance of electronic communication among extension workers in using AI programs and applications in smart agriculture\. The third part measured the electronic communication means most frequently used by extension workers in employing AI programs and applications\. The fourth part measured the contribution of electronic communication to improving extension workers&\#x27; efficiency in using AI programs and applications in smart agriculture\. The fifth part contained 15 items measuring the major obstacles facing extension workers in using AI applications in smart agriculture\. After establishing the face validity of the questionnaire, reliability was assessed using Cronbach&\#x27;s alpha, which reached 0\.95\. The study population consisted of extension workers in the Nineveh Directorate of Agriculture and its 32 agricultural divisions, totaling 256 extension workers\. A simple random sample of 128 extension workers, representing approximately 50% of the population, was selected\. The data were coded, tabulated, and analyzed using SPSS\. The results showed that the level of importance of electronic communication among extension workers in using AI programs and applications in smart agriculture was moderate and tended toward high, with a percentage of 48%\. The item &quot;Using electronic platforms belonging to agricultural institutions to obtain information related to AI programs and applications&quot; ranked first, with a mean of 4\.34\. The contribution of electronic communication to improving extension workers&\#x27; efficiency in using AI programs and applications in smart agriculture was high, with a percentage of 46%\. No significant differences were found in the importance of electronic communication according to gender or training courses, whereas significant differences were reported according to educational qualification, years of occupational service, level of Internet use, and willingness to use social networking sites concerning smart\-agriculture technologies\. The item &quot;Poor compatibility of some AI applications with the nature and needs of agricultural extension work in Nineveh Governorate&quot; was identified as the most important obstacle\. The major recommendation was for the Ministry of Agriculture to establish or develop official agricultural electronic platforms affiliated with agricultural and extension institutions and containing updated information on AI applications and their use in different agricultural fields\. The main proposed future study was to investigate the obstacles to using AI applications in agricultural extension work in Nineveh Governorate from the perspective of extension workers\.

## [Environmental Sustainability and Aid for Trade: A Load Capacity Factor Perspective Using Panel Quantile Regression](../publications/083e316ee48700c6638d.md)

Ayşe Arı; Jørgen Trankjær Lauridsen

ABSTRACT This study investigates the environmental implications of Aid for Trade \(AfT\) flows in developing countries by employing the Method of Moments Quantile Regression \(MMQR\) framework\. By utilizing CO 2 emissions, ecological footprint \(EF\), and the load capacity factor \(LCF\) as comprehensive indicators, the research assesses the effects of total, energy‐oriented, and non‐energy‐oriented AfT flows\. The empirical findings reveal that total AfT disbursements and their sectoral components yield no statistically significant impact on EF\. However, all AfT categories positively impact CO 2 emissions across all quantiles in a statistically significant manner, with the positive effect diminishing in higher‐pollution quantiles\. When evaluating environmental quality through the LCF framework, only energy‐specific AfT flows are found to exert a statistically significant negative impact, thereby confirming environmental degradation\. These results, verified by Driscoll‐Kraay, 2SLS, and FMOLS estimators, demonstrate that environmental consequences are highly sensitive to the chosen indicator\. The study discusses these outcomes via scale and composition effects, advocating for a ‘green’ transformation of AfT\. It recommends prioritizing energy aid for renewable energy development, particularly for countries with lower pollution levels, in order to promote sustainable trade practices and environmental quality\.

## [An Integrated ABC–VED, Machine\-Learning Forecasting, and Optimization Framework for Building a Resilient Pharmaceutical Supply Chain: Evidence from Bangladesh](../publications/086c6419bfacae6b827d.md)

admin admin; Md\. Talha Jubayer; Md\. Hasan Al Habib; Md\. Abu Bakar Siddiq

In pharmaceutical supply chain management within the context of developing economies that rely on imports, such as Bangladesh, the probability of being affected by disruptions becomes greater as over 80% of APIs come from overseas\. Giving equal treatment to all medicines during the prioritization process would not only be ineffective but could even lead to stockouts of essential medicines\. In this study, a framework that consists of three stages of analysis \- \(1\) ABC–VED analysis of criticality, \(2\) forecasting of demand for critical APIs using machine learning algorithms, and \(3\) MILP \(mixed\-integer linear programming\) model formulation – was developed to assist the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies in prioritizing investments into supply chain resilience in terms of which medicines should be considered\. The dataset used consisted of simulated but methodologically realistic information on 20 medicines, 18 APIs, 4 suppliers, and 60\-months&\#x27; observation period \(January 2021 – December 2025\)\. An integrated ABC–VED matrix helped to determine eight medicines \(40% of the portfolio\) as being critical and consumed 73\.25% of the annual value of APIs\. Six machine learning algorithms \(Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, Support Vector Regression, Artificial Neural Network, and CatBoost\) were used to build a forecasting model for the six critical APIs and their performance was compared based on three primary evaluation metrics\. The Artificial Neural Network algorithm showed the best performance in terms of minimizing errors in all the three evaluation metrics \(MAE = 7\.31%, MAPE = 7\.43%, RMSE = 8\.65%\), beating the second one \(XGBoost\) by 9\.7% \-12\.5%\. The forecasts produced by the best algorithm are suggested to be used in the MILP model of procurement, inventory, and supplier allocation for further empirical investigation\.

## [Fabrication of starch/PVA/CuO electrospun nanoscaffolds for enhanced antimicrobial activity](../publications/08708544b30c9c664299.md)

Gopika Mohanakumar; Suresh Subramaniyam; Sivaramakrishnan R; Velliyur Kanniappan Gopalakrishnan; Selvaraj Jayaraman; Chella Perumal Palanisamy

The increasing prevalence of antimicrobial resistance and the limitations of conventional wound dressings necessitate the development of sustainable and effective antimicrobial biomaterials\. In this study, copper oxide nanoparticles \(CuO NPs\) were green synthesized using Turbinaria conoides extract and subsequently incorporated into starch/polyvinyl alcohol \(PVA\) electrospun nanofibrous scaffolds to enhance antimicrobial performance\. The biosynthesized CuO NPs exhibited a characteristic surface plasmon resonance peak at 270–300 nm and a mean particle size of 68 nm with a zeta potential of −11\.4 mV, indicating moderate colloidal stability\. Structural and chemical analyses \(FTIR and XRD\) confirmed the formation of monoclinic CuO and phytochemical\-mediated stabilization, while SEM revealed uniform nanoparticle distribution within nanofibers of 90–110 nm diameter\. The CuO\-loaded nanoscaffolds demonstrated significantly enhanced antimicrobial activity, with inhibition zones of 30 ± 0\.2 mm \( Escherichia coli \), 27 ± 0\.2 mm \( Klebsiella pneumoniae \), and 25 ± 0\.3 mm \( Staphylococcus aureus \), outperforming both algal extract and CuO NPs alone\. The improved efficacy is attributed to synergistic effects of nanoparticle incorporation and sustained release from the nanofibrous matrix\. This study presents a novel integration of T\. conoides \-mediated CuO nanoparticles into biodegradable starch/PVA electrospun scaffolds, offering a sustainable and effective platform for antimicrobial wound dressing applications\.

## [The Synthetic Imputation Approach: Using LLMs to Generate Synthetic Texts for Underrepresented Categories in Supervised Classification Tasks](../publications/087b537dc490465fb423.md)

Joan C\. Timoneda

Abstract Annotated text data are central to many empirical applications in political science, yet many annotation tasks involve categories that are sparsely populated\. These low\- N categories pose problems for both encoder\-only and decoder\-only \(generative\) Transformer large language models \(LLMs\), leading to low performance, biased evaluation and measurement error in downstream analyses\. This article introduces the synthetic imputation approach, a targeted method for expanding sparse categories while remaining consistent with the category\-defining content of the human\-coded examples\. The approach uses a generative LLM to produce additional texts for underrepresented categories by conditioning on small, rotating subsets of human\-coded examples\. Rather than paraphrasing or replacing the original data, synthetic imputation adds informative variation only where data are thin\. I evaluate the approach using both encoder\-only and decoder\-only LLM classifiers across multiple political science applications\. The results show that synthetic imputation substantially improves performance and evaluation stability in sparse settings, recovering full\-sample performance once a modest number of true observations is available, with limited and predictable overfitting at very low levels of N \.

Recent work by Hirata and colleagues identifies site\-specific O\-GlcNAc modification of the cargo\-selecting COPII subunit Sec24D as a dynamic regulatory switch that promotes collagen export from the endoplasmic reticulum \(ER\), providing new insight into how COPII accommodates cargoes far larger than canonical transport vesicles\. Two glycosites in the poorly characterized N\-terminal intrinsically disordered region \(IDR\) of Sec24D, T9 and S13, display strikingly different dynamics: S13 is constitutively glycosylated, whereas T9 is rapidly modified following a synchronized burst of collagen transport and returns to baseline within minutes\. Both sites are required for collagen I trafficking and rescue of Sec24D\-deficient bulldog zebrafish, while T9 is also required for efficient transport of the smaller cargo E\-cadherin, suggesting that a single intrinsically disordered region can encode cargo\-selective information\. Crosslinking proteomics further reveals distinct glycosylation\-dependent changes in the Sec24D interactome and identifies myoferlin \(MYOF\) as a partner proposed to promote fusion of ER exit sites \(ERES\) with ER\-Golgi intermediate compartment \(ERGIC\) membranes\. In this commentary, we discuss how these findings recast the COPII inner coat as a signal\-integrating platform, intersect with TANGO1\-dependent ERGIC recruitment and competing models of large collagen carriers, and raise key mechanistic questions concerning signal transmission across the ER membrane, glycan stoichiometry, and how the recruitment or tethering function proposed for MYOF is coupled to membrane fusion\.

## [A Fatigue Life Prediction Method Based on Optimized Data Augmentation Algorithm and Adaptive Sampling Model](../publications/08970a417c1aff193494.md)

Lingwen Jiang; Xueshu Liu

ABSTRACT Machine learning–based fatigue life prediction is essential; yet their datasets typically contain fewer than 50 samples, severely challenging predictive modeling\. This study proposes an integrated framework of simulated annealing \(SA\)‐guided data augmentation and residual‐driven adaptive sampling \(RAS\) bagging ensemble\. SA optimization identifies augmentation parameters that maximize RAS‐bagging performance, while RAS adaptively reweights bootstrap sampling toward high‐residual regions to enhance ensemble diversity\. Repeated nested cross‐validation \(tenfold, 30 repetitions with identical splits\) showed significant improvements over classical bagging on the CFRP \(\) and DH36 \(\) datasets \(Wilcoxon signed‐rank test, all ; large effect sizes, Cliff&\#x27;s \)\. Mean improved from to and from to , respectively, while mean MAE was reduced by 85\.8% and 64\.3%, and the standard deviation of decreased by more than an order of magnitude \(0\.57–0\.02 and 1\.48–0\.13\)\. In addition, the 80% conformal prediction intervals derived from the proposed model achieved an empirical coverage rate of 84%, providing conservative lower‐bound life estimates for reliability‐oriented decision‐making\. These results demonstrate that physically bounded data augmentation combined with adaptive ensemble resampling effectively alleviates data scarcity in fatigue life prediction within the studied datasets\. Validation on larger independent cohorts, field data, and online learning scenarios is warranted before the framework can be extended to automotive reliability assessment and structural health monitoring\.

## [Irrigation Water Productivity of Field Crops, Vegetables and Orchards in a Semiarid Region of Afghanistan](../publications/0898d4ec9c1c577a3630.md)

Zabihullah Karokhil; Mohammad Anwar Safai; Najibullah Totakhil; Habibullah Saleem

ABSTRACT Irrigation water productivity \(IWP\) was assessed for major field crops, vegetables and orchards under semiarid conditions in Khak‐e‐Jabbar District, Afghanistan\. Field measurements, farmer interviews and agricultural records provided 382 crop‐specific observations\. IWP differed significantly among crops \(Kruskal–Wallis, p &lt; 0\.001\)\. Tomato had the highest mean IWP \(3\.44 kg/m 3 \), followed by onion \(3\.23 kg/m 3 \) and plumcot \(2\.79 kg/m 3 \), whereas beans had the lowest value \(0\.49 kg/m 3 \)\. Vegetables showed the highest group‐level IWP, followed by orchards, cereals and legumes\. A comparison with FAO \(2017\) reference ranges indicated that tomato, potato, maize and apple remained below their respective benchmarks\. These differences show the need for crop‐specific irrigation management in semiarid areas\.

## [From Ancient Records to Agentic Intelligence: A Comprehensive Historical Review of Data Science and Its Role in Intelligent Internet of Things Analytics](../publications/089941b82534c54045e0.md)

Aamo Iorliam; Iveren Blessing Iorliam; Yahaya Isah Shehu

Since the era of the Mesopotamia between 2900 BCE \- 2350 BCE, the goals of “data science\-like” approaches have always revolved around collecting fragments of information and trying to make insights out of such information\. Data Science was not clearly termed as Data Science from the onset\. Moreover, there exists several questions about Data Science just been a polished name for Statistics\. Therefore, there is a need to look carefully at how Data Science has evolved over the years and where it is currently\. The study defines Data Science as a multidisciplinary field that integrates statistics, mathematics, computer science, domain expertise, and ethics\. This is important because, it will give Data Scientists and the Data Science enthusiasts a clear understanding of this discipline\. In addition, the paper demonstrates how Data Science transforms massive Internet of Things \(IoT\) data streams into actionable insights through predictive analytics, anomaly detection, explainable artificial intelligence, cybersecurity analytics, digital twins, and intelligent decision support\. The findings reveal that the evolution of Data Science reflects a transition from descriptive statistical analysis to autonomous, explainable, and trustworthy intelligent systems capable of supporting real\-time decision\-making across diverse domains\. This work provides a unified historical perspective, highlights emerging research directions, and offers a valuable reference for researchers, educators, and practitioners seeking to understand the past, present, and future direction of Data Science\.

## [Monitoring Global Scale Surface Water Quality and Quantity Using Remote Sensing Techniques](../publications/08a4f11a7f83a3d088b6.md)

Elisa Friedmann

Rivers are dynamic and heterogeneous systems that distribute water, energy, and nutrients across ecosystems\. Monitoring fluvial behavior, especially at large scales, remains challenging but increasingly feasible with advances in satellite remote sensing and greater access to computational resources\. In this dissertation, we develop scalable methods to quantify river sediment, discharge, and carbon fluxes using satellite data and machine learning\. Chapter 1 overcomes long\-standing tradeoffs between cloud cover, resolution, and overpass that limit remote sensing of total suspended solids \(TSS\) applications by developing and demonstrating the utility of a continental scale satellite spatiotemporal data fusion reflectance product in Google Earth Engine\. Chapter 2 advances the global Surface Water Ocean Topography \(SWOT\)\-derived discharge product by scaling discharge estimation workflows and harnessing the satellite orbit configurations to assess spatial and temporal hydrologic regime capture\. Chapter 3 applies machine learning techniques to predict shallow groundwater carbon dioxide concentrations, a key unexplored source of riverine carbon evasion, and estimates the groundwater contribution to surface water greenhouse gas evasion across the continental United States\.

## [COLLABORATION BETWEEN ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION TEACHERS AND MOSQUE MANAGEMENT IN FORMING THE RELIGIOUS CHARACTER OF ELEMENTARY SCHOOL STUDENTS AT AL\-AZHAR KELAPA GADING JAKARTA](../publications/08a59733d1d60d35c797.md)
