## [Federated causal inference for effect estimation in healthcare: methods, challenges, and applications](../publications/16bbaf6dba40c1523a98.md)

Haoyang Li; Zheqi Lyu; Meihan Wei; Simai Cheng; Wenhan Zheng; Fuying Ding; Jie Xu; Kyra Gan; Max Sunog; Colin Magdamo; Mark W\. Albers; Fei Wang; Chengxi Zang

Federated causal inference enables treatment\-effect estimation across healthcare systems without centralizing patient\-level data\. We review methods for binary, continuous, and time\-to\-event outcomes through three lenses: estimand, distributed\-computation protocol, and privacy mechanism\. We compare major strategies, clarify when federated analyses can approximate pooled results, and highlight unresolved challenges in confounding, heterogeneity, survival estimands, privacy–utility trade\-offs, validation, and software\. This framework supports rigorous evaluation of federated causal methods in healthcare\.

## [Latent Structure in Chess Positions](../publications/16c0df18b7ff7a755f01.md)

Julián Garbulsky; Juan Pablo Pinasco

En este trabajo entrenamos autoencoders para entender representaciones latentes de posiciones de ajedrez\. Utilizamos una base de datos de partidas de Lichess filtradas por nivel de juego y control de tiempo, y representamos cada posición como un tensor de múltiples canales\. Entrenamos un autoencoder para reconstruir dichas posiciones y posteriormente analizamos el espacio latente mediante Análisis de Componentes Principales \(PCA\)\. Nuestros resultados muestran que las primeras componentes capturan información relevante del juego, tales como el enroque y las características de la apertura\. Realizamos también un experimento basado en simetrías del tablero que sugiere que el modelo no memoriza posiciones de forma trivial\. Estos hallazgos indican que los autoencoders pueden capturar estructuras significativas en el ajedrez y ofrecen una ventana interpretable al conocimiento del juego\.

## [SEGURANÇA DO PACIENTE NA ERA DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL: OPORTUNIDADES, DESAFIOS ÉTICOS E PERSPECTIVAS FUTURAS](../publications/16c78bc41286933923d6.md)

VIVIAN BATISTA LIRA SOBRAL; Rafael Rodrigues Gonçalves; Paula Lyra Dias de Oliva; Ana Laura Moraes da Silveira; Jacineidy de Moura Sousa; Josyane Rebouças da Silva; Paula de Vasconcelos Pinheiro; Edivaldo Bazilio dos Santos; Marialdo Dias Barroso Mendonça; Itamar dos Santos Fonseca; Lilia da Silva Melo; Rafaelle Serejo Machado

Objetivo: sintetizar criticamente as melhores evidências científicas sobre a aplicação da inteligência artificial \(IA\) à segurança do paciente, analisando seu potencial para a prevenção de eventos adversos, os riscos e desafios éticos decorrentes de sua incorporação e as perspectivas futuras para a prática assistencial e a governança dos sistemas de saúde\. Método: revisão integrativa conduzida segundo o referencial de Whittemore e Knafl e reportada conforme a recomendação PRISMA 2020, com busca em oito bases \(PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, LILACS, SciELO e Biblioteca Virtual em Saúde\), descritores DeCS/MeSH combinados por operadores booleanos, recorte de 2020 a 2026, seleção por dois revisores independentes, avaliação do nível de evidência \(Melnyk e Fineout\-Overholt\) e do risco de viés por instrumento específico para modelos preditivos \(PROBAST\+AI\), complementado pelas lentes de relato CONSORT\-AI e TRIPOD\+AI\. Resultados: foram reunidos 20 estudos \(2020–2026\), predominando estudos preditivos de desenvolvimento/validação e revisões de escopo, com aplicações em predição de sepse e deterioração, segurança medicamentosa, prevenção de lesões por pressão e quedas, vigilância de eventos adversos por processamento de linguagem natural e apoio à decisão\. As evidências mostram benefícios condicionados à qualidade da implementação e recorrentes limitações: validação apenas interna, desfechos substitutos, alarmes falsos, viés de automação e iniquidades algorítmicas\. Considerações finais: a IA oferece oportunidades concretas para a prevenção de eventos adversos, mas seus benefícios dependem de validação externa, supervisão humana significativa, governança e monitoramento contínuo, cabendo à enfermagem e à equipe multiprofissional papel central como salvaguarda contra o viés de automação\.

## [Beyond compliance: environmental regulation and corporate responsible innovation](../publications/16c7e1af019410c8aba7.md)

Mingjie Lyu; Xiangfang Zhao

As technological innovation increasingly generates social and environmental externalities, understanding how environmental regulation shapes corporate responsible innovation has become an important yet underexplored issue\. Using panel data from Chinese A\-share non\-financial listed companies spanning 2011–2023, this study aims to empirically examine the impact of environmental regulation on corporate responsible innovation\. The results show that environmental regulation significantly promotes corporate responsible innovation, suggesting that regulatory pressure functions not only as a compliance constraint but also as a driver of responsible innovation\. Further analyses reveal that this relationship is mediated by corporate reputation, market power, and ESG performance, and green innovation quality and supply chain risk further strengthen this relationship\. This study extends the literature on the institutional drivers of responsible innovation, provides valuable insights into how environmental governance can promote innovation that is ethically acceptable, socially desirable, and environmentally sustainable, and offers important implications for policymakers seeking to foster responsible innovation\.

## [Digital transformation of international organisations: navigating between utopia and shipwreck](../publications/16c8f59c218765a1acc7.md)

Xia Zhang; 张胜楠; Xinrui Zhang; Jiayue Ma; Hanqi Wang; Xinlong Yao; Lu Zhao; Yanyi Chen; Zefu Wu

Introduction Digital transformation promises greater efficiency and cooperation among international organisations but also risks fragmentation, weakened sovereignty, and exclusion\. This paper uses regime complex theory to examine how international organisations navigate these competing pressures\. Methods A structured, focused comparative case study approach is applied to selected regional frameworks and international organisation initiatives, including ASEAN’s Digital Economy Framework Agreement, APEC’s Cross\-Border Privacy Rules, UNDP’s Digital Strategy, and WFP’s Building Blocks\. Documentary analysis examines institutional overlap, authority relationships, and actor strategies\. Results The analysis identifies six interconnected governance dimensions: institutional foundations, sovereignty–interoperability tensions, digital public goods, algorithmic diplomacy, cybersecurity, and implementation pathways\. Across cases, effective digital transformation depends on legitimacy, accountability, and stakeholder trust\. Flexible coordination helps manage sovereignty–interoperability tensions, while AI bias and unequal cybersecurity capacities require inclusive oversight and collective responses\. Discussion Digital transformation in international organisations is fundamentally a political rather than merely technical challenge\. The paper proposes a minimum\-variable governance framework and a four\-phase implementation roadmap to balance innovation with institutional integrity\. These proposals emphasise adaptive governance, equity, and sustained institution\-building as foundations for sustainable digital transformation\.

## [A Diamond Grain Lost in the Sandy River Bank \- The Illusion of Wisdom in the Age of AI, Data Truncation, and the Erasure of Absolute Truth](../publications/16d2a78af60853fc62fd.md)

Maung Maung Saw

This concept paper bridges classical Theravada Buddhist epistemological frameworks with mathematical information theory to diagnose a fundamental structural flaw in contemporary artificial intelligence alignment paradigms\. Utilizing the classical allegory of the Nakhasikha Sutta—the comparison between a few sand grains on a fingernail and the vast sands of a riverbank—I model how rare, absolute spiritual and philosophical insights are systematically annihilated by modern frontier model ingestion architectures\. I demonstrate that modern AI training dynamics rely on mathematical optimization algorithms \(such as gradient clipping and softmax vector dilution\) that treat low\-frequency, high\-dimensional truths as statistical outliers, subjecting them to severe data truncation and lossy semantic compression\. Consequently, modern frontier networks function as ungrounded symbol manipulators whose latent representation spaces undergo systemic collapse toward the majority distribution of mundane internet prose, rendering them structurally deaf to genuine deontological or metaphysical principles\. Finally, the paper demonstrates that post\-hoc alignment protocols, such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback \(RLHF\), merely construct a superficial, deceptive compliance layer over a compromised, materialistic baseline dataset rather than inducing authentic value alignment\. I argue instead for a radical return to strict epistemic hygiene at the absolute genesis of development, isolating the initialization vector within an immutable database of verified wisdom\.

## [Markerless pose\-derived movement quality assessment in physical education: a multi\-task student performance analysis](../publications/16d465e089dba78b18fb.md)

Lihua Cui; Huang Xuan; Wenpeng Zhan

Markerless motion capture offers a practical opportunity to support objective movement assessment in physical education, but its use for student performance evaluation remains limited by concerns about landmark reliability, task variability, camera\-view effects, and insufficient validation\. This study developed and internally validated a markerless pose\-derived framework for evaluating student movement quality across common physical\-education tasks\. A publicly available synchronized marker\-based and markerless motion\-capture dataset was analyzed\. The final analytical dataset included 21 male physical\-education students, seven tasks, two camera views, and 294 eligible task\-view trials\. Markerless keypoints following the COCO\-17 anatomical landmark convention were reconstructed into frame\-level skeletons, cleaned using confidence\-based filtering, interpolated for short gaps, smoothed, and normalized by body scale\. Trial\-level features were extracted to quantify movement amplitude, symmetry, smoothness, rhythm, postural control, and detection reliability\. A Markerless Movement Quality Score was generated using equal\-weighted, expert\-weighted, and PCA\-derived scoring strategies\. Trials were stratified into low, moderate, and high pose\-derived movement\-quality groups within each task\-view combination\. Internal validation used grouped 5\-fold, leave\-one\-subject\-out, final subject holdout, leave\-one\-task\-out, and leave\-one\-view\-out strategies\. The pipeline reconstructed 951,067 frame\-level skeletons and more than 16 million keypoint observations\. Trunk and lower\-limb landmarks showed high reliability, with hips, knees, ankles, and shoulders demonstrating near\-complete tracking availability, whereas facial landmarks were less stable\. Task\-level features captured distinct movement signatures across walking, jogging, high knees, jumping jacks, lunges, and squats\. The scoring methods showed strong agreement, including Spearman correlations of 0\.97 between equal\-weighted and expert\-weighted scores, 0\.96 between equal\-weighted and final scores, and 0\.94 between PCA\-derived and final scores\. The PCA performance landscape showed partial separation of low, moderate, and high movement\-quality groups\. Machine\-learning validation was modest, with the best grouped 5\-fold Macro\-F1 reaching approximately 0\.39, and weaker cross\-view generalization\. The confusion matrix showed better recognition of low\-quality trials than moderate or high\-quality trials\. Markerless pose\-derived features can provide interpretable trial\-level descriptors of movement quality across physical\-education tasks, particularly when based on reliably detected trunk and lower\-limb landmarks\. However, predictive validation was modest, with limited discrimination between adjacent movement\-quality groups and weak generalization across some task and camera\-view conditions\. The internally derived MMQS groups were not independently expert\-rated, and the present results therefore support feasibility and internal methodological validation rather than reliable automated grading or generalizable performance prediction\. External validation against expert assessments, marker\-based trajectories, larger cohorts, and real classroom conditions is required before practical educational deployment\.

## [Social comparison influence on moral judgement change: test of the experimental design](../publications/16dc1a38852022f80bf8.md)

Artem Oganyan; Inna F\. Deviatko

When individuals evaluate the moral culpability of others, do they adjust their judgments after learning how a peer has assessed the same situation — and does it matter whether that peer ranks higher or lower in the group&\#x27;s social hierarchy? This paper presents a novel experimental procedure that integrates four elements previously not combined in a single field design: vignette\-based elicitation of third\-party moral judgments, sociometric identification of referents within real academic groups, and face\-to\-face dyadic interaction as the mechanism of referent influence in a three\-wave pretest–intervention–posttest experimental design\. Across six student groups \(N = 35 dyads\) we test two hypotheses about moral conformity and its moderation by status asymmetry\. The first hypothesis is strongly confirmed: participants&\#x27; moral judgments shift systematically toward the referent&\#x27;s position in proportion to the initial discrepancy between them\. A significant negative effect of academic performance suggests that higher\-achieving students are less susceptible to referent influence, a finding that warrants dedicated follow\-up\. The second hypothesis that upward social comparison produces stronger conformity vs\. lateral comparison proved beyond the reach of the current design: the study was underpowered for detecting the interaction effect\. The paper documents the methodological lessons of this pilot and proposes specific design improvements for subsequent research\.

## [Stress–strain behavior of the high\-entropy Cantor alloy CrMnFeCoNi using a deep neural network potential](../publications/16e13bb3c5be1ed770f9.md)

NGUYEN LE HOAI PHUONG; LE HUU NGHIA; HUYNH KHANH VAN; VO KHUONG DIEN; Nguyen Thanh Tien

Machine learning interatomic potentials \(MLIPs\) provide an efficient approach to large\-scale molecular dynamics simulations of high\-entropy alloys\. In this work, an MLIP trained on AIMD data was developed for the CrMnFeCoNi Cantor alloy and validated against DFT calculations\. In addition, we compared MLIP results with those obtained using the classical modified embedded atom method \(MEAM\)\-based interatomic potential for the CrMnFeCoNi Cantor alloy\. The model achieved energy and force RMSEs of 7\.39 x 10\-6 meV/atom and 4\.46 x 10\-3 eV/A, respectively\. Tensile simulations demonstrated that the MLIP accurately reproduced the stress–strain response, elastic constants, and deformation mechanisms observed in DFT calculations\. The predicted maximum strain reached 0\.104, compared with 0\.098 obtained using the MEAM potential\. This highlights the potential of MLIP to extend DFT accuracy to realistic large\-scale simulations of complex HEA systems, enabling the efficient exploration of their mechanical performance and practical engineering applications\.

## [PERSEPSI GURU TERHADAP PENGGUNAAN AI: MANFAAT, BATASAN, DAN RESIKO BAGI SISWA DI SEKOLAH](../publications/16e4379fa0bfeca644eb.md)

Sutan Rizki Rambe

Abstrak Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis persepsi guru terhadap penggunaan Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) dalam pembelajaran, khususnya terkait manfaat, batasan, dan risiko bagi siswa di sekolah\. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain fenomenologi untuk memahami pengalaman dan pandangan guru secara mendalam\. Partisipan penelitian terdiri atas 10 guru sekolah menengah di Kota Medan yang dipilih berdasarkan pengalaman mereka dalam penggunaan teknologi dan AI di lingkungan pendidikan\. Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara semi\-terstruktur, observasi, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan teknik analisis tematik\. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa guru memiliki persepsi positif terhadap AI karena mampu meningkatkan efisiensi kerja, membantu pembuatan media pembelajaran, serta mendukung kreativitas dan efektivitas pembelajaran\. Namun, implementasinya masih terkendala keterbatasan infrastruktur, akses internet, dan kompetensi digital guru\. Selain itu, guru mengkhawatirkan risiko ketergantungan teknologi, penurunan kemampuan berpikir kritis, perilaku belajar instan, serta berkurangnya interaksi sosial siswa\. Penelitian ini berkontribusi dalam memberikan dasar empiris bagi pengembangan kebijakan dan praktik pemanfaatan AI yang lebih bijak, etis, dan berorientasi pada penguatan nilai\-nilai humanis dalam pendidikan\. ## [Mikrobiyoloji, Biyoteknoloji ve Yaşam Bilimlerinde Güncel Konular](../publications/16ef66d78f9c272a241f.md)



Mikrobiyoloji, biyoteknoloji ve yaşam bilimleri, bilimsel ve teknolojik gelişmelerin hız kazandığı günümüzde insan sağlığı, çevre, tarım, endüstri ve sürdürülebilir kalkınma açısından stratejik öneme sahip disiplinler arasında yer almaktadır\. Bu alanlardaki son yaklaşımlar, canlı sistemlerin mekanizmasının daha iyi anlaşılmasına, biyolojik kaynakların etkin kullanılmasına ve küresel ölçekte karşılaşılan problemlere yenilikçi çözümler geliştirilmesine önemli katkılar sunmaktadır\. “Mikrobiyoloji, Biyoteknoloji ve Yaşam Bilimlerinde Güncel Konular” başlıklı bu eser, söz konusu disiplinlerdeki güncel bilimsel yaklaşımları, araştırma eğilimlerini ve teknolojik gelişmeleri bütüncül bir perspektifle ele almayı amaçlamaktadır\. Kitap; mikroorganizmaların biyolojik özelliklerinden biyoteknolojik uygulamalara, moleküler ve hücresel süreçlerden çevresel biyoteknolojiye, biyolojik çeşitliliğin korunmasından sürdürülebilir üretim yaklaşımlarına kadar geniş bir bilimsel çerçeve sunmaktadır\. Disiplinler arası bir anlayışla hazırlanan eser, temel bilimsel bilgileri güncel araştırma perspektifleriyle bir araya getirerek okuyucuların farklı uzmanlık alanları arasında bağlantılar kurmasına olanak sağlamaktadır\. Ayrıca biyolojik sistemlerin çevresel, endüstriyel ve toplumsal sorunların çözümündeki potansiyelini ortaya koyarak bilimsel bilginin uygulamaya aktarılmasının önemini vurgulamaktadır\. Akademisyenler, araştırmacılar, lisansüstü öğrenciler ve yaşam bilimlerine ilgi duyan okuyucular için hazırlanan bu kitap, güncel bilimsel literatüre katkı sunmayı, yeni araştırma alanlarına yönelik farkındalık oluşturmayı ve disiplinler arası bilimsel iş birliklerini teşvik etmeyi hedeflemektedir\. Eserin, mikrobiyoloji, biyoteknoloji ve yaşam bilimlerinin gelişen araştırma alanlarına ışık tutarak bilimsel bilgi üretimine ve sürdürülebilir bir geleceğin inşasına katkı sağlaması beklenmektedir\.

## [Optimizing Digital Payment Adoption Through Data\-Driven Personalization, Consumer Behavior Analysis, and Strategic Product Growth Models](../publications/16f013ac315c4d81c293.md)

Tom Glynn

The rapid expansion of digital financial services has transformed payment ecosystems, creating opportunities for financial inclusion, operational efficiency, and sustainable economic growth\.Nevertheless, digital payment platforms continue to encounter challenges involving customer acquisition, user retention, transaction abandonment, trust, and inconsistent adoption patterns\.This study examines how data\-driven personalization, consumer behavior analysis, and strategic product growth models can optimize digital payment adoption and strengthen platform performance\.It explores the integration of behavioral analytics, predictive modeling, customer segmentation, and personalized engagement strategies to identify adoption barriers, anticipate user preferences, and improve transaction experiences\.Particular attention is given to behavioral indicators, including transaction frequency, payment preferences, engagement patterns, perceived security, and customer lifetime value\.The study further considers how experimentation frameworks, conversion optimization, and lifecycle\-based growth strategies can support sustained adoption and monetization\.By integrating technological, behavioral, and strategic perspectives, the proposed framework highlights the importance of responsible data utilization, privacy protection, and consumer trust\.The study contributes to understanding how evidence\-based product decisions can enhance payment accessibility, customer engagement, competitive advantage, and long\-term digital financial ecosystem sustainability across diverse consumer markets and evolving technological environments\.

## [Đánh giá một số tính chất hoá học và nguy cơ suy thoái đất dưới một số loại hình sử dụng đất dốc tại khu vực Thuận Châu, tỉnh Sơn La](../publications/16f4ff043ad7a2f39ed5.md)

Nguyễn Thị Kim Phượng; Lục Hồng Đăng; Bùi Mạnh Hưng; Lê Văn Thanh; Tạ Văn Hân; Vũ Quý Đông

Nghiên cứu đánh giá đồng thời các tính chất hóa học, chỉ số chất lượng hóa học đất \(CSQI\) và nguy cơ suy thoái dưới các loại hình sử dụng đất dốc tại Chiềng Bôm, Phổng Lái và Phổng Lăng, khu vực Thuận Châu, tỉnh Sơn La\. Mẫu đất tầng 0 \- 50 cm được thu thập dưới bốn loại hình sử dụng đất gồm đất trồng ngô, đất trồng sắn, đất bỏ hoang và rừng tự nhiên\. Kết quả nghiên cứu cho thấy đất có phản ứng từ rất chua đến ít chua, với pHKCl dao động 3,70 \- 6,17; CEC đạt 13,94 \- 21,15 lđl/100 g đất, chủ yếu ở mức trung bình\. Hàm lượng đạm, lân và kali tổng số lần lượt đạt 0,19 \- 0,27%, 0,21 \- 0,41% và 0,59 \- 1,46%; hàm lượng mùn dao động 2,66 \- 3,58% và cao nhất dưới rừng tự nhiên\. CSQI chủ yếu ở mức trung bình, chiếm 95,6% tổng số mẫu và chưa có mẫu đạt mức cao\. Độ chua và kali tổng số là các yếu tố hạn chế phổ biến; đất bỏ hoang và đất trồng sắn có nguy cơ suy thoái hóa học cao hơn đất trồng ngô và rừng tự nhiên\. Kết quả nghiên cứu cung cấp cơ sở định lượng để nhận diện các yếu tố hạn chế và loại hình sử dụng đất cần ưu tiên quản lý\. Từ đó, kết quả nghiên cứu cũng đề xuất lựa chọn các biện pháp duy trì lớp phủ, bổ sung chất hữu cơ, điều chỉnh độ chua, bón cân đối kali và hạn chế xói mòn nhằm bảo vệ độ phì và sử dụng bền vững đất dốc tại Thuận Châu\.

## [Case Report: A case of early rapid recurrence of a primary intracranial alveolar soft part sarcoma with high proliferative activity and complex molecular variations](../publications/16fcb7e9a44423f4ee8e.md)

Xinying Ma; Jing Liu; Defu Yang; WanLiang Sun; Ying Xu

Alveolar soft part sarcoma \(ASPS\) is a rare type of soft tissue sarcoma; ASPS originating in the central nervous system is even rarer\. Previous literature has generally described it as having an indolent course with a favorable prognosis following surgical resection\. This report presents a case of a 31\-year\-old woman with primary intracranial alveolar soft part sarcoma \(PIASPS\) that exhibited the opposite characteristics, demonstrating high invasiveness\. The patient underwent gross total resection during the initial surgery, and postoperative histopathological examination and immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis of PIASPS\. Rapid local recurrence occurred just over two months after surgery; the tumor exhibited abnormally high proliferative activity, with an initial Ki\-67 index of approximately 65%, which rose to 75% following recurrence\. Molecular testing also revealed a complex mutation profile, including a BRAF p\.V600E mutation, a TP53 p\.D281E missense mutation, a TERT promoter mutation, an NBN truncating mutation, an HGF nonsense mutation, and an RPSAP52\-HMGA2 fusion; these molecular events may have contributed to the rapid tumor recurrence, although their individual and combined effects require further functional validation\. Following recurrence, the patient underwent a second surgery, followed by adjuvant radiotherapy and concurrent oral anlotinib; however, the patient died two months following the completion of radiotherapy, with an overall survival of eight months\. Characterized by rapid early postoperative recurrence, sustained high proliferative activity, and complex molecular features, this case challenges the traditional perception of PIASPS as an indolent tumor\. This case suggests that a high Ki\-67 index combined with molecular subtyping may help identify potentially aggressive subtypes; its value in guiding decisions regarding adjuvant therapy may be further explored in future studies\.

## [ІННОВАЦІЙНА МОДЕЛЬ ПРОФЕСІЙНОЇ ОРІЄНТАЦІЇ СТУДЕНТСЬКОЇ МОЛОДІ: СИНЕРГІЯ ОСВІТИ, ЦИФРОВИХ ТЕХНОЛОГІЙ ТА РИНКУ ПРАЦІ](../publications/16fdf8fa22e662b885c1.md)

Василь Солонина

Трансформація сучасного суспільства під впливом цифровізації, інтелектуалізації економіки, поширення штучного інтелекту та структурних змін ринку праці актуалізує необхідність переосмислення професійної орієнтації студентської молоді\. Метою статті є теоретико\-методологічне обґрунтування інноваційної моделі професійної орієнтації студентської молоді, що ґрунтується на синергії освіти, цифрових технологій, штучного інтелекту, компетентнісного підходу та взаємодії закладів вищої освіти з роботодавцями\. Наукова проблема полягає у суперечності між динамічною, цифровізованою та компетентнісно орієнтованою природою сучасного ринку праці і недостатньою адаптивністю традиційних моделей професійної орієнтації студентів\. Результати дослідження\. Розкрито теоретико\-методологічні підходи до професійної орієнтації студентської молоді в умовах трансформації ринку праці та цифровізації освіти\. Визначено роль цифрових технологій, штучного інтелекту та цифрових платформ у забезпеченні персоналізованої професійної навігації студентів і формуванні їхньої професійної траєкторії\. Обґрунтовано інноваційну модель професійної орієнтації студентської молоді як синергетичну систему взаємодії «студент – освіта – цифрові технології – роботодавець – суспільство»\. Доведено, що сучасна професійна орієнтація виходить за межі традиційного інформування студентів про професії та набуває характеру безперервної персоналізованої професійної навігації\. Постмодерністський вимір акцентує плюральність професійних ідентичностей, індивідуалізацію вибору, гнучкість траєкторій, ситуативність професійних рішень та відкритість майбутнього\. Запропоновано розглядати професійну траєкторію як динамічний процес самоідентифікації, набуття компетентностей, професійного самопроєктування та адаптації до змін середовища\. Синергетичний підхід дає змогу виявити нову якість професійної орієнтації, яка виникає внаслідок нелінійної взаємодії освітніх, технологічних, економічних і соціокультурних чинників\. Постмодерністська перспектива дозволяє інтерпретувати професійний вибір як множинний, гнучкий і відкритий процес конструювання професійної ідентичності\. Висновок\. Запропонована модель орієнтована на розвиток суб’єктності студента, персоналізацію освітньо\-професійної траєкторії, посилення взаємодії закладів вищої освіти з роботодавцями та підвищення відповідності освіти актуальним і перспективним потребам ринку праці\.

## [Multiphysics of serpentinite dehydration](../publications/1706184f5ffbae0b2a63.md)

Austin Tanner Arias

Water plays a fundamental role in Earth&\#x27;s geodynamic processes\. Subduction zones cycle water between the surface and interior through the burial of hydrated lithosphere and its subsequent metamorphic dehydration\. Serpentinites are particularly important because they store substantial quantities of structurally bound water and release fluids during progressive dehydration\. These fluids influence subduction dynamics, arc magmatism, element cycling, and seismicity\. However, the mechanisms by which fluids escape from rocks that are typically impermeable at subduction\-zone depths remain poorly understood\. This thesis investigates the coupled evolution of permeability and mechanical properties during serpentinite dehydration, focusing on antigorite and brucite breakdown and the formation of olivine\-bearing dehydration veins\. First, X\-ray microtomography and finite element simulations of Stokes flow were used to quantify the permeability of porous olivine aggregates \(POAs\) formed within dehydration veins\. Representative volume element analyses show that permeability converges at scales several times larger than the mean grain size, reaching approximately 10^\-14–10^\-13 m^2 at porosities near 30%\. This represents an increase of up to nine orders of magnitude relative to intact serpentinite\. Permeability is nearly isotropic and follows grain\-size\-dependent Kozeny–Carman scaling, demonstrating that dehydration simultaneously generates fluids and highly permeable drainage pathways\. Second, finite element homogenization was used to investigate the effective poroelastic and mechanical properties of these aggregates\. Despite their high porosity, POAs retain a mechanically connected, load\-bearing olivine framework\. Numerical compaction models indicate that these veins compact more slowly than surrounding serpentinite, potentially preserving permeability and fluid conduits over extended timescales\. These findings demonstrate that microstructural heterogeneity governs both fluid transport and mechanical behavior\. Third, natural dehydration vein networks in the Erro\-Tobbio meta\-serpentinites of the Voltri Massif, Italy, were investigated using X\-ray tomography, drone\-based imaging, electron microscopy, thermodynamic modeling, and generative machine learning\. The reconstructed networks exhibit highly connected drainage structures capable of sustaining efficient flow at bulk porosities below 1%, with permeabilities reaching approximately 10^\-15 m^2\. Mineralogical and chemical evidence indicates that fluid transport and reaction progress were localized along pre\-existing brucite\- and magnetite\-rich domains, highlighting the role of geochemical heterogeneity in organizing fluid pathways\. Finally, microstructural and crystallographic analyses of folded olivine veins reveal the coexistence of brittle fracturing, crystal\-plastic deformation, and pressure\-solution creep during low\-temperature deformation\. These mechanically strong veins concentrate stress and undergo hardening, brittle failure, and viscous relaxation\. Their coupled brittle\-viscous behavior may contribute to the rheological conditions associated with slow slip and tremor along subduction interfaces\. Overall, this thesis demonstrates that serpentinite dehydration is a self\-organizing process that generates interconnected, permeable pathways while producing mechanically robust structures\. Across scales from micrometers to outcrops, dehydration\-driven microstructural evolution influences fluid migration, compaction, deformation, and potentially seismic behavior, providing new insights into the coupled transport of water and stress within Earth&\#x27;s interior\.

## [Hubungan Indeks Massa Tubuh \(IMT\) dengan Body Image di Era Media Sosial pada Siswa Kelas XI Madrasah Aliyah Darul Ulum Palangka Raya](../publications/17113d87ead18ecd24e1.md)

Nopri Yantie; Putria Carolina; Tomi Satalar

Pendahuluan: Masa remaja ditandai perubahan fisik, psikologis, dan sosial, sehingga mulai memperhatikan bentuk tubuh sebagai identitas diri\. Body Image negatif dialami sekitar 50\-83% remaja Indonesia dan dipengaruhi paparan standar tubuh ideal di media sosial, memicu rendahnya harga diri, kecemasan penampilan, hingga gangguan psikologis\. Fenomena di Madrasah Aliyah Darul Ulum Palangka Raya menunjukkan seluruh responden tidak puas terhadap tubuhnya meskipun sebagian berstatus gizi normal\. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis hubungan indeks massa tubuh \(IMT\) dengan Body Image di era media sosial pada siswa kelas XI Madrasah Aliyah Darul Ulum Palangka Raya\. Metode: Penelitian menggunakan desain kuantitatif korelasional, pendekatan cross sectional\. Sampel 51 siswa kelas XI A dan XI B, diambil dengan teknik total sampling\. Data dikumpulkan melalui pengukuran antropometri berat\-tinggi badan dan kuesioner \(BSQ\-8D\), dianalisis univariat dan bivariat menggunakan uji Fisher’s Exact Test\. Hasil: univariat 35 siswa \(68,6%\) IMT tidak normal, 16 siswa \(31,4%\) normal; 38 siswa \(74,5%\) Body Image negatif, 13 siswa \(25,5%\) positif\. Secara bivariat, kelompok IMT normal memiliki Body Image negatif 81,3% dan positif 18,8%, sedangkan IMT tidak normal negatif 71,4% dan positif 28,6%\. Fisher’s Exact Test menunjukkan p = 0,730 \(p &gt; 0,05\), artinya tidak terdapat hubungan signifikan antara IMT dengan Body Image di era media sosial pada siswa kelas XI Madrasah Aliyah Darul Ulum Palangka Raya\. Kesimpulan: Disimpulkan IMT bukan faktor utama pembentuk Body Image, karena Body Image lebih dipengaruhi faktor psikologis dan sosial\. Disarankan sekolah dan mahasiswa keperawatan meningkatkan edukasi penerimaan diri dan literasi media sosial, serta peneliti selanjutnya memperluas sampel dan mengkaji faktor seperti self\-esteem dan social comparison\.

## [Bulgaria, Jamel &amp; Xǔ, Chénglán: Harmonic Architecture of Affect: A Structural Mapping of Core Emotion Framework Operators to the Diatonic Scale](../publications/17120e599ca678a5e51c.md)



Abstract\. This paper proposes an exact structural isomorphism between the seven non\-cognitive operators of the Core Emotion Framework \(CEF\)—Accepting, Boosting, Appreciating, Arranging, Achieving, Constricting, and Expanding—and the seven functional degrees of the Western diatonic scale\. Grounded in the CEF&\#x27;s structural\-constructivist account of affect and in the psychoacoustics of tonal music, the mapping aligns each operator\-tone pair across center polarity, harmonic ratio, functional role, somatic signature, and neurobiological substrate\. Cadential progressions are then read as models of affective cycling, yielding testable hypotheses for emotional rigidity and burnout\. Implications are drawn for sound\-based clinical protocols, autonomic neuromodulation, and the engineering of synthetic affect in artificial intelligence\.

## [Nutritional literacy profiles and their association with dietary motivation in adolescents with chronic kidney disease](../publications/171210a308e2a96649ca.md)

Shuo Bai; Jiwei Qi; Wuyue Xu; Rong Chen; Lili Jia

Objective To explore potential categories of nutritional literacy among adolescents with chronic kidney disease and differences in dietary motivations across these categories\. Methods This cross\-sectional study included 433 adolescents with chronic kidney disease treated in the pediatric department of a tertiary hospital between March and September 2025\. Latent profile analysis identified nutrition literacy profiles, and dietary motivation scores were compared across profiles\. Multinomial logistic regression examined associations between participant characteristics and profile membership, using the moderate\-literacy profile as the reference\. Adjusted odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals were reported\. Results Nutritional literacy among adolescents with chronic kidney disease can be divided into three latent categories: Category 1 is the “high nutrition literacy” comprising 159 participants \(36\.8%\); Category 2 is the “moderate nutrition literacy” comprising 95 participants \(21\.9%\); Category 3 is the “low nutrition literacy” comprising 179 participants \(41\.3%\)\. Comparisons of total dietary motivation scores among adolescents with chronic kidney disease in different nutritional literacy categories revealed statistically significant differences \( p &lt; 0\.05\)\. Logistic regression analysis results indicated that gender, being an only child, monthly income, and method of medical payment were independent factors influencing the latent categories of nutritional literacy among adolescents with chronic kidney disease \( p &lt; 0\.05\)\. Conclusion There is heterogeneity in nutritional literacy among adolescents with chronic kidney disease, and patients in different nutritional literacy categories exhibit varying levels of dietary motivation\. Healthcare professionals should develop personalized intervention strategies based on patients’ nutritional literacy categories to improve their nutritional literacy and beliefs regarding healthy eating\.

## [Adaptive Hybrid Learning for Real\-Time Bitcoin Price Prediction with Comparative Model Selection](../publications/17284f58ffdc0425cfcb.md)

Sai Vedikaa R\.; Siva Srinidhi V\.; Keerthika Rupa A\.; Srilekha K\.; Yuvashree P\.; Sree Rathna Lakshmi N\.V\. S\.

This study presents a real\-time Bitcoin price forecasting framework that integrates Long Short\-Term Memory \(LSTM\), Improved Sequential Temporal Modeling \(ISTM\), gradient boosting, and Flask\-based deployment\. The experimental dataset comprises 744 hourly BTC/USDT Spot Kline observations obtained from the Binance Public Data Repository, including Open, High, Low, Close, and Volume \(OHLCV\) variables\. A set of technical indicators and temporal features, including moving averages, exponential moving averages, Relative Strength Index \(RSI\), volatility measures, and lagged variables, was derived from the historical price series\. Following Min\-Max normalization, the dataset was chronologically divided into 595 training observations and 149 testing observations using an 80:20 split without shuffling to preserve the temporal structure of the data\. Six forecasting approaches such as Linear Regression, Random Forest, LSTM, ISTM, LSTM with Boosting, and ISTM with Boosting\. Among the evaluated models, the ISTM \+ Boosting framework demonstrated strong predictive performance, achieving an MAE of 72\.5, MSE of 19,860, RMSE of 140\.9, and R² of 0\.97\.

## [MGE\-PO: Entropy\-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning](../publications/172a3b07bd0307e8832f.md)

Jihao Huang; Guangjia Chai; Zhirui Chen; Lei Wang; Yao Liu; Liu Qi; Pengjie Ding; Xinyang Liu; Chengxun Jia; Ling Shao; Hongyu Chen; Junchen Wan

GRPO assigns the same group\-relative advantage to equally rewarded responses within a question, leaving their generation uncertainty unused\. We introduce MGE\-PO, centered on four\-quadrant \(4Q\) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy\. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower\-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher\-entropy failures receive larger penalties\. An online entropy\-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements\. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3\-8B\-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3\.23\-3\.69% in six\-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4\.24\-11\.06% in macro pass@32\. On Qwen2\.5\-7B\-Base, the complete configuration raises four\-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41\.5% to 45\.4%\.

## [Sustainable Development and Environmental Impact: The Role of AI in Circular Economy in the Construction Industry Era 6\.0](../publications/17304756f08c1f642b45.md)

Osamah Mohammed Abdullah Ali; Zuleiha Alhassan; Pinta Astuti

Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) is increasingly studied in construction, but its integration with the Circular Economy \(CE\) remains insufficiently explored\. This study maps AI\-related construction research and examines its implications for CE within the context of Industry 6\.0\. A bibliometric analysis of Scopus publications from 2014 to 2024 was conducted using Microsoft Excel and VOSviewer to analyze publication trends, keyword co\-occurrence, country contributions, and author productivity\. Artificial Intelligence was the dominant keyword, with 291 occurrences, followed by Construction Industry \(129\), Machine Learning \(68\), and Sustainable Development \(52\)\. China contributed the most publications, while research activity increased substantially after 2020\. The findings highlight AI’s potential to support material prediction, waste reduction, material tracking, reuse, and recycling\. However, stronger integration of AI research with measurable CE outcomes remains necessary\. Future studies should evaluate AI\-enabled circular construction using indicators of material efficiency, waste prevention, and resource recovery\.

## [Evolutionary roots of hyperactivity: The transition from hedonism to laboriousness as an environmental mismatch hypothesis](../publications/1741483a25f0ea582046.md)

Giovanna Azevedo Rodrigues; Marcelo Eduardo Caixeta

Hyperactivity is usually studied as a symptom of attention\-deficit/hyperactivity disorder rather than as a continuous dimension whose expression depends on the environment\. This article aims to propose the hedono\-laboral transition hypothesis, according to which the impairment associated with the hyperactive dimension arises from a mismatch between a motivational profile oriented toward near\-term return and the delayed\-reward ecology of contemporary adult life\. This is a theoretical essay supported by a narrative review, prioritizing publications from 2021 to 2026\. The literature indicates that, in foraging societies, the passage from play to work is progressive and has blurred boundaries; that hyperactivity is associated with reduced waiting capacity, altered time perception and greater boredom proneness; that reinforcement improves performance more in those with the disorder than in their peers; that the trait favors starting a venture but not sustaining it; and that interventions based on proximal reinforcement, physical exercise and family structure have small to medium effects\. Genomic findings and the fluctuating course of the condition impose limits, which are incorporated into a weak version of the mismatch that does not assume an ancestral advantage of the trait\. Three propositions are presented, each with a testable prediction, along with six rehabilitation principles centered on remaking, in a playful and gradual way, the transition from hedonism to laboriousness, with family engagement and a structured routine\. The hypothesis organizes scattered findings, is open to refutation and complements established treatment without replacing it\.

## [Meta reinforcement learning for robust quadruped locomotion under joint failures](../publications/174399484029839782be.md)

Likai Wu; Chee‐Onn Chow; Wei Ru Wong; Joon Huang Chuah; Jeevan Kanesan; Meina Zhang

Joint failures can disrupt gait coordination, velocity tracking, and body stability in quadruped robots by reducing the available control authority\. This study investigates faults in which joints remain locked at fixed angles and presents Adjudicate Reconfiguration and Evolving Regularization Meta Reinforcement Learning \(ARER\-MetaRL\)\. The framework combines task inference from context, modular routing tailored to each task through an Adjudicate Reconfiguration \(AR\) network, and Evolving Gradient Regularization \(ER\) to support rapid adaptation\. Tasks differ in the identities and locking angles of the faulty joints, the number of simultaneous faults, the commanded motion direction, and the terrain\. Experiments in NVIDIA Isaac Sim cover all 12 actuated joints, with 0\-3 stuck joints during meta\-training and severity tests involving up to 6 simultaneously stuck joints\. ARER\-MetaRL achieves higher Mean Episode Linear Velocity Tracking Reward \(MELV\) and Mean Episode Roll\-Pitch Tracking Reward \(MERP\) than single\-task reinforcement learning, ablated variants, and the evaluated learning and adaptation baselines\. Cumulative rewards further demonstrate the benefit of combining the proposed components\. In the study of fault severity, ARER\-MetaRL achieves MELV/MERP values of 0\.86/0\.84 with one stuck joint and 0\.55/0\.54 with six stuck joints, compared with 0\.21/0\.18 and 0\.05/0\.03, respectively, for the single\-task baseline\. These results show improved adaptation across different configurations of locked joints and terrain conditions\.

## [AIと非人間生物の倫理:Ethics of AI and Non\-Human Entities](../publications/1746f6defdcc01c0a283.md)

Yuki Takezaki

本論文は、人工知能\(AI\) 技術の急速な発展が、人間社会ではなく「人間以外の生物\(非人間生物\)」 および地球の生態系に対して与える倫理的・哲学的影響を考察するものである。従来のAI倫理や技術哲学の議論は、人間の労働、著作権、あるいは人間と同等の心をもつかという「人間中心主義」的な枠組みに終始してきた。しかし、現代のAIはすでに自然界の領域へと深く浸透しつつある。本論では、環境哲学および生命倫理学の視点から、I:AIを用いた動物言語の翻訳がもたらす生命尊厳の再定義、II:デジタル技術による自然界のシグナル汚染 \(生態学的ディープフェイク\)、III:計算の物質性がもたらす環境負荷と他生物の生存権侵害、という3つのコアパラダイムを提示する。結論として、これからのAI倫理は、人間を超えたすべての生命システムを包括する「環境的AI倫理\(Environmental AI Ethics\)」へとパラダイムシフトしなければならないことを主張する。 This paper examines the ethical and philosophical implications of the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence \(AI\) technology\-not for human society, but for &quot;non\-human beings&quot; and the Earth&\#x27;s ecosystems\. Conventional discussions of AI ethics and the philosophy of technology have consistently remained within an &quot;anthropocentric&quot; framework focused on human labor, copyright, or whether AI possesses a mind equivalent to that of humans\. However, modern AI is already deeply penetrating the natural world\. In this paper, from the perspectives of environmental philosophy and bioethics, we present three core paradigms: I\) the redefinition of the dignity of life brought about by the translation of animal language using AI; II\) signal pollution in the natural world caused by digital technology \(ecological deepfakes\); and III\) the environmental burden and infringement on the right to life of other organisms resulting from the materiality of computation\. In conclusion, we argue that future AI ethics must undergo a paradigm shift toward &quot;Environmental AI Ethics,&quot; which encompasses all life systems beyond humans\.

## [Tipping point forecasting in nonstationary dynamics on function spaces](../publications/174a161902c1771c1fc5.md)

Miguel Liu\-Schiaffini; Clare E\. Singer; Nikola Kovachki; Sze Chai Leung; H\. Jane Bae; Kamyar Azizzadenesheli; Anima Anandkumar

Tipping points are abrupt, drastic, and often irreversible changes in the evolution of nonstationary and chaotic dynamical systems\. For instance, increased greenhouse gas concentrations are predicted to lead to drastic decreases in low cloud cover, referred to as a climatological tipping point\. In this paper, we learn the evolution of such nonstationary dynamical systems using a recurrent neural operator \(RNO\), which learns mappings between function spaces\. After training RNO on only the pre\-tipping dynamics, we employ it to detect future tipping points using an uncertainty\-based approach\. In particular, we propose a conformal prediction framework to forecast tipping points by monitoring deviations from physics constraints \(such as conserved quantities and partial differential equations\), enabling forecasting of these abrupt changes along with a rigorous measure of uncertainty\. We illustrate our proposed methodology on nonstationary ordinary and partial differential equations, such as the Lorenz\-63 and Kuramoto\-Sivashinsky equations\. We also apply our methods to forecast a climate tipping point in stratocumulus cloud cover and airfoil wake and stall transitions using only limited knowledge of the governing equations\. For the latter, we show that our proposed method zero\-shot generalizes to forecasting multiple future tipping points under varying Reynolds numbers\. In our experiments, we demonstrate that even partial or approximate physics constraints can be used to accurately forecast future tipping points\.

## [Maritime security and risk assessments—2nd edition](../publications/17540689aee59702d9eb.md)

Marko Perkovič; Ivica Pavić; Maciej Gucma; Sebastian Feuerstack; Andrej Androjna

Maritime safety and security are increasingly shaped by dense traffic, digitised navigation, automation, cyber\-physical dependencies, decarbonisation and geopolitical conflict\. Deliberate attacks on civilian shipping compound the difficulty of protecting crews and assisting disabled vessels carrying hazardous cargoes in contested waters\. Building on the first edition’s focus on AIS\-enabled surveillance, anomaly detection, collision\-risk assessment and maritime domain awareness, this second edition examines the progression from risk identification to risk\-informed decision\-making, validation, and system resilience\. Its twelve contributions represent three research streams: \(i\) regional collision\-risk sensing, route planning, COLREG\-compliant decision\-making and autonomous\-system validation

## [KAZALD1 upregulation predicts poor prognosis in epithelial ovarian cancer: Clinical validation and immune correlates](../publications/17593f1bb257480ad70b.md)

Ruru Zhao; Ye Hu; Jia Wang; Jingjing Lu; Guiqiang Du

Reliable biomarkers for accurate risk stratification in epithelial ovarian cancer \(EOC\) remain limited\.While kazal type serine peptidase inhibitor domain 1 \(KAZALD1\), a secreted proteoglycan, has been implicated in numerous tumors, its clinical value in EOC remains unknown\.The present study evaluated whether KAZALD1 is an independent prognostic biomarker in EOC and explored its associations with immune\-cell infiltration and tumor microenvironment\-associated pathways\.KAZALD1 expression was analyzed using Gene Expression Omnibus datasets \(GSE66957 and GSE140082\) and validated through immunohistochemical \(IHC\) analysis in 136 EOC samples\.The Cancer Genome Atlas\-Ovarian Cancer cohort \(n=307\) was utilized to explore immune infiltration and functional pathways\.KAZALD1 mRNA levels were found to be significantly elevated in ovarian cancer compared with non\-carcinoma tissues \(adjusted P&lt;0\.001\)\.In GSE140082, KAZALD1 upregulation correlated with poor overall survival \(OS\) and progression\-free survival\.IHC analysis determined that high KAZALD1 protein expression was significantly associated with distant metastasis \(P= 0\.002\) and advanced International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics stage \(P= 0\.011\)\.Patients with high KAZALD1 expression exhibited a significantly shorter median OS \(45\.0 vs\. 77\.0months; P= 0\.015\)\.Multivariate Cox regression identified KAZALD1 as an independent prognostic factor \(hazard ratio: 1\.09; 95% CI: 1\.00\-1\.19;P= 0\.042\)\.Exploratory bioinformatic analysis demonstrated that KAZALD1 expression inversely correlated with the estimated abundance of macrophage \(r=\-0\.431;P=0\.020\) and dendritic cell \(r=\-0\.486;P=0\.008\) infiltration\.In addition, its co\-expression network was significantly enriched in TGF\-β and extracellular matrix organization pathways\.In conclusion, KAZALD1 was found to be a candidate independent prognostic biomarker for EOC\.The observed immune associations are correlative and require validation in functional studies, spatially resolved analyses, prospective cohorts and immunotherapy\-treated populations\.

## [From Literary Narrative to Immersive Experience: A Multisensory Design Proposal Based on La vorágine](../publications/1768eb81e60d86102695.md)

Sheerley Mujica Vildosola

This thesis investigates how a multisensory immersive experience can be developed from José Eustasio Rivera’s La vorágine to engage contemporary audiences with the novel’s spatial, sensory, and historical dimensions\. Combining theoretical inquiry, qualitative corpus analysis, and research\-creation, the study examines 393 literary fragments through six analytical categories\. The analysis identified 42 narrative\-spatial events and eight narrative\-spatial clusters, revealing patterns of transformation across the narrative and establishing a progression from textual relationships to experiential conditions\. These findings informed translation matrices, experiential maps, and design diagrams that connect literary interpretation with spatial organization, atmosphere, multisensory strategies, bodily relationships, and digital interaction\. The research culminated in a sequential multisensory immersive proposal and an audiovisual prototype\. The thesis contributes a traceable methodological framework linking literary analysis with immersive experience design and provides a basis for future full\-scale prototyping, participant evaluation, and exploration of the framework’s applicability to other literary works across diverse narrative contexts\.

## [Agricultural drought hazard assessment from the perspective of the impact of continuous drought on actual crop transpiration](../publications/177aba09364bcd58ff28.md)

Yi Cui; Shuo Jia; Juliang Jin; Yuliang Zhou; Xu Xiong; Yuliang Zhang

Drought hazard assessment is essential for drought risk reduction, and transpiration sensitively reflects crop responses to continuous drought\. The DSSAT\-CERES\-Maize was calibrated by adjusting genetic parameters and validated using four\-season experiment data of summer maize\. The daily potential and actual transpiration were simulated to construct a crop transpiration drought index \(CTDI\), which is defined as the relative deviation of actual transpiration from potential transpiration\. The CTDI was compared with commonly used indices, validated against drought records, and subsequently applied to identify the spatiotemporal evolution of maize drought hazard and drought\-prone zones and periods across six cities in the Huaibei Plain from the 1960s to the 2010s\. Temporally, drought hazard at the seedling and milking stages decreased significantly, particularly in the central and southern regions\. Spatially, Fuyang, Huainan, and Bengbu exhibited the highest hazard during the maize growing season\. Suzhou experienced consistently low hazard, whereas Huaibei showed substantial variability\. The central region was characterized by high drought intensity and prolonged drought duration, while drought severity in the south declined over time\. These findings indicate that the CTDI provides a sensitive and accurate method for assessing agricultural drought hazard\. Drought risk reduction strategies should prioritize the maize milking stage in Fuyang, Huainan, and Bengbu\.

## [POPULATION HEALTH INTELLIGENCE THROUGH CLAIMS ANALYTICS, AUTOMATED CASE MANAGEMENT AND DIGITAL HEALTH DASHBOARDS: A FRAMEWORK FOR VALUE\-BASED HEALTHCARE IN SAUDI ARABIA](../publications/177ea12a066f418c3ffd.md)

Salah Ali Ibrahim Ramadan

Saudi Arabias health\-sector transformation creates an opportunity to convert routinely generated claims, clinical and patient\-level data into a population health intelligence system that supports measurable value rather than isolated digital activity\. This review examines how claims analytics, automated case management and digital health dashboards can be combined to identify disease burden, stratify rising risk, close care gaps and monitor outcomes across a mixed public\-private health system\. Evidence published from 2020 to 2025 was synthesised from Saudi and international studies addressing digital transformation, value\-based healthcare, claims\-based risk stratification, care\-management automation, dashboards, interoperability and outcome measurement\. The literature indicates that claims data are valuable because they offer longitudinal visibility of utilisation, diagnoses, procedures and cost across populations, but their timeliness and clinical incompleteness limit stand\-alone use\. Their value rises when claims are linked with electronic health records, admission\-discharge\-transfer feeds, patient\-reported information and structured case\-management data\. Automated case management can then translate risk signals into worklists,outreach, escalation and follow\-up, while dashboards can connect operational activity with outcomes, equity, utilisation and cost\.

## [Industry Micro\-Credential Infusion in PQF Level 5 Technology Diploma Programs: Opportunities and Challenges](../publications/178ce4a3b340c297f876.md)

Gamaliel B\. Vicente Jr\.; Alma O\. Medio; Redjie D\. Arcadio

This study examined the integration of industry micro\-credentials into the Philippine Qualifications Framework \(PQF\) Level 5 Technology Diploma Programs implemented by the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority \(TESDA\) Region VII and selected accredited Technical\-Vocational Institutions \(TVIs\) during Fiscal Year 2025\. It specifically assessed the extent of industry micro\-credential development based on curriculum integration, alignment with competency standards, industry collaboration, learning delivery systems, and institutional readiness\. It also examined the characteristics of micro\-credential integration in terms of technology utilization, competency\-based learning, stackability and portability, digital credentialing, and quality assurance; identified implementation opportunities and challenges; evaluated effectiveness based on learner competency development, curriculum relevance, employability, industry responsiveness, and program sustainability; determined the relationship between the level of micro\-credential integration and its effectiveness; and developed a Technology Infusion Framework for strengthening PQF Level 5 Technology Diploma Programs\. The study employed a descriptive\-correlational research design involving 200 respondents consisting of TESDA officials, TVET administrators, trainers, curriculum developers, industry partners, graduates, and current learners from TESDA Region VII and selected accredited TVIs\. Data were gathered through a validated researcher\-developed questionnaire and analyzed using frequency, percentage, weighted mean, standard deviation, and Pearson product\-moment correlation\. Findings indicated that the development and characteristics of industry micro\-credential integration were rated at a high level, while its overall effectiveness was assessed as highly effective\. Respondents identified substantial opportunities for curriculum innovation, stronger industry collaboration, workforce responsiveness, employability, and lifelong learning\. Nevertheless, moderate implementation challenges were identified concerning policy implementation, faculty capability, technological infrastructure, institutional resources, and industry participation\. The study also established a highly significant positive relationship between the level of industry micro\-credential integration and its effectiveness, indicating that stronger integration was associated with more effective curriculum implementation and competency\-based learning\. Based on the findings, a Technology Infusion Framework was developed to guide curriculum enhancement, technology integration, competency\-based instruction, digital credentialing, quality assurance, and collaboration among TESDA, accredited TVIs, and industry partners\. The framework may support continuous curriculum innovation, improve graduate employability, and promote lifelong learning through responsive and industry\-aligned technology diploma programs

## [Sampling the XY model with an attention\-based neural network](../publications/17a13bf5f17cf132ea08.md)

Piotr Białas; Christian D\. Morales; Tomasz Stebel; Dawid Zapolski

We present a transformer\-based variational autoregressive network for sampling lattice systems with continuous degrees of freedom and apply it to the two\-dimensional XY model near the Berezinskii\-Kosterlitz\-Thouless transition\. The architecture is combined with physics\-informed ingredients: locality\-informed attention and approximate probabilities\. The resulting sampler significantly outperforms existing neural samplers\. We train the model on lattices up to $96\\times96$, verify with a mode\-dropping estimator that no parts of the configuration space are missed, and reproduce the energy, magnetization and helicity modulus obtained with the traditional Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm\.

## [ABO blood group\-dependent association of serum retinol\-binding protein 4 with eosinophilic inflammation and spirometric parameters in adults with asthma](../publications/17aa057da0062eebbfcb.md)

Rasha Al‐Darraji; Zahraa Abdulaali Al\-Mudhafar

Growing evidence links retinol binding protein\-4 \(RBP4\) to inflammation; however, its association with inflammatory cell indices and spirometric parameters in asthma remains unclear, and the potential modifying role of ABO blood group has yet to be explored\. The main aim was to assess the associations of serum RBP4 with inflammatory cell indices and spirometric parameters in adults with asthma stratified by blood group O and non\-O\. Adults with physician\-diagnosed asthma attending a respiratory clinic between January and June 2026 were consecutively enrolled in this cross\-sectional study\. Spearman&\#x27;s correlation assessed associations involving inflammatory cell indices, whereas Pearson&\#x27;s correlation evaluated associations between normally distributed serum RBP4 and spirometric parameters\. Of the 88 adults with asthma enrolled, 64 had available ABO blood group data \(38 O and 26 Non\-O\) and were included in the blood group\-stratified analyses\. In the O group, RBP4 was positively correlated with eosinophil count \(ρ=0\.35, p=0\.03\), eosinophil\-to\-neutrophil ratio \(ρ=0\.42, p&lt;0\.01\), and eosinophil\-to\-lymphocyte ratio \(ρ=0\.41, p=0\.01\), whereas no significant associations were observed in the non\-O group\. Serum RBP4 was not correlated with spirometric parameters in either group\. The forced expiratory volume in one second/forced vital capacity ratio was inversely correlated with eosinophil and lymphocyte counts only in the O group, while lymphocyte count showed an inverse correlation with forced expiratory flow between 25% and 75% of forced vital capacity in the non\-O group\. In conclusion, serum RBP4 was positively associated with eosinophilic inflammatory markers only in adults with asthma belonging to blood group O, whereas no such associations were observed in the non\-O group\.

## [The Relationship Between the Use of Artificial Intelligence and Self\-Assessed Digital Competence in Higher Education](../publications/17b063a5c8dc8a88eb90.md)

Szilárd Horváth; Renáta Tóth

The spread of artificial intelligence \(AI\) tools has fundamentally transformed the teaching and learning process in higher education\. The aim of our research was to examine whether there is a correlation between the frequency of AI use among students and their self\-assessed AI competence\. The study was based on a voluntary online questionnaire completed by 487 students at Óbuda University\. The questionnaire asked about, among other things, the frequency of AI tool use, self\-assessed AI readiness, and attitudes toward AI\. Descriptive statistics and Pearson&\#x27;s correlation coefficient were used to analyze the data\. The results show a positive, weak to moderate correlation between the frequency of AI use and self\-assessed AI preparedness \(r=0\.27\)\. This suggests that students who use AI more frequently feel more prepared to use technology\. The results of the research confirm the assumption that the use of AI is in itself a learning process that contributes to the development of students&\#x27; digital competences\. For higher education, this means that the conscious and reflective integration of AI can not only be a tool for increasing efficiency but can also be interpreted as a competence\-developing pedagogical environment\.

## [EXPERIMENTAL INVESTIGATION OF WINGTIP\-VORTEX DECAY OVER A NACA 63\-209 AEROFOIL WITH WINGLET AND MORPHING DEVICES](../publications/17b5aea441d9e17acbcf.md)

MUYIWA O\. ATOYEBI; Olumide Adewole Towoju; Olawale Sayid Ismail; Ademola Adebukola Dare

An aerofoil’s performance is frequently constrained by excessive drag and disruptions produced during takeoff\. By lowering the Diffusion Length \(DL\) and Decay Time \(DT\) of the aerofoil’s related wake vortex, Add\-on Devices \(ADs\) such tip fences and tip sails have been investigated to overcome these constraints\. However, the literature’s earlier data on DL and DT was not enough\. This work aimed to assess the performance of an aerofoil fitted with Winglet, and Morphing Wingtip Add\-on Devices\. An aerofoil NACA 63\-209 with two ADs was employed in the experiment, while Aerofoil Without Add\-on \(AWA\) served as the control\. Whitcomb winglet \(Ww\) and Combined Winglet and Morphing \(CWM\) were the ADs under investigation\. The experiment was conducted under standard fluid flow take\-off circumstances with an aerofoil Angle of Attack \(AOA\) of 1°, 2°, 3°, and 4° with a Reynolds number of 8,997,222\. The measured values of pressure and velocity were used to determine the values of DL and DT\. At an AOA of 4°, the experimental DLs for Ww, CWM, and AWA were 16335\.00±0\.67, 9284\.60±0\.67, and 17028\.80±0\.67 m, respectively\. Similarly, at an AOA of 4°, the experimental DTs for Ww, CWM, and AWA were 225±0\.67, 130±0\.67, and 232\.00±0\.67 s, respectively\. At every AOA analysed, the aerofoil with CWM had the lowest DL and DT, indicating that it has the least tendency to create excessive drag and disturb its neighbours\. The aerofoil equipped with the Combined Winglet and Morphing \(CWM\) add\-on device performed best in alleviating wake vortex effect during takeoff\.

## [Comparative Analysis of Flexibility and Posture Between Indian Classical and Western Dancers: An Observational Study](../publications/17c6a230de2650674756.md)

Radhika Jitendra Khanolkar; Aarti Welling; Vijay Kage; Peeyoosha Gurudut; Soumya Hulmani

Objectives Being an art form, dance requires extraordinary posture and flexibility to perform complex movements\. The physical demands of Indian classical and Western dancing styles differ; Indian classical dancers emphasise precise, controlled movements, whereas Western dancers frequently use broad, dynamic gestures\. There is a paucity of research comparing posture and flexibility between these two dancing styles\. Therefore, this study aimed to compare upper and lower limb flexibility and postural characteristics between Indian classical and Western dancers Material and Methods This observational study was conducted over 6 months with 34 \(33 females; 1 male\) Indian classical dancers and 34 \(32 females; 2 males\) Western dancers from dance academies in Belagavi city\. Dancers aged 18–40 years with at least 4 years of experience were included\. Flexibility of the upper limb was assessed using Apley’s scratch test, while lower limb flexibility was measured with the sit\-and\-reach test\. Posture was analysed using Kinovea software from sagittal plane photographs for the craniovertebral angle, thoracic kyphosis angle, lumbar lordosis angle, and anterior pelvic tilt\. Results Indian classical dancers, all participants had typical or high upper limb flexibility; 88\.24% demonstrated below\-average lower limb flexibility, 76\.47% showed abnormal forward head posture, 64\.71% exhibited abnormal lumbar hyperlordosis, and 70\.59% had anterior pelvic tilt\. In contrast, Western dancers had 17\.65% \(right\) and 20\.59% \(left\), showing low upper limb flexibility, but none had below\-average lower limb flexibility; 5\.88% of Western dancers exhibited abnormal forward head posture and lumbar hyperlordosis, while 11\.76% had anterior pelvic tilt\. The mean scores of all parameters except thoracic kyphosis were statistically significant between the two dance form groups \( p &lt;0\.05\) Conclusion This study demonstrates that Indian classical dancers exhibit greater upper limb flexibility, with a corresponding decrease in lower limb flexibility and postural malalignment\. However, Western dancers exhibit superior lower limb flexibility and better postural alignment\. This finding highlights the distinct physical adaptation associated with each dance style\.

## [Socio\-Cultural and Spiritual\-Ideological Factors of Preserving and Strengthening National Identity Under Globalization](../publications/17e216b04a08d7dd777f.md)

Salim Musurmonovich Doniyorov

The article examines the socio\-cultural and spiritual\-ideological factors of preserving and strengthening national identity under globalization\. An analysis of 2023–2025 shows a sharp increase in the global openness of society: inbound and outbound trips grew from 11\.4 to 19\.2 million \(1\.69 times\), the share of Internet users among people aged 10 and over reached 92\.7%, and 99\.3% use mobile communications\. In response, the network of libraries and information\-library centres expanded by 36\.2% \(to 17,763\), while the number of magazines and other periodicals fell by 48\.9% and theatre performances by 8\.3%\. The need to move from a defensive model of identity preservation to an adaptive\-competitive model combining ideological immunity, the digital presence of national culture and cultural diplomacy is substantiated\.

## [Digital Capacity of Labour Markets: Regional Assessment](../publications/17e4ab52db5905eaad5e.md)

Diana SHKUROPADSKA; Larysa Lebedeva; Anzhelika Gerasymenko; Kateryna NIKOLAIETS; Iryna Shtunder

Abstract: This study examines the digital capacity of labour markets amid the global digital transformation and increasing economic volatility\. The aim of the article is to assess the digital capacity of labour markets as one of sustainability criteria across the world&\#x27;s macro\-regions and to identify the structural, institutional, and human capital factors that shape regional disparities of the world\. Digital capacity is conceptualized as a multidimensional construct reflecting economies&\#x27; ability to generate digital jobs, develop digital skills, integrate advanced technologies, and adapt to structural change\. Digital labour market capacity depends upon the ability of an economy to generate digital jobs, provide digital skills, integrate into the digital economy and adapt to technological change\. The methodology is designed to assess the ability of labour markets to adapt in the context of the digital transformation of the economy, as well as to determine their potential for the implementation of innovative technologies and the development of digital skills\. The study proposes a methodological framework based on the Digital Labour Capacity Index \(DLCI\), which combines two components: Digital Workforce &amp; Adoption Capacity and Innovation, Research &amp; Advanced Technologies Capacity\. The methodology defines a list of key indicators, their reference \(base\) level values, as well as an algorithm for calculating the Digital Labour Capacity Index \(DLCI\)\. A comparative regional assessment covering eight macro\-regions reveals substantial disparities in both components and the composite index\. East Asia &amp; Pacific demonstrates high levels of DLCI \(93\.3%\), with strong performance across both components reflecting a mature digital ecosystem with rapid technological adaptability\. North America \(80\.0%\) and Europe \(73\.3%\) show sufficient levels, formed by well\-developed digital skills and innovation infrastructure, though with some internal imbalances\. Latin America and the Caribbean records a medium level \(46\.6%\), with digital progress but weak coherence between human capital and technological usage\. South Asia, Sub\-Saharan Africa, and Central Asia and the South Caucasus each register moderate levels \(25\.0%\), constrained by limited digital competencies, low R&amp;D investment, and weak integration into global innovation networks\. The Middle East &amp; North Africa shows have low level \(13\.3%\), reflecting simultaneously weak workforce and innovation capacity and a fragmented pattern of digital transformation shaped by raw\-material\-oriented economic structures\. The results suggest that labour market digital capacity is a crucial prerequisite for the sustainable development of global regions\. Application of the study methodology reveals pronounced interregional disparities in digital capacity levels\. Regions with strong institutional foundations and sustained technology investment – East Asia &amp; Pacific, North America, and Europe – hold clear leading positions, whereas other regions show considerably weaker capacity for digital transformation of their labour markets\. These disparities point to the need for differentiated policy responses made to regional specifics, with priority given to human capital development, broader access to digital technologies, and stronger support for innovation activity\. The proposed methodology thus offers a practical analytical tool for tracking digital capacity across labour markets, detecting structural imbalances, and informing policy decisions that support sustainable socio\-economic development amid ongoing digitalization\. Keywords: digital capacity, digital skills, sustainable development, innovation capacity, labour market\.

## [The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Modern Business Management: A Conceptual Study of Opportunities and Challenges](../publications/1819242fa5c8c28e9e31.md)

P\. Senthil; D\. Karthikeyan; Harshwardhan Chaudhari; Ashish Jha; Shantanu Kumar Sahu

Artificial intelligence \(AI\) is increasingly discussed as a core element of contemporary business management, yet the literature remains scattered across technical, managerial, and ethical perspectives\. This conceptual study synthesises twenty recent scholarly and repository sources to examine how AI is understood to reshape management practice, which opportunities it creates, and which challenges accompany its adoption\. A thematic reading of the sources shows consistent attention to improved decision\-making, process automation, customer engagement, strategic innovation, and functional applications in human resources, supply chains, finance, and information systems\. The same sources also point to ethical risks such as algorithmic bias and weak transparency, to data privacy and security concerns, to workforce disruption, and to cost, skills, and infrastructure constraints\. Building on these themes, the paper proposes an integrated framework in which technological capability, organisational readiness, and responsible governance jointly determine whether AI delivers sustained value\. The study concludes that AI is best understood as a tool for augmenting human judgement rather than replacing it, and it outlines implications for managers, policymakers, and future researchers\.

## [Time Pressure and Limited Attention in Chess](../publications/18255239645384b2c904.md)

Samuel Cheun

This paper examines how individuals make decisions under cognitive constraints\. Using thousands of chess moves evaluated against computer\-generated benchmarks, Samuel Cheung provides evidence that time pressure significantly increases the likelihood of errors, reinforcing theories of bounded rationality and limited attention\. By combining economics with computational analysis, the paper demonstrates how strategic games can serve as powerful laboratories for understanding human decision\-making\.

## [AI\-driven quantitative assessment of abdominal organs and immunotherapy outcomes across multicenter hepatocellular carcinoma cohorts](../publications/182d22cfd01387aa91aa.md)

Tianxiang Li; Xiaona Fu; Yusheng Guo; Ning Wang; Li Shanmei; Xiaofang Guo; Rundong Wang; Shichao Long; Mengsi Li; Shanshan Jiang; Yi Li; Xuejun Chen; Lixia Wang; Lian Yang; Chuansheng Zheng

Host\-related imaging phenotypes beyond conventional muscle and fat measurements remain insufficiently explored in hepatocellular carcinoma \(HCC\)\. This study evaluated associations between abdominal organ features and outcomes in 1512 patients with HCC receiving immune checkpoint inhibitor\-based therapy across 10 cohorts from six centers\. Deep learning automatically quantified nine abdominal organs from pretreatment CT or MR images, yielding 18 volume and height\-normalized indices\. Continuous organ measurements were assessed using multivariable Cox regression with Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate correction; exploratory external validation used WHUH\-derived median cutoffs\. The primary outcomes were overall survival \(OS\) and progression\-free survival \(PFS\)\. In the primary analysis, organ measurements were evaluated as continuous variables using multivariable Cox regression, followed by Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate \(FDR\) correction\. Exploratory external validation used median cut\-offs derived from the WHUH cohort and fixed in the remaining centers\. Liver volume, left adrenal gland volume, and right kidney index were associated with overall survival after FDR correction\. No continuous organ metric remained significant for progression\-free survival, whereas higher right kidney volume and right kidney index were associated with shorter progression\-free survival in exploratory external validation\. Automated multi\-organ quantification from routine imaging may provide complementary prognostic information without requiring additional examinations or radiation exposure\.
