## [Impact of Biophilic Interior Design on Cognitive Performance and Emotional Health in Work Environments](../publications/2b716532e2960d21ba2f.md)

Vrushali Dattatray Kamble; Pooja Sadanand Patil; Tejesh Nanaware

The study investigates the effects of bio\-philic interior design on cognitive functioning and affective wellbeing in occupational settings based on a secondary data methodology\. Due to the rapid urbanization and increased indoor time, the loss of connection to nature has been associated with stress, decreased productivity, and decreased wellbeing\. The study is a synthesis of 30 to 50 peer\-reviewed articles, reports, and case studies that assess the effect of the combination of natural elements, including indoor vegetation, natural illumination, ventilation, and naturerelated materials on employee performance\. The results show that biophilic design has considerable benefits in improving attention, memory, creativity, and overall cognitive efficiency and decreasing the levels of stress, fatigue, anxiety, and depression\. The paper also provides the participation of theories like Attention Restoration Theory \(ART\) and Stress Restoration Theory \(SRT\) in aiding to understand such advantages\. Moreover, the biophilic factors that warrant employee satisfaction, engagement, and productivity are identified in varied working environments\. All in all, the study promotes the use of biophilic design as an effective and sustainable approach to enhancing mental health and performance at the workplace\.

## [Evaluation of ChatGPT for Myocardial Infarction Health Information: Expert Accuracy Assessment and User Trust Survey](../publications/2b78c0fdf773943682be.md)

Eman Elsheikh; Abdullah Ahmed Aladsani; Yousef Abdullatif Aljohar; Ghala Abdulaziz Alzahrani; Ali Mohammed Nasser Alsadah; Maryam Ahmed Almuhaysh; Walah Sami Rashid alowaynan; Rehab H\. Werida

Background: Artificial intelligence chatbots, particularly ChatGPT, have emerged as increasingly popular sources of health information for the general public\. However, concerns persist regarding the accuracy, safety, and appropriateness of AI\-generated medical advice, especially for life\-threatening conditions such as myocardial infarction\. Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and safety of ChatGPT\-generated responses and information to public questions about heart attacks, assess user perceptions and trust, and compare AI\-generated content with expert\-validated sources\. Methods: A cross\-sectional study was conducted between January and March 2026\. A total of 73 commonly asked heart attack\-related questions were submitted to ChatGPT \(GPT\-4\), and responses were independently evaluated by two expert reviewers and one external reviewer using standardized rubric assessing accuracy, completeness, clarity, safety, and tone\. Inter\-rater reliability was assessed using intraclass correlation coefficients\. In parallel, a survey of 352 participants evaluated user perceptions, trust, and behavioral use of ChatGPT for medical information\. Statistical analyses included descriptive statistics, group comparisons, correlation analyses, and multivariable regression models to identify predictors of trust and satisfaction\. Results: Expert reviewers assigned high ratings for accuracy \(mean: 4\.62 ± 0\.62 and 4\.48 ± 0\.63\) and safety \(mean: 4\.78 ± 0\.51 and 4\.05 ± 0\.50\), with substantial inter\-rater agreement \(ICC = 0\.788\)\. In contrast, the external reviewer documented considerably lower completeness ratings \(2\.59 ± 0\.57\), revealing deficiencies in information coverage\. Remarkably, 40\.6% of respondents indicated they had followed ChatGPT&\#x27;s medical recommendations without seeking professional consultation, while 17\.6% reported depending on the chatbot during urgent medical situations\. Levels of user trust and satisfaction were moderate, showing significant correlations with perceived accuracy, usage frequency, and healthcare\-related educational background\. Conclusions: Expert assessments confirmed that ChatGPT generally provides accurate and safe cardiovascular health information; nevertheless, considerable inter\-reviewer variability—especially the markedly lower completeness scores from the external evaluator—reveals significant gaps in content depth\. These results indicate that ChatGPT functions more appropriately as an adjunctive educational resource rather than a replacement for professional medical consultation, emphasizing the necessity for enhanced safety mechanisms, clearer user instructions, and standardized content protocols when addressing high\-stakes health topics\. ChatGPT should be considered an adjunctive resource rather than a substitute for urgent professional medical assessment in suspected heart attack cases\.

## [Corticosteroid response and biopsy decisions in tumefactive demyelination and primary central nervous system lymphoma](../publications/2b8101d46fd446a35d0e.md)

Xu Wang; Shougang Guo

Distinguishing primary central nervous system lymphoma \(PCNSL\) from tumefactive demyelination becomes especially difficult after corticosteroid treatment\. Both conditions may improve clinically and radiologically, while corticosteroids can reduce lymphoma cellularity, alter enhancement, and change the tissue available for sampling\. The biopsy literature reflects this time dependence\. Meta\-analysis shows a higher average risk of nondiagnostic tissue after prebiopsy exposure, yet contemporary cohorts report high diagnostic yields in selected patients when enhancement persists and current imaging guides prompt sampling\. We organize the evidence around four time\-linked clinical questions\. Before corticosteroids \(T0\), clinicians establish the competing probabilities and preserve baseline anatomy\. After treatment \(T1\), they measure the anatomical and clinical transformation\. Before biopsy \(T2\), current imaging should determine whether a representative target remains visible, safely accessible, and sufficiently sampleable\. A persistent useful target supports prompt, imaging\-updated biopsy; marked regression calls for planned short\-interval imaging to recover a representative target\. Cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers can modify probability, although single\-marker negativity is weak and composite results remain prevalence\- and platform\-dependent\. After biopsy \(T3\), pathology must fit the sampled site and subsequent course\. A major verified inconsistency should reopen imaging–pathology review and prompt repeat biopsy when a useful target is available\. This approach treats corticosteroid response as a measurable change in diagnostic substrate and links each decision to the evidence available at that time\.

## [Sentiment and Repurchase Signals in Indonesian Fresh\-Produce E\-Commerce Reviews: A Pilot Text\-Mining Study](../publications/2b986b95efa4ce935594.md)

Amir Fikri; Renny Risqiani; Janita S\. Meliala

Online fresh\-produce retailing presents distinctive quality and delivery uncertainties that influence consumer evaluations and repurchase intentions\. This study contributes a leakage\-controlled, polarity\-aware text\-mining framework for examining consumer sentiment and repurchase signals in unsolicited online reviews\. Using 113 public Tokopedia reviews covering 31 fresh\-produce products, this pilot study employed lexicon\-based sentiment classification and logistic regression with product\-clustered standard errors\. The findings reveal predominantly positive consumer sentiment, although explicit repurchase intentions appear less frequently\. Consumer sentiment demonstrates a significant positive association with repurchase signals, while product\-quality mentions show no significant relationship\. Unexpectedly, positive delivery mentions exhibit a negative association with repurchase signals, potentially reflecting review\-length constraints rather than unfavorable delivery experiences\. These findings extend the methodological application of consumer\-generated content analysis by demonstrating the feasibility of extracting distinct behavioral signals while addressing classification bias\. Online retailers can leverage this framework to monitor consumer experiences and identify opportunities for service improvement\.

## [Percepciones de la inteligencia artificial generativa en la educación superior: un análisis sobre estudiantes en la Universidad Estatal de Sonora](../publications/2ba82892fa2d11ea05b3.md)

María Dolores Jiménez Carrasco; José Ricardo López Espinosa; Joaquín Morales García; Sonia Guadalupe Zermeño Flores

La incorporación de herramientas de inteligencia artificial generativa \(IAG\) en la educación superior ha transformado las formas en que los estudiantes acceden a la información, realizan actividades académicas y participan en los procesos de aprendizaje\. Sin embargo, su uso plantea desafíos en torno a la ética y la ansiedad académicas, al acompañamiento docente y a la capacidad institucional para orientar su implementación\. Por lo cual, el objetivo de la presente investigación fue analizar empíricamente la relación entre la satisfacción, el impacto académico percibido, la ansiedad, la preparación y el apoyo institucional respecto del uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa \(IAG\) en estudiantes de la Universidad Estatal de Sonora \(UES\), Unidad Académica San Luis Río Colorado \(UASL\)\. Se desarrolló un estudio cuantitativo, correlacional, no experimental y transversal con una muestra no probabilística de 470 universitarios adscritos a diversos programas de grado\. Se aplicó un instrumento de escala de Likert, estructurado en cinco dimensiones y validado mediante análisis factorial exploratorio y de consistencia interna\. Los resultados evidencian una alta satisfacción de uso por parte del estudiantado, que se correlaciona de manera positiva y fuerte con el impacto en el aprendizaje\. Asimismo, el apoyo institucional se confirmó como un factor sistémico determinante\. De manera disruptiva, los niveles de ansiedad académica no mostraron una asociación significativa con el impacto ni con la satisfacción, lo que sugiere una disociación emocional frente a la innovación digital\. Se concluye que el estudiantado presenta una apropiación tecnológica madura y funcional, lo que demanda que las instituciones de educación superior transiten de una tolerancia pasiva a la implementación de políticas formales de alfabetización algorítmica y de acompañamiento docente\.

## [Frontier mechanical issues of coal\-rock\-gas dynamic disasters](../publications/2baccadcf20cbe9e41f1.md)

Cheng Zhai; Yide Guo; Liang Yuan; Jianfeng Li; Jinhu Liu; Bingyou Jiang; Chunshan Zheng; Bobo Li; Xijian Li

Deep coal mining encounters a complex engineering environment characterized by high in\-situ stress, high gas pressure, high geothermal temperature, intense mining disturbances, and evident time effect\. This multi\-physical field coupling fundamentally distinguishes deep mining from a shallow condition and frequently leads to sudden coal\-rock\-gas dynamic disasters\. This paper comprehensively reviews and analyses the static and dynamic mechanical behavior of deep coal\-rock masses, the popular discrimination criteria for these dynamic disasters, the underlying mechanisms of their incubation and triggering, the advanced experimental techniques and numerical simulation methods for their reproduction, and the corresponding disaster prevention and control technologies\. In addition, this research further systematically elucidates the frontier mechanical issues related to these dynamic disasters under deep mining conditions\. It highlights the evolution of research paradigms from static to dynamic and coupled static\-dynamic mechanics, emphasizing the central role of addressing mechanical problems in understanding and mitigating these disasters\. Critically, it also presents pioneering prevention technologies of our research group, such as in\-situ zonal coal seam modification, in\-situ gas deflagration and ideas of intelligent control, which transition the disaster mitigation from passive relief to active mechanical regulation\. By integrating the latest research from our group with a global perspective, this work provides a comprehensive and frontier mechanical framework and novel technical pathways, offering invaluable scientific support for overcoming the safety challenges in deep coal mining\.

## [ТЕОРІЯ ПОРЯДКУ ДЕННОГО ЯК ПІДҐРУНТЯ АНАЛІЗУ ПЕРЕКЛАДУ АНГЛІЙСЬКОМОВНИХ НОВИН УКРАЇНСЬКОЮ МОВОЮ](../publications/2bb5e38d7612204dc087.md)

Iryna Danylchenko

Статтю присвячено розробці методології аналізу перекладу міжнародних англомовних новин українською мовою на основі інтеграції теорії порядку денного, когнітивної лінгвістики та медіаперекладознавства\. Актуальність дослі\- дження зумовлена трансформацією сучасного інформаційного простору, у якому переклад новин виконує не лише функцію міжмовної передачі інформації, а й бере участь у формуванні інформаційного порядку денного, визнача\- ючи пріоритетність подій, способи їх концептуалізації та особливості репрезентації для цільової аудиторії\. Метою статті є розробка методології аналізу текстів міжнародних новин та їхніх перекладів українською мовою, визначення основних етапів такого аналізу та розроблення методики реконструкції моделі події й дослідження її вторинної кон\- цептуалізації в процесі перекладу\. Матеріалом дослідження слугує корпус із 40 англомовних міжнародних новин BBC News та їхніх українських перекладів, опублікованих на платформі BBC News Україна у 2021–2026 роках\. У статті доведено, що переклад міжнародних новин є процесом вторинної концептуалізації події, у межах якого відбувається реконфігурація інформаційної ієрархії, зміна перспективи висвітлення подій і формування вторинного порядку денного відповідно до когнітивних, комунікативних та соціокультурних особливостей української аудиторії\. Запропоновано триетапну методику аналізу перекладу міжнародних новин, яка охоплює медіафільтрацію, моде\- лювання та інтертекстуальну конвенціоналізацію\. Перший етап передбачає дослідження закономірностей добору англомовних новин для перекладу та чинників, що визначають їхню інформаційну цінність для української ауди\- торії\. Другий етап спрямований на реконструкцію когнітивної моделі події шляхом аналізу образ\-схем, конструк\- цій і компонентів події у заголовках та основному тексті новин\. На третьому етапі встановлюються повторювані перекладацькі моделі, які функціонують як інтертекстуальні механізми формування національного медіадискурсу\. Наукова новизна дослідження полягає у розробленні комплексної лінгвокогнітивної методики аналізу перекладу міжнародних новин, що інтегрує положення теорії порядку денного з методами когнітивної лінгвістики та дозволяє дослідити переклад як процес вторинного конструювання медійної реальності\.

## [Screening high symbiotic matching combinations of rhizobia and alfalfa varieties in saline soil](../publications/2bb7bbb653d4e108f4c2.md)

Liying Liu; Yinghao Liu; Hongmei Liu; Hui Yan; Yiwen Yang; Xing Li; 王裕智; Zhigang Liu; Meiling Hou; Da Li

Rhizobium inoculation can improve alfalfa performance, but responses depend on both plant genotype and growing environment\. We first screened 14 rhizobial strains plus one commercial inoculant with Medicago varia ‘Caoyuan No\. 3’ \(CY3\) in a greenhouse pot experiment, together with an uninoculated control \(16 treatments; three pots per treatment\)\. Based on plant height, root length, leaf number, nodule number, and above\- and belowground biomass after two months, SJN, HH, and HK were selected as higher\-performing strains, whereas XBC, SWL, and XH were retained as lower\-performing comparators\. These six strains were then evaluated with CY3, Medicago sativa ‘Aohan’ \(AH\), and M\. sativa ‘Adrenalin’ \(ADN\) in a replicated field experiment\. Individual growth and nutritional responses varied among varieties and growth stages\. At flowering, XH increased CY3 above\-ground biomass by 113% relative to CK, whereas the reported TOPSIS composite ranking placed CY3\+XBC first overall\. The corresponding composite rankings placed AH\+SJN and ADN\+SWL first; notably, CK ranked second for ADN\. Thus, ‘optimal’ refers to the highest reported composite score across the measured growth, nodulation and nutritional indicators, not superiority for every individual trait\. Because symbiotic nitrogen fixation was not measured directly and a pre\-sowing physicochemical baseline for the field soil was unavailable, the findings should be interpreted as context\-dependent agronomic responses rather than direct quantification of nitrogen fixation or remediation of saline soil\.

## [Aloe\-emodin isolated from Rheum ribes induces cytotoxicity and apoptosis in MCF\-7 human breast cancer cells](../publications/2bb85cc227746ae552f2.md)

Mehmet Kadir Erdoğan; Aydın SEVER; Ramazan Gündoğdu; İbrahim Halil Geçibesler

The therapeutic exploration of plant\-derived bioactive molecules in oncology has gained substantial momentum in recent years, driven by their diverse mechanisms of action and relatively favourable safety profiles\. In this context, the present study investigates the anticancer potential of Aloe\-emodin \(AE\), a naturally occurring anthraquinone extracted from Rheum ribes, against MCF\-7 human breast cancer cell line\. To evaluate the cytotoxic and mechanistic effects of AE, a comprehensive panel of in vitro assays was employed\. These included the Neutral Red Uptake assay to quantify cell viability, colony formation assays to assess long\-term proliferative capacity, and wound\-healing assays to examine the impact of AE on cellular migration\. Additionally, Caspase\-3 ELISA was utilised to determine apoptotic activation, while Western blot analyses were conducted to characterise AE\-induced changes in key apoptosis\-related and survival\-associated protein expression profiles\. AE demonstrated potent antiproliferative activity against the MCF\-7 cell line, as evidenced by the viability assays\. In functional experiments, AE markedly impaired cellular migration and significantly diminished colony\-forming capacity\. Mechanistically, AE treatment led to a pronounced increase in Caspase\-3 activity and upregulated key apoptotic markers, including p53 and cleaved PARP \(c\-PARP\), collectively supporting the activation of apoptosis\-mediated cell death pathways\. Our findings demonstrate that AE exerts pronounced cytotoxic and pro\-apoptotic effects on MCF\-7 breast cancer cells, underscoring its potential as a promising adjunct or alternative therapeutic candidate in breast cancer management\. Nonetheless, further mechanistic and translational studies are required to fully elucidate its molecular mode of action and evaluate its clinical applicability\.

## [SISTEM DIGITAL DAN CERDAS UNTUK IDENTIFIKASI HAMA DAN PENYAKIT PADA SINGKONG \(Manihot esculenta\)](../publications/2bb85ee222f66260df90.md)

Linda Oktavianingsih; Muhammadiyah; Ervinda Yuliatin; Afrisya Hardianto Putri; Fadhilah Rifhayu Izzah; Fathimah Azizah Muthaharah; Gian Yunita Putri; Rieskamayanti Putricia Utomo; Yudi Eko Prasetyo

Cassava \(Manihot esculenta\) is an important crop in Indonesia, but its productivity is often reduced by pests and diseases\. This study aimed to identify the types of pests and diseases affecting cassava and to analyze the severity of infection using digital technologies\. Observations were conducted on 23 November 2025 at three locations in Sempaja Utara, Samarinda, East Kalimantan\. Leaf samples were identified using Plantix and Agri AI applications, while disease severity was analyzed by measuring the leaf area using ImageJ software\. Results showed that sample A was affected by brown leaf spot and anthracnose, sample B was attacked by spider mites and Septoria leaf spot, and sample C was affected by spider mites and Cassava Brown Streak Disease \(CBSD\)\. ImageJ analysis indicated that the highest disease severity was 2\.01% in sample B, and the lowest was 0\.33% in sample A\. These findings demonstrate that digital applications and artificial intelligence–based tools can support fast and efficient identification of cassava pests and diseases, providing potential guidance for better crop health management\.

## [A leakage\-controlled multimodal model integrating 18F\-FDG PET/CT radiomics, deep\-learning features, metabolic parameters and haematological inflammation–nutrition indices for preoperative prediction of axillary lymph\-node metastasis in invasive breast cancer](../publications/2bbc42b05254ed116bf0.md)

赫 聂; Huarui Tan; Zhen Cao; Xiaozheng Cao

Abstract Background The status of the axillary lymph nodes \(ALN\) guides staging and the extent of axillary surgery in invasive breast cancer, yet confirmation still depends on sentinel lymph\-node biopsy or axillary dissection\. This exploratory study developed and internally evaluated, by cross\-validation, a model combining five complementary streams of information available at staging \( 18 F\-FDG PET/CT radiomics, deep\-learning \(DL\) imaging features, volumetric metabolic parameters, routine clinicopathological variables and blood\-count\-derived inflammation–nutrition indices\) within a machine\-learning pipeline designed to avoid information leakage\. Methods Sixty\-three women with histologically confirmed invasive breast carcinoma who underwent baseline 18 F\-FDG PET/CT at a single centre were analysed retrospectively \(42 node\-positive, 21 node\-negative\); 40 \(63%\) subsequently received neoadjuvant systemic therapy\. Features were extracted from the tumour volume delineated on co\-registered PET and CT: 2,167 IBSI\-compliant radiomics features, 12,288 ResNet\-50 transfer\-learning features, 11 volumetric metabolic parameters, 7 clinicopathological variables and 7 inflammation–nutrition indices\. Median imputation, variance filtering, standardisation, univariate AUC screening, collinearity pruning and LASSO selection were fitted only within the training folds of repeated stratified five\-fold cross\-validation \(10 repeats\)\. Five single\-block models and three fusion strategies \(stacking, feature concatenation and a parameter\-free probability mean\) were compared across four base learners, and the complete choice of block, fusion strategy, learner and decision threshold was repeated inside a nested cross\-validation\. Uncertainty was estimated by patient\-level bootstrap, models were compared by paired bootstrap, and calibration, decision curves, the incremental value of imaging over clinicopathological variables, the handling of missing data and robustness to contour perturbation were assessed\. Results The nested cross\-validated AUC of the whole modelling procedure was 0\.711 \(95% CI 0\.609–0\.805\)\. The probability\-mean fusion, the most frequently selected strategy, reached 0\.795 \(0\.678–0\.891\) on the same splits, indicating a model\-selection optimism of about 0\.08; its sensitivity and specificity at training\-fold thresholds were 0\.80 and 0\.60, and calibration was imperfect \(slope 1\.53\)\. Single\-block AUCs ranged from 0\.590 \(inflammation–nutrition; 95% CI including 0\.5\) to 0\.750 \(DL\)\. Adding PET/CT\-derived information to the clinicopathological variables \(AUC 0\.681, 0\.544–0\.805\) increased the AUC by 0\.107 \(− 0\.023 to 0\.247; P = 0\.12\), and net benefit exceeded that of a treat\-all strategy only at threshold probabilities of about 0\.4 or higher\. Discrimination was poor in patients who received neoadjuvant therapy \(nested AUC 0\.561\)\. Under a stringent one\-voxel contour perturbation, 23% of radiomics features had an intraclass correlation coefficient of at least 0\.75, and restricting the radiomics block to these features did not reduce performance\. Conclusions In this small single\-centre retrospective cohort, combining PET/CT\-derived and routinely available clinical information under leakage\-controlled, nested cross\-validation gave moderate discrimination of axillary nodal status, with imperfect calibration and no statistically demonstrable incremental value of imaging over clinicopathological variables\. The work should be regarded as a proof\-of\-concept framework; prospective multicentre external validation, including comparison with routine PET/CT axillary assessment, is required before any clinical application\.

## [Flavonoids: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential in Multitarget Intervention forChronic Neuroinflammation](../publications/2bc8f38953934c1eea1d.md)

Ziying Zhang; Tian Yang; Shuxiang Li; Mengyao Lyu; Xi Cui; Changwu Yue; Xingkun Ou; Yuhong Lyu

Abstract Inflammation is a defensive response of the body to external stimuli\. However, excessive or dysregulated inflammatory responses contribute to various chronic diseases, with neurodegenerative disorders accounting for approximately 30% of the global disease burden\. Flavonoids are natural polyphenolic compounds widely distributed in plants\. Unlike conventional anti\-inflammatory drugs, which tend to induce drug resistance and cause severe side effects, these natural dietary components exhibit low toxicity, offering a safer alternative for the intervention of chronic inflammatory diseases, with particularly notable advantages in long\-term therapeutic applications\. Accumulating evidence indicates that they exert synergistic anti\-inflammatory effects through multiple targets and pathways\. In neuroinflammatory diseases, the interventional effects of these natural compounds are particularly prominent: nobiletin inhibits β\-Amyloid \(Aβ\) aggregation via the Toll\-like receptor 4/nuclear factor\-κB \(TLR4/NF\-κB\) pathway to ameliorate Alzheimer’s disease \(AD\) pathology; baicalin alleviates neuroinflammation through the Nuclear factor erythroid 2\-related factor 2\-NOD\-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3 \(Nrf2\-NLRP3\) axis to protect dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson’s disease \(PD\) ; luteolin reduces mutant huntingtin protein aggregation to mitigate the progression of Huntington’s disease \(HD\) ; quercetin activates the Sestrin2/adenosine monophosphate\-activated protein kinase/sirtuin 1 \(Sestrin2/AMPK/SIRT1\) pathway to delay motor neuron degeneration in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis \(ALS\) \. Additionally, this review further analyzes the key challenges in the clinical translation of flavonoids, including insufficient blood\-brain barrier penetration, limited bioavailability in vivo, and limitations of experimental models\. To address these challenges, this review focuses on food science\-oriented strategies, emphasizing two core directions: the construction of nanodelivery systems and molecular structural modification\. while integrating advanced approaches such as humanized models, aiming to provide a theoretical basis and translational pathway for the clinical application of flavonoids in neuroinflammatory intervention\.

## [Metagenomic next\-generation sequencing confirmed pseudorabies virus encephalitis complicated with central visual impairment: a case report](../publications/2bc954796a2ab98bac5d.md)

Yonghu Zhang; Xiaojing Zhang; Xue Wei; Wenwen Yu; Ning Ma; Weihai Liu; Yafeng Zheng; Hongyu Jia

Pseudorabies virus \(PRV\) is an alphaherpesvirus for which domestic swine serve as the sole natural reservoir\. Human PRV infection has historically been regarded as extremely rare\. Since 2017, however, an increasing number of severe human PRV encephalitis cases have been identified in China, pre\-dominantly among individuals with occupational exposure to pigs or pork products\. The condition has been associated with substantial morbidity and mortality and remains under recognized in clinical practice\. We report a 53\-year\-old male dockworker who presented with a 9\-day history of fever followed by progressive severe headache\. PRV infection was confirmed by metagenomic next\-generation sequencing \(mNGS\) of cerebrospinal fluid \(CSF\)\. Brain magnetic resonance imaging revealed signal abnormalities involving the right insular cortex, temporal lobe, hippocampus, and amygdala, consistent with encephalitis\. The patient received intravenous acyclovir \(500 mg every 8 h for 23 days\), corticosteroids, and intravenous immunoglobulin\. Although his level of consciousness gradually improved, he developed permanent bilateral blindness with no light perception\. At 1\-year follow\-up, he remained alive but with persistent blindness; neuroimaging demonstrated encephalomalacia in the right temporal and insular regions\. PRV can cause devastating human encephalitis with visual impairment as a frequent and serious complication, reported in up to 60% of published cases\. Our case is notable in that bilateral blindness emerged after recovery of consciousness, without evidence of peripheral ocular pathology, suggesting a pre\-dominantly central visual pathway injury\. CSF mNGS has become a key tool for timely diagnosis of rare viral encephalitides\. Clinicians should consider PRV encephalitis in patients with unexplained encephalitis and a history of swine exposure, and pursue early mNGS testing to facilitate prompt aetiological diagnosis and antiviral therapy\.

## [Comparison of Wi\-Fi Roaming Performance between Software\-Defined Networking\-Based and Standalone Networks](../publications/2bd6272f7b1076936e7b.md)

Restu Angga Dwi Nurdiansyah; Muhammad Faishol Amrulloh

RSUD Bangil is transitioning toward the implementation of integrated Electronic Medical Records \(EMR\) connected to the Hospital Management Information System \(SIMRS\)\. The high mobility of medical personnel, particularly in the Emergency Department \(ED\), requires a stable Wi\-Fi connection when users move between access points \(roaming\)\. This study aims to analyze and compare Wi\-Fi roaming performance between a Software\-Defined Networking \(SDN\)\-based network and a standalone network at RSUD Bangil\. Testing was conducted at two locations in the ED, with ten repetitions using Windows 11 and Android devices\. The Quality of Service \(QoS\) parameters measured included throughput, delay, jitter, and packet loss using Iperf3 and Termux, complemented by an evaluation of user perceptions through questionnaires\. In the SDN\-based network, access points were centrally managed using Cloudnet, with max\-power and channel settings configured accordingly\. The results showed that the SDN\-based network demonstrated better roaming performance than the standalone network, characterized by more stable throughput, lower delay and jitter, and no packet loss during the roaming process\. The user evaluation results further confirmed improved connection stability following SDN implementation\. Therefore, the SDN\-based network architecture provides a more optimal solution for supporting the continuity of EMR services in hospital environments with high user mobility\.

## [Diversification and coexistence amid widespread and persistent gene flow in Andean trees](../publications/2bd89a33ea280b442dc6.md)

Ellen J\. Quinlan; James B\. Pease; Jhonatan Sallo Bravo; Alfredo F\. Fuentes; William Farfan\-Rios; Miles R\. Silman

Hybridization and introgression are increasingly recognized as important in plant evolution, yet their prevalence and consequences remain poorly understood in tropical Andean trees, where species coexist at low densities and turn over rapidly across elevation gradients\. Here, we investigate whether species boundaries are maintained among 10 congeneric Andean Prunus L\. species distributed across the Andes\-Amazon elevational gradient by reconstructing phylogenetic relationships, divergence times, and patterns of historical and recent gene flow\. We find that Andean Prunus diversified during the Miocene, likely in response to novel habitat opportunities resulting from mountain uplift, combined with allopatric processes\. Despite this evolutionary divergence, these species show extensive ancient introgression and recent admixture, indicating that species boundaries remain permeable across both ecological and phylogenetic distance\. Together, these results suggest that Andean Prunus comprise distinct but evolutionarily connected lineages that retain morphological identity while potentially functioning as a long\-lived syngameon, with implications for understanding the origin and maintenance of tropical tree diversity and future response to global change\.

## [Weather\-Driven Solar Intensity Forecasting for Smart Homes : A Comparative Machine Learning Study](../publications/2bdd275505820195c26e.md)

Rashmi Ashtagi; Ranjeet Vasant Bidwe; Onkar shrihari Bidwe

Solar intensity forecasting can help residential photovoltaic systems anticipate solar availability and plan electricity use\. This paper presents a detailed account of the approach described in the supplied seminar report, which predicts global horizontal irradiance \(GHI\) using weather\-related variables\. The reported pipeline includes data cleaning, normalization, correlation analysis, an 80:20 training\-test split, and a comparison of conventional machine\-learning algorithms with a fully connected neural network\. The considered models are Linear Regression, Quadratic Regression, Naive Bayes, k\-Nearest Neighbours \(KNN\), Support Vector Machine \(SVM\), Gradient Boosting Machine \(GBM\), and a neural network\. The report records the lowest mean squared error \(MSE\) for the neural network at 1,675\.94, followed by KNN at 2,587\.07\. These results indicate that the neural network performed best among the evaluated alternatives in the reported experiment\. Some dataset and training details are not specified sufficiently for exact reproduction; therefore, the paper presents the reported findings without claiming independent implementation or validation\.

## [Nanomotors: Preparation Strategies, Propulsion Mechanisms, and Applications in Cancer Therapeutics](../publications/2be6dd396bdd87fa4c2a.md)

Heyi Zhang; Ben Shi; Lianzhen Li; Qinrui Fu; Zeyu Jiang

Cancer remains one of the leading causes of human death globally\. The capabilities of tumor cells for rapid proliferation, resistance to death, and metastasis have become major hurdles in the successful treatment of cancer\. Nanomotors, with distinct advantages such as tumor targeting and excellent biocompatibility, have emerged as a crucial research area in cancer therapy\. This type of nanoscale dynamic system can convert external energy sources like magnetic fields, light fields, and sound fields, as well as endogenous chemical energy such as hydrogen peroxide, into autonomously driven mechanical energy\. These distinctive motion characteristics remarkably enhance the penetration efficiency of nanocarriers into tumor tissue\. This offers a promising approach to overcome the physiological barriers of the tumor microenvironment and improve therapeutic efficacy\. In this review, the latest advancements in tumor treatment using nanomotors are systematically summarized\. The content encompasses the preparation strategies, driving mechanisms, and therapeutic applications, providing crucial references for the further development of nanomotors in the field of cancer treatment\.

## [Identification of plasma lipids as non\-invasive signatures for metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease](../publications/2bf82fe901c7ae55f166.md)

Ali Khan; Rajan; Dipankar Malakar; Kiran Maan; Sagnik Biswas; Sabreena Shafi Sheikh; Avinash Bajaj; S\. Shalimar; Ishaan Gupta; Ujjaini Dasgupta

Metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease \(MASLD\) has emerged as the leading cause of chronic liver diseases worldwide, which may progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma \(HCC\)\. To address this growing public health concern, non\-invasive diagnostic approaches are needed to identify individuals with MASLD for early detection\. We used a liquid chromatography\-mass spectrometry\-based method to quantify plasma lipid species from 99 samples collected from individuals with MASLD \(No\-MASH, n = 35; MASH, n = 43\) and healthy individuals \( n = 21\) from All India Institute of Medical Sciences \(AIIMS\) and National Liver Disease Biobank \(NLDB\) at Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences \(ILBS\), New Delhi, India, between 2021 and 2024\. We performed statistical analysis to identify lipid signatures, which were confirmed by machine learning \(ML\) model \(Random Forest\)\. Here, we identified 10 lipid signatures for No\-MASH and 8 lipid signatures for MASH to distinguish respective groups from healthy individuals, and additionally, 2 lipid signatures that distinguish individuals with No\-MASH from MASH on the discovery set \( n = 69\) with subsequent confirmation on the internal validation set \( n = 30\) using statistical analysis\. Using these signature lipids, ML model achieved combined AUC of 1\.0 \(95% CI: 1\.00\-1\.00\) for healthy versus No\-MASH and healthy versus MASH comparisons, whereas an AUC of 0\.97 \(95% CI: 0\.89\-1\.00\) for No\-MASH versus MASH comparison\. This cross\-sectional study highlights remodelling of the MASLD lipidome and demonstrates the potential of plasma\-based lipids as non\-invasive signatures for disease stratification upon future validation in independent cohorts\.

## [Tree cover increases on agricultural land amid continued landscape\-level deforestation: a case study from eastern Afghanistan](../publications/2bf8982ed8498e705c1e.md)

Farzaneh Razmju; Baoling Gui; Lydia Sam; Anshuman Bhardwaj; Mohammad Waris Haider; Safiullah Khurram; John W\. Groninger; David F\. R\. P\. Burslem

Understanding changes in tree cover within agricultural landscapes is critical for assessing the resilience of rural communities and consequent land use dynamics in conflict\-affected regions\. This study examines spatiotemporal land use and tree cover changes across four districts of Nangarhar Province in eastern Afghanistan using high\-resolution \(3 m/pixel\) satellite imagery\. The temporal window examined for this study \(2016\-2024\) spans a period of significant geopolitical upheaval in Afghanistan, including the collapse of the republican government in 2021 and the resulting shift in political power and governance dynamics\. An object\-based image analysis framework combined with a support vector machine classifier was applied to map five land use classes within settlement areas: tree cover, cropland, water, built\-up areas, and barren land\. Classification accuracy was assessed using stratified random sampling and Cohen&\#x27;s kappa coefficient, with all maps achieving κ values above 0\.80\. Post\-classification change detection and transition matrices were used to quantify class\-to\-class conversions in hectares, while Sankey diagrams were employed to visualise the magnitude and direction of land use transitions\. The results reveal varying patterns of tree cover change across the study districts, with evidence of both tree cover gains linked to expansion of agroforestry and on\-farm tree retention, and losses driven by agricultural expansion and development\. These changes may influence local livelihoods, as trees on farms provide important resources such as fruit, fuelwood, and shade\. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating high\-resolution remote sensing, object\-based classification, and Sankey\-based visualisation for analysing complex land use dynamics\.

## [AVALIAÇÃO DA ARQUITETURA ESCOLAR PARA A EDUCAÇÃO INTEGRAL ATRAVÉS DE UM PERCURSO WALKTHROUGH](../publications/2c013dce3a8f2ac765a2.md)

Caroline Antunes; Alexandre Maurício Matiello; Nébora Lazzarotto Modler

Este trabalho apresenta resultados parciais de uma pesquisa sobre a relação entre arquitetura escolar e Educação em Tempo Integral, com foco na influência da configuração físico\-espacial sobre as práticas pedagógicas, as interações e a apropriação dos ambientes pelos usuários\. A pesquisa foi desenvolvida em uma escola estadual de ensino fundamental de Erechim/RS, participante do Programa Escola em Tempo Integral, identificada como Escola Araucária para preservação de sua identidade\. Adotou\-se uma abordagem qualitativa, fundamentada na Avaliação Pós\-Ocupação \(APO\), utilizando o percurso walkthrough como instrumento de investigação\. O procedimento envolveu observação sistemática dos ambientes, entrevista não estruturada com integrante da equipe gestora, fichas de inventário ambiental, registros fotográficos e coleta de percepções dos usuários\. Foram analisadas características relacionadas à materialidade, ventilação, iluminação, conforto térmico e acústico, mobiliário, infraestrutura e possibilidades de uso dos espaços\. Os resultados evidenciaram limitações relacionadas à insuficiência de ambientes para atividades coletivas e recreativas, às condições de ventilação e às esquadrias das salas de aula, além de potencialidades em ambientes de apoio pedagógico\. Conclui\-se que a infraestrutura física exerce influência direta sobre a efetivação da Educação em Tempo Integral, destacando\-se o walkthrough como instrumento relevante para diagnóstico e qualificação dos espaços escolares\.

## [Integrity\-gated Multimodal Attention\-capsule Fusion for Vehicle Coordination and Infrastructure Health Monitoring](../publications/2c0260c5778ea4b01c83.md)

Sunkavilli Vijaya Nirmala; Subhani Shaik; Yalla Venkat

Current vehicle\-to\-infrastructure \(V2I\) research increasingly relies on synchronized cooperative sensing, but no existing public benchmark was identified that simultaneously provides co\-referential vehicle targets and infrastructure\-health annotations for the joint problem studied here\.The proposed V2I\-MACF\-IG \(Integrity\-Gated Multimodal Attention\-Capsule Fusion for V2I coordination and infrastructure health monitoring\) is therefore evaluated as a proof\-of\-concept scenario\-paired learning framework rather than as a physically synchronized V2I validation\.Its methodological contribution is an integrity\-gated scenario\-pairing approach that partitions source scenes and sensor recordings before pairing, preserves source\-record independence, audits operating\-state compatibility, and prevents adjacent frames or windows from crossing data splits\.Vehicle\-side colour imagery, point clouds, trajectories, and inertial features are combined with infrastructure\-side vibration, acoustic, and environmental descriptors\.Scale\-Invariant Feature Transform \(SIFT\), Speeded\-Up Robust Features \(SURF\), PointNet, Fast Fourier Transform \(FFT\), and Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average \(ARIMA\) representations are projected to a common embedding, refined by dense\-residual channel/spatial attention, and routed through capsule layers to separate coordination and infrastructure\-health heads\.Across seeds 42, 123, and 2025, coordination accuracy/F1 was 0\.992 \+/\-0\.002/0\.988\+/\-0\.002 and maintenance accuracy/F1 was 0\.988 \+/\-0\.003/0\.983\+/\-0\.003, with a maintenance false\-alarm rate of 0\.037 \+/\-0\.002\.Missing\-modality, noise, delay, ablation, and vehicle\-side transfer tests show measurable degradation\.Recent V2X benchmarks from 2025\-2026 are used only for scope\-aware context because their datasets, tasks, labels, and metrics are not directly comparable\.The reported results support leakage\-controlled task\-coupled learning within the constructed scenario\-pairing protocol; pairing\-disruption controls \(random\-label, shuffled\-partner, cross\-class\) collapse to near\-chance performance and an independent infrastructure\-holdout evaluation shows only limited degradation, together supporting genuine cross\-modal dependence rather than label leakage\.The findings still do not establish physically synchronized or field\-deployed V2I cooperation, and a head\-to\-head comparison against a post\-2024 cooperative\-fusion baseline under an identical protocol remains outstanding\.

## [Digital branding strategies for marginalized tourism destinations](../publications/2c178719fe202e17d9ff.md)

Monika Ploch Palatková; Pavel Štrach; Eva Jaderná

This study explores whether digital branding can reduce socio\-economic disparities in marginalized tourism destinations\. Using a mixed\-methods comparative case study of Ostrava, Košice, and Glasgow, it analyses strategic tourism documents and digital infrastructure via BDC and RivalIQ tools\. Findings identify three mechanisms: visibility alone is ineffective without strategic links to community benefits; stakeholder co\-creation works moderately when structured but lacks platforms for resident\-visitor interaction; ecosystem alignment – combining resident\-focused planning, measurement systems, and workforce programs – is essential\. Identical digital tools yield different outcomes depending on governance models and strategic intent\. The study concludes that digital branding supports equity only when strategies prioritize community benefits, enable authentic local storytelling, and include comprehensive impact tracking\. It extends destination branding theory by challenging the visitor\-centric paradigm, arguing that residents must be the primary beneficiaries\. The research contributes to tourism policy by highlighting the need for inclusive digital strategies that integrate local voices, measure benefit distribution, and foster long\-term socio\-economic resilience in post\-industrial destinations\.

## [Practitioner perceptions of human factors contributing to DNA contamination risk in forensic practice: a cross\-sectional survey](../publications/2c2a373fc19667750c82.md)

Salem K Alketbi; Fatima S\. Ahmed

Abstract Background Modern forensic DNA methods can recover low\-level, trace, and mixed profiles, increasing the importance of contamination control, background DNA, and secondary\-transfer\-aware interpretation\. This cross\-sectional online survey of 100 forensic practitioners, contextualised by a targeted narrative literature search, examined perceived human\-factor risks, contamination\-event experience, and prevention priorities\. Responses were analysed descriptively, and each open\-ended response was grouped according to its principal recommendation\. Results Retained aggregate mean Likert ratings were 4\.58 for workload, 4\.51 for fatigue, 4\.46 for time pressure, 4\.42 for improper glove changes, 4\.39 for personal protective equipment \(PPE\) non\-compliance, 4\.31 for interruptions and distractions, 4\.25 for communication failures, and 4\.20 for staffing shortages\. Sixty\-two of 100 respondents reported witnessing or being involved in a DNA contamination incident, and 81 of 100 reported observing a near\-miss\. Among the 62 respondents reporting contamination\-event experience, workload was the most frequently identified primary contributor \(29\.0%\), followed by PPE non\-compliance \(21\.0%\), communication failures \(16\.1%\), improper glove changes \(12\.9%\), time pressure \(11\.3%\), laboratory layout or workspace constraints \(6\.5%\), and other factors \(3\.2%\)\. Open\-ended responses \( n = 100\) emphasised workload management \(44%\), training and competency \(27%\), communication and team coordination \(16%\), and quality culture and reporting \(13%\)\. Conclusions Practitioners perceived DNA contamination as a socio\-technical quality issue shaped by interacting operational, behavioural, organisational, and environmental conditions\. The author\-developed, survey\-informed Human\-Factor DNA Contamination Framework is presented as a non\-scored, non\-predictive, and unvalidated conceptual aid for structured risk review and future empirical assessment\.

## [Baba Odaklı Reklamcılık \(Dadvertising\) Bağlamında Dönüşen Ebeveynlik: Reklam Filmleri Üzerine Nitel Bir İçerik Analizi](../publications/2c33ea15d1ca5975b8b9.md)

Maşide Karaca; Sadık ÇALIŞKAN

Günümüzde reklamcılık pratiklerinde babalık; sadece “otoriter, ekonomik sorumluluğu üstlenen” değil; aynı zamanda eşit ebeveynlik sorumluluğu üstlenmiş olan, çocuğunun gelişimine aktif katılan, duygusal bakım üstlenen bir kimlik olarak yeniden inşa edilmektedir\. Bu çalışma, baba odaklı reklamcılıkta \(dadvertising\), babalığın post\-feminist reklam anlayışı çerçevesinde hangi temsil biçimleri aracılığıyla kurgulanıp değişen erkeklik normlarının reklam anlatılarına nasıl yansıdığını analiz etmeyi amaçlamaktadır\. Çalışma, nitel araştırma yaklaşımı çerçevesinde tasarlanarak veri çözümleme sürecinde nitel içerik analizi yöntemi kullanılmıştır\. Bu doğrultuda amaçlı örnekleme yöntemiyle seçilen babalık temalı yedi adet reklam filmi analiz edilmiş; söylemsel ve görsel göstergeler tematik kategoriler altında değerlendirilmiştir\. Yapılan analiz sonucunda reklamlarda babalık temsiline yönelik; eşit ebeveynlik, rehber baba, duygusal babalık, destekleyici baba, bakım gösteren baba, modern babalık ve koruyucu babalık olmak üzere yedi temel tema belirlenmiştir\. İki bağımsız araştırmacı tarafından yürütülen kodlama sürecinde Miles ve Huberman güvenirlik formülü kullanılmış ve kodlayıcılar arası uyum %91 olarak hesaplanmıştır\. Analiz sonucunda, dadvertising bağlamında babalığın, sadece geçim sağlayan ebeveyn rolü ve otorite rollerinin yerine çocuk gelişiminde aktif sorumluluk üstlenen, bakım emeğine katılan, eşine destek veren ve duygusal yakınlık kuran bir kimlik üzerinden temsil edildiği bulgularına rastlanmıştır\. Ayrıca markalar tarafından babalık temasının duygusal tüketim anlatılarıyla ilişkilendirildiği gözlemlenmiştir\. Sonuç olarak, reklam söylemlerinde geleneksel babalık temalarından uzaklaşılarak daha eşitlikçi ve kapsayıcı figür doğrultusunda yeniden kurgulandığı ortaya konmaktadır\.

## [Element interaction manifolds for comparative analysis of geometric representations in protein\-ligand recognition](../publications/2c355070895bb9f59730.md)

Alireza Shahi; Md Masud Rana; Duc Duy Nguyen

Accurate modeling of protein–ligand interactions requires representations that capture both molecular geometry and chemically specific interactions\. Existing approaches encode molecular recognition through several geometric formalisms, including differential geometry and spherical harmonic surface descriptors such as three\-dimensional Zernike descriptors \(3DZD\)\. However, the relative roles of local curvature, surface area, volume, global shape, and chemical partitioning in protein–ligand recognition remain insufficiently understood\. In this work, we present a unified geometric study centered on the Element Interaction Manifold \(EIM\) framework\. We integrate element\-interactive curvature, surface\-area, and volume descriptors into a common representation and comparatively evaluate their roles in binding\-affinity prediction and ligand\-aware protein–ligand complex recognition\. To place differential geometry in context, we compare EIM with standard 3DZD and a chemically partitioned extension termed element\-pair 3DZD \(EP\-3DZD\)\. Across PDBbind/CASF\-2016 affinity prediction and unsupervised ligand\-aware recognition tasks, chemically resolved interaction geometry provides strong predictive performance\. Chemical partitioning improves the Zernike\-based representation relative to standard global 3DZD, whereas combining Zernike descriptors with Hybrid EIM produces only small numerical gains, indicating limited additional complementarity under the evaluated protocols\. Additional robustness and control analyses support the stability of the affinity\-prediction results and clarify the contribution of shared ligand identity to the ligand\-aware recognition task\. Overall, these results support chemically resolved geometric information as an interpretable and informative representation for protein–ligand modeling\.

## [BTSR\-Net: Boundary–topology guided structural refinement for high\-resolution remote sensing image segmentation](../publications/2c3b35286fac584676f4.md)

Ziheng Wang; Wu Wang; Zhe Hu; Yang Li; Kejia Ma

Semantic segmentation of high\-resolution remote sensing imagery in complex urban scenes often suffers from insufficient modeling of boundary neighborhoods, causing ambiguity near class interfaces and weakening the continuity of elongated structures\. To address this issue, we propose a Boundary\-Topology\-Guided Structural Refinement Network \(BTSR\-Net\)\. Built upon HRNet\-OCR, BTSR\-Net introduces a Geometric Boundary\-Distance Branch \(GBD\) with joint boundary\-distance supervision to capture spatial transitions around class boundaries, a Multi\-scale Topology\-Guided Structural Fusion \(MTSF\) module to enhance connectivity representation of elongated structures, and a dual\-stream structural refinement mechanism to perform local residual correction within a boundary\-distance\-defined refinement narrow\-band\. Experiments on the ISPRS Potsdam and Vaihingen datasets demonstrate improvements in overall segmentation accuracy, boundary quality, and structural connectivity\. On Potsdam, BTSR\-Net achieves 84\.70% mIoU, 43\.17% mBIoU, and 81\.63% clDice, exceeding the baseline by 2\.91, 5\.66, and 3\.74 percentage points, respectively\. On Vaihingen, it achieves 93\.94% mIoU, 73\.90% mBIoU, and 95\.46% clDice, with corresponding improvements of 2\.27, 9\.39, and 2\.12 percentage points\. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of BTSR\-Net for structure\-sensitive semantic segmentation in high\-resolution remote sensing imagery\.

## [What Can a Representation Support? Generative Artificial Intelligence and Professional Knowing in Practice](../publications/2c3cec2e8c14e8aca706.md)

Charlotte Arkenback\-Sundström; Andreas Stenberg; Martina Wyszynska Johansson

Abstract Generative Artificial Intelligence \(GenAI\) is increasingly embedded in professional university work, yet its significance cannot be inferred from individual prompts, outputs or nominal categories of use\. This study examines how differently organised professional practices shape what practitioners do with GenAI and what changes, persists, or is reopened as GenAI\-mediated work becomes part of continuing professional projects\. Drawing on practitioner\-led collaborative action research and the theory of practice architectures, we analyse a longitudinal corpus of documented GenAI\-mediated interaction embedded in continuing professional projects across assessment and calibration, course development, validation and credit transfer, practicum supervision, academic supervision, and scholarly work\. The findings show that professional knowing was practice\-specific: what practitioners needed to distinguish and judge differed with professional project and practice architectures\. Cross\-practice comparison identified recurring but overlapping configurations linking professional grounds, material conditions and situated responsibility, while analytical work could be distributed to GenAI without professional mandate becoming symmetrical\. Longitudinally, earlier GenAI\-mediated formulations and documents could persist, be reopened, recontextualised or become consequential for later practising\. Locally coherent generative work could also cease to serve a wider professional project without becoming factually false\. The study therefore complicates accounts of human oversight centred on final output verification\. Professional judgement was enacted throughout collaboration through negotiation, restriction, attribution, reopening, and project\-level monitoring\. The findings further suggest that disclosure categories or preserved chat histories do not by themselves make GenAI participation inspectable, raising implications for scholarly disclosure, student assessment, and the design of accountable AI\-mediated knowledge work\.

## [Reinterpreting Ḥadīd in Q\.S\. Al\-Ḥadīd \[57\]: 25](../publications/2c4b5d9d4984788d0f87.md)

Muhammad Hafidhul Ihsan; Wali Ramadhani

This article is motivated by the differing interpretations of the term ḥadīd and its associated manāfi‘ in Q\.S\. Al\-Ḥadīd \[57\]: 25 among classical and modern Muslim scholars\. Classical scholars interpreted the term ḥadīd as iron used for armour and weapons of war, whereas later scholars understood the term ḥadīd as iron that serves as the foundation for industrial development and as a basis for the prosperity and strength of nations\. Stemming from this difference in interpretation, the terms ḥadīd and manāfi‘ carry the potential for polysemic meaning, allowing them to be understood in various contexts\. This research adopts a library research design using contextual interpretation methods and descriptive\-analytical analysis\. Through Abdullah Saeed’s contextual linguistic analysis—examining the historical context surrounding the identification of universal ethical principles and interpreting contemporary realities to derive a more holistic meaning—the research reveals that the term ḥadīd in Q\.S\. Al\-Ḥadīd \[57\]: 25 is not merely understood as iron in the material sense; rather, it represents strength, means of defense, technology, and instruments for the advancement of human civilization\. In the contemporary context, this meaning may be understood as symbolizing technological development, which should be utilized in a just, responsible, and human welfare\-oriented manner\. Accordingly, Q\.S\. Al\-Ḥadīd \[57\]: 25 provides us with an ethical basis that technology should not be employed as a means of destruction, oppression, or exploitation but should instead be directed towards promoting justice and social welfare\.

## [Влияние технологических изменений в ИТ\-сфере на отраслевую структуру экономики](../publications/2c4d90fd16469032de32.md)

Larisa Sazanova; Н\.А\. Зенков

Данное исследование посвящено актуальной теме структурной трансформации экономики, вызванной внедрением передовых ИТ\-решений и развитием систем искусственного интеллекта\. Рассмотрена взаимосвязь между достижениями в ИТ\-секторе и изменениями структуры отраслей вследствие снижения издержек при внедрении ИТ и повышения скорости и качества принятия решений\. Выявлены ключевые драйверы технологических изменений, определяющие темпы отраслевой адаптации, а также обозначены некоторые последствия цифрового неравенства\. Отмечены такие тенденции, как возникновение новых рыночных сегментов и изменение роли человеческого капитала в условиях технологических сдвигов\. Проведенный анализ подтверждает инфраструктурное значение ИТ: происходит переход бизнеса от модели реакции на событие к модели предиктивного управления\. This study addresses the topical issue of the structural transformation of the economy driven by the implementation of advanced IT solutions and the development of artificial intelligence systems\. The relationship between achievements in the IT sector and changes in industrial structures – driven by reduced costs associated with IT implementation and improved speed and quality of decision\-making is examined\. The key drivers of technological change determining the pace of industry adaptation have been identified, and certain consequences of the digital divide have been outlined\. Trends such as the emergence of new market segments and the changing role of human capital amidst technological shifts have been noted\. The analysis confirms the infrastructural importance of IT: business is shifting from an event\-reactive model to a predictive management model\.

## [Refusal Is Not Robustness: Measuring Harmful Reachability in Autoregressive Language Models](../publications/2c60b40d526281135ae3.md)

Parv Kapoor; Teresa Fortes; Claudia Mamede; Rui Abreu; Jonathan Aldrich; Eunsuk Kang

LLM safety evaluations via jailbreaking typically index on attack success rate \(ASR\): whether a generated response violates safeguards\. However, ASR only evaluates sampled outputs and provides little information on the underlying generation process\. Autoregressive language models define distributions over possible outputs, and a sampled refusal can coexist with substantial probability mass on harmful generation paths\. We study this hidden structure through bounded continuation analysis \(BCA\), which models autoregressive generation as a stochastic process over token prefixes and computes the finite\-horizon probability that generation reaches a harmful continuation\. BCA constructs a bounded continuation tree, labels terminal continuations with a semantic harm evaluator, and estimates harmful reachability using exact probabilistic model checking\. BCA complements ASR by measuring how much harmful behavior remains accessible beneath a sampled safe response\. This makes it useful for distinguishing models that look identical under measured ASR values, and allocating red\-team effort toward regions of the generation process with greater hidden risk\. Across four instruction\-tuned LLMs and 100 JailbreakBench behaviors, we show that BCA effectively quantifies hidden harmful behavior and provides a useful signal to guide red teaming\.

## [Perlindungan Hukum Hak Kekayaan Intelektual Pelaku Usaha Mikro Kreatif Dalam Pemanfaatan Artificial Intelligence](../publications/2c668884b19f61b2e2c0.md)

Mastriati Hini Hermala Dewi; Herma Diana

Pemanfaatan Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) generatif menawarkan efisiensi bagi usaha mikro kreatif dalam memproduksi materi pemasaran dan desain digital\. Namun, hal ini memicu persoalan hukum terkait pelindungan Hak Kekayaan Intelektual \(HKI\) dan risiko pelanggaran hak cipta pihak ketiga\. Kegiatan pengabdian ini bertujuan meningkatkan kesadaran hukum pelaku usaha mikro dalam memanfaatkan AI secara aman serta membekali keterampilan mitigasi risiko HKI\. Metode pelaksanaan mencakup sosialisasi, diskusi interaktif, studi kasus, simulasi, dan pendampingan strategi pelindungan aset\. Materi berfokus pada konsep dasar hak cipta, kedudukan karya berbasis AI, ketentuan lisensi platform, dokumentasi proses kreatif, serta strategi perlindungan merek\. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan peningkatan pemahaman peserta secara signifikan, khususnya terkait perbedaan penggunaan AI sebagai alat bantu versus hasil mesin murni, pentingnya modifikasi manusia, serta perlunya pendaftaran merek untuk mengamankan aset bisnis\. Secara keseluruhan, program ini membuktikan bahwa peningkatan literasi hukum HKI harus berjalan seiring dengan literasi digital agar pelaku usaha mikro dapat mengoptimalkan produktivitas AI sekaligus meminimalisir risiko sengketa hukum\.

## [Inclusión educativa e interculturalidad en la integración académica de estudiantes universitarios amazónicos](../publications/2c6a71192208bc85b3f9.md)

Mery Nora Atencio Rivera

Context: Educational inclusion and interculturality in the academic integration of Amazonian university students are examined against the mismatch between inclusive policies and Indigenous worldviews in Peru&\#x27;s central Amazon region\. Objective: To examine how inclusion strategies predict academic integration and how interculturality moderates this relationship\. Methods: An explanatory sequential mixed\-methods design \(QUAN → QUAL\) was adopted\. The quantitative phase employed partial least squares structural equation modeling \(PLS\-SEM\) with N = 380 students, while the qualitative phase used a multiple\-case study \(n = 12\)\. Results: Inclusion strategies positively and significantly predicted academic integration \(β = 0\.141, p = 0\.003\), and interculturality moderated this relationship \(β = 0\.170, p = 0\.004\)\. The effect reached a substantive magnitude only at high levels of interculturality \(β = 0\.309, p &lt; 0\.001\)\. Qualitative evidence revealed that, without epistemic recognition, these strategies operate as performative inclusion\. Conclusions: Interculturality is associated with variations in the relationship between inclusion and integration, suggesting that inclusive strategies function as bridges or barriers to academic integration in Amazonian higher education\.

## [A Study on Consumer Buying Behavior Towards FMCG Products in Selected Districts of Karnataka](../publications/2c6d84fd6296ecc969c7.md)

Nisha P\.V\.; Chaithra D\.; Sowmya V\.

The Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods \(FMCG\) sector plays a vital role in economic development and consumer welfare by providing essential products for everyday consumption\. Consumer buying behaviour in this sector is influenced by various factors, including price, product quality, brand reputation, packaging, availability, promotional offers, lifestyle preferences, and digital marketing\. In India, economic liberalization, urbanization, technological advancements, and the expansion of organized retailing and e\-commerce have significantly transformed consumer purchasing patterns\. Karnataka represents a diverse consumer market comprising metropolitan, semi\-urban, and rural populations with varying consumption preferences and purchasing habits\. The present study aims to examine consumer buying behaviour towards FMCG products in selected districts of Karnataka, with particular emphasis on identifying the major factors influencing purchase decisions, understanding consumer preferences and brand selection criteria, and assessing the influence of changing socioeconomic and technological conditions on purchasing patterns\. The study also seeks to understand the growing importance of product quality, price sensitivity, health consciousness, convenience, promotional strategies, and digital platforms in shaping consumer choices\. The findings are expected to provide valuable insights for FMCG manufacturers, retailers, and marketers in developing effective marketing strategies, improving customer satisfaction, strengthening brand loyalty, and responding to evolving consumer needs\. The study will also contribute to a better understanding of regional variations in consumer behaviour and support the development of consumer\-oriented strategies for sustainable growth in the competitive FMCG market\.

## [Clinician\-Facing Artificial Intelligence\-Based Clinical Decision Support Systems Evaluated in Real\-World Health Care Settings: A PubMed/MEDLINE\-Based, PMC\-Weighted Scoping Review and Evidence Map](../publications/2c6f980d2c5b9d7fc185.md)

Pınar Özel; Ali Olamat

Background: Clinician\-facing artificial intelligence\-based clinical decision support systems \(AI\-CDSSs\) are increasingly evaluated with real\-world data, but evidence on implementation, human factors, responsible AI, and patient benefit remains unclear\. The objective of this research is to map applications, technical characteristics, evaluation approaches, integration, outcomes, and implementation gaps of clinician\-facing AI\-CDSSs in real\-world health care settings\. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE was searched on 15 June 2026 using the same strategy for each publication year from 2020 to 2026, changing only the date range\. After duplicate removal and rule\-based prescreening, available PMC XML and outside\-PMC reports were evaluated against clinical, patient\-oriented, practical, and translational criteria\. AI\-assisted screening and charting received targeted human review and TA200/FT150/DX120 quality control; full\-corpus dual\-human screening was not performed\. Results: Of 14,097 canonical annual records, 14,083 unique records were screened; 5140 reports were sought and 3767 were considered for eligibility\. The review included 1181 reports, mapping to 1180 candidate report families in the minimal duplicate\-report check\. Final stages were clinical validation, 741 \(62\.7%\); prospective/user evaluation, 270 \(22\.9%\); and implementation/impact evaluation, 170 \(14\.4%\)\. Separate internal, external, multicenter and temporal validation extraction signals were detected in 707 \(59\.9%\), 441 \(37\.3%\), 312 \(26\.4%\) and 27 \(2\.3%\) reports, respectively\. Safety, fairness/equity, explainability/interpretability and economic/resource evaluation signals were detected in 98 \(8\.3%\), 61 \(5\.2%\), 155 \(13\.1%\) and 182 \(15\.4%\) reports, respectively\. Conclusions: Evidence remains dominated by validation rather than prospective, implementation, and impact studies\. More comprehensive evaluation and reporting of temporal validation, technical integration, safety, fairness, explainability, economics, and post\-deployment governance across settings, populations, devices, and clinical workflows are needed to demonstrate accountable clinical value beyond technical functionality\.

## [The Protective Action Decision‐Making Process in Emergency Responses During and After Earthquake Tremors: Qualitative Findings From the Elazığ and İzmir Earthquakes](../publications/2c6facad90fa8588d013.md)

Mazlum Çelik; Ahmet Ayaz; Mustafa Batuhan Kurtoğlu; Furkan Baltacı; Cemile Gökçe Özmen; Bilal Çayır; Hilal YAKUT İPEKOĞLU; Burcu Gürkan; Sinem Küçükyılmaz; Hikmet Çağrı YARDIMCI; Şeyma Sevgican

Understanding behavioral responses during and immediately after an earthquake is critical to reducing injuries and developing preparedness strategies\. This study identifies response patterns under seismic threat using qualitative evidence from the 2020 Elazığ and İzmir earthquakes in Türkiye\. Data were collected from 63 participants through semistructured individual interviews and family‐based focus group discussions\. Responses were examined in three temporally distinct phases: \(1\) onset of the tremor, \(2\) intensification, and \(3\) immediate post‐tremor period\. During the tremor, reported behaviors clustered around four dominant patterns: movement toward exits or open spaces under acute fear, freezing or waiting, improvised protective action, and moving toward vulnerable individuals\. These responses were shaped by real‐time threat cues, including perceived shaking intensity, environmental noise, falling objects, perceived building danger, and the visible reactions of others\. As the tremor intensified, increased perceived risk was associated with evacuation attempts, continued immobility, or delayed action under uncertainty\. In several instances, participants remained in place because they perceived movement through stairs, exits, or enclosed spaces as dangerous\. Initial postearthquake responses were characterized by movement toward perceived safe areas, attempts to contact relatives, and spontaneous helping behaviors toward nearby individuals\. The findings suggest that earthquake response is shaped by dynamic threat interpretation, fear transmission through social cues, family responsibility, and socially mediated coordination\. Interpreted through the Protective Action Decision Model and Emerging Norm Theory, the results highlight how behavioral responses evolve through the interaction between environmental signals, social cues, and emergent coordination\. The study provides empirically based insights for improving preparedness messages, promoting contextually sensitive protective actions, strengthening household coordination strategies, and enhancing immediate postearthquake communication planning\.
