## [Bilimsel Araştırmalar İçin Google Trends Veri Kullanımı Üzerine Teknik Bir Not](../publications/2c74297c0c7752727b7c.md)

Aytaç Burak Dereli

Google Trends \(GT\), anahtar sözcüklere, arama terimlerine ve konulara yönelik göreli aramailgisinin zamansal ve coğrafi dağılımını incelemeye olanak sağlayan bir dijital veri analizi aracıdır\. Kullanıcıların arama davranışlarına dayanan veriler, toplumsalilginin ve gündemdekideğişimlerin yorumlanmasında kullanılabilmektedir\. İlgili verilerin bilimsel araştırmalarda nasıl kullanılacağına ilişkin teknik ilkeler, veri üretme mantığı, örnekleme yapısı ve analiz tekniklerini bütüncül şekilde ele alan yöntem odaklı çalışmalar oldukça sınırlıdır\. Çalışmada, dijitalleşmeyle birlikte bilimsel araştırmalar için yeni bir veri kaynağı hâline gelen GT’nin kullanımının teknik ve yöntemsel açıdan değerlendirilmesi amaçlanmaktadır\. Çalışma GT’nin arama motoru eğilimini ortaya koyan bir araç olmasından ziyade kullanıcı davranışlarını, toplumsal ilgiyi ve dijital eğilimleri yansıtan büyük veri temelli bir gösterge sistemi olduğunu ortaya koymaktadır\.Araştırma, nitel araştırma yaklaşımı kapsamında doküman incelemesine dayalı teknik not niteliğinde tasarlanmıştır\. Çalışmada,GT’nin veri üretim mantığı, örnekleme ve normalizasyon süreçleri, veri sorgulama türleri, analiz boyutları ve farklı disiplinlerdeki kullanım biçimleri ele alınmaktadır\. Araştırmada ilk olarak GT’nin zaman, bölge, kategori ve arama davranışı filtreleriaracılığıyla çok katmanlı veri analizi yapılmasına olanak sağladığı vurgulanarak zaman serisi analizleri, korelasyon analizleri, mekânsal dağılım incelemeleri, nedensellik testleri ve tematik analizler gibi farklı analitik yaklaşımların GT verileriyle kullanılabileceği ortaya konulmaktadır\. Çalışma kapsamında alanyazın taraması ile ekonomi, sağlık, iletişim, finans, sürdürülebilirlik ve sosyal politika gibi farklı disiplinlerden örnek araştırmalar incelenerek GT’nin bilimsel bir veri kaynağı niteliği taşıdığıgösterilmektedir\.GT verilerinin tek başına mutlak gerçekliğin göstergesi olarak kabul edilmemesi ve daha güvenilir sonuçlara ulaşmak amacıyla verilerin birden fazla kez elde edilerek destekleyici veri kaynaklarıyla birlikte kullanılması gerektiği sonucuna ulaşılmaktadır\.Çalışmada, GT’nin bilimsel araştırmalar için güçlü bir dijital veri kaynağı sunduğu ve bu verilerin dikkatli, yöntemsel açıdan kontrollü biçimde analiz edilmesi gerektiği ortaya konulmaktadır\.

## [AI\-Based Traffic flow optimization system using computer vision: research design and prototype](../publications/2c7779ef3014feca2a39.md)

Tarun Sharma; Chitransh Nagar

AI\-Based Traffic Flow Optimization System Using Computer Vision: Research Design and Prototype Abstract Urban traffic congestion contributes to increased travel time, fuel consumption, and road\-safety challenges\. Conventional fixed\-time traffic signal systems may not respond efficiently to changing traffic demand\. This project presents the design of an AI\-based traffic flow optimization system using computer vision to support traffic monitoring, vehicle detection, traffic density estimation, vehicle tracking, and adaptive traffic signal recommendations\. Objectives The primary objectives are to: Detect and count vehicles from traffic video footage using computer vision\. Estimate traffic density across different approaches at an intersection\. Analyze traffic conditions to identify congestion and potential incidents\. Develop a density\-aware signal allocation approach that responds to changing traffic demand\. Explore emergency vehicle prioritization and traffic\-performance evaluation\. Methodology The proposed system integrates computer vision, vehicle detection, tracking, traffic density analysis, and signal optimization into a unified monitoring framework\. Traffic observations are processed to estimate vehicle counts and congestion levels\. These estimates can inform signal\-duration recommendations, subject to appropriate operational and safety constraints\. The research workflow also includes dataset inspection, data cleaning, source documentation, and an experimental comparison framework\. Potential evaluation metrics include vehicle\-counting accuracy, average waiting time, queue length, throughput, and fairness across traffic approaches\. Research Contribution The project provides an integrated prototype for investigating computer\-vision\-based traffic management\. Its contribution lies in combining traffic observation, density analysis, adaptive signal recommendations, and research\-oriented data\-quality tools within a single system\. The framework is intended to support further experimentation and reproducible evaluation of intelligent transportation approaches\. Data Sources and Limitations Official road\-safety statistics from published government sources are used to provide historical context for Jaipur and Rajasthan, with geographic scope identified separately\. The demonstration intersection dataset contains synthetic records for testing the data\-processing workflow; it is not a collection of measured Jaipur traffic observations\. The current prototype does not establish experimentally validated reductions in real\-world waiting time, congestion, fuel consumption, or emissions\. Such claims require verified traffic observations, documented experimental conditions, and controlled comparisons against a fixed\-time baseline\. Future Scope Future work includes collecting authorized traffic\-video observations from selected Jaipur intersections, validating vehicle\-detection accuracy against manually annotated samples, evaluating signal\-allocation strategies under comparable demand conditions, and reporting statistical uncertainty and limitations\. Keywords Computer Vision; Intelligent Transportation Systems; Traffic Flow Optimization; Vehicle Detection; Vehicle Tracking; Traffic Density Estimation; Adaptive Traffic Signal Control; Road Safety; Jaipur; Artificial Intelligence\.

## [Forensic Handwriting Identification Using Chicken Swarm Optimization\-Enhanced Convolutional Neural Networks](../publications/2c8504cb37337a4f34ce.md)

Olufemi S\. Ojo; Mayowa Oyedepo Oyediran; Janet Olubunmi Jooda; Sunday Adeola Ajagbe; Olufemi Adeyanju Awodoye; Adeyinka Kabir Akanbi

Forensic handwriting identification plays a pivotal role in criminal investigations and legal proceedings, requiring accurate and reliable techniques for analyzing handwriting samples\. Convolutional Neural Networks \(CNNs\) are effective at feature extraction and classification for handwriting analysis, but their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of architectural hyperparameters, and manually tuned CNNs are prone to overfitting on forensic handwriting data\. This study integrates the Chicken Swarm Optimization \(CSO\) algorithm with a CNN classifier \(CSO\-CNN\) to automatically search the number of convolutional layers, the number and size of filters, and the batch size that minimize overfitting and maximize recognition accuracy\. Handwritten samples were collected from staff and students of Ajayi Crowther University, Oyo, Nigeria, and organized into three variants \(Original, Disguised, and Forged\) with each variant split into training and test sets \(72% and 28%, respectively\) using a random\-sampling hold\-out procedure\. CSO searched 30 candidate CNN configurations over the number of convolutional layers \(1–3\), the number of filters, the filter size, and the batch size, using recognition rate as the fitness function; the best\-performing configuration used a single convolutional layer with 128 filters of size 3×3 and a batch size of 256\. The resulting CSO\-CNN model was compared against a standard, non\-optimized CNN using accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, false positive rate, and recognition time\. CSO\-CNN outperformed the standard CNN on every dataset variant: on the original dataset, accuracy improved from 82\.14% to 86\.43%; on the Disguised dataset, from 85\.00% to 87\.86%; and on the Forged dataset, from 83\.57% to 89\.29%, while recognition time was also reduced in all three cases\. These results indicate that CSO\-based hyperparameter search can meaningfully improve CNN\-based forensic handwriting identification without requiring architectural redesign\. As the evaluation reported here is based on a single hold\-out split, repeated cross\-validation and testing on independently collected datasets are recommended as a next step to confirm the statistical robustness and generalizability of these gains\.

## [Influence of differential structural deformation on pore structure and fractal characteristics of shale reservoirs: a case study of the Longmaxi Formation in the Yongchuan area, South Sichuan Basin](../publications/2c8d9d03ae4c902881e1.md)

Xiaoxia Dong; Nanxi Zhang; Baobao Wang; Tong Wang; Meiyan Fu; Jiasui Ouyang

In complex structural settings, clarifying the influence of differential structural deformation on reservoir pore systems is crucial for shale gas exploration\. This study investigates the shale reservoirs of the first member of the Longmaxi Formation in the Yongchuan area of the Sichuan Basin, with emphasis on the effects of differential structural deformation on pore characteristics and their fractal properties\. Mineral composition, pore types, pore structures, and gas content were analyzed using X\-ray diffraction \(XRD\), petrographic thin\-section observation, scanning electron microscopy \(SEM\), and low\-temperature nitrogen adsorption experiments\. The shale is predominantly siliceous, rich in quartz and clay minerals, and highly brittle, favoring fracture development\. Variations in structural deformation across different structural units lead to distinct pore types, pore structures, and fractal characteristics\. Weakly deformed areas \(synclines\) are dominated by organic pores and relatively simple pore networks, whereas strongly deformed areas \(anticlines and fault blocks\) exhibit inorganic pores, microfractures, and composite pores with complex networks and higher fractal dimensions\.These findings indicate that structural deformation not only alters pore geometry but also significantly affects the fractal scaling of the pore system, thereby controlling shale gas enrichment\. The study provides a theoretical framework for the efficient exploration and development of shale gas in complex structural settings\.

## [Effects of climate change on marine biodiversity on the western Atlantic coast](../publications/2c9bc399fbde58b666f6.md)

Ubirajara Oliveira; Fernanda Azevedo; Alan Dias; ANA C\.S\. ALMEIDA; André R\. Senna; António Carlos Marques; Dafinny Rezende; Eduardo Hajdu; Erick Alves Pereira Lopes‐Filho; Fábio Bettini Pitombo; Gabriela Moura de Oliveira; João Gabriel Doria; João Luís Carraro; Joel Campos De‐Paula; Juliana Bahia; Juliana Magalhães de Araújo; Karla Paresque; Leandro Manzoni Vieira; Luanny Martins Fernandes; Micaele Niobe Martins Cardoso; Luciano Neves dos Santos; Lucília S\. Miranda; Michelle Klautau; Paulo Roberto Pagliosa; Pedro Henrique Braga Clerier; Rafael Bendayan de Moura; Rafael R\. Fortes; Raquel A\. F\. Neves; Rosana Moreira da Rocha; Sérgio N\. Stampar; Sula Salaní; Thaís Pires Miranda; Ulisses S\. Pinheiro; Virág Venekey

The current climate crisis, driven by greenhouse gas emissions, threatens global biodiversity, including that in marine ecosystems\. However, projections for the western Atlantic Ocean that jointly quantify species richness and endemism while accounting for spatially biased and incomplete occurrence data remain limited\. We addressed this gap across the western Atlantic from 57°S to 40°N, within 1500 km of the coast and on the continental shelf in waters shallower than 150 m\. Using broad taxonomic coverage across vertebrates, invertebrates, and algae, we modeled biodiversity metrics directly as species richness and the corrected weighted endemism index \(WEIc\), applied uniform sampling from sampling effort \(USSE\) to minimize the effects of spatially biased and incomplete occurrence records on predictions, and tested multiple algorithms to project these metrics under Shared Socioeconomic Pathway \(SSP\) scenarios SSP2\-4\.5 and SSP5\-8\.5 for 2050 and 2100\. The results indicated a significant reduction in species richness and endemism, with up to 69% of the study area projected to experience a reduction of more than 5% in species richness under the high\-emissions scenarios\. The most affected areas included the coast of Florida, the Gulf of Mexico, the Caribbean, the northern region of South America, and southern Brazil\. The decrease in endemism was equally concerning, with significant reductions predicted in areas of high diversity, threatening species adapted to specific ecological niches and increasing the risk of local extinctions\. Vertebrates and invertebrates showed the greatest reductions in richness in the Gulf of Mexico, the Caribbean, northeastern Brazil, and northern Argentina\. For algae, the most significant decreases were predicted for Florida and southern Brazil\. This loss of biodiversity could compromise the resilience of marine ecosystems and the availability of fishery resources, highlighting the urgent need for coordinated global actions\.

## [Artificial Intelligence for Classroom Teaching – Novel Applications, Challenges and Practical Review](../publications/2c9ef694490c6338ff45.md)

Yicheng Xiao

This article provides an organized overview and discussion on the use of AI for classroom teaching from an empirical perspective instead of reviewing opinions only\. Combined witha study of case reports on AIuse in real classrooms, the review findsfour main modes of usage: didactical feedback and teaching collaboration, virtual classrooms, and big data analytics\. The main problems can be grouped into three categories – technology integration, teaching practice, and subject adaptation\. The resultsindicate that a successful implementation of AI in education needs to align technology, pedagogy, and institutional support, although these resultsshould be considered tentative given that most work is based on small\-scale case studies and the rapidly changing nature of AI technology\. The reviewpresents an organized basis for future empirical research, but itmust acknowledge that drawing broad inferences from published works and examples can also lead us astray\.

## [Agentic Delegation Charter: A Preliminary Terminological and Governance Proposal](../publications/2cb203c020ace877da02.md)

Bertrand Laugeri

Abstract This research note introduces the proposed designation Agentic Delegation Charter \(ADC\), alongside its French equivalent, Charte de délégation agentique, within the research programme of Blooming Semantics Institute \(BSI\)\. Drawing on established project management principles, the proposal outlines a governance framework for successive delegations involving artificial intelligence agents\. Three interdependent principles are identified: recursive project governance, whereby each successive delegation is treated as a subordinate project subject to the overarching charter; terminological invariance and semantic continuity, supported by an authoritative project\-specific lexicon; and distributed authority, governed through explicit conditions of authorization, competence, accountability, and control\. The note also identifies challenges concerning semantic interpretation, the evolution of delegated authority, human oversight, and the temporal constraints of decision\-making\. Its purpose is to document a preliminary terminological and conceptual proposal dated 16 October 2026, without claiming exclusive authorship of the expression or establishing scientific originality prior to a comprehensive review of the literature\.

## [METODOLOGIAS ATIVAS E INOVAÇÃO PEDAGÓGICA: CONTRIBUIÇÕES PARA A FORMAÇÃO E O DESEMPENHO ACADÊMICO](../publications/2cb4a80f1815216bc7f8.md)

Raul Barreira dos Santos; Ordália Dias da Silva Guilherme; Adriana Demite Stephani

Este artigo apresenta uma reflexão sobre o uso das práticas inovadoras e das metodologias ativas como novas formas de ensinar e aprender na educação contemporânea\. A pesquisa, de caráter bibliográfico e abordagem qualitativa, teve como objetivo compreender como essas metodologias contribuem para a formação e o desempenho acadêmico dos estudantes\. A partir de autores como Moran, Freire, Dewey, Bacich e Perrenoud, foi possível perceber que as metodologias ativas colocam o aluno no centro do processo de aprendizagem, promovendo autonomia, criticidade e engajamento\. Observou\-se que estratégias como a sala de aula invertida, a aprendizagem baseada em projetos, a gamificação e a aprendizagem colaborativa favorecem o desenvolvimento de competências cognitivas, sociais e emocionais\. Destaca\-se, ainda, o papel da Inteligência Artificial como ferramenta emergente capaz de potencializar e personalizar tais práticas\. Constatou\-se que a inovação pedagógica não depende apenas do uso da tecnologia, mas da mudança de postura do professor, que passa a ser mediador e facilitador do conhecimento\.

## [Pengaruh Strategi Bisnis terhadap Kinerja Keuangan PT Telkom Indonesia \(Persero\) Tbk Periode 2021–2025](../publications/2cc24588be444cd2d064.md)

Ayu Larasati; Ria Aulia

This study aims to analyze the relationship between business strategy and the financial performance of PT Telkom Indonesia \(Persero\) Tbk during the 2021–2025 period\. Business strategy is operationalized through the Capex Ratio \(capital expenditure allocation\) and BOPO \(operational efficiency\), while financial performance is measured by Return on Assets \(ROA\) and Return on Equity \(ROE\)\. Using 20 quarterly observations, multiple linear regression analysis indicates that Capex Ratio and BOPO jointly have a statistically significant relationship with ROA \(F\-test ; \) and ROE \(F\-test ; \)\. For ROA, both indicators are individually significant at the 5% level, whereas their individual relationships with ROE are not statistically significant\. Diagnostic testing results show that several regression assumptions are not fully satisfied; thus, the findings should be interpreted as empirical associations rather than definitive causal effects\.

## [Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models](../publications/2ccdf561371a871ed88b.md)

Xiuhui Zhang; Ning Gao; Xingyu Jiang; Yihui Chen; Yuheng Pan; Mohan Zhang; Yue Deng

Traditional reinforcement learning \(RL\) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long\-term tasks with sparse rewards\. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models \(LLMs\) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation\. However, planning\-based approaches often depend on pre\-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low\-level control policies, while reward\-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks\. In this paper, we propose the Progress Reward Model for RL \(PRM4RL\), a novel framework that integrates task planning and dense reward to enhance RL\. For high\-level planning, a complex task is decomposed into a series of simple manageable subtasks, with a subtask\-oriented, fine\-grained progress function designed to monitor task execution progress\. For low\-level reward generation, inspired by potential\-based reward shaping, we use the progress function to construct a Progress Reward Model \(PRM\), providing theoretically grounded optimality and convergence guarantees, thereby enabling effective policy optimization\. Experimental results on robotics control tasks demonstrate that our approach outperforms both LLM\-based planning and reward methods, achieving state\-of\-the\-art performance\. Code is available at https://github\.com/deng\-ai\-lab/PRM4RL\.

## [The Ministry of The Interior’s Regulatory Initiatives Regarding the Administration of Ottoman Prisons \(1880–1897\)](../publications/2cdaaa9e2721d9dd113d.md)

Faysal Uzkan; Besim Özcan

In the Ottoman Empire, the changes and transformations that took place in various state institutions following the Tanzimat were also strongly felt in the legal sphere\. Developments in this area significantly impacted the administration of prisons\. Moreover, with the increasing prevalence of imprisonment, prisons came to the forefront not only as spaces that restricted freedom but also in terms of their administrative, legal, financial and physical aspects\. The central government intervened directly in these areas through the regulations it enacted\. This study evaluates the initiatives undertaken by the Ministry of the Interior between 1880 and 1897 to transform prisons into a more institutionalized, systematic and controllable structure\. The content of these initiatives is evident from official documents recorded in the Ottoman archives\. During the aforementioned period, the Ministry of the Interior undertook numerous initiatives regarding prisoners’ rights, inspection activities, the duties and responsibilities of prison officials, public order issues and daily basic needs\. These measures aimed to establish a standardized operational framework across prisons nationwide\. In particular, the central government’s reformist structure was sought to be implemented in the provinces through general circulars sent to administrators nationwide\. Additionally, these documents were used to enforce oversight and disciplinary mechanisms\. These efforts can be evaluated as a reflection of centralization efforts on prison administration\. In conclusion, although economic shortages and physical deficiencies across the country hindered the success of the reforms, the initiatives of the Ministry of the Interior are considered quite significant in terms of demonstrating the institutional perspective of the state center\.

## [Case Report: A case of postneurosurgery Klebsiella pneumoniae meningitis with longitudinal CSF cytokine profiling and combined intrathecal therapy](../publications/2cdfb9e55be1bd3afa0a.md)

Zhu Li; Qian Wu; Jing Xu; Deshan Ge; Shujuan Dai

A 47\-year\-old woman with poorly controlled diabetes developed acute fever, headache, seizures, and progressive confusion during an admission for glycemic management\. Neurological examination showed mild meningeal signs, and brain MRI demonstrated diffuse linear leptomeningeal enhancement\. Lumbar puncture revealed strikingly viscous, ‘jelly\-like’ cerebrospinal fluid \(CSF\), and culture identified Klebsiella pneumoniae \. Despite systemic antimicrobial therapy, central inflammatory activity persisted\. Serial CSF analyses revealed pronounced elevations of IL\-1β, IL\-6, and IL\-8, with IL\-1β closely paralleling CSF leukocyte dynamics and demonstrating relative independence from systemic inflammatory fluctuations\. Clinical and laboratory improvement occurred after combined intravenous and intrathecal administration of polymyxin B, amikacin, and dexamethasone, leading to full neurological recovery\. This case highlights the diagnostic significance of mucoid CSF in Klebsiella pneumoniae meningitis and underscores the therapeutic value of intrathecal antibiotics in severe central nervous system infections\. Longitudinal CSF IL\-1β measurements may provide a potentially useful marker of intracranial inflammatory activity and treatment response, although this requires validation in larger cohorts\.

## [The Role of Sodium Valproate in Clozapine\-Associated Cardiotoxicities: The Importance of Cellular and Systemic Energetics](../publications/2ce06508143795904d74.md)

Amanda Groenewald; Amelia Power; Kathryn Elisa Burns; Malcolm Drummond Tingle; Marie‐Louise Ward

Abstract The antipsychotic drug clozapine is associated with one of the broadest spectra of cardiac adverse effects\. Many of these are of unknown aetiology, hindering clinicians’ ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat them\. Risk factors for clozapine\-associated cardiotoxicities include concomitant valproic acid therapy and comorbidities associated with the dysregulation of systemic metabolism, such as obesity and diabetes\. Therefore, this review aims to summarise existing evidence for the adverse effects of these drugs on cellular and systemic energetics\. Both drugs are strongly associated with mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress, but in different tissues\. Clozapine may be bioactivated within cardiomyocytes and their mitochondria, producing reactive species that damage these organelles, thus impairing oxidative phosphorylation\. Valproate may have similar effects in hepatocytes but doesn’t appear to be bioactivated in all cell types, though it reportedly has modest inhibitory effects on fatty acid oxidation\. Both drugs affect substrate supply, altering serum lipid, carbohydrate, and ketone levels\. In concert, these medications are likely to impair cardiac metabolic flexibility and energetics\. Considering the absolute dependence of cardiomyocyte function on continuous energy supply, the dysregulation of cardiomyocyte energetics is likely to have a significant role in the development of clozapine\-associated cardiotoxicities\. However, limited investigation has been made of the effects of these drugs in cardiomyocytes specifically\. Rectifying this could inform improved prevention, detection, and management of cardiotoxicities to facilitate the development of clinical strategies to enable the safer use of these medicines\. Graphical Abstract Overview of the potential effects of clozapine and valproic acid on cardiomyocyte energetics\. Highlighted regions are those where clozapine \(orange\) or valproic acid \(purple\) have been shown to have some effect, with colour\-coded arrows to indicate the direction of the effect\. Partially shaded regions indicate those areas where contradictory effects have been reported in different experimental models\. Key enzymes, indicated in brackets, include glutamine synthetase \(GS\), glutamate synthase \(GLS\), glutamate dehydrogenase \(GDH\), glutamate\-pyruvate transaminase \(GPT\), lactate dehydrogenase \(LDH\), pyruvate dehydrogenase \(PDH\), and fatty acyl\-CoA synthetase \(FACS\)\.

## [CONTINUOUS MULTIDISCIPLINARY HEALTH MONITORING OF HIGH\-RISK CHILDREN IN A REGIONAL FOLLOW\-UP CENTER](../publications/2ce3f3b4ff6e90806edc.md)

Olena Vasylivna Vlasova; S\.V\. Kapitula; M\.P\. Perepichka; H\.S\. Horokhova; K\.I\. Zhar

Despite significant advances in modern neonatology in the survival and care of infants with critical conditions and extremely low birth weight, the number of children at high risk of developing long\-term neurological, cognitive, and behavioral impairments continues to increase\. Under these circumstances, the development of an effective system of continuous follow\-up care has become particularly relevant\. Such a system should be based on a multidisciplinary approach, standardized assessment tools, and the early implementation of personalized rehabilitation interventions\. Objective\. To improve the effectiveness of follow\-up care for children during the first four years of life who belong to high perinatal risk groups through the development and implementation of a clinical patient pathway in a follow\-up clinic\. Materials and methods\. The performance of the follow\-up clinic of the Chernivtsi Regional Children&\#x27;s Clinical Hospital was analyzed during 2025 and the beginning of 2026\. The study included 202 children at high perinatal risk\. The multidisciplinary assessment was performed using standardized international tools, including WHO growth charts, the Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination \(HINE\), Alberta Infant Motor Scale \(AIMS\), and Ages and Stages Questionnaire \(ASQ\-3\)\. Demographic characteristics, nosological structure, gender\-related features, and the effectiveness of the implemented clinical pathway were evaluated\. Results\. During the first 11 months of operation, 155 children were enrolled, and an additional 47 patients were registered during the first quarter of 2026, resulting in an increase in the average monthly admission rate from 14\.1 to 15\.7 patients\. Boys predominated \(55\.9%\)\. The most common conditions were hypoxic\-ischemic encephalopathy, feeding disorders, and neonatal sepsis\. The prevalence of hypoxic\-ischemic encephalopathy increased from 30\.3% in 2025 to 46\.8% in the first quarter of 2026 \(AR – 17\.41%; RR – 1\.4; 95% CI: 0\.9\-2\.0; OR – 2\.0; 95% CI: 1\.1\-3\.6\)\. Severe congenital malformations were first identified in 12\.8% of children during the first quarter of 2026\. Several gender\-related trends in the distribution of pathological conditions were observed and require further investigation\. The implemented clinical pathway ensured standardized assessment, early detection of developmental disorders, and optimization of multidisciplinary follow\-up care\. Conclusions\. The establishment of a clinical follow\-up center with an implemented standardized patient pathway and digital technologies provides effective monitoring of children at high perinatal risk, facilitates early identification of pathological conditions, and creates prerequisites for personalized rehabilitation and long\-term medical support programs\.

## [Cross\-tissue domain adaptation of gene expression embeddings using machine learning and optimal transport](../publications/2ce8695dbccaf6a63157.md)

Ανδρέας Καραμιχάλης

Η έρευνα για τη σχιζοφρένεια αξιοποιεί ολοένα περισσότερο μεταγραφωμικά δεδομένα μεταθανάτιου εγκεφάλου και περιφερικού αίματος\. Ο εγκέφαλος συνδέεται αμεσότερα με τη διαταραχή αλλά δεν είναι προσβάσιμος σε ζώντες ασθενείς, ενώ το αίμα παρέχει προσιτά, βιολογικά διακριτά προφίλ έκφρασης χωρίς ωστόσο να συνιστά άμεσο βιολογικό υποκατάστατό του\. Η εργασία εξέτασε ειδικότερα αν η ευθυγράμμιση μεταγραφωμικών αναπαραστάσεων αίματος προς τη λανθάνουσα κατανομή του εγκεφάλου με βέλτιστη μεταφορά \(Optimal Transport \- ΟΤ\) προσφέρει πρόσθετη προγνωστική χρησιμότητα στην ταξινόμηση σχιζοφρένειας έναντι ομάδας ελέγχου\. Υπομονάδες συνέκφρασης από WGCNA \(Ανάλυση Σταθμισμένου Δικτύου Γονιδιακής Συνέκφρασης\) καθόρισαν αυτοκωδικοποιητές που παρήγαγαν συγκεντρωμένες λανθάνουσες αναπαραστάσεις εγκεφάλου και αίματος\. Μετά την ευθυγράμμιση των λανθανόντων χαρακτηριστικών αίματος μέσω ΟΤ, ταξινομητές συνέκριναν την άμεση γονιδιακή πρόβλεψη, τη μη ευθυγραμμισμένη λανθάνουσα αναπαράσταση και τις εναλλακτικές ΟΤ σε κοινό πλαίσιο ανάπτυξης με πενταπλή εσωτερική διασταυρούμενη επικύρωση\. Η μη ευθυγραμμισμένη λανθάνουσα αναπαράσταση διατηρήθηκε ως τελική επιλεγμένη αναφορά, με μέσο AUC εσωτερικής διασταυρούμενης επικύρωσης 0\.8265 και μέσο log\-loss 0\.7449\. Πέτυχε υψηλότερη διακριτική ικανότητα από τον άμεσο γονιδιακό συγκριτή και στις πέντε αντιστοιχισμένες πτυχές, αλλά υψηλότερο μέσο log\-loss\. Στη σφραγισμένη αξιολόγηση μετά την επιλογή μοντέλου, απέδωσε AUC 0\.8941 και log\-loss 0\.7555 σε 48 παρατηρήσεις εκτός ανάπτυξης\. Ούτε η τοπική επέκταση πλησιέστερων γειτόνων \(k\-NN\) ούτε η καθολική αφινική επέκταση ridge στις δοκιμές ΟΤ ικανοποίησαν όλες τις απαιτήσεις προαγωγής για αντικατάστασή της\. Μολονότι η μετρούμενη γεωμετρική απόκλιση στο χώρο εκπαίδευσης μεταξύ των λανθανουσών κατανομών αίματος και εγκεφάλου περιορίστηκε μετά την ΟΤ, η μείωση αυτή δεν συνοδεύτηκε από το συγκριτικό προγνωστικό όφελος που απαιτούνταν για την προαγωγή του μοντέλου\. Η μεθοδολογική συμβολή της εργασίας αυτής είναι ότι υποστηρίζει την αξιολόγηση της διαϊστικής ευθυγράμμισης μέσω αντιστοιχισμένων προγνωστικών συγκρίσεων αντί να βασίζεται αποκλειστικά στη γεωμετρική ομοιότητα των ιστικών κατανομών\.

## [A Machine Learning Approach to Predict Hypertension Using Cross\-Sectional &amp; Two Years Follow Up Data from A Health &amp; Demographic Cohort](../publications/2cea9cce6ea7c57223e9.md)



Background: Hypertension is a major public health problem and an important modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular disease, stroke, chronic kidney disease, and premature mortality\.Machine learning techniques have shown considerable potential for improving hypertension prediction by analyzing complex interactions among multiple demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables\.Aim: To evaluate the performance of different machine learning algorithms for predicting hypertension using crosssectional and two\-year follow\-up data from a health and demographic cohort\.Methods: A prospective observational cohort study was conducted among 2,000 adults aged ≥18 years using baseline cross\-sectional and two\-year follow\-up data\.Demographic, anthropometric, clinical, and lifestyle variables were collected using standardized methods\.Data preprocessing included missing value handling, normalization, categorical encoding, and feature selection\.The dataset was divided into training and testing sets for model development\.Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Extreme Gradient Boosting \(XGBoost\), and Artificial Neural Network models were developed and evaluated\.Model performance was assessed using accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, F1\-score, receiver operating characteristic \(ROC\) curve, and area under the curve \(AUC\)\.Results: Among the 2,000 participants, 720 \(36\.0%\) had hypertension and 1,280 \(64\.0%\) were non\-hypertensive\.Hypertension was significantly associated with age ≥50 years, body mass index ≥25 kg/m², diabetes mellitus, family history of hypertension, smoking, and physical inactivity \(p&lt;0\.05\)\.XGBoost demonstrated the best predictive performance with an accuracy of 92\.7%, sensitivity of 91\.8%, specificity of 93\.4%, precision of 91\.1%, F1\-score of 0\.914, and AUC of 0\.971\.Random Forest showed the second\-highest performance with an accuracy of 91\.8% and AUC of 0\.963\.Feature importance analysis identified age, body mass index, systolic blood pressure, family history of hypertension, and diabetes mellitus as the strongest predictors of hypertension\.Conclusion: Machine learning algorithms, particularly XGBoost, demonstrated excellent performance in predicting hypertension using combined cross\-sectional and longitudinal cohort data\.These models may facilitate early identification of high\-risk individuals, support personalized preventive strategies, and improve clinical decisionmaking\.Further external validation using multicenter population\-based cohorts is recommended before routine clinical implementation\.

## [Σχεδίαση και ανάπτυξη προσωποποιημένης διαλογικής διεπαφής για εφαρμογή &quot;Fantasy football&quot;](../publications/2ceb8ad210acb1504406.md)

Ιγνάτιος Παναγιώτης Τουβλέλιος

Fantasy Premier League \(FPL\) is one of the world’s most popular online fantasy sports games, in which millions of managers worldwide are required to make a series of critical decisions regarding their virtual teams every gameweek, in order to accumulate as many points as possible from the real\-world performances of the footballers they select\. However, the official platform primarily provides raw statistical information and limited decision\-support capabilities, while existing third\-party applications are mainly targeted at experienced users and frequently organise information through dense tables and long lists of metrics\. Managers are therefore forced to switch between multiple websites and tools to analyse players, compare alternatives, and manage their squads, frequently through subscription\-based services\. They are left with a fragmented and demanding environment that imposes a considerable cognitive load and requires substantial time to learn, and that becomes difficult to use for those without much experience\. This thesis presents the design, development, and evaluation of a complete full\-stack Fantasy Football web application with a personalized conversational interface \(AI chatbot\)\. The central contribution is twofold: first, it implements the game itself and comprehensively redesigns the overall user experience \(UI/UX\) compared with both the official Fantasy Premier League application and existing third\-party platforms, bringing together team management, data analysis, player\-performance predictions, and decisionsupport functionalities within a single coherent and user\-friendly environment\. Second, it integrates a conversational Artificial Intelligence coaching assistant that personalises its recommendations according to each manager’s preferences, playing style, and current squad status, providing tailored explanations and decision support through natural language interaction\. Underneath runs a machine\-learning pipeline that forecasts points, minutes played and likelihood of appearance for the next gameweek, using gradient\-boosted tree models with rolling\-origin cross\-validation and an acceptance check that retains the previous model whenever a retrained one performs worse\. The resulting predictions are utilised by a hybrid recommendation engine that combines machine\-learning techniques with heuristic rules, as well as by an integer linear programming optimiser for constructing the initial squad\. A Large Language Model layer then turns these structured numerical recommendations into natural, explanatory dialogue\. The platform is supported by a complete backend, a relational database, an automated data\-synchronisation mechanism, a job\-scheduling system, and user authentication\. The implementation employs the Next\.js and Express frameworks with TypeScript, Python for the machinelearning pipeline, and PostgreSQL for data management\. The system was evaluated with respect to the accuracy of its predictive models, the quality of its recommendations, and the usability, clarity, and overall user experience delivered by the application\.

## [LangNCO: Compiling Natural\-Language Constraints into Inference\-Time Interventions for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](../publications/2cf291371ef90c4607ed.md)

Hironori Ohigashi

Neural combinatorial optimization \(NCO\) rapidly produces high\-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language\. We propose LangNCO, a framework that compiles instance\-specific requirements into structured inference\-time interventions for a frozen NCO solver, without changing the pretrained policy&\#x27;s architecture, learned input representation, or parameters\. A pretrained LLM serves as a replaceable semantic front end, translating each requirement into a schema\-validated domain\-specific language \(DSL\) rule set\. A deterministic Rule Executor applies the rules as nonexpansive hard action masks\. Because local masking prevents immediate violations but does not ensure that a complete feasible continuation remains reachable, Critical\-Offset Decoding extracts rule\-referenced critical nodes and reallocates part of a fixed rollout budget to multi\-strength biased rollouts\. Using controlled task\-specific language to isolate solver adaptation from open\-ended language robustness, we evaluate a CVRP policy on road closures, time windows, vehicle assignments, visit\-order requirements, all pairwise combinations, and twelve additional constraint types\. LangNCO achieves 100% feasibility on the four primary datasets with mean reference gaps of 1\.63\-\-3\.26%, 97\.33\-\-100% feasibility when separately generated rules are composed for pairwise constraints, and 98\.67% feasibility across the additional constraints\. These results demonstrate modular post\-training adaptation of a frozen NCO solver through inspectable language\-derived rules, without retraining\.

## [Controlled gonad development: effects of environmental factors on sexual maturity in red swamp crayfish, Procambarus clarkii](../publications/2cfaa6f2a69f106b6bd3.md)

Jian‐Gang Jiao; Biao Yun; Xueqiao Qian

Because development of crustacean gonads can impede growth potential, a balance between growth and gonad development is necessary to promote the healthy and sustainable development of aquaculture\. We report growth and gonad development in red swamp crayfish Procambarus clarkii at six temperatures between 16 °C and 36 °C, and conduct experiments to investigate the impact of light intensity on growth, gonad development, and survival at 36 °C\. Growth in crayfish first increased, then decreased with increased temperature\. Above 28 °C, 10%–30% of gonads were mature, but the survival rate of crayfish above 28 °C was significantly lower than that below 28 °C\. Hemolymph vitellogenin \(VTG\) content increased significantly with increased temperature; expressions of vtg gene and molt\-inhibiting hormone \(MIH\) in hepatopancreatic and ovarian tissues gradually increased; and expression of vitellogenesis\-inhibiting hormone decreased significantly\. At 36 °C, crayfish treated with 400–500 lx light \(50% relative light intensity, RLI\) showed significantly higher weight gain and survival rates than controls \(800–1,000 lx, 100% RLI\), and gonad development was slightly lower; hemolymph VTG contents of treatment crayfish were lower than that of controls; vtg expression decreased significantly in the ovary but not in the hepatopancreas; expression of vitellogenesis\-inhibiting hormone in the hepatopancreas gradually increased; and expression of molt\-inhibiting hormone did not differ significantly\. Therefore, growth promotion and delayed gonad development can be achieved by decreasing light intensity during crayfish culture at high temperature, reducing VTG accumulation rates in ovaries\.

## [Time Series Forecasting and Root Cause Analysis for Reducing Liquid Oxygen Delivery Losses](../publications/2cff4dbdb4b1abeb0db8.md)

Martua Manik; Muhammad Aresi Yasin Noor; Dian Jingga Permana; Ridwan Usman

Liquid oxygen \(LO₂\) delivery losses can reduce its distribution efficiency, increase operational costs, and affect delivery reliability\. This study analyzes delivery\-loss patterns, evaluates forecasting methods, and identifies operational factors contributing to loss variability at PT XYZ\. A quantitative case\-study approach was applied using delivery\-loss data from February to July 2025, with monthly averages of 10\.00%, 39\.20%, 9\.00%, 8\.20%, 9\.20%, and 9\.30%, respectively\. Linear regression, three\-period moving average, single exponential smoothing, and Holt’s linear trend were evaluated using Mean Absolute Deviation \(MAD\), Mean Squared Error \(MSE\), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error \(MAPE\)\. Linear regression indicated a downward tendency \(Ŷ = 23\.58 − 2\.694X; R² = 16\.83%\), but with limited explanatory power\. The three\-period moving average achieved the lowest MAD \(5\.45\) and MAPE \(63\.37%\), whereas single exponential smoothing yielded the lowest MSE \(45\.25\)\. Holt’s method produced the largest forecasting errors, indicating its unsuitability for the short and highly fluctuating dataset\. The findings highlight the importance of selecting forecasting methods according to data characteristics and strengthening operational controls\. Improvements in data recording, SOP compliance, equipment maintenance, calibration, and routine monitoring are recommended to enhance the reliability and efficiency of liquid oxygen distribution\.

Оценка сердечной функции у новорождённых необходима для понимания причин гемодинамической нестабильности и выбора дальнейшей тактики наблюдения\. Интерпретацию эхокардиографии осложняют переходное кровообращение, изменение нагрузки на желудочки и особенности недоношенного ребёнка\. Поэтому совершенствование метода требует сочетания автоматических измерений, контроля качества изображений и возрастной клинической интерпретации\.

## [Configuration\-dependent predictors of methane variation in forage systems](../publications/2d11b3e7924a29e1c92a.md)

Ibrahim Osman; 侯向阳 HOU Xiangyang

Predicting enteric methane \(CH₄\) emissions from forage\-based ruminant systems is challenging because nutrient\-methane relationships may vary across forage and experimental contexts\. This study evaluated whether forage nutritional characteristics provide transferable predictive information across heterogeneous multi\-study datasets\. We analyzed 244 observations from 22 independent studies using eight nutritional predictors: dry matter digestibility \(DMD\), acid detergent lignin \(ADL\), acid detergent fibre \(ADF\), crude protein \(CP\), neutral detergent fibre \(NDF\), CP: NDF ratio, lignification index, and fibre: protein ratio\. Six machine\-learning approaches were evaluated using leave\-one\-study\-out cross\-validation\. Feature importance, pure\-versus\-mixture comparisons, nutrient\-methane correlations, and sensitivity analyses were used to examine configuration\-dependent relationships\. A Proportion\-Weighted Study Ensemble \(PWSE\) analysis was additionally conducted as a secondary evaluation of configuration\-aware representation\. Cross\-study prediction remained challenging across all models\. Random Forest provided the strongest performance \(R² = \-0\.375; RMSE = 29\.88 mL/g DM; MAE = 23\.34 mL/g DM\), followed by Gradient Boosting \(R² = \-0\.389; RMSE = 30\.02 mL/g DM\)\. DMD was the dominant predictive feature, with a mean importance of 0\.626 across the tree\-based models\. However, its relationship with methane was strongly configuration\-dependent: DMD was positively correlated with methane in pure forage systems \( r = 0\.684, p &lt; 0\.001\) but negatively correlated in mixture systems \( r = \-0\.809, p &lt; 0\.001\), with the difference between correlations statistically distinguishable by Fisher’s r\-to\-z analysis \( p &lt; 0\.001\)\. Mixture systems had higher crude protein and lower ADL than pure systems, and methane emissions were also higher in mixture systems \(51\.39 vs\. 43\.61 mL/g DM; p = 0\.033\)\. PWSE showed weak predictive performance and substantial sensitivity to study concentration\. Methane variation is better characterized by configuration\-dependent nutritional relationships than by isolated nutrient effects\. The contrasting DMD\-CH 4 relationships demonstrate that the predictive meaning of a nutritional trait can change across forage contexts\. These findings support context\-aware machine learning, study\-level validation, and improved evidence representation in future methane modelling\.

## [An Integrated Deep Learning Approach for Chest X\-Ray Abnormality Recognition and Automated Radiological Report Synthesis](../publications/2d29422413dab87febb3.md)

Haragopal V\.P\.; Shaik Munna; Penujuvi Sandeep; Thummaluru Soumith Reddy

Chest X\-ray \(CXR\) interpretation and radiology report creation depend on efficient feature extraction and report creation in medical terms\.
