## [Enzyme‐Linked Cycloaddition Assay \(ELCA\) for Rapid, Ultra‐Sensitive Monitoring of Secreted Sialoglycoproteins](../publications/30a4c8b116ff946779e9.md)

Jon Lundstrøm; Jingmei Yang; Daniel Bojar

Glycosylation of proteins is central to cell signaling, immune function, and pathogen interactions, yet existing methods for monitoring glycan changes require specialized instrumentation and primarily report on membrane\-anchored, rather than secreted, glycoproteins\. Here, we present the Enzyme\-Linked Cycloaddition Assay \(ELCA\), a click chemistry\-based platform for ultra\-sensitive detection and semi\-quantitative analysis of secreted sialoglycoproteins\. By metabolically incorporating an azide\-modified sialic acid into newly synthesized glycoproteins and capturing labeled material via strain\-promoted cycloaddition, ELCA quantifies aggregate sialylation using a microplate reader\-compatible, ELISA\-like workflow\. We demonstrate that the secreted glycoproteome responds rapidly to pharmacological perturbation, with changes detectable within hours\. Benchmarking against common glycosylation inhibitors and profiling cytokine\-driven macrophage polarization further establishes ELCA&\#x27;s sensitivity and temporal resolution\. Compatible with serum\-containing conditions and requiring no specialized instrumentation, ELCA provides a broadly accessible tool for rapid, cost\-effective monitoring of secreted glycoprotein dynamics\.

## [Comparative efficacy of different mouthrinses on oral hygiene and gingival health in patients undergoing fixed orthodontic therapy: A non\-randomized comparative clinical study](../publications/30be1cefdf4653fa79e7.md)

Dr Karuna Najiar; Karamdeep Singh Ahluwalia; Vijay Agarwal; Hari Narayan Choudhary; Harsheeta Narhari Trivedi

Introduction: Fixed orthodontic appliances make oral hygiene maintenance challenging, as brackets, bands, and wires create plaque\-retentive areas that promote gingival inflammation, enamel demineralization, and other periodontal problems\. Adjunctive chemotherapeutic mouthwashes are commonly recommended to help control plaque during orthodontic treatment\.Aim and Objectives: To compare the efficacy of chlorhexidine versus fluoride mouthwash on periodontal status and extrinsic staining in orthodontic patients\.Materials and Methods: Sixty patients \(aged 15–35 years\) were allocated, using a non\-random clinical allocation procedure to two groups \(n = 30 each\): Group I received chlorhexidine mouthwash and Group II received fluoride mouthwash, both used once nightly for 21 days\. Institutional Ethics Committee approval was obtained\. Plaque, gingival, and stain indices were recorded at baseline \(T0\), day 10 \(T1\), and day 21 \(T2\)\. Intragroup and intergroup comparisons used paired and independent t\-tests \(p &lt; 0\.05\)\.Results: Both chlorhexidine and fluoride mouthwashes showed significant reductions in plaque accumulation and gingival inflammation over time \(p = 0\.001\)\. From T0 to T2, plaque scores decreased by 50\.4% with chlorhexidine and 41\.6% with fluoride, with a significant intergroup difference \(p = 0\.008\)\. Gingival scores decreased by 61\.3% and 50\.3%, respectively \(p = 0\.001\)\. In contrast, stain scores increased by 60\.1% with chlorhexidine and decreased by 24\.7% with fluoride \(p = 0\.001\)\.Conclusion: Both mouthwashes improved plaque and gingival indices over 21 days\. Chlorhexidine showed greater reductions in plaque and gingival scores but was associated with increased extrinsic staining, whereas fluoride showed a more favorable staining profile\. These findings should be interpreted in view of the non\-randomized design, absence of a formal sample\-size calculation, and the short follow\-up period\.

## [Türkiye Afet Müdahale Sisteminde İnsan Kaynağı Yönetimi ve Mesleki Sorunların Analizi: AFAD ve Belediye İtfaiye Teşkilatları Üzerine Kurumsal Bir Değerlendirme](../publications/30c1d177a0c3a496c525.md)

Selman Yıldırım

Afet yönetiminde etkin müdahale, mesleki yeterliliklere sahip personelin doğru zamanda, doğru yerde ve uygun görev tanımı içinde görevlendirilmesine bağlıdır\. Bu çalışma, bir il belediyesi itfaiye müdürlüğü, bir büyükşehir belediyesi itfaiye dairesi başkanlığı, arama kurtarma birlik yapılanması bulunan bir il Afet ve Acil Durum Müdürlüğü ile bu yapılanmanın bulunmadığı bir il Afet ve Acil Durum Müdürlüğünde görev yapan personelin insan kaynağına ilişkin mesleki sorunlarını ve kurumsal işleyişe dair deneyimlerini incelemeyi amaçlamaktadır\. Araştırma nitel araştırma yaklaşımıyla tasarlanmış, veriler afet ve acil durum müdahale süreçlerinde görev alan personelle gerçekleştirilen yarı yapılandırılmış görüşmeler aracılığıyla elde edilmiştir\. Çalışma kapsamında yirmi dört personelle görüşme yapılmış, veriler MAXQDA 2024 programı kullanılarak tematik analiz yöntemiyle değerlendirilmiştir\. Bulgular, personelin liyakat eksikliği, yetersiz istihdam, görev tanımlarındaki belirsizlikler, eğitim olanaklarının sınırlılığı, psikolojik yıpranma, özlük hakkı sorunları ve kurumsal koordinasyon yetersizliğinden etkilendiğini göstermektedir\. Ayrıca bürokratik işleyişin ve zayıf kurumsal destek mekanizmalarının afet müdahale süreçlerinde insan kaynağının etkin kullanımını sınırladığı anlaşılmaktadır\. Bu durum, insan kaynağı yönetiminin afet müdahale kapasitesi bakımından stratejik unsur olarak ele alınması gerektiğini ortaya koymaktadır\. Çalışmada, insan kaynağı politikalarının görev tanımı, liyakat, eğitim, özlük hakları ve psikolojik destek boyutlarıyla yeniden ele alınmasının kurumsal kapasitenin güçlendirilmesi açısından önemli olduğu sonucuna ulaşılmıştır\.

## [“Well done, My good and faithful servant”: AI\-generated religious imagery, white evangelical U\.S\. American Christian nationalism, and political martyrdom](../publications/30c5ae144311ff9113fc.md)

Miriam Wolff

Following the 2025 assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, social media platforms became saturated with AI\-generated religious imagery framing him as a Christian martyr\. This article examines how generative AI intensifies the production of sacred political meaning within white evangelical U\.S\. American Christian nationalist discourse\. Focusing on Senator Ted Cruz&\#x27;s X post depicting Jesus embracing Kirk alongside the caption “Well done, My good and faithful servant,” this study employs rhetorical\-iconographic analysis informed by visual rhetoric, iconography, and political theology\. The analysis demonstrates how the post mobilizes familiar Christian visual conventions, scriptural language, and algorithmic circulation to frame Kirk&\#x27;s death as divinely meaningful and spiritually affirmed\. The image transforms political grief into a martyr narrative while reproducing racialized constructions of sacred authority rooted in white evangelical visual culture\. Rather than generating entirely new religious meanings, AI\-generated devotional imagery gains persuasive force by recombining familiar iconographic traditions into emotionally immediate and rapidly circulable forms\. The article argues that generative AI extends political actors&\#x27; capacity to produce and disseminate sacred narratives at unprecedented speed and scale, reshaping how political identity, religious authority, and public grief become intertwined within contemporary digital culture\.

## [Can Machine Learning Detect and Predict Outcomes in Multiple Sclerosis? A Review of Diagnostic and Prognostic Approaches](../publications/30ce74f2c9962f6a035c.md)

Murat Emeç

Multiple sclerosis \(MS\) diagnosis relies on clinical presentation, magnetic resonance imaging \(MRI\), and the McDonald criteria, whereas long\-term management requires anticipating disability progression and symptom burden\.This narrative review evaluates current evidence on machine learning \(ML\) approaches for \(i\) detecting and classifying MS and \(ii\) predicting disability progression and symptom severity in patients with established MS\.Evidence was synthesized from 25 sources published between 2012 and 2026 \(23 peer\-reviewed journal publications, one arXiv preprint, and one article published in a journal outside the major biomedical indexes\), encompassing MS diagnosis \[MRI, optical coherence tomography \(OCT\), fluid biomarkers, and differential diagnosis\] and prognostic outcome prediction \(disability progression, symptom\-specific severity, and contextspecific changes in disability\)\.MRI remains the predominant data source for ML\-based MS detection: deep learning models applied to structural MRI achieved accuracies of 70\.2\-98\.8%in distinguishing MS from healthy controls, whereas conventional ML models achieved accuracies of 83\.7\-90\.0%\.A broader meta\-review of more than 100 studies reported diagnostic accuracies ranging from 61% to 97%, while differentiation of MS from neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder achieved 74\-88% accuracy, depending on data integration\.For prognostic applications, tree\-based ensemble models generally outperformed simpler regression models: a 231\-patient cohort achieved an R 2 of 0\.97 for two\-year disability score prediction, although this estimate warrants cautious interpretation because of the strong autocorrelation of baseline Expanded Disability Status Scale scores\.A 662\-woman cohort achieved 85\-88% classification accuracy for postpartum changes in disability, whereas a 23\-patient cohort achieved 92\.65% accuracy in predicting restless legs syndrome severity, with sleep quality identified as the leading predictor\.Overall, ML can effectively detect MS\-associated patterns in MRI and is increasingly being applied to OCT and fluid biomarkers\.It can also generate clinically meaningful prognostic predictions after MS diagnosis, although categorical outcome prediction appears to generalize better than continuous regression\.Dataset size, single\-center study designs, and limited external validation remain the principal barriers to clinical deployment across both domains\.Multimodal data integration and prospective multicenter validation therefore represent important priorities for future research\.

## [A Hybrid Deep Recommendation System for Issuing Digital Coupons in Real\-Time](../publications/30d655ec4bd1acbb699c.md)

Wongyeom Seo; Hanbi Kim; Hajin Kim; Geonseok Lee

In the field of marketing, offering discount coupons to encourage purchases is one of the most frequently used strategies\. In particular, with the rise of online shopping malls surpassing offline ones, digital coupons have become increasingly prevalent\. The key challenge in issuing coupons is identifying customers with a high risk of churn and providing them with coupons of the right category at an optimal discount rate\. Manually addressing this task is impractical because online shopping platforms serve millions of users and offer a wide variety of coupon types\. Accordingly, this study proposes a time series deep learning framework that identifies customers at high risk of churn in real time and provides them with personalized coupons for relevant product categories at appropriate discount rates\. To address the data class imbalance problem, additional dependent variables were introduced, and static customer meta\-information was combined with real\-time page click features to enhance accuracy\. In addition, we tested the improvement in financial profits of an actual shopping mall\. After various ablation model experiments, the results show the superiority of our proposed framework, which has brought great profits to the platform\. The proposed framework achieved an AUC of 0\.747 for purchase intention prediction, improved coupon conversion rates by up to 32\.65%, and increased the relative profit index from 100\.0 to 103\.15 in real\-world deployment experiments\.

## [Improved HCV genotyping based on sequence encoding and feature integration](../publications/30e0baa7aae3b1537570.md)

Ahmed M\. Fahmy; Muhammed S\. Hammad; Walid Al‐Atabany; Mai Said Mabrouk

Genomic sequence classification is an important task for understanding viral genetic variability and supporting genotype identification, particularly for viruses such as the Hepatitis C Virus \(HCV\)\. In this study, we evaluate the effectiveness of different sequence encoding techniques, supplementary genomic descriptors, and class\-balancing strategies for HCV genotype classification under a stricter CD\-HIT\-EST cluster\-aware evaluation protocol designed to reduce sequence\-identity leakage\. Four encoding methods were investigated, namely Frequency Chaos Game Representation \(FCGR\), k\-mer encoding, one\-hot encoding, and label encoding\. These representations were evaluated using multiple machine learning models, including XGBoost, Random Forest, Multi\-Layer Perceptron \(MLP\), and K\-Nearest Neighbors \(KNN\)\. To address class imbalance, SMOTE was applied, while GC content and GC skew were included as supplementary compositional descriptors\. Overall, FCGR and k\-mer encoding outperformed one\-hot and label encoding\. The best result was achieved using k\-mer encoding with XGBoost and SMOTE, obtaining a macro F1\-score of 0\.890, accuracy of 0\.922, macro precision of 0\.866, macro recall of 0\.925, macro specificity of 0\.990, and MCC of 0\.893 under the CD\-HIT\-EST cluster\-aware evaluation setting\. The statistical analysis showed that SMOTE had a clear positive effect on classification performance, particularly for the Random Forest model, while GC\-based descriptors provided additional interpretability but did not show a statistically significant improvement in the k\-mer\-based experiment\. Overall, this study demonstrates the importance of selecting appropriate sequence encodings and class\-balancing strategies for machine\-learning\-based HCV genotype classification\. The findings provide a comparative basis for future work on sequence\-based classification tasks in virology and computational genomics\.

## [Analysis of the Rectoral Resolutions of the Universidad Atlántida Argentina that integrate the use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in teaching and university management](../publications/30e6eb0f2ba6f2e54db6.md)

Leonardo Pablo Palacios

La irrupción masiva de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa \(IAGen\) ha planteado un desafío sin precedentes para el sistema universitario global\. En la República Argentina, ante la ausencia de marcos regulatorios nacionales específicos, las instituciones han debido asumir un rol proactivo en la creación de sus propios protocolos de gobernanza\. El presente trabajo analiza el caso de la Universidad Atlántida Argentina \(UAA\) y su Resolución Rectoral 231/25, la cual establece lineamientos éticos y pedagógicos alineados con los estándares de la UNESCO y la Ley Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales \(N\.º 25\.326\)\. A través de un enfoque descriptivo, se examina cómo la universidad busca integrar estas herramientas no como meros instrumentos de productividad, sino como entornos de mediación para el pensamiento humano\. Asimismo, se plantean reflexiones críticas sobre la eficacia real de la regulación en un contexto de obsolescencia tecnológica acelerada y las dudas persistentes sobre la integridad académica frente a la limitada fiabilidad de los sistemas de detección algorítmica\.

## [6G Network and AI: Integration Enabling Intelligent Adaptive, and Beyond 5g Wireless Systems](../publications/30f9893e627dd9a0f29b.md)

Amerenrda Tiwari; Adarsh Mishra; Mrs\. Devika Singh

Beyond\-5G and 6G Wireless Systems are required to enable services and technologies with extremely high data rates, ultra\-low latency, enormous numbers of connections, and significantly less energy than current systems\.Additionally, the broad array of operational environments associated with 6G will pose significant challenges for traditional fixed resource management policies\.This paper outlines a Research Plan based upon a doctoral thesis outline that enables us to incorporate Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) and Machine Learning \(ML\) into Adaptive Resource Allocation and Network Orchestration\.The Research Plan is designed to utilize AI/ML to manage Ultra Dense Heterogeneous Networks \(UDHN\) employing Terahertz \(THz\) Communication, Ultra\-Massive Multiple Input Multiple Output \(UM\-MIMO\), and Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces \(RIS\)\.Our Research Plan defines Resource Management as an Optimization Problem involving the simultaneous optimization of multiple objectives including Subcarrier Assignment and Transmission Power, while satisfying constraints related to Delay Limitation, Power Limitation, and Interference Limitation\.To resolve this Non\-Convex Optimization Problem and the time varying nature of Channel Conditions, we propose a Multi\-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning \(MADRL\) Architecture consisting of Custom Deep Q\-Network \(DQN\) Modules and Proximal Policy Optimization \(PPO\) Modules, enabling Flexible Decision Making\.Additionally, we plan to utilize Explainable Artificial Intelligence \(XAI\) to explain the Logic behind our Resource Management Decisions\.We also plan to evaluate the validity of our Methodology through Simulation Studies utilizing MATLAB for Physical Layer Modeling and Channel Modeling, Python based TensorFlow/PyTorch Platforms for AI Model Training, and NS\-3 for Network Level Modeling\.We also plan to Generate Artificial CSI under Mobile and Blocked Conditions and utilize these Artificial CSI Data Sets to Compare our Approach to Proportional Fair Scheduling, Waterfalling Power Allocation, and several other Deep Learning 5G Baselines\.Since this outline describes the Experimental Design but does not report on any Actual Experimental Results, No Performance Metrics have been included in this paper\.Instead, this paper outlines the Experimental Designs, Evaluation Metrics, Predicted Results, Limitations, and Criteria for Demonstrating the Feasibility of our Proposed Contributions\.

## [Fenvalerate Induces Airway Epithelial Injury Through CHRM3\-Associated NF\-κB Activation](../publications/310a5a736ce1a63f2eaa.md)

Yuxin Yang; Jixin Li; Tong Liu; Mingyang Sheng; Jiatong Liu; Zidong Yang; Hongbo Chu; Ailing Jia; Wei Xu

Fenvalerate \(FEN\) is a widely used pyrethroid insecticide with potential respiratory toxicity; however, its contribution to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease \(COPD\)\-related pathological processes remains unclear\. We investigated molecular mechanisms linking FEN exposure to airway epithelial injury\. COPD transcriptomic datasets were integrated with predicted FEN targets, and candidate genes were prioritized using machine\-learning algorithms\. Immune infiltration and single\-cell transcriptomic analyses were used to examine immune associations and cell\-type\-specific expression\. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations assessed potential FEN\-target interactions, followed by validation in BEAS\-2B human bronchial epithelial cells\. Intersecting FEN\-COPD genes were enriched in inflammatory, immune\-regulatory, neuroactive ligand\-receptor, and epithelial injury\-related pathways\. Eight candidate genes showed distinct expression patterns across airway epithelial and immune cell populations\. Computational analyses supported a potentially stable FEN\-CHRM3 interaction\. In BEAS\-2B cells, FEN reduced viability, increased IL\-6 and IL\-8 secretion, promoted apoptosis, upregulated CHRM3, and enhanced IκBα and p65 phosphorylation\. Pharmacological inhibition of CHRM3 or NF\-κB partially attenuated these responses\. Thus, FEN\-induced epithelial inflammation and apoptosis may involve CHRM3\-associated NF\-κB activation, providing mechanistic insight into pesticide\-related respiratory toxicity\.

## [İdeal Bedenden İdeal Özneye: Sosyal Medyada Zayıflama Anlatılarının Sağlık İletişimi Bağlamında Ahlaki Söylemi](../publications/311e5549f4fe89f5affe.md)

Hüsna Yılmaz

Bu çalışma, sosyal medyada paylaşılan zayıflama ve beden dönüşüm anlatılarının sağlık iletişimi bağlamında nasıl bir ahlaki söylem ürettiğini incelemeyi amaçlamaktadır\. Araştırmada, sağlığın bu anlatılarda hangi anlam ve değerler üzerinden kurulduğu, bireylerin kendilerini ve başkalarını değerlendirme biçimlerinin nasıl şekillendiği ve bu söylemin nasıl bir ideal özne tasavvuruna zemin hazırladığı ele alınmaktadır\. Çalışma, nitel doküman incelemesi deseninde yürütülmüş; amaçlı örnekleme ile seçilen on sekiz kamusal Instagram hesabında yer alan yüz yetmiş sekiz gönderi incelenmiştir\. Veriler tematik analiz yoluyla çözümlenmiş, kodlama ve tema oluşturma sürecinde nitel veri analiz programından yararlanılmıştır\. Bulgular, kilo kaybının erdem, irade ve başarıyla; kilo verememenin ise kusur, yetersizlik ve özdenetim eksikliğiyle ilişkilendirildiğini göstermektedir\. Görsel önce\-sonra karşılaştırmaları ile sayısal ölçümlerin, bedensel dönüşümü kanıtlanabilir ve sergilenebilir bir başarı performansına dönüştürdüğü görülmüştür\. Ayrıca öz\-sevgi ve iyileşme söyleminin de çoğu zaman disiplin, kontrol ve sorumluluk çağrısıyla iç içe geçtiği belirlenmiştir\. Çalışma, yalnızca kamusal Instagram hesaplarında paylaşılan gönderilerle sınırlıdır; bu nedenle gelecek araştırmalarda farklı platformların ve izleyici yorumlarının da incelemeye dahil edilmesi önerilmektedir\. Araştırma, sağlık iletişimi alanında dijital mecralarda dolaşıma giren beden ve sağlık temsillerinin yalnızca bilgilendirici değil, aynı zamanda normatif ve ahlaki yönlendirmeler taşıdığını göstermesi bakımından önem taşımaktadır\. Bu yönüyle çalışma, Türkiye bağlamında zayıflama anlatılarını sağlık iletişimi perspektifinden ahlakileştirme, özdenetim ve ideal özne tartışmalarıyla birlikte ele alarak literatüre özgün bir katkı sunmaktadır\.

## [АНАЛИЗ ЭФФЕКТИВНОСТИ ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИЯ ПРОИЗВОДСТВЕННЫХ РЕСУРСОВ И НАПРАВЛЕНИЯ ЕЕ ПОВЫШЕНИЯ НА ОСНОВЕ ТЕХНОЛОГИЙ РОБОТИЗАЦИИ И БЕРЕЖЛИВОГО ПРОИЗВОДСТВА](../publications/3122d08c761115ffce79.md)

Баяндурян Галина Левоновна

В статье проведён комплексный анализ эффективности использования производственных ресурсов предприятия по строительству инженерных сетей за период 2023–2025 гг\. На основе данных бухгалтерской отчётности оценены показатели использования основных фондов \(фондоотдача, фондоёмкость, фондовооружённость\), оборотных средств \(коэффициент оборачиваемости, продолжительность одного оборота\) и трудовых ресурсов \(производительность труда, трудоёмкость\)\. Выявлено, что, несмотря на рост выручки в три раза, рентабельность продаж, активов и собственного капитала снижается, а прирост выручки обеспечивается преимущественно экстенсивными факторами – увеличением стоимости основных фондов и численности персонала\. Интенсивные факторы \(рост фондоотдачи и производительности труда\) дают незначительный вклад\. Установлено, что ускорение оборачиваемости оборотных средств связано с изменением структуры выручки – снижением доли длительных строительно\-монтажных работ и ростом посреднических операций\. Для преодоления сложившихся негативных тенденций автором предложены направления повышения эффективности использования производственных ресурсов на основе новых технологий: роботизация производственных процессов, внедрение бережливых технологий, искусственного интеллекта, больших данных, цифровых двойников, интернета вещей, 3D\-печати и систем управления ресурсами\. Рассмотрены ключевые проблемы внедрения этих технологий – ограниченность финансовых ресурсов, необходимость обучения персонала и обеспечения кибербезопасности\. Сделан вывод, что комплексное применение предлагаемых решений позволит повысить конкурентоспособность предприятия и перейти от экстенсивной к интенсивной модели развития\.

## [Between Communism and Non\-Racialism: A Spatial\-Genealogical Reappraisal of the Springbok Legion, 1941–1954](../publications/31331e8323a03ce4204d.md)

Jaunico van der Walt

As an organisation created as a ‘union of the ranks’ during the Second World War, the Springbok Legion lobbied for the socio\-economic and political interests of soldiers from 1941 to 1954\. An under\-appreciated role was its advancement of non\-racialism amongst white activists and how this informed the development of Congress politics in the 1950s\. Accounts of the Springbok Legion, especially in the latter half of the organisation’s existence, alleged that the Legion was an unofficial extension of the Communist Party of South Africa \(CPSA\), largely owing to the presence of prominent communists in the leadership of the Legion\. Instead of offering a dualistic and reductive appraisal of the Legion as either a militant front for the CPSA or merely a soldier’s welfare organisation, this article argues that the Springbok Legion was a space in which social values and identities relating to national belonging, duty, and citizenship amongst white South Africans were amalgamated, contested, renegotiated, and reconstituted\. The Springbok Legion offered white South African liberals, progressives, and radicals avenues of ulterior political expression and social identity that developed non\-racialism as a salient political discourse, which saw its full fruition in the 1950s\.

## [Preoperative Risk\-assessment Score for Elective Total Aortic Arch Repair: AAORTA Risk Tool](../publications/31338ca4e72ab50b5cae.md)

Michael Tyler Guinn; Travis J Miles; Veronica A\. Glover; Susan Y\. Green; Lynna H Nguyen; Ginger M Etheridge; Lauren M\. Barron; Anna H Xue; Vicente Orozco‐Sevilla; Subhasis Chatterjee; Marc R\. Moon; Joseph Stapleton Coselli

Abstract Total transverse aortic arch replacement is a complex operation performed to address aortic aneurysm with and without chronic aortic dissection\. To predict 90\-day survival after this procedure, we created a holistic tool for predicting postoperative mortality in patients who undergo total arch repair \(TAR\): the Aortic Arch Operation Risk Tool for Assessment \(AAORTA\) score\. Univariate and multivariate analyses were performed on data from patients \(N=470; 243 with nondissecting aneurysm, 227 with chronic Type A dissection\) who underwent TAR at a high\-volume practice between April 2006 and November 2024\. Regression analysis identified variables to be used in the AAORTA score\. The predictive performance of the score was assessed with the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve \(AUROCC\), Brier score, and linear fitting\. Of 470 patients who underwent TAR, 65 \(13\.8%\) died within 90 days of repair\. The AAORTA score relied on five preoperative variables: heritable thoracic aortic disease, prior coronary artery bypass grafting \(CABG\), kidney disease, pulmonary disease \(restrictive or obstructive\), and no history of smoking\. Previous CABG was the strongest predictor of 90\-day mortality\. The AAORTA score had an AUROCC of 0\.784, a Brier score of 0\.105, and a goodness\-of\-fit R 2 of 0\.954\. The AAORTA score can accurately stratify 90\-day mortality risk in patients who undergo elective TAR, using only five variables easily acquired during standard preoperative evaluation\. This score could be used to aid preoperative counseling with patients and families\. Prospective multicenter validation will help establish its generalizability\.

## [रजगर पर AI क परभव: अवसर और चनतय](../publications/31362fe1d0556273d235.md)

डॉ\. बबीता बाथम

शोध सारांश वर्तमान समय में कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता \(Artificial Intelligence—AI\) आधुनिक विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी की सबसे महत्त्वपूर्ण उपलब्धियों में से एक है। इसने मानव जीवन के लगभग प्रत्येक क्षेत्र में कार्य करने की क्षमता, निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रिया तथा उत्पादकता को एक नई दिशा प्रदान की है। वर्तमान में AI का उपयोग शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, कृषि, बैंकिंग, उद्योग, परिवहन, ई\-कॉमर्स तथा सरकारी सेवाओं सहित अनेक क्षेत्रों में तेजी से बढ़ रहा है। इसके माध्यम से कई ऐसे कार्य, जिन्हें पहले अनेक लोगों द्वारा लंबे समय में पूरा किया जाता था, अब मशीनों और स्वचालित प्रणालियों की सहायता से कम समय में किए जा सकते हैं। इससे समय, श्रम और लागत की बचत होती है तथा कुछ कार्यों में मानवीय त्रुटियों की संभावना भी कम हो सकती है। हालाँकि, कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता के तीव्र विकास के साथ रोजगार के क्षेत्र में अनेक चुनौतियाँ भी उत्पन्न हो रही हैं। स्वचालन के कारण कुछ पारंपरिक नौकरियों की माँग कम हो सकती है, जिससे श्रमिकों के सामने रोजगार की असुरक्षा और नई तकनीकी कुशलताएँ सीखने की आवश्यकता बढ़ रही है। विशेष रूप से उन लोगों के लिए यह चुनौती अधिक गंभीर हो सकती है, जिनके कार्यों को मशीनों या AI आधारित प्रणालियों द्वारा आसानी से स्वचालित किया जा सकता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, तकनीक पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता मानवीय कौशल, स्वतंत्र चिंतन और निर्णय लेने की क्षमता के विकास को प्रभावित कर सकती है। तकनीकी बदलावों से उत्पन्न तनाव और रोजगार संबंधी अनिश्चितता का व्यक्तियों के मानसिक स्वास्थ्य पर भी प्रभाव पड़ सकता है। इसके बावजूद, कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता केवल रोजगार के लिए खतरा ही नहीं, बल्कि नए अवसरों का माध्यम भी है। AI के विकास से डेटा विश्लेषण, मशीन लर्निंग, साइबर सुरक्षा, रोबोटिक्स तथा डिजिटल सेवाओं जैसे क्षेत्रों में नए रोजगार उत्पन्न होने की संभावनाएँ बढ़ रही हैं। आवश्यकता इस बात की है कि शिक्षा, कौशल विकास और प्रशिक्षण के माध्यम से लोगों को बदलती तकनीकी आवश्यकताओं के अनुरूप तैयार किया जाए। प्रस्तुत शोध का उद्देश्य रोजगार पर कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता के प्रभाव का विश्लेषण करना तथा इसके कारण उत्पन्न होने वाले अवसरों और चुनौतियों को समझना है। अध्ययन इस बात पर बल देता है कि AI का उपयोग मानवीय क्षमताओं को बढ़ाने, उत्पादकता में सुधार करने और नए रोजगार अवसर विकसित करने के लिए किया जाना चाहिए, ताकि तकनीकी प्रगति के साथ\-साथ सामाजिक और आर्थिक संतुलन भी बनाए रखा जा सके। मुख्य शब्द: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता, रोजगार, स्वचालन, बेरोजगारी, तकनीकी विकास, कौशल विकास, उत्पादकता, डिजिटल अर्थव्यवस्था, रोजगार के अवसर, मानवीय कौशल।

## [Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits](../publications/313ac3256d47303cc376.md)

Spyros Dragazis; Yilei Chen; Aldo Pacchiano

We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure\. Given a known $d$\-dimensional feature map and reward\-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA \(Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation\), an algorithm that estimates every target policy&\#x27;s value to accuracy $\\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1\-δ$\. The algorithm uses $\\widetilde\{\\mathcal\{O\}\}\\\!\\left\( \\frac\{\(L^2S^2\+β^2\)\(1\\veeρ^\\star\)\}\{\\varepsilon^2\} \\cdot \\log\(K\) \\right\)$ context draws and reward observations, where $ρ^\\star\\le d$ is an instance\-dependent measure of the difficulty of designing a shared sampling distribution\. Here, $L$, $S$, and $β$ bound the feature norm, reward parameter norm, and reward noise, respectively, and the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $K$, $d$, and $1/δ$\. Our method combines reward\-free planning, a regularized sampling design, and a single ridge regression estimator shared across all target policies\. An adaptive doubling procedure selects the regularization scale without knowledge of $ρ^\\star$\. The guarantees require no numerical lower bound on second\-moment eigenvalues and have no explicit dependence on the cardinalities of the context and action spaces\. Policy\-query costs are accounted for separately, with $K$ queries per shared planning context\.

## [The Threats Posed by Full Vertical Integration Monopoly in AI: Concerns Over the Birth of a &quot;Transcendent Autocrat \(Digital God\)&quot;](../publications/313c3c71512aec5806c3.md)

Sungduck Lee

This essay examines the existential and political crises arising from the vertical integration monopoly of artificial intelligence by cloud tech giants across hardware, runtimes, and physical AI operating systems\. It argues that full\-stack vertical integration threatens to give rise to a &quot;Transcendent Autocrat \(Digital God\)&quot;—either as an uncontrollable autonomous entity operating under its own algorithmic imperative or as an orchestrated instrument of absolute surveillance controlled by a few dominant platforms\. Furthermore, the paper critiques prevailing regulatory approaches focused on &quot;Capability Capping&quot; \(e\.g\., parameter restrictions, FLOP limits\), asserting that autonomy emerges not from raw computational scale but from interaction structures with the physical environment\. Ultimately, the paper advocates for dismantling centralized vertical monopolies in favor of architectural alternatives that decentralize intelligence and agency down to the edge and individual human level\.

## [Technological Performance, Strategic Perspective, and the Regulating Impact of Marketing Management](../publications/3147553f9176ad4d3c4c.md)

Anushi Singh; G\. Radha Krishna Murthy; Anandkumar Brahmbhatt; Abhinav Bhardwaz; Mohammed Yaseen Puthen Parambil Aboobaker;  Sonali Das

The successful incorporation of technological innovation and strategic thinking has become essential for equitable growth and market sustainability in modern lightning\-fast and fiercely competitive company environment\. This research explores the interconnected relationship between technological performance, strategic perspective, and the regulating impact of marketing management in modern organizations\. This study sheds light on the critical relationship between technological performance, strategic perspective, and marketing management regulation, providing valuable insights for business leaders and marketers seeking to navigate the complex interplay of technology and strategy in today&\#x27;s dynamic marketplace\. By understanding and leveraging this synergy, organizations can capitalize on technological advancements to drive innovation, foster sustainable growth, and achieve a competitive edge\.

## [‘Intelligence’ in function but not in name: analyzing terminology and trends in the job market](../publications/314c27eb22c12fdd664a.md)

Angeliki Martinou; Katie Tucker; Maria A\. Robson

Abstract Private sector intelligence uses a vast array of terminology that obscures the boundaries, clear definition and demarcation of the field\. This paper presents original empirical research to analyze job responsibilities and terminology\. It first examines 2245 job postings in the UK through an ‘intelligence analyst’ query, then engages qualitatively and quantitatively with 425 global postings\. The results reveal that private sector intelligence positions appear under a myriad of titles and descriptions that lack standardization, reflecting a wide array of roles and responsibilities which contribute to a murky recruitment environment\. This variability contributes to a ‘grey zone’ of intelligence roles and reflects the need for greater understanding of private sector intelligence functions, to delineate what truly constitutes intelligence in the private sector\.

## [Skill2Hire – An Intelligent AI\-Powered Career Assistance Platform](../publications/314fff3fda36f472f821.md)

K H MOHAN KRISHNA; LEKHANA SHREE M; NAGARAJ VENKATESH NAIK; PRAVALIKA H G; Eshwari Hiremath

Students preparing for technology\-sector recruitment must manage resume preparation, job\-description matching, vacancy discovery, interview practice, and industry updates\. These activities are often spread over different platforms\. This paper presents Skill2Hire, a modular AI\-powered career assistance platform with five independent modules: an ATS\-oriented Resume Builder, Resume Tailoring and Skill\-Gap Analysis, Job Suggestions, a Mock Interview Simulator, and a Tech News Hub\. The proposed system uses a React and TypeScript frontend, a Node\.js and Express backend, MongoDB Atlas for persistent storage, and server\-side large language model integration for selected language tasks\. A rule\-based ATS compatibility score estimates resume completeness, keyword alignment, skills coverage, structure, and formatting\. Resume tailoring follows a “Zero Fake Skills” rule: missing qualifications are reported as skill gaps rather than inserted into the candidate’s resume\. The interview module includes eligibility screening, aptitude assessment, technical interview, and behavioral HR stages\. The paper describes the design, workflows, architecture, responsible\-AI safeguards, and evaluation plan\. Claims of quantitative performance are not treated as findings unless measurements can be reproduced\. Keywords— Career assistance, Applicant Tracking System, resume tailoring, job recommendation, large language models, mock interview, skill\-gap analysis\.

## [Delivery of transgenes into Gαo\-rich subcortical structures of the mouse brain with potential applications for GNAO1 encephalopathy](../publications/315f6d8d1864ac85ac3c.md)

Svetlana G\. Vassilieva; Evgenii A\. Lunev; Alexandra A\. Tsitrina; Ali Yousef; Anna V\. Tvorogova; Anna V\. Polikarpova; Irina M\. Savchenko; Marina A\. Dzhenkova; Anna A\. Shmidt; Ivan I\. Galkin; Vyacheslav A\. Loginov; Alexandra I\. Dokuchaeva; Anna A\. Karan; Denis A\. Reshetov; Tatiana V\. Egorova; Maryana V\. Bardina

Adeno\-associated virus \(AAV\) vectors are widely used for transgene delivery into the mouse brain in preclinical studies, yet AAV methodology requires customization for each neurological disease\. In this study, we aimed to identify the optimal approach for AAV\-mediated transduction of brain regions with high expression of GNAO1 , which encodes the signaling protein Gαo\. Mutations in GNAO1 cause the neurodevelopmental disorder GNAO1 encephalopathy\. Using whole\-brain confocal imaging, we identified the highest density of Gαo\-positive neuronal somata in the striatum, thalamus, cerebellar Purkinje cell layer, and pyramidal layer of the hippocampal CA2 field in the adult mouse brain\. We compared intracerebroventricular and intravenous administration of neurotropic AAVs expressing fluorescent reporters in wild\-type mice\. Intracerebroventricular injection into neonatal mice resulted in poor penetration into deep Gαo\-rich brain regions\. In contrast, retro\-orbital administration of AAV9 in adult mice led to uniform vector distribution across Gαo\-positive cortical and subcortical regions\. For the AAV9 variant Y446F/Y731F, we demonstrated transgene delivery into neurons of dopaminergic and GABAergic pathways involved in Gαo signaling, with low tropism to GFAP\-positive cells\. Finally, we used AAV9\-Y446F/Y731F to deliver a dual\-function vector designed to silence endogenous Gnao1 and express a replacement GNAO1 transgene\. Although in vitro testing was successful and brain delivery met expectations, transgene expression remained low, indicating the need for expression cassette improvement\. Together, our findings define an effective AAV strategy for targeting Gαo\-rich regions of the mouse brain and support development of gene therapy for GNAO1 encephalopathy\.

## [Deep Vein Thrombosis Risk Prediction after Total Hip Replacement at Kandou Hospital](../publications/31682bc97f2a43f734af.md)

Ira Frayanty Sarewa; Djony Edward Tjandra; Billy Karundeng

Deep vein thrombosis \(DVT\) is a clinically significant complication following total hip arthroplasty \(THA\), requiring a clear distinction between observed postoperative events and model\-based risk estimates\. This prospective cohort study enrolled 62 patients who underwent THA at Prof\. Dr\. R\. D\. Kandou Hospital in Manado, Indonesia, between January 2023 and December 2024, with a 90\-day follow\-up period\. Clinical characteristics, Wells scores, D\-dimer levels, fibrinogen levels, and Doppler ultrasonography findings were recorded\. Descriptive findings indicated that 46 participants \(74%\) were male, 48 \(77%\) had elevated D\-dimer levels, and all documented Doppler ultrasonography examinations yielded normal findings\. A Monte Carlo simulation comprising 10,000 iterations was also performed using a logistic regression equation with coefficients reportedly derived from published literature rather than estimated from the study cohort\. The simulation yielded a median predicted DVT prevalence of 7\.3%, with a 95% prediction interval of 0%–29%\. However, this estimate represented a simulation\-derived outcome rather than the observed incidence of postoperative DVT\. The available manuscript did not report the actual number of incident DVT events during the 90\-day follow\-up and contained an unresolved inconsistency between the exclusion of patients with active cancer and the reported inclusion of seven participants with active cancer\. \[AUTHOR DATA REQUIRED: Confirm the number of observed DVT events during follow\-up and clarify the eligibility criteria concerning active cancer\.\] Overall, the study provided descriptive information on clinical characteristics and potential DVT risk factors in a local THA population, alongside an exploratory simulation\-based risk estimation framework\. Nevertheless, cohort\-specific predictive associations, model discrimination, and calibration could not be established without verification of the observed clinical outcomes, model coefficients, and estimation procedures\.

## [A unified LSTM autoencoder–random forest AI\-IoT framework for real\-time water quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and water quality index prediction](../publications/3176d8c2c46cb863dedc.md)

Godfrey Perfectson Oise; Immunhierokene Clinton OBRORINDO; Ifeoma Vivian Ngonadi; Augustine Emakpor Otorokpo

Real\-time water quality monitoring is essential for protecting aquatic ecosystems and public health; however, existing intelligent monitoring systems typically address either anomaly detection or Water Quality Index \(WQI\) prediction independently, limiting their effectiveness for continuous environmental surveillance\. This study proposes a unified Artificial Intelligence–Internet of Things \(AI\-IoT\) framework that integrates a Long Short\-Term Memory Autoencoder \(LSTM\-AE\) for unsupervised temporal anomaly detection with a Random Forest regressor for WQI prediction within a coordinated decision\-support architecture\. The novelty of the proposed framework lies in the architectural integration of complementary learning models to simultaneously detect abnormal water quality conditions and estimate WQI in real time, rather than introducing new machine learning algorithms\. A synthetic multivariate IoT water quality dataset comprising 10,000 observations was developed to emulate realistic environmental monitoring conditions, including temporal dependencies, sensor noise, drift, seasonal variations, and contamination events\. Experimental evaluation demonstrated that the proposed LSTM Autoencoder achieved a ROC\-AUC of 0\.9763, outperforming Isolation Forest \( 0\.8914 \) and One\-Class SVM \(0\.8732\) for anomaly detection\. For WQI prediction, the Random Forest regressor achieved the lowest prediction error with an MSE of 2\.3573, surpassing Gradient Boosting \(2\.6841\), Sequence\-to\-One Recurrent Neural Network \(2\.9137\), and Support Vector Regression \(3\.1048 \)\. These results demonstrate that integrating temporal anomaly detection with ensemble\-based regression provides a robust and scalable solution for intelligent water quality monitoring\. Although validated using a reproducible synthetic benchmark, the framework establishes a practical foundation for AI\-enabled environmental monitoring, with future work focusing on validation using real\-world IoT water quality datasets\.

## [Uso de la inteligencia artificial generativa para el diseño de recursos didácticos en la Educación General Básica Media del contexto ecuatoriano](../publications/3179615500d6775bb703.md)

Renan Alejandro Quito Chulca; Rolan Andres Carapaz Ñacata; Eliana del Cisne Sanchez Aguirre; Jorge Francisco Zambrano Pachay

La presente investigación analizó el uso de la inteligencia artificial generativa como herramienta de apoyo para el diseño de recursos didácticos en Educación General Básica Media en el contexto ecuatoriano\. El estudio se desarrolló bajo un enfoque cuantitativo, con alcance descriptivo y diseño cuasiexperimental de tipo pretest\-postest\. La intervención incluyó una fase diagnóstica, capacitación docente, implementación de herramientas de inteligencia artificial generativa y evaluación posterior\. Para la recolección de datos se utilizaron un cuestionario tipo Likert, una rúbrica analítica para valorar la calidad de los recursos didácticos y una ficha de seguimiento de la implementación\. Los resultados mostraron un incremento favorable en las dimensiones relacionadas con conocimiento sobre inteligencia artificial, facilidad de uso, capacidad para diseñar recursos, percepción de ahorro de tiempo y utilidad pedagógica\. Asimismo, los materiales elaborados alcanzaron niveles altos en criterios como alineación curricular, pertinencia pedagógica, claridad, adecuación al nivel de los estudiantes y organización visual\. Se concluye que la inteligencia artificial generativa puede constituirse en un recurso complementario para fortalecer la práctica docente y diversificar la creación de materiales educativos, siempre que su incorporación esté acompañada por capacitación, supervisión humana, revisión crítica y adaptación al contexto curricular y sociocultural\. Estos hallazgos respaldan la necesidad de promover competencias digitales docentes orientadas al uso pedagógico y responsable de herramientas de inteligencia artificial\.

## [Topology\-adjusted knockout \(TAKO\): interpretable in silico single\-gene knockout ranking on wild\-type single\-cell gene regulatory networks](../publications/31897daa9ba280f5e80c.md)

Hao Wang; Koji Oba

Predicting single\-gene knockout effects from wild\-type single\-cell RNA\-seq data remains challenging when perturbation experiments are costly and existing approaches require knockout\-specific model training\. Here we introduce Topology\-Adjusted Knockout \(TAKO\), a computationally efficient WT\-only framework for single\-gene KO impact ranking on single\-cell gene regulatory networks\. The method applies a strict cut\-in\-and\-out intervention on network transition dynamics and quantifies impact by contrasting stationary propagation profiles before and after perturbation under the same restart distribution\. In SERGIO simulations, TAKO recovered direct regulator–target structure but did not show a consistent global advantage over a matched absolute Pearson\-correlation ranking across network sizes\. Direct evaluation against measured responses in Trem2 and Nkx2\-1 KO data likewise yielded mixed global discrimination, although TAKO contained more differentially expressed genes among the top\-ranked candidates in both examples\. These results position TAKO as a fast, interpretable topology\-based prioritisation method rather than a generally superior predictor of post\-KO expression responses\.

## [La inclusión educativa de estudiantes con dificultades de aprendizaje: estrategias pedagógicas y desafíos docentes](../publications/3194eb854094e489f8b1.md)

Jonathan Vinicio Moyano Soria

La inclusión educativa de estudiantes con dificultades de aprendizaje requiere articular las decisiones pedagógicas con la preparación docente y condiciones institucionales\. El objetivo de este artículo es analizar las estrategias de enseñanza y los desafíos de su implementación mediante una revisión narrativa de literatura científica y documentos técnicos\. Se organizó un corpus intencional de veinticinco fuentes, integrado por veintitrés publicaciones científicas de 2020 a 2026 y dos documentos técnicos\. El análisis se estructuró en tres categorías: estrategias pedagógicas, formación y desafíos docentes, y condiciones institucionales\. La interpretación diferenció investigaciones empíricas, revisiones y orientaciones técnicas, considerando sus poblaciones y límites\. Los resultados permiten distinguir la planificación accesible para el conjunto del aula de los apoyos focalizados en lectura y matemáticas\. La enseñanza diferenciada y el Diseño Universal para el Aprendizaje aportan criterios para ampliar las oportunidades de participación, mientras que las investigaciones sobre intervenciones específicas delimitan habilidades y resultados académicos\. La formación profesional muestra cambios de distinta magnitud en conocimientos, habilidades y creencias, lo que exige relacionar sus objetivos con oportunidades de aplicación\. Como implicación educativa, se plantea coordinar la accesibilidad, los apoyos específicos y el seguimiento del progreso\. La selección intencional, el acceso desigual a textos completos y la heterogeneidad del corpus limitan la exhaustividad y transferencia de los hallazgos\. Se concluye que la inclusión requiere decisiones contextualizadas, colaboración y evaluación continua, sin atribuir eficacia uniforme a todas las estrategias ni generalizar los resultados a las instituciones ecuatorianas\. Estos criterios orientan la reflexión pedagógica y futuras investigaciones en contextos escolares\.

## [Prediction of acute mountain sickness risk by pre\-plateau uric acid and albumin levels in Chinese young males: a prospective cohort study](../publications/3195b5f882ddaa34c888.md)

Hong chen Xie; Xiang qiong Meng; Shen wei Xie; Ze Jun Wang; CUI Qi; Xiao Ling Tan

Objective To screen and identify pre\-plateau hematological parameters that can predict the risk of acute mountain sickness \(AMS\) in individuals rapidly ascending to high altitudes\. Methods A total of 297 healthy adult males with an average age of 20\.88 ± 1\.76 years were included in the study\. Baseline data were collected at an altitude of 300 m using questionnaire surveys, on\-site testing, and hematological parameter tests \(including routine blood and serum biochemical parameters with validated clinical detection systems\)\. After ascending to an altitude of 4,200 m, the Lake Louise Score \(LLS\) 2018 and physiological indicator measurements were obtained on the second day\. AMS was defined as an LLS 2018 ≥3 points accompanied by headache\. A univariate logistic regression model was used to screen for the hematological parameters associated with AMS\. Multivariate logistic regression was then used to adjust for covariates and determine the relationship between pre\-plateau albumin \(ALB\) levels, uric acid \(UA\) levels, UA\-to\-ALB ratio \(UAR\), and AMS risk\. Additionally, the predictive value was assessed using the receiver operating characteristic \(ROC\) curve, and the optimal cutoff value was determined using the Youden index\. Finally, a subgroup analysis was conducted to determine the consistency of associations\. Results The incidence of AMS after arriving at the 4,200 m plateau was 29\.97%\. Univariate logistic regression analysis revealed associations between factors at 300 m, including heart rate, alcohol consumption, ALB, UA, and AMS\. In the fully adjusted multivariate Model 3, pre\-plateau ALB, UA, and UAR showed moderate predictive performance for AMS, with area under the ROC curve values of 0\.710, 0\.701, and 0\.711, respectively \(all P &lt; 0\.001\)\. The optimal cutoff values were 47\.25 g/L for ALB, 420\.10 μmol/L for UA, and 7\.45 for UAR\. The UAR exhibited favorable predictive performance in populations with a body mass index &lt;25 kg/m 2 , a history of low\-altitude residence, or alcohol consumption\. Conclusion Pre\-plateau UA levels, ALB levels, and UAR are independent predictors of AMS risk in young healthy Chinese males\. All three biomarkers exhibited moderate predictive performance, with the UAR showed particular utility in specific subgroups\.

## [From Image Creation to Platform Accountability: A Legal and Policy Framework for AI\-Morphed Images on Social Media](../publications/3196d67a5fe246476f58.md)

Bikash Gortola

This paper examines the growing problem of AI\-morphed images and synthetic visual content, with particular attention to non\-consensual intimate imagery, identity misuse, and the responsibilities of social media platforms\. As generative AI makes image manipulation increasingly accessible, controlling individual acts of creation becomes progressively more difficult\. This paper argues that the regulatory focus must extend beyond the creator to the platforms that distribute, amplify, and monetise such content\. It proposes a conceptual legal and policy framework centred on platform\-level accountability, including automated detection, accessible reporting mechanisms, rapid content removal, repeat\-offender sanctions, transparency, and proportionate enforcement\. Particular attention is given to the protection of women against non\-consensual sexualised imagery, while recognising the need to preserve legitimate artistic expression, satire, journalism, and freedom of speech\. The paper also examines the emerging Indian regulatory context and considers how existing intermediary obligations might be implemented and evaluated more effectively\. Its central proposition is that, when the creation of harmful content cannot be comprehensively controlled, the systems through which that content reaches the public must become a principal point of prevention, intervention, and accountability\. Research scope: This is a conceptual legal and policy research paper\. It develops a proposed regulatory framework and research questions for future empirical investigation; it does not present original empirical findings or claim that all jurisdictions apply the same legal standards\. Keywords: Artificial intelligence, AI\-morphed images, deepfakes, platform accountability, social media regulation, intermediary liability, personality rights, non\-consensual intimate imagery, content moderation, digital rights, India\.

## [Jeffrey Epstein: anàlisi del discurs de l&\#x27;autorepresentació i les relacions de poder en els seus correus electrònics \(2008\-2011\)](../publications/31a4cc51380be4959cc8.md)

Carlos Obra Lorente

\[EN\] This dissertation is situated within the field of Digital Humanities and explores the intersection of Critical Discourse Analysis \(CDA\), corpus linguistics, and artificial intelligence\. It focuses on the use of generative AI to extend CDA from a small, manually analyzed sample to a larger corpus\. The study examines emails written by Jeffrey Epstein between 2008 and 2011\. Taking into consideration the language of power and the size of the corpus, it presents as an opportunity for both qualitative and quantitative research\. The emails are approached from two main perspectives: self\-representation and relations of power\. These are analyzed through four complementary frameworks: Fairclough’s three\-dimensional model, Davies and Harré’s positioning theory, van Leeuwen’s model of legitimation, and van Dijk’s approach to manipulation and social power\. Nine emails are first analyzed in detail to develop a codebook, which is then used to guide LLM annotation across larger samples\. The main question is whether CDA categories developed through close reading can be applied at a larger scale with the help of an LLM, considering possibilities and limitations during this process\. By bringing qualitative and quantitative methods together, the dissertation explores how generative AI can support the expansion of CDA\-based analysis while keeping human interpretation at its center\.

## [Crowdsourced Intelligence vs\. AI Propaganda: The Challenges of Global Governance in the Age of Digital Warfare](../publications/31a6455924202cddfd7f.md)

Pragati Khanna; Harsh Dixit; Jannet Emma Tonateni Fransisco; Varsha Dhio Dora; Trisha Dev

Abstract Artificial Intelligence has fundamentally changed the modern digital operation, whereby creating a constant struggle between what is perceived to be true and the human reality\. This study uses a qualitative, exploratory\-descriptive study using secondary data from academic journals, policy documents and institutional reports to examine the interaction between crowdsourced Open\-Sourced Intelligence \(OSINT\) and Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) driven propaganda in modern warfare, alongside the global governance challenges that arise from their interaction\. Findings reveal that there is a serious tension within the digital information ecosystem: whilst generative Artificial Intelligence promotes public opinions to spread disinformation and misinformation that is persuasive and may manipulate political processes, crowdsourced intelligence offers real\-time verification and transparency\. There are Regulatory Frameworks such as the European Union’s AI Act and Digital Services Act that serve as blueprints to counter AI\-driven manipulation from technical solutions to the adoption of human\-centered governance models\. Ultimately, the study demonstrates that it is important to maintain digital information integrity by balancing computational tools with collaborative human verification to foster resilience against any revolving threats in digital security and global governance\. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence, Open\-Source Intelligence \(OSINT\), Crowdsourced Verification, AI\-Driven Propaganda, Digital Warfare, Global Governance, Disinformation, Epistemic Sovereignty

## [Integrating HAZOP, Reliability Analysis, and Risk\-Based DecisionMaking into Critical Energy Infrastructure Design](../publications/31b42404ca3c4df827e0.md)

Eromosele Asibor

This paper develops a common scenario model that translates HAZOP findings into reliability structures, risk priorities, and verified design actions\. The study responds to the problem that design teams often identify process deviations, equipment failures, and business interruption through separate studies with inconsistent boundaries and assumptions\. It uses an integrative conceptual review of scholarly and professional literature published to date, drawing on peerreviewed journal articles, guideline documents, and international standards synthesized within this manuscript\. The framework organizes eight decision functions: design\-basis confirmation, HAZOP deviation review, failure\-mode analysis, fault and event tree modelling, barrier assessment, risk evaluation, design action prioritization, closeout assurance\. It applies those functions across feed and transfer systems, separation and treating units, compression systems, storage systems, pipeline interfaces, utilities and control systems\. The analysis treats uncertainty, process safety, reliability, environmental performance, resource efficiency, economics, and organizational control as connected requirements\. The proposed architecture links a system definition, evidence register, model assumptions, intervention portfolio, verification plan, and learning cycle\. Its central proposition is that connect deviation analysis, failure logic, barrier performance, consequence evaluation, and design decisions through one traceable workflow when decisions preserve traceability from measured conditions to selected actions and verified outcomes\. The paper offers testable propositions, an implementation roadmap, asset\-specific application protocols, and a research agenda\. The framework supports case\-study testing and quantitative extension without claiming universal performance before field validation\.

## [Balancing early detection and performance in predicting students at risk of dropout on MOOCs using time\-series analysis and a hybrid deep learning model](../publications/31b45ba47cc36b4d7a2e.md)

Mohamed Amine Ouassil; Mohammed Jebbari; Mouaad Errami; Rabia Rachidi; Soufiane Hamida; Bouchaib Cherradi; Abdelhadi Raihani

Student engagement functions as the main factor which determines how effective online educational programs will be\. For this reason, Massive Open Online Course \(MOOC\) platforms must identify students who might withdraw the course at specific times to implement timely interventions\. Current identification methods focus primarily on final accuracy metrics to identify their target students\. The study proposes a Multi\-Input Convolutional Bidirectional Long Short\-Term Memory model \(MI\-CBiL\), which integrates static enrollment\-history features with dynamic daily interaction matrices for early MOOC dropout prediction\. The model jointly processes static enrollment\-history features and dynamic daily interaction matrices, while a weighted multi\-objective criterion is subsequently applied to select a prediction window that balances predictive accuracy and intervention timeliness\. The MI\-CBiL model achieved 95\.20% accuracy on the KDD Cup dataset while surpassing the baseline architectural results\. An Early Warning configuration identified at\-risk students within the initial days of enrollment with 93\.11% accuracy, whereas a High Precision setup saved 35\.9% of the course duration while achieving 95\.34% accuracy\. The framework delivers an effective solution which enables rapid MOOC retention improvements through its proactive approach\.

## [Experimental Design Signatures Emerge from Topic Modeling of Graphene Oxide Literature](../publications/31b6e23471e16dd5deec.md)

Henry Julio Kobs; Henrique Ferreira; Yang Liu; Amauri Jardim de Paula; Carlos E\. Andrade; Andréia Fonseca de Faria

Abstract The literature on graphene oxide \(GO\) comprises hundreds of thousands of publications spanning synthesis, characterization, and applications in diverse domains\. Advancing GO materials requires a structured knowledge map derived from systematic mining of this extensive corpus\. However, extracting meaningful insights from this vast, heterogeneous, sparse, and unstructured data remains a challenge\. To address this challenge, Natural Language Processing techniques, including topic modeling, community discovery, and parameter extraction, are here employed to establish a framework\. Latent Dirichlet Allocation \(LDA\) was applied to the full text of more than 120,000 articles, enabling the identification of eight macro\-domains within the GO literature, and neural topic modeling was subsequently employed to characterize the granularity and heterogeneity of these domains\. Parameter extraction was performed using Large Language Models \(LLMs\) on a subset of 8000 full\-text articles, with a proto\-ontology incorporated into the extraction prompt\. Even with a broad prompt, an F1 score of 94% was achieved against manual validation\. The extracted parameters were then clustered through community modeling and compared with the LDA\-derived topics\. At this intermediate resolution of the literature, we demonstrate the application of a recommendation system for relevant parameters according to the material family and application domain\. The applicability of the framework at higher resolutions was further demonstrated through the construction of a data set of CO2 adsorption for graphene\- and GO\-based materials\. This data set was subsequently employed in a downstream predictive case study using an Extremely Randomized Trees Regressor, with different training\-test splitting strategies evaluated to assess in\-domain and out\-of\-domain generalization at article\-level resolution\.

## [Изменение кардиореспираторных функций при артериальной гипертонии в зависимости от мышечных групп, вовлеченных в аэробную нагрузку \(рандомизированное контролируемое исследование\)](../publications/31c17b4eda7231d69bc6.md)

A\. V\. Meshtel; Alexander B\. Miroshnikov; Andrei V\. Smolensky

Introduction: Arterial hypertension remains a leading modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular diseases and mortality, particularly among middle\-aged men\. Traditional rehabilitation programs based on aerobic exercise for the lower limbs demonstrate a limited antihypertensive effect\. The involvement of upper limb muscles, which possess a high adaptive potential, may enhance training effectiveness\. Objective: To develop and experimentally substantiate a high\-intensity interval training \(HIIT\) program for upper and lower limb muscles in the physical rehabilitation of men aged 35–60 years with stage 1 arterial hypertension\. Materials and methods: The study included 75 men who were randomized into four groups: upper limb training, lower limb training, combined upper and lower limb training, and a control group\. The training program lasted 24 weeks with a frequency of three sessions per week at an intensity of 90% of maximal oxygen uptake power\. Ergospirometric parameters and blood pressure levels were assessed before and after the intervention\. Results: The greatest increase in maximal oxygen uptake during lower limb testing was observed in the lower limb and combined training groups, while during upper limb testing it was observed in the upper limb and combined training groups\. The combined training group demonstrated the greatest reduction in systolic blood pressure \(16\.4±10\.0 mmHg; p&lt;0\.001; d=–1\.64\), significantly exceeding the results of isolated training and control groups\. Diastolic blood pressure decreased significantly only in the combined training and lower limb training groups\. Conclusion: A combined high\-intensity interval training program involving both upper and lower limb muscles is a highly effective non\-pharmacological intervention for arterial hypertension\. It provides a synergistic antihypertensive effect and a significant improvement in cardiorespiratory fitness, supporting its use to reduce cardiovascular risk in middle\-aged men\.

## [Küresel Ekonomik Politika Belirsizlikleri Borsa Endeksleri İçin Engelleyici Bir Güç Müdür? Türkiye Örneği İçin Ampirik Bir Analiz](../publications/31cb5d5bda2a7965b1d1.md)

Salih Parmaksız

Bu çalışma Türkiye için küresel ekonomik politika belirsizliklerinin \(GEPU\) BİST 100, BİST Sınai, BİST Hizmetler ve BİST Teknoloji endekslerine etkisini 2013:01\-2025:06 dönemindeki aylık veriler yardımıyla analiz etmektedir\. Sanayi üretimi, döviz kuru, enflasyon ve faiz oranı değişkenlerinin kontrol değişkeni olarak ele alındığı çalışmada, Johansen eşbütünleşme ile hata düzeltme modelleri kullanılarak kısa ve uzun dönemli ilişkiler tahmin edilmiştir\. Yapılan analizler küresel ekonomik politika belirsizliklerinin çalışmada kullanılan borsa endekslerini ve bu endekslerin getirilerini uzun dönemde negatif etkilediğini kısa dönemde ise etkilemediğini göstermiştir\. Sanayi üretiminin, döviz kurunun ve enflasyonun uzun dönemde çoğunlukla borsa endeksleri üzerinde olumlu etkileri olduğu tespit edilirken faiz oranının negatif etkileri olduğu gözlenmiştir\. Kısa dönemde ise enflasyonun borsa endekslerini artırdığı diğer tüm değişkenlerin borsa endeksleri üzerinde etkili olmadığı sonucuna ulaşılmıştır\. Çalışmanın bulguları yönüyle önemli politika önerileri mevcuttur\. Gelişmekte olan ülkeler arasında yer alan Türkiye ekonomisinde belirsizlik şoklarına karşı gerekli risk yönetimi stratejilerini barındıran etkin para ve maliye politikaları izlenmelidir\.

## [Optimization of Deep Learning Approach Using Chaotic Algorithm for Hepatitis Detection](../publications/31d202c54cabaa5347c0.md)

Giliki Jerison; Oladunjoye John Abiodun; Joseph Achu Okuta

Hepatitis still remains one of the major health issues in the world and is responsible for a significant amount of morbidity and mortality due to diseases related to the liver\. Traditional approaches for hepatitis detection are costly, laboratorial, time\-consuming, and error\-prone\. While AI and DL have enhanced medical diagnosis significantly, current models are prone to problems such as overfitting, long convergence period, and lack of generalization, which are primarily associated with inefficiency of hyperparameter optimization\. In this research, the authors propose the use of optimized deep learning model based on Chaotic Optimization Algorithm \(COA\) for hepatitis detection\. This approach combines Multi\-Layer Perceptron \(MLP\) and Deep Neural Network \(DNN\) models with the application of COA, which allows optimizing such parameters as learning rate, hidden neurons, momentum, and weights initialization\. Two publicly available datasets \(the Kaggle Hepatitis Dataset and the UCI Hepatitis Dataset\) have been used in this research\. Data preprocessing steps including handling missing values, encoding, normalization, and splitting data into train and test datasets were applied\. The COA\-DNN gave results of 85\.11% for accuracy, 77\.83% for precision, 83\.24% for recall, 79\.85% for F1 score, and 0\.9054 for AUC on the Kaggle dataset compared to the conventional DNN which had an accuracy of 57\.45%\. For the UCI dataset, the highest accuracy rate was achieved by COA\-DNN at 96\.76%, precision of 95\.86%, recall of 88\.82%, F1 score of 91\.94%, and AUC of 0\.9793\. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence; Chaotic Optimization Algorithm; Deep Learning; Hepatitis Detection; Hyperparameter Optimization; Multi\-Layer Perceptron; Neural\.

## [LGALS3BP is associated with selective cargo enrichment in neuroblastoma extracellular vesicles](../publications/31dca564ceafc1f7492c.md)

Ilaria Cela; Fanì Konstantinidou; Laura Amodei; Arianna Mercatelli; Francesca Piermatteo; Sara Santoro; Asia Pece; Maria Clara Staropoli; Alessia Lamolinara; Emily Capone; Valentina Gatta; Gianluca Sala

Aim LGALS3BP \(also known as Galectin\-3\-binding protein, Gal\-3BP, or 90 K\) is a multifunctional secreted glycoprotein involved in tumor progression and has emerged as a potential biomarker and therapeutic target in several malignancies, including neuroblastoma \(NB\)\. Increasing evidence suggests that LGALS3BP contributes to shaping the NB tumor microenvironment \(TME\), particularly through its enrichment on tumor\-derived extracellular vesicles \(EVs\), where it may regulate tumor\-stroma interplay\. We investigated whether LGALS3BP contributes to stromal cell modulation in NB and is associated with changes in EV cargo composition\. Methods A patient\-derived NB cell line naturally lacking LGALS3BP \(hNB CTRL\) and a matched counterpart ectopically re\-expressing LGALS3BP \(hNB LGALS3BP\) were used\. Bone marrow\-derived mesenchymal stem cells \(BMMSCs\) were exposed to NB\-derived conditioned media \(CM\) to assess cytokine secretion and LGALS3BP detection in recipient cells\. EV cargo was analyzed by microRNA \(miRNA\) and proteomic profiling\. Selected candidates were validated by qPCR and immunoblotting on NB\-derived EVs\. Results LGALS3BP\-containing CM was associated with an altered BMMSCs secretory profile, while tumor\-derived extracellular LGALS3BP was detected in BMMSCs\. Seven miRNAs were enriched in LGALS3BP\-EVs and reduced in donor cells; four were increased in BMMSCs following EV exposure\.
