## [FDG PET/CT in Primary Extranodal Non\-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma: Imaging Spectrum and Diagnostic Challenges in the Abdomen and Musculoskeletal System](../publications/31e3807af26f7e138c1b.md)

Prakash Singh; Siddharth Sharma; Punita Pavecha; Manish Ora; Gaurav Datta; Vineet Mishra

Primary extranodal non\-Hodgkin lymphomas \(eNHL\) are clinically and radiologically diverse\. The clinical and imaging presentation is heterogenous and often mimicking primary malignancies, infection, or inflammatory diseases\. FDG PET/CT although provides whole\-body metabolic assessment but presents unique challenges\. To illustrate the diverse manifestations of primary eNHL and highlight imaging patterns, pitfalls, and clinically differentials, in abdominal and musculoskeletal involvement\. Histopathologically confirmed cases of primary eNHL evaluated with FDG PET/CT were retrospectively reviewed\. Cases were purposively selected to represent common and uncommon sites\. Imaging findings were correlated with CT morphology, histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and treatment response\. In eNHL, FDG PET/CT demonstrated a wide spectrum of involvement, including liver, spleen, stomach, bowel, adrenals, kidney, skin, and bone\. Recognition of characteristic various patterns, such as bulky lesions with preserved tissue architecture, aneurysmal bowel dilatation, vascular encasement without narrowing, and permeative osseous involvement, helped distinguish eNHL from common mimics\. PET/CT also identified occult disease, multifocal involvement and extent of disease and allows assessment of treatment response\. Inflammation and variable FDG avidity in indolent lymphomas remained important pitfalls\. FDG PET/CT is a valuable tool for staging, detection of occult extranodal disease, and treatment\-response assessment in eNHL\. Awareness of site\-specific imaging patterns and mimics, integrated with contrast\-enhanced CT and histopathological correlation, is essential for optimal clinical management\.

## [Beyond Compliance: A Reflexive Thematic Analysis of Healthcare Workers&\#x27; Job Satisfaction through Perceptions of Organizational Justice in an Indonesian Hospital](../publications/31ed4c9b4da1e77e7904.md)

Muhammad Krisnanda Candra Mahkota; Rusmalia Dewi; Arumwardhani Nusandari

This qualitative study explores how healthcare workers perceive organizational justice and how these perceptions shape their job satisfaction in an Indonesian hospital\. Using a reflexive thematic analysis guided by the Gioia methodology, this study examined lived experiences of fairness, leadership responsiveness, and trust in the hospital workplace through in\-depth interviews with five healthcare workers across radiology, pharmacy, medicine, and nursing\. The analysis produced five second\-order themes organized under three aggregate dimensions: perceived imbalance between contribution and outcome, erosion of organizational trust, and psychological dissociation with a recovery\-oriented orientation\. Findings indicate that uneven workload distribution, limited leadership presence during periods of strain, and repeated unmet expectations progressively erode employees&\#x27; trust, even as employees continue to perform their professional duties competently\. Despite this erosion, participants consistently expressed hope for organizational repair rather than intentions to leave, suggesting a reservoir of goodwill that hospital management can still draw upon\. The findings extend organizational justice theory by illustrating a process\-oriented, rather than static, model of justice perception in a hierarchical, collectivist healthcare setting\. This study discusses practical implications for hospital leadership, including transparent workload allocation and responsive crisis communication\. Keywords: Healthcare workers; Job satisfaction; Organizational justice; Reflexive thematic analysis; Trust

## [AI\-Powered Decision Support System for Forest Fire Rescue Using Twitter and GPT\-Based Analysis](../publications/31eed327f79a4c516dee.md)

Özge Doğuç

This study presents the Forest Fire Rescue Decision Support System \(FFR\-DSS\), an AI\-powered framework integrating GPT\-4\-based semantic analysis with real\-time Twitter data to support emergency rescue coordination during forest fires in Turkey\. Using tweets from the catastrophic 2021 wildfires affecting Muğla and Antalya, FFR\-DSS employs prompt\-engineered large language model \(LLM\) pipelines to extract urgency scores, emotional tone, geographical information, and actionability indicators from crisis\-related social media content\. Unlike traditional natural language processing \(NLP\) approaches such as Bag\-of\-Words \(BoW\) and TF\-IDF, which may struggle with contextually rich and emotionally variable messages, the proposed framework leverages GPT\-4&\#x27;s zero\-shot semantic reasoning capabilities without requiring task\-specific labeled training datasets\. A geospatial risk mapping component further aggregates tweet\-level outputs into district\-level risk scores and dynamic heatmaps, enabling emergency teams to identify critical areas and prioritize resource allocation\. Evaluation against a manually annotated sample demonstrates that FFR\-DSS achieves 92\.4% classification precision and 89\.1% recall, substantially outperforming the BoW\+SVM baseline with 72\.8% accuracy\. These results demonstrate the potential of LLM\-augmented social media analytics to transform unstructured crisis communications into actionable intelligence, improving situational awareness, rescue coordination, and data\-driven decision\-making during large\-scale natural disasters\.In addition to its natural language understanding capabilities, FFR\-DSS incorporates a geospatial mapping component to visualize and monitor critical rescue zones dynamically\. By aligning semantic outputs with location data, the system helps authorities prioritize interventions in areas of greatest need\. Empirical evaluations show that FFR\-DSS achieves higher classification accuracy and interpretability than prior baseline methods, offering a more robust, transparent, and context\-aware framework for emergency response\. The results suggest that GPT\-based systems represent a transformative step in disaster management technology, particularly in scenarios requiring rapid analysis and decision\-making based on unstructured social media content\.

## [LexPilot: Benchmarking the Proactive Interaction Ability of Legal LLMs with Laypeople in Chinese Civil Case Consultation](../publications/31febe18ecab40394c76.md)

Wenbin Zhang; ShangZhan Li; Bingxiang He; Ye He; Yuxin Zhou; Muzhen Cai; Qi Shi; Wanxiang Che

Large Language Models \(LLMs\) have greatly assisted legal professionals\. However, our empirical studies reveal that, when faced with underspecified consultations from non\-experts, current LLMs often produce irresponsible responses with limited utility despite lacking sufficient case details for definitive conclusions\. To better assist laypeople, legal LLMs must identify focal points of dispute and proactively elicit crucial context from users\. Unfortunately, existing data resources often focus on interaction and response quality, offering limited insight into how proactive interaction affects LLMs&\#x27; downstream claim\-level judgment prediction in actual civil cases\. To address this gap, we introduce \\textbf\{LexPilot\}, a benchmark linking proactive legal interaction to claim\-level verdict prediction using authentic Chinese civil judgments\. Constructed from 432 real\-world judgments across 36 common causes of action, LexPilot comprises expert\-reviewed pairs of complete and underspecified consultation histories with corresponding court verdicts\. Experiments reveal that current LLMs struggle with proactive legal interactions in underspecified consultations, with downstream judgment prediction substantially underperforming that in the fully specified consultation setup \(\-23\.84% on average\)\. Further analysis identifies critical bottlenecks hindering these capabilities\. Our work highlights the urgent need for more user\-centered legal AI to better serve the public\.

## [Thermo\-Mechanical Analysis of Laminated and Sandwich Plates—Bending and Buckling Behavior](../publications/321241acd9cd9f1c7851.md)

Mohini Khade; Keshav Kashinath Sangle

This paper presents a comprehensive thermo\-mechanical analysis of laminated composite sandwich plates, focusing on bending deformations and buckling stability under combined thermal and mechanical loading\.A First\-Order Shear Deformation Theory \(FSDT\)\-based formulation is employed, and a finite element model is developed in ABAQUS to simulate plate response\.A symmetric sandwich plate with carbon/epoxy face sheets and a lightweight core is analyzed under a uniform transverse pressure and a through\-thickness temperature gradient\.Results show that thermal effects substantially increase the bending deflection \(over 100% rise for a 100°C gradient\) and alter stress distributions, with face sheets carrying most of the load while the core bears minimal stress\.Parametric studies indicate that a higher temperature gradient notably reduces the plate&\#x27;s effective bending stiffness \(by \~18%\) and consequently lowers the critical buckling load and natural frequencies\.The numerical predictions are validated against an analytical FSDT solution, showing close agreement \(&lt;5% difference in deflection\)\.These findings highlight the importance of including thermal loads in the design of composite sandwich structures and demonstrate the accuracy of the FSDT\-based finite element approach for predicting their structural behavior\.

## [Stimuli\-Responsive Nanocarriers in Oncology: Tumor Microenvironment Triggers, Overcoming Biological Barriers, and Clinical Reality](../publications/3213573e2a80daeb09ea.md)

Dipu Pan; Shubhajit Sarkar; Souvik Adhikary; Amit Mia; Shamim Khandokar; Kunal Das; Bipasha De; Megha Das; Sagarika Ghosh

Conventional anticancer nano\-therapies often rely on passive accumulation through the enhanced permeability and retention \(EPR\) effect, resulting in insufficient penetration of tumor tissue and heterogeneous cellular uptake\. Smart nanocarriers that are able to respond to specific stimuli through conformational, charge\-reversal, or structural phase changes to improve targeting efficacy at the tumor site have been proposed as promising alternatives\. These stimuli\-responsive smart nanocarriers undergo conformational changes or transitions in charge, solubility, or structure when exposed to a specific triggering stimulus\. Smart nanocarriers can be triggered by either endogenous biochemical perturbations associated with the tumor microenvironment or external ex vivo physical triggers\. The former includes the extracellular and endosomal pH gradients, the increased intracellular glutathione redox potential, and dysregulated proteolytic enzymes in the tumor microenvironment, while the latter includes near\-infrared light, alternating magnetic fields, and high\-intensity focused ultrasound\. This article reviews the fundamental bio responsive molecular mechanisms, nanocarrier types, clinical reality, translational barriers, and design\-by\-quality principles relevant to the development of responsive nanotherapeutics for clinical oncology\. Keywords: Stimuli\-Responsive Nanocarriers, Tumor Microenvironment, Smart Drug Delivery, Redox Trigger, Endosomal Escape, Clinical Translation\.

## [A human\-centred, explainable digital system to support emotional self\-regulation and everyday psychological well\-being](../publications/321e5adca8a8a1e84d55.md)

Ayodeji Olusegun Ibitoye; Omolola Oluyemisi Haastrup; David B\. Olawade

Abstract Self\-regulating emotions, thoughts, and behaviours is central to psychological well\-being but often difficult to sustain without structured support, particularly under stress or cognitive overload\. This study introduces a human\-centred digital system designed to support everyday emotional self\-regulation through personalised, explainable self\-care guidance grounded in established models of emotion regulation and self\-regulated behaviour\. The system adapts to users’ reported emotional state, cognitive load, time and energy constraints, and personal preferences to generate actionable self\-care plans accompanied by natural\-language explanations that clarify the system’s reasoning and contrast alternative strategies, supporting user understanding and autonomy\. The system is intended for non\-clinical, self\-care contexts and does not provide diagnosis or treatment\. A formative scenario\-based evaluation was conducted using three representative non\-clinical user archetypes\. The generated outputs were independently assessed using a structured rubric, producing mean scenario scores of 4\.2–4\.8 out of 5\. Findings suggest that explainable digital systems can function as cognitive and emotional scaffolding, enhancing reflective engagement and supporting behaviour change in everyday contexts\. This work contributes to research at the intersection of behavioural science and technology by demonstrating how explainability and personalisation can be operationalised in supportive digital systems, offering design insights for transparent, adaptive technologies that promote trust, autonomy, and sustained engagement in psychological well\-being support\.

## [Labor transition networks based on collective bargaining agreements: Argentina 2014\-2024](../publications/3225e1b270d14dba38df.md)

Hernán Varela

Los flujos de empleo resumen características tanto coyunturales como de largo plazo del mercado de trabajo\. Este trabajo en desarrollo realiza un acercamiento novedoso al caso argentino, a partir del análisis de registros administrativos durante el período 2014\-2024, con los cuales se construyen redes complejas con los cambios de empleo y de convenio colectivo de asalariados del sector privado\. Estas transiciones muestran no solo posibles similitudes entre las habilidades necesarias en cada convenio, sino que también reflejan la estructura general del mundo del trabajo en el país\. Este artículo analiza los cambios en la conectividad y su estabilidad en tres momentos del período analizado \(antes, durante y después de la pandemia\) y también busca regularidades que se mantengan en el tiempo\. Finalmente, se aplican algoritmos de detección de comunidades para comparar los distintos momentos y la estabilidad de los agrupamientos que se producen en dichas redes\.

## [THE IMPACT OF CHATGPT ON MORPHO\-SYNTACTIC AWARENESS AMONG GENERATION\-Z ESL LEARNERS IN PAKISTAN: A QUASI\-EXPERIMENTAL STUDY](../publications/32296d9f9ad5d92eaf12.md)

Muhammad Tayyab Khan; Marya Sarwar; Tariq Usman

Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) has rapidly become a part of education, revolutionizing language learning by offering interactive, personalized and instant linguistic help to students\. One AI\-powered tool that has garnered a lot of attention recently is ChatGPT, which can help with English as a Second Language \(ESL\) learning, especially in grammar\. But, empirical research about its effect on learners&\#x27; morpho\-syntactic awareness is limited particularly in the context of Pakistan\. The present study aimed to examine the effects of ChatGPT on the morpho\-syntactic awareness of Generation\-Z ESL learners in Pakistan employing a quantitative quasi\-experimental pre and post\-test control group design\. The total number of samples were 80 undergraduate students of ESL and consequently 40 students were assigned to experimental group and 40 students were assigned to control group using convenience sampling\. The experimental group participated in the grammar learning using ChatGPT for six weeks, while the control group were taught the grammar in a traditional manner\. The experimental group was given six weeks of grammar instruction that involved ChatGPT while the control group was given six weeks of traditional grammar instruction\. The data were collected by using researcher developed morpho\-syntactic awareness test and a structured questionnaire\. The quantitative data was analyzed using descriptive statistics, paired\-samples t\-tests, and independent\-samples t\-tests in SPSS and the responses on the questionnaires were summarized using descriptive analysis\. The results showed that the morpheo\-syntactic awareness of learners who used Chat\-GPT was statistically significantly better than that of learners who were taught by the traditional method\. The participants also had positive perceptions of the usefulness, prompt feedback, and helping them with grammar of ChatGPT, but they also mentioned some concerns about becoming dependent on ChatGPT and not being able to do this alone\. The study finds that ChatGPT can be used as a useful additional teaching aid to enhance the grammatical ability of students when used in pedagogically guided learning environment\. The results build on a body of research on using generative AI for language learning and have implications for both ESL teachers and curriculum designers and policymakers who want to facilitate responsible use of generative AI in language learning\.

## [DiffusionRVGE: Reinforcement Learning via Regression\-Based Value Gradient Estimation](../publications/322c51ed35f2e034da61.md)

Jiayuan Wang; Tongyao Pang

Reinforcement learning improves diffusion models using rewards on generated images, but repeated denoising and gradient estimation make training expensive\. We introduce \\method, an efficient method that constructs useful update directions by regressing centered rewards on centered final denoised images\. It requires neither reward derivatives nor adjoint backpropagation through the sampling trajectory\. A unified first\-variation formulation identifies the value\-gradient target with or without a trajectory\-KL penalty\. A population analysis under Gaussian noising explains the regression geometry, while a subspace analysis motivates clean\-image coordinates\. The implementation adapts rollout bandwidth and query weights to reward continuity: local rollouts suit smooth rewards, whereas broader groups provide informative contrasts for discrete rewards\. Trained jointly on five rewards, one SD3\.5\-Medium model matches or exceeds DiffusionNFT&\#x27;s joint model on seven of eight metrics, reaching GenEval $0\.94$, OCR $0\.92$, and PickScore $23\.82$ at about one fifth of its estimated training compute\. In single\-reward training, \\method reaches matched reward thresholds $2\.1$\-\-$6\.7\\times$ faster than reproduced DiffusionNFT on identical hardware\. Ablations support the clean\-image estimator, direct direction transfer, and reward\-dependent rollout choices\. Code is available at https://github\.com/jy\-wang\-tsinghua/DIFFUSIONRVGE\.

## [A clinical case series evaluation of cross\-linked gelatin foam to treat naturally occurring periodontal pockets and furcation defects in dogs](../publications/322d18c8cc81520ffe41.md)

K\. S\. Stepaniuk; A\. M\. Sievers; A\. A\. Lalonde

This clinical case series evaluated periodontal debridement and the application of a biodegradable liquid scaffold composed of a porcine\-derived crosslinked gelatin foam for the treatment of naturally occurring furcation defects and combined suprabony and infrabony defects in client\-owned dogs\. A total of 21 treated sites in 9 client\-owned dogs were evaluated\. Periodontal probing, intraoral computed radiography \(CR\), and cone beam computed tomography \(CBCT\) under general anesthesia were performed\. Full\-mouth periodontal treatment and closed \(13 sites\) or open \(8 sites\) root planing were performed before the application of the flowable scaffold\. The mean duration between treatment and recheck was 169 days \(with a range of 101–388 days and a median of 167 days\)\. The mean decrease in periodontal pocket depth was 1\.9 mm\. The mean furcation stage decreased by 1\.4, and the treated tooth periodontal stage was reduced by a mean of 0\.8\.

## [Genome‐wide analysis of the caspase gene family in common carp \( C yprinus carpio \) and their transcriptional responses to nitrate exposure](../publications/3266007c8d0373fb9fc4.md)

Naime Filiz Karadaş; Esra Yaprak; Harun Arslan; Emre İlhan

Caspases are a family of cysteine proteases that play essential roles in apoptosis, inflammation and cellular homeostasis\. Despite their biological importance, the genomic organization and stress\-related functions of the caspase gene family remain insufficiently characterized in many teleost fish species\. In the present study, a comprehensive genome\-wide analysis of the caspase gene family was conducted in common carp \(Cyprinus carpio\), and the transcriptional responses of selected caspase genes to nitrate\-induced stress were investigated\. A total of 37 caspase genes were identified and classified into initiator, executioner and inflammatory groups based on phylogenetic relationships, conserved domain architecture and motif composition\. Comparative genomic analyses revealed extensive gene family expansion associated with the allotetraploid genome structure of common carp, while synteny and duplication analyses supported the evolutionary conservation of caspase genes among teleosts\. Structural characterization demonstrated the preservation of the conserved caspase catalytic domain and typical caspase protein architecture\. Functional enrichment analyses indicated that Cc\_CASP proteins are predominantly involved in apoptosis, programmed cell death, immune regulation and stress\-response pathways\. Gene expression analyses further revealed tissue\-specific transcriptional responses to nitrate exposure, with several caspase genes showing significant differential expression in liver and brain tissues\. These findings provide new insights into the evolution, structural diversity and functional roles of the caspase gene family in common carp and suggest that selected caspase genes may serve as potential molecular biomarkers for assessing environmental stress in freshwater ecosystems\.

## [Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture\-of\-Experts](../publications/3272d68cddd8467a7161.md)

Bingcong Li; Hao Ma; Michael Muehlebach; Niao He; Yi Ma

Mixture\-of\-experts \(MoE\) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters\. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine\-grained expert segmentation and shared experts\. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token\. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations\. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine\-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space\. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine\-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice\. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token\-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts\. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales\.

## [Navigating the AI Era: How Perceived Organizational Support Shapes Employees’ AI\-Related Anxiety via AI Self\-Efficacy](../publications/32741eb438972aa8399d.md)

Hind Alsudays; Sultanah Alsudays

Hind A Alsudays,1 Sultanah Alsudays21Department of Business Administration, College of Business, Majmaah University, Al Majmaah, 11952, Saudi Arabia; 2Department of Business Administration, College of Business, Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University \(IMSIU\), Riyadh, Saudi ArabiaCorrespondence: Sultanah Alsudays, Department of Business Administration, College of Business, Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University \(IMSIU\), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Email Smalsudays@imamu\.edu\.saPurpose: This quantitative study examined the relationships between perceived organizational support \(POS\), Artificial intelligence self\-efficacy \(AISE\), employees’ artificial intelligence learning anxiety \(AILA\), and AI job replacement anxiety \(AIJRA\) in private sector employees; it examined the potential direct effect of POS on both AILA and AIJRA, and the indirect effect via AISE by drawing on social cognitive theory and using structural equation modeling \(SEM\)\.Participants and Methods: Convenience and snowball sampling techniques were used to recruit 311 employees from the private sector in the Saudi context\. Data were collected using an online survey and analyzed using Mplus to conduct confirmatory factor analysis \(CFA\) and SEM\.Results: In the total sample, POS influences AI learning anxiety only via AI self\-efficacy \(β = \- 0\.073; p ≤ 0\.01\)\. However, AI job replacement anxiety was influenced only directly by POS \(β = − 0\.184; p ≤ 0\.01\)\. These findings suggest that the relative importance of organizational and individual factors varies based on the type of AI anxiety\. Finally, Age has a significant and negative relationship with AIJRA \(β = − 0\.121, P ≤ 0\.05\)\.Conclusion: The Study’s findings underscore the importance of individual factors such as AISE in enhancing the role of POS on AILA\. Furthermore, These findings suggest that the relative importance of organizational and individual factors varies based on the type of AI anxiety\.Keywords: perceived organizational support, artificial intelligence self\-efficacy, artificial intelligence learning anxiety, artificial intelligence job replacement anxiety, social cognitive theory, Saudi private sector

## [Science teacher professional learning through the Change Laboratory: insights from participants’ perspectives](../publications/32820587ce60e0609847.md)

Isaac Sonful Coffie; George Harb; Justice Edusei Ackah; Iddrisu Mohammed

This study employed the Change Laboratory, a formative intervention methodology, to examine how six junior high school science teachers in Ghana experienced professional learning during the implementation of a new curriculum\. Six Change Laboratory sessions were conducted, with transcribed discussions forming the primary data for thematic analysis\. The study examined teachers’ perceptions of the features of the Change Laboratory that supported their professional learning and changes in practice\. Five interconnected features were identified: self\-generation of ideas and teacher agency, collaborative and collegial engagement, small\-group participation, extended and iterative engagement, and practical, application\-oriented learning\. Teachers perceived these features as supporting reflection, collaborative problem\-solving, lesson planning, and shifts toward more student\-centred pedagogical practices\. The study demonstrates how the formative intervention structure of the Change Laboratory can bring established features of effective professional learning together as mutually reinforcing components within a single professional development approach\.

## [Human Resource Management at KPPBC TMP C Sampit: A Qualitative Case Study](../publications/329106f3d28f88692393.md)

Ali Ahmad Nururrohim; Gorendva R\. Warganegara

Human resource management in public organizations faces digital era challenges\. KPPBC TMP C Sampit, a vertical unit of the Directorate General of Customs and Excise, needs to optimize HR through work\-life balance, competency development, talent management, and employee engagement\. The novelty of this study is an in\-depth case study integrating recruitment, training, performance management, career paths, and employee engagement within a single analytical framework in a customs institution, including inhibiting factors rarely discussed\. This study employs a qualitative case study approach\. Data were collected through literature review, in\-depth interviews, and observation\. Data analysis used the Miles and Huberman interactive model\. Results indicate that HR management has been on the right track but faces structural and technical challenges\. Recruitment through STAN and CPNS follows central regulations\. Training utilizes self\-directed learning, coaching, mentoring, and learning from experience\. Performance management follows the Ministry of Finance system, yet a gap remains between career planning and implementation\. Main obstacles include HRIS Satu Kemenkeu database disruptions, SSO Ministry of Finance system issues, and limited strategic thinking\. ## [From Geographic Immersion to Digital Immersion: Rethinking English Language Learning Without Study Abroad](../publications/32acdfb5d80b1d5ab8af.md)

Khalid Al\-Seghayer

Study abroad has traditionally been regarded as one of the most effective contexts for second\-language development, providing learners with extensive target\-language exposure, sustained interaction, and contact with culturally situated communicative practices\. However, the expansion of digital communication challenges the assumption that meaningful language immersion requires geographical mobility\. Learners who remain in their home countries can participate in international communities, engage in virtual exchange, access authentic audiovisual and written materials, and use English for academic, professional, and social purposes\. Drawing on research in second\-language acquisition, study abroad, computer\-mediated communication, telecollaboration, virtual exchange, and learner autonomy, this article argues that immersion is more productively conceptualized as sustained and meaningful engagement with a target language than as physical presence in a particular geographical location\. To operationalize this concept, the article proposes a seven\-dimensional model of digital immersion encompassing input, interaction, output, feedback, intercultural engagement, identity, and autonomy\. The model provides a framework for examining the extent to which digital environments create conditions conducive to sustained language development\. At the same time, digital immersion cannot fully reproduce the embodied interaction, spontaneous encounters, and physically situated cultural experiences associated with study abroad\. Nevertheless, when deliberately structured, digital environments can provide substantial opportunities for language input, interaction, output, intercultural learning, and learner agency\. The article concludes by discussing implications for curriculum design, digital literacy, authentic assessment, and educational accessibility, and considers how digital immersion may reshape the future of English language learning\.

## [Impaired immune surveillance of senescent hepatocytes in MASLD: SASP signaling and fibrogenic progression](../publications/32c817250bdf758a10ec.md)

Shuhao Cheng; Yinan Zhao; Wei Wang

Metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease \(MASLD\) is sustained not only by lipid overload and hepatocellular injury but also by maladaptive responses to persistent metabolic stress\. Cellular senescence has emerged as a candidate mechanism linking metabolic stress to persistent inflammation and fibrosis\. This Mini Review aims to examine how hepatocyte senescence develops and persists in MASLD, how senescent hepatocytes interact with immune surveillance, and how senescence\-associated secretory phenotype \(SASP\) signaling contributes to fibrotic remodeling\. As a narrative review, we synthesized recent human, animal, and in vitro evidence, prioritizing mechanistic studies directly addressing hepatocyte senescence, immune\-cell interactions, SASP signaling, and fibrosis, while retaining landmark studies where they provided essential mechanistic context\. Current evidence indicates that senescent hepatocytes accumulate in experimental and human MASLD and can influence macrophages, hepatic stellate cells, liver sinusoidal endothelial cells, and neighboring hepatocytes\. Under conditions of effective immune surveillance, senescence may remain transient and contribute to the removal of damaged cells\. In chronically injured liver, however, continued generation of senescent hepatocytes, altered immune\-cell function, and persistent SASP signaling may favor their retention and promote inflammatory and fibrogenic remodeling\. Important uncertainties remain, including the lack of universal senescence markers, limited direct evidence for defective senescent\-hepatocyte clearance in human MASLD, and the context\-dependent effects of senescence across hepatic cell types\. Overall, available evidence supports hepatocyte senescence as a plausible contributor to MASLD progression, but its pathogenic importance appears to depend on cellular context, immune competence, and the duration of the senescent state\. Defining these conditions will be important for developing senescence\-directed therapies without disrupting beneficial repair responses\.

## [Climate change knowledge and associated factors among undergraduate sport sciences students: a single\-center cross\-sectional study at a Turkish university](../publications/32cd5f370e61046a8aef.md)

Cemile Nihal Yurtseven; Ali KAYA; Selcuk Bora Cavusoglu; Özge Ercan; Ahmet Uslu; Ayşe Nilay KANTAR

Climate change is a major environmental and public health threat with consequences for human health, physical activity, and sport participation\. Evidence concerning climate literacy among undergraduate sport sciences students remains limited\. This study aimed to assess climate change knowledge and examine sociodemographic, academic, and information\-source factors associated with knowledge levels among undergraduate sport sciences students\. A cross\-sectional online survey was conducted among sport sciences undergraduates\. Based on a sample\-size calculation for estimation of a population proportion, a minimum of 234 participants was required\. A recruitment target of 300 accounted for potential non\-response\. All eligible students in the faculty \(N ≈ 600\) were invited, and 320 students comprised the final analytic sample\. The questionnaire included sociodemographic, academic, and information\-source variables together with a 20\-item climate change knowledge test\. Internal consistency was assessed using the Kuder–Richardson Formula 20 coefficient\. Participant characteristics and knowledge scores were summarized descriptively\. Associations between categorical variables and knowledge level were examined using Pearson’s chi\-square tests\. Multivariable multinomial logistic regression was used to identify factors independently associated with knowledge level, with the low\-knowledge group as the reference category\. Overall model significance and explanatory performance were assessed using the likelihood\-ratio chi\-square test and Nagelkerke’s pseudo\-R 2 \. The mean climate change knowledge score was 12\.6 ± 3\.4\. Overall, 38\.4% of participants were classified as having low knowledge, 41\.6% as moderate knowledge, and 20\.0% as high knowledge\. Prior environmental education was associated with higher odds of high versus low knowledge \(AOR = 2\.34, 95% CI \[1\.28, 4\.26\], p = 0\.006\)\. Use of scientific or academic information sources \(AOR = 1\.89, 95% CI \[1\.07, 3\.32\], p = 0\.029\) and senior\-year status \(AOR = 1\.76, 95% CI \[1\.01, 3\.04\], p = 0\.045\) were also associated with higher odds of high versus low knowledge\. Climate change knowledge was predominantly moderate among participating students\. The observed associations support further investigation of structured climate change education within sport sciences curricula\. Because of the cross\-sectional design, causal and temporal relationships cannot be established\. Multicentre longitudinal studies and educational intervention trials are needed to confirm these associations and evaluate whether curriculum\-based interventions improve climate literacy among sport sciences students\.

## [कतरम बदधमतत क नय यग](../publications/32cedd79c3060042f8d6.md)

डॉ\. गिरिजा नरवरिया

सारांश कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता का खुमार रोजमर्रा की जिंदगी में बढ़ता जा रहा है, क्योंकि हम सब हर रोज कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग लगातार किसी न किसी रूप में कर रहे हैं। जैसे—जीमेल, गूगल, व्हाट्सएप, फेसबुक, इंस्टाग्राम पर रील आदि के माध्यम से। कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता मानव\-जनित यंत्र है, फिर भी हम इसकी गिरफ्त में फँसते जा रहे हैं। यह हमारे इतिहास की खोज नहीं करता, बल्कि उसको दोहराने का कार्य करता है। माना कि कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता 21वीं सदी की सबसे परिवर्तनकारी तकनीक है, क्योंकि आज इसका दबदबा शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, बैंकिंग, यातायात, उद्योग, मीडिया, रचनात्मकता एवं सांस्कृतिक संरक्षण, पर्यावरण संरक्षण जैसे अनेक क्षेत्रों में क्रांतिकारी बदलाव के रूप में बढ़ता जा रहा है। इसने मानव विकास को सरल\-सहज बनाने के साथ नई संभावनाओं को जन्म दिया है। अब हम न चाहते हुए भी इसकी उपयोगिता को नकार नहीं सकते। फिर भी हमें इस बात का ध्यान रखना है कि यह एक मशीन है, जो मानव\-जनित है। इसके पास वही सामग्री है, जो हमने इसे दी है। यह मानव की अपेक्षा कार्य को अधिक गतिशील बना सकती है। इसकी सबसे बड़ी कमजोरी यह है कि इसके पास मानवीय संवेदनाओं का अभाव है। इसलिए यह यंत्र तभी तक लाभदायक है, जब तक यह मानव के नियंत्रण में रहेगा।

## [Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On\-Policy Self\-Distillation](../publications/32d4b60e1166ee29b54a.md)

Kaijian Zou; Emiliano Penaloza; MohammadHossein Rezaei; Anisha Gunjal; Mohit Raghavendra; Lu Wang; Yunzhong He; Anas Mahmoud

On\-policy self\-distillation \(OPSD\) enables large language models \(LLMs\) to learn from privileged information \(PI\) without a separate teacher model\. However, prior work largely treats PI as a fixed design choice, leaving the effects of its content and construction poorly understood\. This challenge is particularly important in multi\-turn agentic settings, where trajectories contain actions, observations, and reasoning that can be transformed into PI in many ways\. We systematically evaluate 16 PI configurations across three multi\-turn agentic benchmarks and three student models that vary in scale and reasoning mode\. We find that PI effectiveness depends on its content, generation source, and the student model\. Information\-dense trajectories and PI produced by more capable generators generally yield larger gains, whereas thinking models benefit less consistently\. To assess PI before training, we compare PI utility with two KL\-based metrics: sampled\-token reverse KL \($D$\) and error\-step KL contrast \($Δd^\{\-\}\_\{\\mathrm\{err\}\}$\)\. The KL\-based metrics track post\-training performance more consistently than PI utility, which can be distorted by information leakage\. Empirically, selecting each task&\#x27;s PI by $Δd^\{\-\}\_\{\\mathrm\{err\}\}$ also improves post\-training performance over random selection, most when the PI candidates differ widely\. Finally, effective PI remains beneficial when combined with GRPO, allowing the combined objective to outperform a strong GRPO baseline\. Overall, our results provide practical guidance for constructing and evaluating PI in OPSD training\.

## [70th Annual Meeting of the German Society of Neuropathology and Neuroanatomy \(DGNN\) \- Meeting Abstracts, November 04–07, 2026](../publications/32d6c655e170e13cc21c.md)

German Society of Neuropathology and Neuroanatomy \(DGNN\)

Sehr geehrte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, zur Neurowoche 2026 begrüßen wir Sie im Namen der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Neuropathologie und Neuroanatomie herzlich\. Die Neuropathologie hat ihr diagnostisches und wissenschaftliches Spektrum in den vergangenen Jahren deutlich erweitert\. Molekulare Tumorklassifikation, Methylierungsdiagnostik, Hochdurchsatzsequenzierung und digitale, KI\-gestützte Analyseverfahren sind heute fester Bestandteil unseres Faches und prägen zunehmend klinische Entscheidungen und wissenschaftliche Entwicklungen\. Viele dieser Entwicklungen wurden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den klinischen Neurofächern aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt\. Dies betrifft nicht nur die Neuroonkologie, sondern ebenso neurodegenerative, entzündliche und neuromuskuläre Erkrankungen\. Die Neuropathologie bewegt sich dabei an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung, Diagnostik und klinischer Anwendung\. Der enge Austausch mit Neurologie, Neurochirurgie, Neuroradiologie, Neuropädiatrie und den weiteren neurowissenschaftlichen Disziplinen ist hierfür von zentraler Bedeutung\. Gerade deshalb bietet die Neurowoche einen besonderen Rahmen\. Sie ermöglicht den fachübergreifenden Austausch und schafft Raum für gemeinsame Diskussionen über neue wissenschaftliche Entwicklungen, diagnostische Konzepte und klinische Herausforderungen\. Gerade die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Neurofächer ist eine wesentliche Voraussetzung, um translationale Entwicklungen in die klinische Anwendung zu überführen\. Im neuropathologischen Programm erwarten Sie wissenschaftliche Sitzungen mit aktuellen Entwicklungen aus Diagnostik, translationaler Forschung und experimenteller Neurowissenschaft\. Besonders wichtig ist uns dabei auch die Einbindung jüngerer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die mit neuen wissenschaftlichen und methodischen Impulsen zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Faches beitragen\. Wir freuen uns auf die Diskussionen und den persönlichen Austausch während der Neurowoche 2026\. Mit besten Grüßen Prof\. Dr\. Till Acker Prof\. Dr\. Christian Mawrin DGNN\-Kongresspräsidenten

## [Multi\-swarm Improved Sparrow Search Optimized Variational Encoder with Kolmogorov\-Arnold Networks and Bidirectional Multiscale Dilated Convolutional Recurrent Architecture for Maize Leaf Disease Detection and Classification](../publications/32d8585bb923a5592dfd.md)

Gaurav Singla; Vijay Laxmi; Sanjay Kumar

Field\-deployable diagnosis of maize leaf disease is limited by shallow representations that do not separate visually similar lesions and by fixed activations that constrain decision boundaries\.This work proposes MS\-ISSA\-VAE\-KAN\-PMDC\-BGRU, one end\-to\-end pipeline: a variational encoder maps each leaf image to a 16 × 16 grid of 64\-dimensional latent codes whose Kullback\-Leibler term acts as an information bottleneck; a Parallel Multiscale Dilated Convolution block with dilation rates one, two and four samples that grid at three rates; a bidirectional gated recurrent unit encodes dependencies across the patch sequence; and a Kolmogorov\-Arnold Network with learnable Bspline edge activations replaces the multilayer\-perceptron head\.Five hyperparameters are tuned by the proposed Multi\-Swarm Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm\.All experiments use 20 independent runs under two protocols kept separate: a leakage\-controlled protocol \(perceptual\-hash de\-duplication with group\-aware splits\), primary here, and the conventional random split, retained only for comparability with published work\.Under the primary protocol the model attains 97\.86 ± 0\.29% on the PlantVillage maize subset and 96\.36 ± 0\.32% on the 4,188\-image Corn or Maize Leaf Disease dataset \(MDID\); the random\-split values are 98\.62 ± 0\.24% and 96\.98 ± 0\.27%\.Every baseline is reimplemented under one protocol and tuned by MS\-ISSA at an identical budget, four architectures additionally under random search and Bayesian TPE\.The leakage\-controlled margin over the strongest recent baseline is 0\.55 and 0\.70 points at 8\.4 M parameters against 86\.4 M\. The advantage is efficiency and stability rather than peak accuracy: the smallest loss when near\-duplicates are removed \(\-0\.76 / \-0\.62 against \-0\.88 to \-1\.33 points\) and the smallest crossdataset drop \(4\.31\-7\.52 against 6\.50\-13\.90points under the random\-split in\-domain reference; 3\.69\-6\.76against 5\.61\-12\.57under the primary leakage\-controlled reference\)\.Code, per\-seed results and the full baseline configuration are released\.

## [AI\-Based Decision\-Making Framework for Climate Change\-Induced Flood Risk Management and Urban Resilience](../publications/32f1410d45d9e623183a.md)

Monir Ahmad Meahrayen; Jinliang Hai; Prasanna Koirala; Soraya Sarwari

Climate change has intensified the frequency and severity of urban flooding, creating unprecedented challenges for municipalities worldwide\. This study develops an AI\-based decision\-making framework that integrates machine learning, explainable artificial intelligence, and geospatial analytics to enhance urban flood risk management and resilience planning\. The framework employs ensemble machine learning algorithms including Random Forest, XG Boost, and Cat Boost for flood susceptibility mapping, coupled with SHAP\-based interpretability to decode model predictions and translate them into actionable policy insights at administrative scales\. A city\-scale digital twin component enables real\-time flood impact simulation and cascading infrastructure disruption analysis, while a multi\-criteria decision support module prioritizes adaptation investments based on economic risk assessment and equity considerations\. The framework was validated using multi\-temporal Sentinel\-1 SAR data and hydrological records across diverse urban environments, demonstrating superior predictive performance with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values exceeding 0\.95 for ensemble models\. Results reveal that elevation, proximity to hydrological features, and impervious surface density consistently emerge as dominant flood drivers, with their relative importance varying significantly across districts\. The decision support system successfully transformed pixel\-level predictions into ward\-level actionable recommendations, enabling evidence\-based zoning, drainage infrastructure prioritization, and targeted nature\-based solutions deployment\. The framework addresses critical gaps in explainability, scalability, and policy relevance that have limited the operational adoption of AI in urban flood governance\. The study concludes that integrating AI\-driven analytics with participatory decision\-making processes can substantially enhance adaptive capacity in flood\-prone urban systems, though algorithmic transparency, data equity, and institutional readiness remain essential preconditions for equitable implementation\.

## [Estudo de caso da perda de eficiência energética em painéis fotovoltaicos danificados por impacto mecânico](../publications/32f917cf442065526755.md)

Huesdra Nogueira de Campos; Alana Magalhães da Silva; Lidiaine Maria dos Santos; Kelias de Oliveira; João Batista José Pereira; Arquimedes Lopes da Silva; Júnio S\. Bulhões; Cleuber Marques Siqueira

A energia solar fotovoltaica é um pilar da transição energética global, mas sua eficiência a longo prazo é condicionada pela degradação dos módulos devido a estresses operacionais\. Rachaduras e microfissuras, muitas vezes invisíveis, representam um desafio crítico que pode comprometer significativamente a geração de energia\. Neste contexto, este trabalho quantifica a perda de desempenho em módulos fotovoltaicos com danos mecânicos, utilizando uma metodologia integrada\. O estudo correlaciona a análise de curvas elétricas I\-V e P\-V com a inspeção por termografia infravermelha para diagnosticar e mensurar o impacto dos defeitos\. Todas as medições de campo foram normalizadas para a irradiância de referência de 1\.000 W/m² segundo o procedimento da IEC 60891 antes de qualquer comparação\. Como resultado principal, foi identificada uma perda de eficiência global de 43,4 % no arranjo testado, decomposta de forma multiplicativa em três mecanismos: 2,00 % de descasamento elétrico intrínseco à associação em série de módulos de potências distintas, 10,10 % de estresse térmico e 35,74 % de degradação física\. Esta última parcela decompõe\-se, por sua vez, em quedas de 10,35 % na corrente de curto\-circuito, 8,41 % na tensão de circuito aberto e 21,75 % no fator de forma, o que caracteriza um aumento da resistência em série da ordem de 2,1 Ω\. A eficiência de conversão do arranjo cai de 18,72 % para 10,60 %\. A termografia validou o diagnóstico ao localizar os pontos quentes na região do dano mecânico, com pico de 84,2 °C\.

## [استخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي في دراسة التاريخ الإسلامي للأندلس: أدوات وأساليب مهنية جديدة](../publications/32f9a9d1cbb8eac8ebb9.md)

هاشم ناصر حسين الكعبي; لقاء فضل صالح

يركز هذا البحث على العلاقة بين الذكاء الاصطناعي ودراسة التاريخ الإسلامي للأندلس، موضحًا كيف أسهمت التقنيات الحديثة في تطوير طرق تحليل المصادر التاريخية\. فقد أصبح بإمكان الباحثين الاستفادة من أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي لمعالجة كميات ضخمة من النصوص التاريخية، وتحويل المخطوطات القديمة إلى نسخ رقمية قابلة للبحث، مما يسهل التعرف على الأحداث والشخصيات والأنماط التاريخية بشكل أسرع وأكثر دقة كما تتيح هذه التقنيات إمكانية ربط المعلومات بين مصادر متعددة كانت سابقًا بعيدة أو صعبة الوصول، وهو ما يفتح آفاقًا جديدة لفهم الحضارة الإسلامية في الأندلس بشكل أكثر شمولية، وأظهرت الدراسة أن الذكاء الاصطناعي لا يقتصر دوره على التحليل الرقمي فحسب، بل يمكنه أيضًا المساهمة في إعادة بناء النصوص والخرائط التاريخية المفقودة، واستنتاج العلاقات بين الوقائع التاريخية بطريقة منهجية يمكن أن تدعم البحث الأكاديمي وتكمله ومع ذلك، تبين أن هذه الأدوات تواجه تحديات مهمة، مثل الحاجة إلى دقة البيانات التاريخية، وتحيز الخوارزميات، وصعوبة فهم السياق التاريخي الكامل، مما يبرز أهمية دمج التحليل الرقمي مع الخبرة البشرية\.

## [Forecasting realized volatility using idiosyncratic and systematic jump risks: A machine learning approach with market regimes](../publications/33038e228cc80d1ea074.md)

Weijia Peng; Eman Abdelfattah

Accurate forecasting of equity market volatility is essential for risk management, portfolio allocation, and derivative pricing\. From a machine learning and soft\-computing perspective, this paper investigates the relative predictive role of idiosyncratic and systematic jump risks in forecasting realized volatility across major U\.S\. equity market sectors, considering both volatility levels and directional movements\. We conduct a comprehensive out\-of\-sample comparison of linear benchmark models and a broad set of machine learning methods\. The results show that selected machine\-learning models improve forecasting accuracy relative to HAR, but the gains depend on the sector and model, and HAR remains a competitive benchmark\. Feature\-importance analysis indicates that systematic jump measures rank above idiosyncratic jump measures in several specifications, although their relative importance varies across sectors and models\. To further capture nonlinear and time\-varying market dynamics, we propose novel regime\-dependent predictors derived from a Markov regime\-switching framework and incorporate them into the learning process\. These regime\-sensitive features lead to a marked improvement in volatility direction prediction\. Overall, the findings demonstrate that integrating jump\-based feature engineering and regime\-dependent information within machine learning frameworks yields more accurate and robust volatility forecasts\.

## [Moderating Effect of Tax Fairness on Determinants of Tax Morale Amongst SMEs Tax Payers in Thika Town, Kiambu County in Kenya](../publications/330ca5b609a988982a5e.md)

Konse Sarah Akey; Dr\. Joel Tuwey; Naomi Chepkorir Koske

Tax morale, understood as the intrinsic willingness of taxpayers to comply with tax obligations, is important to voluntary tax compliance because enforcement alone may not explain why similarly situated taxpayers behave differently\. This study examined the moderating effect of tax fairness on the relationship between taxpayer knowledge, tax complexity, taxpayer tolerance and tax morale among SME taxpayers in Thika Town, Kiambu County, Kenya, during the period September 2024–September 2026\. The study was primarily anchored on Utilitarian Theory of Tax Evasion, with Social Learning Theory and Economic Deterrence Theory providing complementary explanations of taxpayer behavior\. An explanatory cross\-sectional research design was adopted\. The target population comprised 3,700 registered SME taxpayers in Thika Town\. A sample of 139 SME taxpayers was determined using Nassiuma’s formula and selected through proportionate stratification by business sector followed by simple random sampling\. Primary data were collected using a structured questionnaire containing five\-point Likert\-scale items covering taxpayer knowledge, tax complexity, taxpayer tolerance, tax fairness and tax morale\. Of the 139 questionnaires distributed, 120 were completed and returned, representing an 86\.3% response rate\. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, multiple linear regression and hierarchical regression at the 5% significance level\. The reported regression results indicate that taxpayer knowledge was positively associated with tax morale \(β = 0\.283, p&lt;; 0 \.001\), while tax complexity was negatively associated with tax morale \(β = 0\.325, p&lt;; 0\.001\) and taxpayer tolerance was positively associated with tax morale \(β = 0\.450, p&lt;; 0\.001\)\. The direct\-effect model explained 66\.4% of the variation in tax morale \(R²=0\.664; F \(3,116\) = 76\.327, p&gt;; 0 \.001\)\. In the full moderation model, the interaction between taxpayer knowledge and tax fairness was significant \(β = 0\.268, p = 0\.021\), as was the interaction between tax complexity and tax fairness \(β = 0\.221, p =0\.029\) and taxpayer tolerance and tax fairness \(β = 0\.478, p = 0\.046\)\. The findings indicate that perceived tax fairness changes the strength of the relationships between the three determinants and tax morale\. The study recommends targeted taxpayer education, simplification of tax procedures and communication, and measures that strengthen perceptions of fairness in the tax system\. Because the study used cross\-sectional self\-reported data, the regression findings are interpreted as statistical associations rather than definitive causal effects\.

## [Birth\-quarter distribution, morphological characteristics, and team competitive performance in group rhythmic gymnastics](../publications/332adb065ef810f588bd.md)

Jonatha Flávio Souza Lemos; Alicia Almeida de Souza Ruvieri; Lucas Savassi Figueiredo; Vivian de Oliveira; Luís Carlos Oliveira Gonçalves; Cláudia Marlise Balbinotti Andrade; Henrique de Oliveira Castro

This study examined birth\-quarter patterns across competitive categories in group rhythmic gymnastics, their associations with morphological characteristics, and whether team\-level relative\-age composition, chronological age, and height were associated with competitive success\. The sample comprised 241 female gymnasts from the 2025 Brazilian Group Rhythmic Gymnastics Championship: Pre\-Juvenile \(n = 68\), Youth \(n = 51\), Junior \(n = 62\), and Senior \(n = 60\)\. Birth dates were classified into quarters \(Q1–Q4\), and anthropometric measures included body mass, standing and sitting height, leg length, and body mass index\. Birth\-quarter distributions were compared with population\-based expected frequencies derived from Brazilian female live\-birth data and weighted by birth year\. Morphological associations were tested using generalized estimating equations clustered by club and adjusted for competitive category and decimal age\. Exploratory associations with Top\-3 success were assessed using conditional logistic regression stratified by competitive event\. No category showed a significant departure from the population\-based expected birth\-quarter distribution after multiplicity adjustment \(Holm\-adjusted p ≥ 0\.251\), and the ordinal trend in first\-semester representation was nonsignificant \(OR = 0\.799, 95% CI 0\.637–1\.000, Holm\-adjusted p = 0\.251\)\. No morphological outcome remained significantly associated with birth quarter after adjustment for within\-club dependence and multiple testing \(Holm\-adjusted p ≥ 0\.083\)\. Exploratory team\-level associations with Top\-3 placement were nonsignificant and imprecise \(Holm\-adjusted p = 1\.000\)\. Overall, the study found no statistically supported evidence of birth\-quarter asymmetry or team\-level associations with competitive performance, although imprecision precludes excluding potentially meaningful team\-level effects\.

## [Mora, Diego Andres: IA, mais artificial do que inteligente: a diferença ontológica entre humano e máquina](../publications/33314616ff3180ac4633.md)



Este artigo argumenta que comparar inteligência artificial e orgânica usando métricas quantitativas — como capacidade de memória ou velocidade de processamento — é um erro categórico fundamental\. Isso ocorre porque a definição de inteligência reside não apenas na adição de novas informações, mas também na capacidade de discernir essas informações\. Essa incapacidade de negar — e, consequentemente, de discernir — é reconhecida na inteligência artificial pela tradição fenomenológica\. A comparação necessária entre humanos e máquinas será apresentada neste artigo utilizando uma abordagem fenomenológica existencial de orientação sartreana\. A experiência de ambas as inteligências será estudada a partir das diversas maneiras pelas quais elas se apresentam a nós, em seus domínios físico, semântico e existencial\. Essa incapacidade de reconhecer a negatividade não é meramente uma característica da IA, mas sim sua característica definidora e a principal diferença entre ela e a inteligência orgânica\. Em conclusão, argumenta\-se que comparar as duas inteligências é inútil, pois elas são incomparáveis\.
