## [Neutrophil to Lymphocyte Ratio and Neurological Outcome in Ischemic Stroke at 4\.5 to 24 Hours: A Post Hoc Analysis of TRACE\-III Trial](../publications/951994393b11d34bb26f.md)

Manjun Hao; Yujie Ma; Lihua Wang; Aoming Jin; Zhe Kang Law; Bruce C\.V\. Campbell; Lee H\. Schwamm; Mark William Parsons; Marc Fisher; Yuming Xu; Anding Xu; Zhixin Cao; Liyuan Wang; Shuangzhe Wu; Yongjun Wang; Yunyun Xiong

INTRODUCTION: Whether neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio \(NLR\), as a marker of increased inflammatory response, modifies the efficacy and safety of tenecteplase is uncertain in patients 4\.5\-24 h after stroke onset\. We investigated this in the Tenecteplase Reperfusion Therapy in Acute Ischemic Cerebrovascular Events\-III \(TRACE\-III\) trial\. METHODS: TRACE\-III was a phase 3, multicenter, prospective, open\-label, randomized, blinded\-endpoint trial that enrolled 516 patients from 58 centers in China between January 2022 and November 2023\. Patients had anterior large vessel occlusion and evidence of salvageable brain tissue on perfusion imaging, presented 4\.5\-24 h after symptom onset, and were randomized 1:1 to intravenous tenecteplase \(intervention\) or standard medical treatment \(control\)\. The primary efficacy and safety outcomes were modified Rankin scale score of 0\-1 at 90 days and symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage or death, respectively\. This post hoc analysis in 513 patients with complete admission NLR data compared outcomes in patients with elevated NLR \(&gt; first quartile\) and non\-elevated NLR \(≤ first quartile\)\. RESULTS: In the elevated NLR group \(&gt; 3\.0\), tenecteplase was associated with increased functional independence \(61 \[30\.2%\] vs\. 36 \[19\.6%\]; adjusted relative rate \[aRR\] 1\.51; 95% confidence interval \[CI\] 1\.05\-2\.17; P = 0\.03\) compared to standard medical treatment\. This benefit was not observed in the non\-elevated NLR group \(26 \[41\.9%\] vs\. 25 \[38\.5%\]; aRR 1\.12; 95% CI 0\.73\-1\.73\)\. Safety outcomes did not differ in either the elevated or non\-elevated NLR groups\. CONCLUSION: Baseline NLR may provide a potential signal for differential treatment response to intravenous tenecteplase in patients with acute ischemic stroke, although these exploratory findings require further validation in independent studies\. TRIAL REGISTRATION: TRACE\-III is registered with ClinicalTrials\.gov, NCT05141305\.

## [Biotecnología, ética y conflicto: una revisión narrativa crítica desde la ética convergente y las filosofías contemporáneas de la tecnología](../publications/951a4f4f10d9ac300d03.md)

Gina Sofía Moreno; Karin Rondón\-Payares

La convergencia entre biotecnología, inteligencia artificial, ciencia de datos y sistemas ecológicos ha desplazado los conflictos bioéticos del ámbito clínico hacia dimensiones sociotécnicas, políticas y de gobernanza\. Esta revisión narrativa examina la pertinencia de la ética convergente para deliberar sobre dichos conflictos y la contrasta con las filosofías contemporáneas de la tecnología, a partir de literatura científica, institucional y filosófica analizada mediante lectura hermenéutica y síntesis temática\. El análisis abarca siete categorías: el conflicto moral como estructura, el ecosistema sociotécnico, la mediación tecnológica, la biopolítica y la justicia de datos, la responsabilidad intergeneracional, la tecnodiversidad y los comités de bioética\. La ética convergente ofrece una base sólida, aunque insuficiente si no se articula con enfoques sobre el poder, los datos y la diversidad cultural\. De esa articulación surge un modelo de deliberación en cinco momentos que orienta a los comités hacia una gobernanza anticipatoria y adaptativa de las tecnologías emergentes\.

## [DIGITAL\-INTELLIGENT MODELS FOR FINANCING RENEWABLE ENERGY PROJECTS](../publications/951dedeb3b945c6cdda8.md)

Xamidov Bekzod Xolmirzayevich

This paper examines how digital\-intelligent models can support the financing of renewable energy projects in Uzbekistan\. Using World Bank data on two solar projects, it reviews the role of international lending, guarantees and blended finance, proposes a conceptual framework combining AI\-based generation forecasting, cash flow forecasting and risk assessment, and outlines key risks and recommendations\.

## [An Automated Exam Marking Framework using an Artificial Intelligence Tool for English Writing in General Foundation Program](../publications/95220609adb4223d93c2.md)

Nauman Ahmad

This study proposes a fully automated exam marking framework for English writing in the General Foundation Program \(GFP\) through the use of prompt engineering with artificial intelligence \(AI\) tool ChatGPT and computer\-based analysis\. The AI tool generated 120 GFP B2 level writing responses \(120 to 150 words each\) with intentional grammatical errors\. Four prompts were applied for automated marking by the AI tool as an examiner, based on a provided rubric, to detect errors, and awarding of a score \[/10\] \(out of 10\) to each response\. A combination of different prompting techniques, including instruction\-based, role\-based, and formatting prompting were collectively used to design each prompt\. All of the 120 responses were marked by each prompt\. The first and second prompts were similar, just with a difference of paraphrasing\. Prompts 3 and 4 were based on Prompt 2, containing only an addition of a single word for Prompt 3, and replacement of the added word with another word for Prompt 4\. Statistical comparisons were done in SPSS\. The Friedman test showed the similarities \(Prompts 1 and 2 with paraphrased versions\) and significant differences \(Prompts 2, 3 and 4; p &lt; \.001, just due to an addition, and replacement of a single word\) among the prompts outcomes based on the markings\. Pairwise comparisons were performed using the Bonferroni correction to check for significant differences, while Kendall’s W test was used to measure the strength of agreement among the rankings\. Human involvement in the study was limited to author\-led validation of all the 120 responses, toward the accuracy of intentional added errors\. The framework demonstrated how different prompts impacted the marking outcomes, which highlighted the sensitivity of the prompts to the addition of a single determinative word and the replacement of that word with another\. Moreover, statistical comparisons showed how scalable assessment design and quality checks can be consistently applied for GFP English writing\. This study showed that the proposed automated marking framework can support consistent, scalable, and prompt\-sensitive assessment of GFP English writing\.

## [Personalized Disease Risk Scoring Using Wearable\-Derived Circadian Rhythm Variability](../publications/952737399f28b07818ba.md)

Naveen Shrivastava; Mahesh Marri; Sojy John; Venkata Phaneendra Reddi; Pradeep Rao Vennamaneni; Sri Prudhvi Adusumilli

Circadian rhythm disruption \(CRD\) is emerging as a risk factor for the onset of chronic disease, but has not been fully leveraged into personalized risk scoring\. This paper reviews the existing studies on the use of wearable\-derived circadian rhythm variability \(CRV\) data for generating personalized disease risk scores, discussing the potential use of actigraphy, photoplethysmography \(PPG\) and heart rate variability \(HRV\) signals\. Continuous streams of wearable data are used to extract features such as interdaily stability \(IS\), intradaily variability \(IV\), relative amplitude \(RA\), mesor, amplitude and circadian phase, along with clinical biomarkers, within machine learning frameworks\. Synthesized evidence shows that composite CRV\-based risk models have area under the receiver operating characteristic curve \(AUC\) up to 0\.92 for sleep apnea staging, up to 0\.89 for mood disorder prediction and up to 0\.87 for cardiovascular risk stratification – which are improvements of around 14–19% compared to traditional clinical biomarkers alone\. Using cross\-population validation with consumer wearable devices, the accuracy of CRV estimation ranges from 76\.9 to 88\.6% for sensitivity and 79–91% for specificity, depending on the type of wearable device and algorithm\. The prevalence of motion artifacts \(up to 38% of raw epochs\) and non\-compliance with wearing \(22–41% of user\-days\) are analyzed alongside other critical challenges in the context of data quality, as are inter\-device variability \(±12–18%\) and mitigations\. The results provide a methodological strategy for incorporating the CRV obtained from wearable devices into new generation personal risk assessment tools to improve the cardio\-metabolic, neuropsychiatric and sleep\-related management of patients\.

## [Development of multi\-dimensional pressure sensing textiles](../publications/952c96935ca9c490edf9.md)

Jinxing Jiang

Flexible and wearable electronics have emerged as a transformative technology platform, enabling a new generation of smart devices for applications across a wide spectrum of fields, including healthcare monitoring, sports training, aerospace, defense, and industrial protection\. Among the various functional components in these systems, pressure sensors play a vital role, enabling accurate detection and quantification of mechanical forces\. This capacity is essential for realizing functionalities such as physiological monitoring, motion analysis, and human\-machine interaction\. To achieve seamless integration with wearable gears, electronic textiles \(e\-textiles\) have attracted increasing attention\. By embedding electronic components directly into textile substrates, e\-textiles offer softness, breathability, and lightweight properties, providing superior comfort and wearability compared to conventional film\-based electronics\. In the context of pressure sensors, e\-textiles typically employ flexible sensing components that are fabricated by printing electronic functional materials onto textile substrates\. This approach not only preserves the desirable mechanical properties of textiles but also enables large\-area, scalable production\. However, the inherent mechanical mismatch between textiles and functional electronic materials can lead to interfacial delamination and subsequently the device failure under repeated or complex deformations\. Additionally, the limited selection of materials and structural design strategies available for textile\-based sensing layers restrict their sensitivity, sensing range, and ability to detect multi\-dimensional force detection\. As a result, simultaneously achieving high mechanical robustness, exceptional sensitivity, broad sensing range, and reliable multi\-axis detection in pressure\-sensing textiles remains a critical challenge\. This thesis systematically addresses these challenges through the rational design and fabrication of advanced pressure\-sensing textiles, integrating innovative functional ink formulations, engineered sensing architectures, and robust device integration strategies\. The development of novel inks enables highly conductive and durable electrodes, while optimized sensing architectures significantly improve sensitivity and expand the sensing range\. Integration strategies further advance pressure\-sensing textiles from single\-axis to multi\-dimensional force detection\. Together, these innovations result in e\-textiles with outstanding mechanical robustness, high sensitivity, broad sensing range, and reliable multi\-axis force detection capability, paving the way for applications in intelligent healthcare and interactive wearables\. Firstly, a cohesive functional ink formulation is developed to achieve strong adhesion and mechanical stability on various textile substrates\. By rationally tailoring the ink’s solvent system, such a cohesive ink facilitates the in\-situ formation of a robust interfacial adhesive layer during the printing process between the ink and fabric surface\. The incorporation of various functional fillers, including silver, liquid metal, carbon nanotubes, and piezoelectric materials, imparts the ink with exceptional versatility, enabling tunable electrical properties\. This formulation is compatible with multiple textile substrates and printing techniques, resulting in printed e\-textiles that demonstrate remarkable durability under repeated bending, stretching, washing, and wear\. This work establishes a solid foundation for the subsequent development of high\-performance pressure\-sensing textiles\. Building upon this material platform, a skin\-inspired, structure\-gradient fiber mat \(SGFM\), which can serve as the sensing layer for self\-powered pressure sensors, is then developed via template\-assisted layer\-by\-layer electrospinning and electrode printing techniques\. Mimicking the gradient mechanical structure of the human skin, SGFM demonstrates outstanding dielectric property and mechanical resilience that outperforms the one only with homogeneous fiber\-mat design\. It endows the pressure\-sensing textile with high sensitivity and broad pressure detection range \(0\.068 kPa⁻¹ from 0\-53 kPa, and 0\.013 kPa⁻¹ from 53\-660 kPa\)\. The resulting pressure sensing textile showcases excellent resistance to wear and washing, and can be integrated into a wearable rehabilitation monitoring system, highlighting its practical potential for rehabilitation assistance and sports training\. Furthermore, the sensing capability of the pressure\-sensing textile was extended to multi\-axis force detection by printing the multi\-channel strain\-sensing array with a pressure\-sensing unit within the multilayered fiber\-mat matrix\. Such an integrated pressure\-sensing textile can sensitively detect the magnitude and direction of the pressure forces, and transmit to the terminal when coupled with a data\-acquisition circuit and machine\-learning algorithms\. As a proof of concept, such pressure\-sensing textile is adhered to a fingertip to perform real\-time tactile sensing, enabling the real\-time recording of delicate finger motions such as object manipulation and writing\. In summary, this work advances high\-performance, flexible and multi\-dimensional pressure\-sensing textiles through material innovation, structural engineering, and device integration\. The resulting fabrics deliver outstanding sensitivity, broad sensing range, multi\-dimensional detection, and long\-term durability, thereby paving the way for next\-generation smart textiles\. Moreover, the fabrication and integration strategies investigated in this work are believed to be readily adaptable to other textile\-based wearable electronics, including power sources, computing components, and displays\. Collectively, the findings of this thesis are poised to make a meaningful impact on the continued evolution of flexible electronics and smart textile systems\.

## [Australia’s blue economy at a crossroads: toward an integrated/interwoven systems model for sustainable ocean prosperity](../publications/952cf18b4f77f41a9ba4.md)

Nico Adams; Christopher Frid; Angela Williamson

Australia’s blue economy, worth about A$229 billion and growing faster than the broader economy, stands at a strategic turning point\. Despite its vast and biodiverse marine estate, Australia’s capacity to realise sustainable ocean prosperity is constrained by fragmented governance, weak data infrastructure, and the lack of a coordinated national strategy\. This paper proposes an integrated systems model built on six interdependent pillars: national coordination, Indigenous and community partnership, industry\-led innovation, cross\-sector integration, real\-time data and prediction, and adaptive governance\. Across nine blue economy sectors, it identifies key knowledge gaps, technological needs, and governance innovations required to achieve sustainable development by 2035\. The model offers a practical architecture for competitive, coordinated, and ecologically responsible ocean development at scale\.

## [Hisse Senedi Fiyatlarının CatBoost ve Destek Vektör Makineleri Yöntemleriyle Tahmin Edilmesi: BIST Katılım 30 Endeksi Uygulaması](../publications/953acc786a33224a20c4.md)

Hakan Yılmaz

Çalışmada, 3 Ocak 2022 ile 31 Aralık 2025 periyodunda Borsa İstanbul \(BIST\) Katılım 30 Endeksinde sürekli olarak işlem gören işletmelerin hisse senetlerinin gelecek fiyatlarının tahmin edilmesi amaçlanmıştır\. Bu kapsamda işletme hisse senetlerinin belirtilen tarihlerdeki günlük kapanış fiyatlarına ve finansal tablolarına ulaşılmıştır\. Bu tablolardan seçili 9 finansal oran hesaplanmıştır\. Veri teminini takiben CatBoost ve Destek Vektör Makineleri \(DVM\) yöntemleri kullanılarak işletmelerin hisse senetlerinin gelecek fiyatları tahmin edilmiştir\. Çalışma sonucunda, CatBoost algoritmasının hisse senedi fiyat tahmininde DVM algoritmasına kıyasla daha başarılı sonuçlar ürettiği belirlenmiştir\. Test veri seti sonuçları incelendiğinde CatBoost algoritmasının 0,726 R² değeri elde ettiği, DVM algoritmasının ise 0,495 R² değerine ulaştığı görülmüştür\. Bununla birlikte CatBoost algoritmasının RMSE ve MSE hata ölçütlerinde daha düşük hata değerleri ürettiği ve yine CatBoost algoritmasının hisse senedi fiyatlarındaki değişimi açıklama ve tahmin etme konusunda daha yüksek performans sergilediğini göstermiştir\. Algoritmaların tahmin performanslarının değerlendirilmesinin ardından gerçekleştirilen SHAP analizi sonuçlarına göre her iki modelde de Özsermaye/Toplam Aktifler oranının hisse senedi fiyatlarının tahmininde en önemli değişken olduğu belirlenmiştir\. Türkiye’de BIST Katılım 30 Endeksi üzerine CatBoost ve Destek Vektör Makineleri yöntemleri kullanılarak yapılan hisse senedi fiyat tahmini çalışmaları araştırıldığında belirtilen tarihler için ilgili endeks üzerinde herhangi bir çalışmaya rastlanamamıştır\. Bu durum çalışmanın özgün yanını ve finans literatürüne olan katkısını ifade etmektedir\.

## [Contribution of ictal\-interictal SPECT and SISCOM to preoperative localization of the epileptogenic zone in frontal lobe epilepsy\.](../publications/954788a0ef8ca754ebe6.md)

Lauro Wichert‐Ana; Ricardo Fernandes do Amaral; J\. C\. T\. Fernandes; Felipe Arriva Pitella; Felipe Alves Mourato; Mery Kato; Tonicarlo Rodrigues Velasco; Frederico Nakane Nakano; Marina Teixeira Ramalho Pereira Dalio; Veriano Alexandre; Úrsula Thomé; Ana Paula Andrade Hamad; Antonio Carlos; Américo Ceiki Sakamoto

Objective: To describe the contributions of conventional single\-photon emission computed tomography \(SPECT\) and subtraction ictal\-interictal SPECT coregistered to magnetic resonance imaging \(SISCOM\) for the preoperative identification of the epileptogenic zone \(EZ\) in patients with frontal lobe epilepsy \(FLE\)\. Materials and methods: In this retrospective study, we reviewed medical records of all patients with refractory FLE who underwent frontal lobectomy at our institution between 2015 and 2020, all of whom had undergone at least one ictal SPECT, one interictal SPECT, one high\-resolution magnetic resonance imaging examination, SISCOM, and at least one year of follow\-up\. Fourteen patients met the inclusion criteria\. Results: After a mean follow\-up of 32 months \(range, 14\-60 months\), surgical outcomes were classified as good in five patients \(35\.7%\) and poor in nine \(64\.3%\)\. For localizing the EZ, SISCOM achieved the highest sensitivity \(80%\), negative predictive value \(85%\), and overall diagnostic accuracy \(71%\), whereas ictal SPECT had the highest specificity \(70%\) and interictal SPECT had the lowest performance overall\. Conclusion: In patients with FLE, ictal and interictal SPECT alone do not seem to predict the surgical outcome\. However, SISCOM seems to perform better for that purpose\.

## [Can digital\-real integration effectively curb urban sprawl? Evidence from China using double/debiased machine learning](../publications/9551a79d35529cf0c3a4.md)

Chunjie Hu; Jinsong Zheng; 赖南希; 王秋裕; 何寿奎

Urban sprawl \(URS\) has become a major challenge to China’s sustainable development under the backdrop of rapid urbanization\. Digital\-real integration \(DRI\) provides a new pathway for urban spatial governance, yet its concrete impacts and mechanisms remain insufficiently tested\. Based on panel data from 280 prefecture\-level Chinese cities between 2013 and 2023, this study constructs a multidimensional DRI index and employs a partially linear double/debiased machine learning \(DML\) framework to estimate the effect of DRI on URS\. Multiple robustness checks, including complementary instrumental\-variable analyses, yield results consistent with the baseline finding\. The findings show that a one\-unit increase in DRI is associated with a 0\.06\-unit reduction in the URS index, and this conclusion holds under various robustness tests\. The mechanism analysis provides evidence consistent with three potential transmission pathways: industrial structure upgrading, stronger aggregate city\-level correspondence between employment opportunities and resident population, and reduced dependence on highway commuting\. Further heterogeneity analysis reveals that the restraining effect of DRI is more pronounced in eastern regions, major national urban agglomerations, and cities at more advanced stages of urban development\. This study not only provides empirical evidence on how digital technologies reshape urban spatial structures but also offers policy implications for implementing differentiated digital governance strategies and enhancing the effectiveness of spatial planning\.

## [Early caudate involvement marks a Lewy body spectrum phenotype in parkinsonism: a 5\-year longitudinal study](../publications/9556bef1b376ba4fcb2c.md)

Sara Varanese; Maria Pia Buongarzone; Stefano Viola; Maria Felice Ghilardi; Alessandro Di Rocco; Rino Speranza; Alessia Masòtino; Christian Durante; Laura Bonanni

Background Parkinsonian syndromes are increasingly recognized as part of a heterogeneous spectrum of Lewy body diseases, ranging from Parkinson’s disease \(PD\) to dementia with Lewy bodies \(DLB\)\. Identifying early markers of clinical heterogeneity remains challenging\. Objective To investigate whether striatal dopaminergic denervation patterns on DAT\-SPECT are associated with distinct clinical phenotypes and long\-term cognitive trajectories in early parkinsonism\. Methods Twenty\-eight patients with early parkinsonism fulfilling clinical diagnostic criteria for PD underwent DAT\-SPECT and were classified according to the topography of dopaminergic denervation into isolated putaminal involvement \(P group\) or combined putaminal and caudate involvement \(PC group\)\. Motor, neuropsychiatric, and cognitive assessments, including the MoCA, were performed at baseline and after 5 years\. Results At baseline, patients with caudate involvement \( n = 16\) showed greater motor impairment and a higher prevalence of psychiatric symptoms than the P group\. Early cognitive impairment was observed in 32% of the PC group versus 0% of the P group\. Over 5 years, the PC group showed greater cognitive deterioration, with 83% scoring below the cognitive impairment threshold compared with 9% in the P group\. Visual hallucinations developed in a subset of PC patients during follow\-up\. Conclusion Early caudate dopaminergic denervation identifies a parkinsonian phenotype associated with greater motor severity, neuropsychiatric manifestations, and accelerated cognitive decline\. Its longitudinal evolution may reflect a trajectory toward the cognitive and neuropsychiatric end of the Lewy body disease spectrum, including a DLB\-like phenotype\. DAT\-SPECT may provide prognostic information beyond its diagnostic utility\.

## [Agentic AI and Academic Workforce Resilience in Malaysian Higher Education: An Integrative HRD Framework](../publications/955ab3fb7b64c72d1eee.md)

Mahadi Abu Hassan; Shahrulanuar Mohamed; Erwan Ismail; Norliah Binti Kudus; Asniyani Nur Haidar Abdullah; Shafina Abd Karim Ishigaki

This conceptual paper develops an integrative Human Resource Development \(HRD\) framework for understanding academic workforce resilience in Malaysian higher education institutions \(HEIs\) under the disruptive conditions of Agentic AI\. Drawing on Cascio&\#x27;s BANI framework, Hobfoll&\#x27;s Conservation of Resources \(COR\) theory, the professional identity perspective, and Strategic HRD theory, the paper synthesises a curated body of contemporary literature to explain how technological disruption becomes a workforce\-resilience problem\. The framework advances four theoretical propositions\. First, BANI conditions generate distinct resource threats through structural brittleness, professional anxiety, non\-linear skill depreciation, and algorithmic incomprehensibility\. Second, strategic HRD architectures can alter these appraisal pathways by replenishing individual and institutional resources\. Third, sustained resilience depends on professional identity reconstruction from task\-centred &\#x27;doing&\#x27; towards human\-centred &\#x27;being&\#x27;\. Fourth, agile governance and AI\-adaptive leadership provide the institutional conditions through which individual resilience can contribute to organizational antifragility\. The paper reframes academic resilience as a systemic HRD outcome rather than an individual coping responsibility and identifies a theory\-led agenda for empirical testing in Malaysia and comparable ASEAN higher education contexts\.

## [Feature Selection and Model Optimization for Accurate Classification of Complex Data](../publications/9561b75c46b847c5cea3.md)

Ghulam Rasool; Muhammad Asif; Abdul Wahab

The present study aimed to investigate the role of feature selection and model optimization in improving the classification performance of machine learning algorithms for complex data\. A quantitative, experimental, and comparative research design was adopted using a structured dataset collected from a relevant data source in the selected study context\. The dataset comprised the observations and predictor variables required for classification, while data collection involved obtaining the dataset, identifying the target variable, and preparing the data for analysis\. Data preprocessing included checking missing values, removing duplicate observations where necessary, identifying inconsistencies, and dividing the dataset into training and testing subsets\. Feature selection techniques were applied to identify informative variables and reduce data dimensionality, while hyperparameter optimization was performed to identify suitable configurations for Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting algorithms\. Python\-based data analysis was conducted using relevant data processing and machine learning libraries\. Model performance was evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1\-score, and the results were compared between baseline models and models developed using feature selection and optimization\. The study provides a systematic framework for examining the combined contribution of feature selection and model optimization to classification performance, computational efficiency, and model generalizability\. Its significance lies in supporting the development of more efficient and reliable classification systems for complex datasets and providing methodological guidance for researchers applying machine learning in different fields\. The findings are expected to contribute to improved understanding of how data dimensionality reduction and appropriate model configuration can support predictive performance, subject to empirical validation using the actual dataset\.

## [NOT EVERYONE NEEDS PSYCHOTHERAPY, AND COUNSELING PSYCHOLOGY OFFERS A PROPORTIONATE, NON\-PATHOLOGISING FORM OF HELP](../publications/95678f7c6aba79089156.md)

Václav Šimek; Michal Slavik

Public and professional discourse increasingly treats psychotherapy as the default response to psychological distress, while counselling is often represented as a preliminary, less rigorous, or less profound form of help\. This article challenges that hierarchy without constructing an artificial opposition between the two practices\. A critical integrative review of literature published from 2022 to July 2026 was used to examine recent evidence on professional identity, expansion of mental\-health concepts, stepped and low\-intensity care, shared decision making, autonomy support, client\-defined outcomes, non\-response, and adverse experiences in psychotherapy\. The synthesis suggests that counselling\-oriented and psychotherapy\-oriented work overlap substantially in methods and relationship processes, but can still be distinguished by their primary centre of gravity\. Counselling\-oriented work commonly prioritises contextual understanding, decision support, resource mobilisation, developmental adaptation, and transfer of competence, whereas psychotherapy\-oriented work more often prioritises sustained modification of persistent symptoms, pervasive patterns, and recurrent relational or intrapsychic difficulties\. On this basis, the article proposes the Proportionate Psychological Help Framework, which matches the intensity and form of help to safety and clinical complexity, functional impairment, persistence and pervasiveness, the primary change task, contextual determinants, client agency and preference, and response to intervention\. The framework rejects both under\-treatment and therapeutic overreach\. Counselling psychology is consequently positioned not as a diluted precursor to psychotherapy, but as a distinct and necessary part of a plural mental\-health system in which escalation, de\-escalation, referral, and collaborative choice are normal features of ethical practice

## [Towards Unified Approaches in Self\-Supervised Event Stream Modeling: Progress and Prospects](../publications/956cd78c77871e8f377f.md)

Levente Z´olyomi; Tianze Wang; Sofiane Ennadir; Oleg Smirnov; Lele Cao

The proliferation of digital interactions across diverse domains, such as healthcare, e\-commerce, gaming, and finance, has resulted in the generation of vast volumes of event stream \(ES\) data\. ES data comprises continuous sequences of timestamped events that encapsulate detailed contextual information relevant to each domain\. While ES data holds significant potential for extracting actionable insights and enhancing decision\-making, its effective utilization is hindered by challenges such as the scarcity of labeled data and the fragmented nature of existing research efforts\. Self\-Supervised Learning \(SSL\) has emerged as a promising paradigm to address these challenges by enabling the extraction of meaningful representations from unlabeled ES data\. In this survey, we systematically review and synthesize SSL methodologies tailored for ES modeling across multiple domains, bridging the gaps between domain\-specific approaches that have traditionally operated in isolation\. We present a comprehensive taxonomy of SSL techniques, encompassing both predictive and contrastive paradigms, and analyze their applicability and effectiveness within different application contexts\. Furthermore, we identify critical gaps in current research and propose a future research agenda aimed at developing scalable, domain\-agnostic SSL frameworks for ES modeling\. By unifying disparate research efforts and highlighting cross\-domain synergies, this survey aims to accelerate innovation, improve reproducibility, and expand the applicability of SSL to diverse real\-world ES challenges\.

## [Tecnologías basadas en inteligencia artificial para la educación inclusiva en niños con necesidades educativas especiales niños](../publications/95904f9c92fa5626b871.md)

Marcelo Xavier Núñez Velasco; María Eugenia Játiva Parra; Sandra Elizabeth Bautista Barba; Gabriela Maritza Ayala Trujillo

La incorporación de la inteligencia artificial \(IA\) en la educación ha ampliado las posibilidades de personalizar la enseñanza y de reducir barreras de acceso, participación y aprendizaje\. Esta revisión sistemática tuvo como objetivo analizar la evidencia disponible sobre el uso de tecnologías basadas en IA en la educación inclusiva de niños y adolescentes con necesidades educativas especiales \(NEE\), considerando sus aplicaciones pedagógicas, efectos reportados, condiciones de implementación y principales desafíos\. Se realizó una revisión documental siguiendo las directrices de PRISMA 2020\. La búsqueda se planteó en Scopus, Web of Science, ERIC, ScienceDirect, PubMed, Dialnet y Latindex, mediante combinaciones de términos relacionados con inteligencia artificial, educación inclusiva, necesidades educativas especiales, discapacidad, rendimiento académico y accesibilidad\. El proceso de selección reportado identificó 1\.879 registros, de los cuales 1\.291 permanecieron después de la eliminación de duplicados; posteriormente, 373 textos fueron evaluados a texto completo y 27 publicaciones fueron incorporadas a la síntesis\. Los estudios revisados describen aplicaciones de IA adaptativa, sistemas tutoriales inteligentes, modelos de lenguaje, herramientas de accesibilidad y reconocimiento, robótica social y entornos inmersivos\. En conjunto, la literatura reporta posibilidades de personalización, apoyo a la comunicación, accesibilidad y participación; sin embargo, los resultados presentan heterogeneidad en diseños, poblaciones y tecnologías\. También se identifican barreras relacionadas con conectividad, infraestructura, formación docente, accesibilidad de las interfaces, privacidad y sesgo algorítmico\. La evidencia disponible respalda el uso de la IA como recurso complementario a la intervención educativa, siempre que exista mediación docente, criterios de accesibilidad y mecanismos de protección de datos\.

## [Attribution of changes in vegetation structure and carbon–water fluxes in the Ji\-shaped bend of the Yellow River based on process\-guided machine learning](../publications/95942d71d188b76a65ed.md)

Chao Li; Long Ma; Xing Huang; Chenyue Wang; Ruolin Bu; Bolin Sun; Tingxi Liu; Qiang Zhang

Arid and semi\-arid ecosystems play an important role in the global terrestrial carbon cycle, but the relative contributions of climate change, elevated CO₂, and land\-use change \(LUCC\) to their carbon–water processes remain uncertain\. In this study, we developed a process\-guided machine learning \(PGML\) framework integrating Biome\-BGC and LightGBM, which achieves synergistic simulation of mechanistic constraints and data\-driven modeling through residual learning\. PGML significantly improved the pixel\-scale simulation accuracy of LAI, GPP, and ET in the Ji\-shaped Bend of the Yellow River, a typical arid and semi\-arid region of China, with R 2 values of 0\.70, 0\.95, and 0\.91, respectively, and reduced RMSE by 61%–83% compared with the calibrated process model\. Full\-factorial attribution showed that LAI, GPP, ET, and WUE all increased significantly during the study period, with the growth rate of GPP exceeding that of ET, thereby promoting an increase in WUE\. Under the process representations and driving factors considered in the PGML framework, elevated CO₂ was identified as the largest simulated contributor to the increases in LAI, GPP, and ET, with contribution rates of 71\.8%, 78\.7%, and 75\.2%, respectively; climate change contributed approximately 15%, while the direct contribution of LUCC was less than 0\.25%\. Meanwhile, the regional mean climate–CO₂ interaction effect was negative, indicating that local climatic conditions generally weakened the CO₂ fertilization effect\. These results reveal that elevated CO₂ made the largest contribution to the enhancement of vegetation structure and carbon–water fluxes in the Ji\-shaped Bend of the Yellow River over the past two decades\.
