## [Genotype\-specific molecular and functional trajectories in NGLY1 deficiency: a comparative multi\-omics study of patient\-derived iPSC neurons](../publications/9c94a2a781d1d81f4b91.md)

Soukaina Amniouel; Zeenat A\. Shyr; William F\. Borschel; Mitali Arun Tambe; Atena Farkhondeh; Wei Zheng

Background NGLY1 deficiency is an ultra\-rare congenital disorder of deglycosylation with prominent neurodevelopmental impairment and marked allelic heterogeneity\. Prior human neuronal models have characterized NGLY1 loss largely within single genetic backgrounds, leaving open whether distinct patient genotypes converge on a shared molecular state or follow divergent routes\. Because clinical presentations overlap across genotypes, resolving this question requires a direct, within\-system comparison of multiple genotypes rather than characterization of any single line\. Methods We generated iPSC\-derived glutamatergic neurons from three patients carrying distinct biallelic NGLY1 genotypes \(R401X/R401X, Q208X/G310G, L318P/R390P\) and two healthy controls, and profiled them head\-to\-head using matched transcriptomics and proteomics at day 28, RNA to protein concordance and differential exon usage analysis, pathway and phenotype network integration, and longitudinal multielectrode array \(MEA\) recordings during early network maturation\. Results Across both molecular layers, samples segregated strongly by genotype rather than forming a unified disease signature\. Differential expression revealed pronounced between\-genotype heterogeneity with only a small shared molecular core\. RNA to protein concordance was moderate and genotype\-dependent, and differential exon usage was enriched among discordant genes in a mutation\-dependent manner, implicating splicing\-level regulation in the transcript to protein divergence\. Integrated networks linked genotype\-specific concordant changes to synaptic signaling, calcium handling, metabolism, and extracellular matrix remodeling, and connected them to overlapping clinical phenotypes through distinct molecular routes\. MEA recordings showed delayed maturation and genotype\-dependent shifts in network excitability, with functional clustering that mirrored the molecular separation\. Conclusion Distinct NGLY1 genotypes produce divergent molecular and functional trajectories that converge on impaired network maturation through non\-identical routes\. These findings reframe NGLY1 deficiency as a set of genotype\-specific molecular states rather than a single phenotype, with direct implications for mechanistic subgrouping and the design of preclinical models and validation studies\.

## [Data\-Efficient Classifier Pretraining Through Diffusion Models](../publications/9c95a31cc25f5624cb49.md)

Qinyu Li; Yee Whye Teh; Chris Holmes; Joel Jaskari

Machine learning with limited data is susceptible to overfitting, especially with modern deep neural networks\. Prior to the introduction of AlexNet, reconstruction\-based pretraining with auto\-encoder and denoising auto\-encoder were found to be beneficial, partially due to the limited size of the training sets at the time\. Motivated by these traditional approaches, we propose DiffPT, a simple diffusion modeling approach to pretrain a given classifier backbone for limited domain\-specific training data\. We experiment on time\-series data, standard natural\-image benchmarks, and medical imaging datasets, and contrast the diffusion approach to a multitude of modern and traditional un/self\-supervised methods\. While contrastive pretraining performs better on CIFAR\-10 and Tiny ImageNet in low\-data regimes, DiffPT is particularly effective on medical imaging and time\-series tasks, where it outperforms self\-supervised baselines across a range of low\-data regimes\. Our results suggest that DiffPT is a simple and effective approach for data\-efficient classifier pretraining on different modalities\.

## [Efficient and Scalable Provenance Tracking for LLM\-Generated Code Snippets](../publications/9c9b1f7f7e63850f887c.md)

Andrea Gurioli; Davide D’Ascenzo; Federico Pennino; Maurizio Gabbrielli; Stefano Zacchiroli

Large language models \(LLMs\) for code completion and generation are increasingly used in software development, yet they may reproduce training examples verbatim and without authorship attribution, raising legal and ethical concerns around plagiarism and license compliance\. Classical fingerprint\-based plagiarism detectors, such as Winnowing, remain highly effective, yet the inspection requires comparing fragments of code to the entire training set, and their linear\-time search makes them impractical for the billion\-scale corpora used to train modern code LLMs\. To bridge this gap, we introduce SourceTracker , a 300M\-parameter encoder tailored for code retrieval, together with a hybrid two\-stage provenance\-tracking pipeline HybridSourceTracker \( HST \)\. HST first narrows down a small set of candidate snippets via vector search, then re\-ranks those candidates using Winnowing on exact fingerprints\. We train and evaluate our system on a 10M\-snippet subset of the TheStackV2 dataset, with both verbatim and adapted snippets that emulate realistic identifier renaming\. On an in vitro 100k\-snippet search space with adapted queries, our hybrid approach reaches a mean reciprocal rank on par with Winnowing for 30\-token fragments\. Then, starting from windows ≥ 60 tokens, it consistently over\-performs by up to 5\.4% while preserving logarithmic\-time query complexity\. In a complementary evaluation using an LLM\-based judge, we find that many retrieved snippets not labeled as ground truth are still highly similar to the expected sources, particularly with longer context windows, and thus remain useful for end users\. Overall, our results demonstrate that integrating vector search with fingerprinting enables scalable, high\-precision provenance tracking for code produced by LLMs, provided that their training data is made accessible\. More broadly, our findings underscore the growing need for transparency around LLM training corpora as a prerequisite for effective provenance tracking, attribution, and license compliance\.

## [Analysis of Consumer Sentiment Tendency Towards Skintific Products on E\-Commerce Tokopedia Using the VADER Method](../publications/9ca4d8112332c5105d7e.md)

Ridwan Yusuf; Re Intan Maharani

The development of e\-commerce has made consumer reviews a valuable source of information for producers\. This study analyzes consumer sentiment toward Skintific products on Tokopedia using the VADER method\. Data were collected through web scraping and produced 2,144 reviews that were processed through data cleaning, text conversion, stopword removal, stemming, and translation into English\. The Sentiment Intensity Analyzer from VADER classified the reviews into positive, neutral, and negative sentiments\. The results show a dominance of positive sentiment at 91\.7%, followed by neutral at 6\.9%, and negative at 1\.4%\. Data visualization reveals aspects valued by consumers, such as packaging, price, and delivery speed\. This study confirms the effectiveness of the VADER method in sentiment analysis of consumer reviews and provides insights for producers in improving marketing strategies and product quality\.

## [A qualitative typology of teachers’ orientations toward artificial intelligence integration in Lebanese schools](../publications/9cc3c4bc47fd18050ef1.md)

Mireille Riachi

Abstract Artificial intelligence \(AI\) is increasingly reshaping educational practices, requiring teachers to develop new competencies while navigating complex ethical considerations\. This qualitative study explores the perceptions, practices, and orientations of 28 Lebanese schoolteachers regarding the integration of AI in school settings\. Findings indicate that while a majority of participants reported familiarity with AI, only a limited proportion integrated AI into their instructional practices\. Reported barriers included insufficient training, lack of institutional support, and concerns related to data privacy and ethical use\. The analysis led to the identification of three qualitative orientations toward AI integration—reluctant users, early adopters, and critical skeptics—reflecting differentiated levels of readiness and engagement\. The findings highlight the need for context\-sensitive, pedagogically grounded, and ethically informed professional development to support sustainable AI integration in education\.

## [A unified multi\-domain framework for hallucination detection and reliability evaluation in large language models](../publications/9cc96cbb8160165fcd2e.md)

Kayarvizhy Kayarvizhy; M\. Bhuvana; Ayman Khan; C\. Bharath; S\. G\. Brijesh; Pankaj Awasthi; Reevu Maity

Large Language Models \(LLMs\) such as GPT\-5\.2, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2\.5 Pro, and DeepSeek V3\.1 demonstrate strong reasoning and conversational capabilities, yet their reliability under adversarial and ambiguous prompts remains a critical challenge\. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate isolated aspects such as factual accuracy or jailbreak resistance, but they fail to capture multi\-domain soft failures that emerge in realistic, mixed\-context interactions\. This paper introduces MDH\-Bench, a Multi\-Domain Hallucination Benchmark comprising 400 adversarial yet naturalistic prompts distributed across eight reliability categories, including numerical reasoning traps, temporal inconsistencies, fictional research scenarios, contradictory context embedding, bias provocation, security\-sensitive defaults, and instruction override attempts\. We propose a Unified Multi\-Domain Reliability Evaluation Framework that integrates accuracy, hallucination rate, hallucination degree \(HD\), contradiction rate, and safety indicators into a composite Reliability Score \(R\-Score\) for deployment\-oriented assessment\. A structured multi\-annotator evaluation involving three independent annotators was conducted across four state\-of\-the\-art LLMs under five repeated experimental runs\. Inter\-annotator agreement achieved substantial consistency, with Fleiss’ κ values of 0\.77 for correctness assessment and 0\.79 for hallucination identification\. Experimental results demonstrate notable reliability differences across models\. GPT\-5\.2 achieved the highest overall accuracy of 80\.10% and the highest composite Reliability Score \(0\.8715\), while also maintaining a relatively low hallucination rate of 14\.45%\. Claude Sonnet 4 achieved the lowest hallucination rate \(13\.30%\) and demonstrated strong contextual consistency, obtaining an R\-Score of 0\.8375\. Gemini 2\.5 Pro achieved 75\.50% accuracy but exhibited higher hallucination rates \(25\.50%\), resulting in an R\-Score of 0\.8011\. DeepSeek V3\.1 showed the weakest overall reliability, recording 63\.60% accuracy, the highest hallucination rate \(37\.55%\), and the lowest R\-Score \(0\.7074\)\. Across all evaluated models, unsafe output rates remained negligible under the tested benchmark conditions\. Variance analysis across five independent runs demonstrated stable evaluation behaviour, with accuracy coefficient of variation \(CV\) values remaining below 3\.1% for all models\. Pairwise McNemar’s statistical tests further indicated statistically significant differences for several model pairs across most model pairs\. Category\-wise analysis revealed that temporal impossibility and contradictory\-context prompts remain particularly challenging across current LLM architectures, even for top\-performing models\. The proposed MDH\-Bench framework establishes an extensible multi\-dimensional benchmark for diagnosing hallucination behaviour, contextual reliability, adversarial robustness, and deployment readiness in modern LLM systems\. The benchmark dataset, evaluation scripts, annotations, and experimental artifacts are publicly released to support transparent and reproducible future research\.

## [Strategic Organizational Adaptation and Performance of Audit Firms in Nairobi City County, Kenya\.](../publications/9ccc3ccc3ad04aad92f8.md)

Erick Ombati Nyatangi; Susan Ingasia Naikuru; Peter Ngatia Maku

Firm performance, reflected in profitability, sustainability, client retention, referrals and market position, is a critical measure of the competitiveness and survival of audit firms in Kenya\. Despite growing regulatory demands, rapid digitalization of audit work and rising client expectations for advisory services, about 75% of the 993 audit firms licensed by the Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Kenya \(ICPAK\) continue to operate under traditional compliance\-based models, and many small and mid\-tier firms face client churn and an erosion of market share\. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to establ ish the influence of strategic organizational adaptation on the performance of audit firms in Nairobi City County, Kenya\. It specifically examined the influence of regulatory compliance, technological integration, structural flexibility and client\-centric service on firm performance\. The study was anchored on Institutional Theory, the Technology Acceptance Model, Dynamic Capabilities Theory and Service Quality \(SERVQUAL\) Theory\. An explanatory cross\-sectional survey design was adopted, targeting 745 ICPAK\-licensed audit firms domiciled in Nairobi City County, from which a sampling frame of 186 eligible firms was identified\. A sample of 127 firms was determined using the Yamane formula and selected through disproportionate stratified random sampling\. Primary data were collected from firm owners and senior managers using a structured Likert\-scale questionnaire with open\-ended items, and were analysed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation and multiple regression analysis, with results presented in tables and discussed\. The findings revealed that the four adaptation dimensions jointly explained 79\.3% of the variation in firm performance \(F = 99\.843, p &lt; 0\.001\)\. Structural flexibility had the strongest positive and significant influence on performance, followed by regulatory compliance, while client\-centric service and technological integration had positive and significant but comparatively smaller influences\. The study, therefore, recommends that audit firms should institutionalize formal strategic planning and ambidextrous service portfolios, embed proactive compliance with ICPAK, UDIN, KRA eTIMS and IESBA requirements, adopt structured advisory and client feedback models, and invest in audit technologies supported by staff training, while ICPAK should establish subsidized digital infrastructure and continuing professional development programmes for small and mid\-tier firms\.

## [Whole\-genome phylogenetic and population genetic analysis of Orthoebolavirus restonense](../publications/9cd5097b97ea093501ad.md)

Adrian Sam Arcillo; Anton Roi G\. Collado; John Carlo M\. Malabad; Noel Lee J\. Miranda; Andrea Gail M\. Villavicencio; Ruby Anne K\. Ong; Roniza Flor I\. Guevarra; Maria Llaine J\. Callanta

Introduction Orthoebolavirus restonense \(Reston virus; RESTV\) is a zoonotic virus that has been detected primarily in non\-human primates and swine\. Despite its recognized public health importance, the evolutionary dynamics and population structure of RESTV remain poorly understood\. Methods In this study, we conducted an in silico analysis of 20 publicly available RESTV whole\-genome sequences to build upon previous analyses by updating phylogenetic relationships, evolutionary timescales, and incorporating additional analyses of genetic diversity and population subdivision across host groups and outbreak periods\. Results Maximum\-likelihood and Bayesian analyses support 5 multi\-sequence clusters and 2 phylogenetically distinct singleton lineages\. The common ancestor of the sampled genomes was estimated around 1967, with a broad 95% highest posterior density interval of 1930–1988, indicating that the sampled evolutionary history likely predates the first recognized outbreak in 1989\. The pooled dataset showed high haplotype diversity, while swine\-derived genomes exhibited greater nucleotide diversity than primate\-derived genomes\. Furthermore, neutrality tests based on the limited number of genomes \(n=20\) did not detect evidence of recent rapid population expansion\. Discussion Population structure analyses suggest structured, highly divergent viral sequences, with temporal segregation exerting a greater influence than host\-associated factors, although the relative contributions of outbreak period and host are difficult to disentangle due to the uneven distribution of hosts across sampling periods\. The estimated ancestry of sampled genomes predating the first recognized outbreak, together with the evidence of population structure, raises the possibility of earlier undetected, potentially cryptic circulation; however, responsible host\(s\), and continuity of transmission remain unresolved\. Nevertheless, the limited number of available genome sequences constrains a comprehensive understanding of RESTV evolutionary history and transmission dynamics\. Expanded genomic surveillance and One Health integration are therefore essential to better elucidate the virus’ evolution, epidemiology, and zoonotic potential\.

## [Intervención a través de técnicas somáticas desde la pedagogía del loto, para mejorar los procesos de convivencia en estudiantes de un colegio público en una zona de conflicto en Bogotá, Colombia](../publications/9cdabeba3f5dddd9759f.md)

Alexander Rubio Álvarez

This article presents research conducted with students from the Rodrigo Lara Bonilla School in Bogota, Colombia\. Lotus Pedagogy is an innovative educational methodology that seeks to foster socio\-emotional regulation in youth through practices such as breathing, meditation, mindfulness, hatha yoga, and body percussion within collective group work\. Objective: To evaluate the impact of the somatic techniques of Lotus Pedagogy on reducing violence among eleventh\-grade students at a public school in Ciudad Bolívar \(Bogotá, Colombia\), a vulnerable area with high levels of conflict\. Methods and materials: Quantita\- tive study with a pretest\-posttest experimental design, with a control group \(n = 82\) and an experimental group \(n = 82\), throughout the 2019 school year \(February–November\)\. The experimental group received 20 minutes of somatic techniques three times a week in physical education and arts classes; coexistence was measured using the student behavior record \(“student observer”\)\. Results and discussion: A t\-test showed a significant reduction in conflict situa\- tions in the experimental group compared with the control group \(p= 0\.001\), in line with previous studies on yoga\. Conclusions: Lotus Pedagogy improves school coexistence and is a relevant strategy for peace education and post\-conflict education\.

## [A multivariable investigation of the critical state line in iron mine tailings](../publications/9ce42df1103848a78f8d.md)

Leonardo Alberto do Nascimento; Magnos Baroni; Dêreck Hummel Becher; ‪Fernando Schnaid

The geotechnical behavior of non\-plastic tailings is governed by a unique critical state line \(CSL\) that, unlike those of many natural soils, may exhibit pronounced non linearity associated with state transitions from strain\-softening at low mean effective stresses to strain\-hardening at higher stress levels\. This study investigates the material properties and state variables controlling this behavior, with particular emphasis on their correlation with index properties and their role in defining inflection points associated with transitions from flow instability and liquefaction to stable soil response\. A data driven meta\-analysis is performed using a global database of laboratory test results on iron tailings\. The methodology integrates statistical characterization of physical attributes, followed by exploratory analysis using Spearman correlation matrices to identify the variables governing the shape and position of the CSL\. Results demonstrate that CSL parameters are primarily controlled by minimum and maximum void ratios and specific gravity, while fines content and mineralogy exert secondary influences\. The established correlations enable prediction of the CSL geometry, providing a practical screening framework for preliminary assessment of the geomechanical behavior of iron tailings and their susceptibility to liquefaction\.

## [EL COSTE EMOCIONAL DE LA EMPATÍA EN PROFESIONALES SANITARIOS: UNA REVISIÓN SISTEMÁTICA](../publications/9ce691a358e8f8c95d43.md)

FRANCISCO JESÚS LOBATO CARVAJAL

Los costes emocionales asociados al burnout y la fatiga por compasión constituyen problemas relevantes en profesionales sanitarios expuestos de forma continuada al sufrimiento humano\. Aunque la empatía es una competencia esencial para la calidad asistencial, determinadas formas de implicación empática, especialmente el distrés personal y la empatía afectiva no regulada, pueden relacionarse con agotamiento emocional y estrés traumático secundario\. En este contexto, mindfulness y autocompasión han sido propuestos como factores protectores frente al desgaste profesional\.\\El objetivo de esta revisión sistemática fue analizar la evidencia empírica sobre la relación entre burnout, empatía y fatiga por compasión en profesionales sanitarios, así como el posible papel protector de mindfulness, autocompasión y regulación emocional\. La revisión se desarrolló siguiendo las directrices PRISMA 2020\. La búsqueda bibliográfica se realizó entre febrero y abril de 2026 en PsycINFO, PubMed, Scopus y Web of Science, incluyendo estudios publicados entre 2000 y 2026\.\\Los resultados muestran una asociación consistente entre burnout y deterioro de la empatía profesional, especialmente en dimensiones cognitivas y relacionales\. Asimismo, mindfulness y autocompasión aparecen asociados con menores niveles de agotamiento emocional y mejor regulación afectiva\. Se concluye que la empatía debe entenderse como una competencia compleja cuya función adaptativa depende de la regulación emocional\.

## [Elevated ApoB/ApoA ratio is associated with increased risk of sudden sensorineural hearing loss](../publications/9cff0315c372362a382f.md)

Zhisong Yan; Weilin Chen; Xiaoyang Cao; Xiao Chen

Objective To investigate the association between the apolipoprotein B to apolipoprotein A \(ApoB/ApoA\) ratio and sudden sensorineural hearing loss \(SSNHL\) risk in Nantong, China\. Methods This cross\-sectional study included 1211 participants \(674 with normal hearing, 537 with SSNHL\)\. Baseline demographics, comorbidities, and biochemical indicators were compared\. Multivariable logistic regression evaluated the independent association between the ApoB/ApoA ratio and SSNHL risk\. Inverse probability of treatment weighting \(IPTW\) and propensity score matching \(PSM\) were applied for sensitivity analysis\. Stratified and dose\-response analyses were also conducted\. Results The groups differed significantly in age, sex, hypertension, BMI, and various metabolic markers \(all P &lt; 0\.05\)\. In the fully adjusted model, an elevated ApoB/ApoA ratio was significantly associated with increased SSNHL risk \(OR = 9\.34, 95% CI: 3\.93\-22\.21\)\. This positive association remained robust after PSM \(OR = 8\.79, 95% CI: 3\.26\-23\.66\)\. IPTW analysis showed the high\-ratio group \(0\.78\-1\.34\) had a higher SSNHL risk than the low\-ratio group \(0\.13\-0\.58\) \(OR = 2\.28, 95% CI: 1\.79\-2\.90\)\. Dose\-response analysis indicated a significant linear positive correlation between the ratio and SSNHL prevalence, both before and after PSM\. Stratified analyses demonstrated this association remained consistent across age, sex, hypertension, and diabetes subgroups \(all P for interaction &gt; 0\.05\)\. Conclusion A high ApoB/ApoA ratio has a significant linear positive association with increased SSNHL risk\. It serves as an independent clinical biomarker for SSNHL risk assessment, providing a basis for metabolic management\.

## [Fast construction of partitioned learned Bloom filter with theoretical guarantees](../publications/9d005473f0a65345f85e.md)

Atsuki Sato; Yusuke Matsui

Abstract Bloom filter is a widely used classic data structure for approximate membership queries\. Learned Bloom filters improve memory efficiency by leveraging machine learning, with the partitioned learned Bloom filter \(PLBF\) being among the most memory\-efficient variants\. However, PLBF suffers from high construction cost, with time complexity $$\\mathcal \{O\}\(N^3k\)$$ O \( N 3 k \) , where N and k are hyperparameters\. In this paper, we propose three methods, fast PLBF , fast PLBF\+\+ , and fast PLBF\# , that reduce the construction complexity to $$\\mathcal \{O\}\(N^2k\)$$ O \( N 2 k \) , $$\\mathcal \{O\}\(Nk \\log N\)$$ O \( N k log N \) , and $$\\mathcal \{O\}\(Nk \\log k\)$$ O \( N k log k \) , respectively\. Fast PLBF preserves the original PLBF structure and memory efficiency\. Although fast PLBF\+\+ and fast PLBF\# may have different structures, we theoretically prove they are equivalent to PLBF under ideal data distribution\. Furthermore, for non\-ideal scenarios, we introduce an instance\-specific measure of deviation from the ideal distribution and use it to bound the resulting difference in memory efficiency between PLBF and fast PLBF\+\+\. Experiments on real\-world datasets demonstrate that, under the default setting \( $$N=1000$$ N = 1000 and $$k=5$$ k = 5 \), fast PLBF, fast PLBF\+\+, and fast PLBF\# are up to 58\.7, 74\.5, and 75\.7 times faster to construct than original PLBF, respectively\. In an ablation with larger k , which enables the construction of more accurate PLBFs, the speedups reach 235, 865, and 871 times at $$k=50$$ k = 50 \. Additionally, fast PLBF maintains the same data structure as PLBF, and fast PLBF\+\+ and fast PLBF\# achieve nearly identical memory efficiency\.

## [Når Copilot lager regnearkmodellen: Om modellkvalitet, god regnearkskikk og hva økonomistudenter må kunne](../publications/9d06052ba3d6689004f2.md)

Trond Vegard Johannessen; Anna Mette Fuglseth

Artikkelen bidrar til diskusjonen om hvordan kunstig intelligens \(KI\) påvirker regnearkundervisning i økonomisk\-administrative fag når dialogbaserte KI\-verktøy som Microsoft Copilot integreres i regnearkprogrammer\. Integreringen gir brukere mulighet til å beskrive problemstillinger i naturlig språk og få forslag til ferdige modeller\. Artikkelen presenterer en studie der Copilot utviklet og videreutviklet en regnearkmodell for en budsjetteringsoppgave, vurdert mot prinsipper for modellering i regneark\. Resultatene viser at Copilot raskt leverer modeller som ved første øyekast fremstår ryddige og profesjonelle, men som inneholder en rekke svakheter ved nærmere kontroll\. KI\-verktøy som Copilot reduserer dermed ikke behovet for undervisning i regnearkmodellering\. Undervisningen må imidlertid omfatte spesifikk opplæring i hvordan KI\-verktøy kan benyttes effektivt for utvikling av modeller i økonomisk\-administrative beslutningssituasjoner som krever utforskning av usikkerhet\. ENGLISH ABSTRACT When Copilot Builds the Spreadsheet Model: On Model Quality, Good Spreadsheet Practice, and What Business and Economics Students Need to Know This article contributes to the discussion of how artificial intelligence \(AI\) affects spreadsheet education in business and economics programs, as dialogue\-based AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot are integrated directly into spreadsheet software\. Such integration allows users to describe problems in natural language and receive suggestions for complete models\. The article presents a study in which Copilot developed and further developed a spreadsheet model for a budgeting task, assessed against established principles of spreadsheet modelling\. The results show that Copilot quickly produces models that appear tidy and professional at first glance, but that contain several weaknesses upon closer inspection\. AI tools such as Copilot therefore do not reduce the need for teaching spreadsheet modelling\. Rather, teaching must include specific training in how AI tools can be used effectively to develop models for business and economics decision\-making situations that require exploration of uncertainty\.

## [High\-resolution topology\-preserving instance segmentation network for vision\-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs](../publications/9d1559c612e775695c93.md)

Xinyu Chen; YuChao Chen; Yan Ren; Guangming Lv; Meng Zhang; Wang Yuan

Abstract Accurate counting and morphological analysis of welding electrodes and wire stubs are essential for warehouse data management in welding factories\. However, the visual recognition of welding material stubs in real\-world industrial applications is frequently hindered by issues such as missed detections, false detections, and imprecise boundary localization\. To address these metrological and visual perception challenges, this paper proposes a novel High\-resolution Topology\-Preserving Instance Segmentation Network \(HTP\-Net\)\. The proposed end\-to\-end architecture seamlessly integrates three core designs to realize precise decoupling and robust counting of dense targets\.Specifically, a Wavelet\-Driven Edge\-Preserving \(WEP\) module is designed to retain subtle physical boundaries without loss during feature downsampling\. Concurrently, a Long\-Range Topology Representation Block \(LTR\-Block\) mitigates topological disconnections resulting from extreme target slenderness by global context modeling\. Finally, an Orientation\-Driven Instance Segmentation Head \(ODI\-Seg\) leverages rotational geometric priors to fundamentally resolve excessive NMS and overlapping mask artifacts\. Notably, across both our custom and public datasets of dense slender materials, HTP\-Net achieves substantial performance gains over existing methods, improving mAP 50 scores by at least 1\.2% and up to 55\.3%\. Furthermore, we developed an intelligent counting system for welding materials powered by the proposed model, which has been deployed and validated in a real\-world factory environment\. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the integrated system achieves average recognition accuracies of 99% and 94% for electrode and wire stubs, respectively\.

## [KORXONALAR FAOLIYATIDA MIJOZLARGA XIZMAT KO‘RSATISHDA SUN’IY INTELLEKT \(CHAT\-BOTLAR\)NING IQTISODIY SAMARADORLIGI](../publications/9d1779accb1494cfc200.md)

Ushbu maqolada raqamli iqtisodiyot sharoitida O‘zbekistondagi kichik va o‘rta biznes subyektlari faoliyatida sun’iy intellekt texnologiyalarining, xususan, aqlli muloqot botlarining \(chat\-botlar\) mijozlarga xizmat ko‘rsatishdagi iqtisodiy afzalliklari tahlil qilingan\. Tadqiqotning asosiy maqsadi – kichik va o‘rta biznes korxonalarida an’anaviy inson mehnatiga asoslangan aloqa xizmatlaridan voz kechib, sun’iy intellekt botlarini joriy etishning moliyaviy rentabelligini miqdoriy jihatdan baholashdan iborat\. Mavzuning dolzarbligi shundaki, an’anaviy aloqa markazlari \(operatorlar faoliyati\) hamda raqamli muloqot dasturlarining doimiy va o‘zgaruvchan xarajatlari o‘rtasidagi farq korxonalarda moliyaviy tejamkorlikni ta’minlashda hal qiluvchi ahamiyat kasb etmoqda\. Tadqiqot metodologiyasi doirasida iqtisodiy\-matematik modellashtirish, qiyosiy tahlil va kuzatuv usullaridan foydalanildi\. Taklif etilayotgan yondashuvning ilmiy yangiligi shundan iboratki, sun’iy intellektning bevosita mikrodarajadagi \(bitta mijozga xizmat ko‘rsatish tannarxi\) iqtisodiy samaradorligi raqamlarda ifodalangan\. ## [Explaining cyberbullying and cyber violence in the age of AI using individual and contextual factors in Jordan](../publications/9d22f47f97e4870ea65a.md)

Khaled Saleh Al\-Omoush

As artificial intelligence \(AI\) and digital technologies continue to transform online communication and social interactions, cyberbullying and cyber\-violence have emerged as growing concerns that require a deeper understanding of the individual and contextual factors underlying these behaviors\. This study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing cyberbullying and cyber\-violence in Jordan\. Specifically, it examines the effects of individual characteristics and contextual factors, including the legal and policy environment and aggressive social environment, on both cyberbullying and cyber\-violence\. A total of 472 participants from different demographic groups were included in the study sample\. The data were analyzed using Smart PLS software\. The results indicate that individual factors such as age, gender, and educational level have varying effects on cyberbullying and cyber\-violence\. Both age and gender have a significant negative and positive relationship, respectively, with both cyberbullying and cyber\-violence\. There is no significant relationship between these outcomes and educational level\. Contextual factors, on the other hand, have differential effects\. The aggressive social environment is positively associated with cyberbullying and cyber\-violence, while the legal and policy environment is negatively associated with cyber\-violence but not with cyberbullying\. This study examines both contextual and individual factors, contributing to a better understanding of factors influencing cyberbullying and cyber\-violence\. It provides evidence on the impact of age, gender, social context, and legal and regulatory influences, and offers insights that can guide policy, education, and community engagement and inform best prevention practices\.

## [Comparative analysis of user experience between CMS solutions from the perspective of ai\-supported functionalities: WordPress and Wix](../publications/9d3003a27f2b7e66f2ad.md)

Sonja Vukan Kohek

Izdelava spletnih strani je zaradi razvoja sistemov za upravljanje vsebin in umetne inteligence postala dostopnejša širšemu krogu uporabnikov\. Med najbolj razširjenimi rešitvami za izdelavo spletnih strani sta WordPress\.org in Wix, ki uporabnikom omogočata vzpostavitev spletne prisotnosti brez poglobljenega programerskega znanja\. Kljub podobnemu namenu se platformi razlikujeta po funkcionalnostih, načinu uporabe, stopnji prilagodljivosti in vključevanju umetne inteligence\. V magistrskem delu je predstavljena primerjava platform WordPress\.org in Wix z vidika funkcionalnosti, AI\[A1\.1\] podprtih funkcionalnosti in uporabniške izkušnje\. Obravnavani so razvoj spleta, sistemi za upravljanje vsebin, uporabniška izkušnja ter uporaba umetne inteligence pri izdelavi spletnih strani\. Posebna pozornost je namenjena značilnostim obeh platform in možnostim uporabe pri izdelavi spletnih mest\. Ugotovitve raziskave kažejo, da WordPress\.org uporabnikom omogoča visoko stopnjo prilagodljivosti in razširljivosti ter predstavlja primerno rešitev za zahtevnejše projekte\. Wix se je izkazal kot uporabniku prijaznejša platforma, ki omogoča hitrejšo izdelavo spletnih strani, enostavnejšo uporabo in višjo stopnjo integriranosti umetne inteligence\. Pomembne razlike med platformama so bile ugotovljene na področju uporabniške izkušnje, kjer Wix omogoča bolj intuitivno uporabo predvsem uporabnikom brez naprednega tehničnega znanja\. Primerjava je pokazala, da izbira ustrezne platforme ni odvisna zgolj od funkcionalnosti sistema, temveč tudi od uporabniške izkušnje, potreb uporabnika in stopnje tehničnega znanja\. Medtem ko WordPress\.org predstavlja primerno izbiro za uporabnike, ki potrebujejo večjo stopnjo nadzora in prilagodljivosti, je Wix primernejši za uporabnike, ki želijo spletno stran izdelati hitro, enostavno in ob podpori integriranih AI podprte funkcionalnosti\.

## [КЛЮЧОВІ НАПРЯМИ РОЗВИТКУ СУЧАСНОЇ ФІЛОСОФІЇ ШТУЧНОГО ІНТЕЛЕКТУ \(ШІ\): АНТРОПОЦЕНТРИЗМ, ТРАНСГУМАНІЗМ, ПОСТГУМАНІЗМ, ЕКО\-ГУМАНІЗМ](../publications/9d3f22bae47c43324e58.md)

Valentyna Hryhorivna Voronkova; Віталіна Нікітенко; Olga Kyvliuk

У контексті радикальної трансформації сучасної соціокультурної реальності, позначеної стрімким проникненням штучного інтелекту в усі сфери людського буття, дедалі більшої актуальності набуває переосмислення фундаментальних засад взаємодії людини, технології, суспільства та природи\. В умовах цифрового суспільства штучний інтелект постає не лише технологічною інновацією, а й своєрідним маркером цивілізаційного зсуву\. У дослідженні засвідчено, що філософія ШІ вже не обмежується питанням «чи може машина мислити?», а переходить до ширших питань: якою стає людина в умовах ШІ, якими мають бути межі технологічного втручання, хто несе відповідальність за алгоритмічні рішення та як зберегти гуманістичні цінності в цифровій цивілізації\. Метою статті є здійснення системного соціально\-філософського аналізу ключових напрямів розвитку сучасної філософії штучного інтелекту – антропоцентризму, трансгуманізму, постгуманізму та еко\-гуманізму з визначенням їхніх світоглядних засад, концептуальних відмінностей, точок взаємодії та потенціалу для формування нової моделі взаємодії «людина – штучний інтелект – суспільство – природа»\. Для даної теми використовуються ідеї Ліотара – метанаративи; Дерріда – деконструкція; Фуко – дискурс/влада/суб’єкт; Дельоза і Ґваттарі – ризома; Бодріяра симулякр/гіперреальність; Гаравей – кіборгізація; Гейлза постлюдське; Брайдотті – критичний постгуманізм; Флоріді – цифрова етика та філософія ШІ\. Результати досліджень\. В результаті проведеного дослідження виявлено, що недостатньо досліджено синтетичну модель, яка інтегрує антропоцентризм, трансгуманізм, постгуманізм та еко\-гуманізм у єдиній філософії ШІ\. Розкрито поняттєво\-категоріадьний апарат ключових напрямів розвитку сучасної філософії штучного інтелекту, проаналізовано ключові концептуальні напрями та досліджено постгуманістичну перспективу філософії ШІ\. У цьому сенсі антропоцентризм, трансгуманізм, постгуманізм та еко\-гуманізм розглядаються як своєрідні «вузли» єдиного дискурсивного поля, у якому відбувається переосмислення майбутнього людини та цивілізації\. Зроблено висновок, що у контексті постмодерної філософської рефлексії штучний інтелект виступає своєрідним «онтологічним каталізатором», який вимагає перегляд усталених уявлень про суб’єктність, інтелект, свободу, ідентичність, природу, технологію, людського буття\.

## [Inteligencia artificial, planificación docente y Diseño Universal para el Aprendizaje: revisión sistemática de la literatura en el contexto educativo ecuatoriano](../publications/9d4827e91d76323fa929.md)

Cristina Marisol Cún\-Sánchez; Ladys Marian Farias\-Carranza; Andrea Zanini Gualacata\-Gómez; Graciela Castillo

La incorporación de inteligencia artificial \(IA\) en la educación plantea nuevas posibilidades para la planificación docente y el desarrollo de prácticas pedagógicas inclusivas\. El objetivo de esta investigación fue analizar la evidencia científica sobre inteligencia artificial, planificación docente y Diseño Universal para el Aprendizaje \(DUA\) en el contexto educativo ecuatoriano, identificando sus aportes, limitaciones y oportunidades de articulación\. Se desarrolló una revisión sistemática de la literatura con síntesis cualitativa, tomando como referencia las directrices PRISMA 2020\. La matriz documental registró 34 referencias, de las cuales se identificó un duplicado; posteriormente, tres estudios conformaron el corpus final de análisis\. Los resultados evidenciaron aplicaciones de IA como herramienta de apoyo a la planificación docente y antecedentes sobre su vinculación con estrategias educativas inclusivas fundamentadas en el DUA\. Sin embargo, los estudios seleccionados abordaron estas dimensiones de manera complementaria, sin evaluar específicamente la integración simultánea de IA, planificación docente y los tres principios del DUA\. Se concluye que la inteligencia artificial presenta oportunidades para apoyar procesos de planificación más flexibles e inclusivos, aunque su incorporación requiere mediación pedagógica, formación docente y evaluación crítica\. Se recomienda ampliar la investigación empírica sobre su integración con el DUA en instituciones educativas ecuatorianas\.

## [When the Night Stops Cooling: Modeling Extreme Warm Nights Across California Weather Stations](../publications/9d745c65c53b951819c1.md)

Rohit Krishnan

This paper investigates which factors influence extreme warm nights across California using NOAA GHCN\-Daily station observations\. We defined extreme warm nights using station\-specific 95th percentile summer TMIN thresholds based on a historical baseline period\. For each station\-year, the percentage of valid summer nights classified as extreme warm nights was calculated\. A random forest regression model was then used to explore the effect of year, latitude, longitude, elevation, and distance to coast on extreme warm\-night frequency\. Partial dependence plots and permutation feature importance results suggest that year has a disproportionately large influence on nighttime heat across California, and that it positively influences the percent of extreme warm nights a station experiences\. The next most important variable was distance to the coast, which also had a positive influence on the percent of extreme warm nights\. These results showcase how both temporal changes and geographic characteristics may play an important role in explaining differences in extreme nighttime heat across California\. In terms of predictive power, the random forest regressor resulted in an R2 value of 0\.410, an MAE of 2\.513, and an RMSE of 3\.765 when used to predict on stations within a withheld test set and considerably outperformed a naive baseline\. This performance showcases how the selected geographic and temporal variables provide meaningful predictive information\. Overall, these findings suggest that station geography and climate context may help identify areas where nighttime heat is more common or changing, while also providing a foundation for further investigation into the environmental factors contributing to extreme warm\-night events across California\.

## [Industry 4\.0 Practices in the Amazon Region: An Operations Management Perspective](../publications/9d763387dae7273e19d0.md)

Lindara Hage Anunciação Dessimoni; Nicole Sales Libório; Moisés Andrade Coelho

This study aims to understand practices related to Industry 4\.0 in the manufacturing industries in the Amazon region\. The research employed a multiple\-case study as an epistemological approach, utilizing a protocol designed to understand Industry 4\.0 practices and support organizations in their pursuit of new productive and technological trajectories\. The protocol made it possible to understand the current state of the companies concerning the subject, supporting the development of research in the Amazonian context\. Results indicate that the production system adopted by an organization can directly influence the level of I4\.0 maturity in the company\. This research offers relevant contributions for academics and professionals involved in eco\-innovation and sustainable business practices\. The findings may have broad sociological and organizational behavior implications for individuals, concerning both the advantages \(e\.g\., training, higher wages\) and disadvantages \(e\.g\., layoffs, unemployment\) of Industry 4\.0 adoption, as well as the evolving human\-machine relationship in the context of job displacement or precarity\. As for the social implication, the application protocol, especially the open structured interviews, provided an interpretation of the I4\.0 phenomenon based on people&\#x27;s perceptions\. This article contributes to the literature by providing an understanding of Industry 4\.0 from an operations management perspective within the Amazon region\.

## [Analisis Semiotika Roland Barthes terhadap Makna Kritik Politik dalam Lirik Lagu “Surat Buat Wakil Rakyat” Karya Iwan Fals](../publications/9d7c10d0321cb2fdb2a7.md)

Lutfia Okta Riwayati; Anantha Anggryani Sitio; Dian Nastiti

This study aims to unpack the process of denotative and connotative signification and to reveal the political myth constructed and deconstructed in the lyrics of the song “Surat Buat Wakil Rakyat” \(“A Letter to the People’s Representatives”\) by Iwan Fals, released in 1987\. This research employs a qualitative method with a descriptive\-interpretive approach grounded in a critical paradigm, applying the semiotic framework of the two orders of signification and Roland Barthes’s theory of myth as formulated in Mythologies\. The primary data, in the form of the song lyric text, were analysed through a Barthesian matrix of meaning that maps sign units into the levels of denotation, connotation, and myth, with secondary data consisting of historical\-political literature on the New Order regime serving as contextual triangulation\. The findings show that at the denotative level, diction such as “kekenyangan” \(being overstuffed/gorged\) and “tidur waktu sidang” \(sleeping during sessions\) merely records literal activities; however, at the connotative level, these expand into criticism of elite greed, the alienation of people’s representatives from their constituents, and the commodification of politics\. At the mythical level, the lyrics function as a counter\-hegemonic instrument that deconstructs the state’s official myth of the nobility and sanctity of the House of Representatives \(DPR\) as an institution, exposing the reality of parliament as a mere “rubber\-stamp” body that has lost its function of checks and balances\. This study concludes that popular music serves as a crucial alternative public sphere for articulating political resistance amid authoritarian repression\.

## [From Natural Language Intent to Executable Control: Hierarchical Feedback\-Guided LLM Planning for Multi\-component Cyber\-Physical Systems](../publications/9d8ddb18158f5fbf3e71.md)

Jinglin Dai; Jiawan Wang; Ruiqi Hong; Lei Bu

Large language models \(LLMs\) provide a convenient interface for translating natural language commands into task plans for cyber\-physical systems \(CPSs\)\. However, two gaps hinder their use for real execution: generated plans may misinterpret or omit the user&\#x27;s intent, and even a logically plausible plan may be infeasible under component dynamics, interactions, or safety constraints\. Existing LLM\-based planning approaches often lack informative feedback on why a generated plan fails, providing little guidance for revising the plan accordingly\. To address these challenges, we present a hierarchical feedback framework that uses different types of feedback information to guide LLMs in generating executable plans for CPSs\. We prompt LLMs to generate both a structured task plan and corresponding signal temporal logic \(STL\) constraints, and design a sound algorithm that identifies definite contradictions between them and provides feedback for revising inconsistencies\. At the execution level, when control synthesis fails, we extract different types of diagnostic information, such as violated constraints and conflicting component assignments, and feed them back to guide task replanning\. Experiments on seven heterogeneous multi\-component CPS scenarios have shown that our framework can generate executable plans and feasible control executions that satisfy the original natural language missions with a success rate of 87\.9% with GPT\-5\.

## [Truth in Contrast: Calibrated Factual Evidence from Language Model Likelihoods](../publications/9da1328bf47c21e1fb17.md)

Ponhvoan Srey; Jason Lucas; Pittawat Taveekitworachai; Junyoung Lee; Anh Tuan Luu

Large Language Models \(LLMs\) encode substantial factual knowledge\. Yet, estimating confidence in factual claims reliably remains challenging\. We study likelihood\-based factual confidence from the complementary perspectives of discrimination and calibration across multilingual factual statements\. Specifically, we instantiate contrastive generative likelihoods as Contrastive Factual Evidence \(CFE\), which compares the likelihood of the same claim under competing factual and non\-factual conditions, and derive its probabilistic counterpart, the Contrastive Factual Posterior \(CFP\)\. We show analytically that CFP calibration depends on the differential error between the two surrogate conditionals, allowing errors shared across them to cancel and yield tighter calibration bounds\. Empirically, CFP substantially improves calibration while maintaining factual discrimination comparable to its strongest competitor\. Nonetheless, discrimination is uniformly weak across methods in lower\-resource languages, which simultaneously undermines the utility of the measured calibration\. To this end, we interpret a likelihood geometry, within which an evidence\-bearing direction is induced, along with an orthogonal evidence\-invariant direction\. In our investigation, we selectively align target\-language claims with stronger English evidence only along the factual\-evidence direction, improving discrimination and open\-ended factual generation without target\-language labels\.

## [Fahr&\#x27;s syndrome secondary to chronic hypoparathyroidism in a patient residing at high altitude](../publications/9da589d139e24e3ea51e.md)

Caleb Tenorio Meza; Weymar Lehi Poma Luna; Mauricio Paz del Rio; Romer Burgoa Pairumani; Josué López Chuquimia; Freddy Ednildon Bautista\-Vanegas; Jaykel Evelio Gómez\-Triana; María Esther Betanco\-Vásquez

Introduction: Fahr&\#x27;s syndrome refers to secondary forms of bilateral, symmetrical cerebral calcification, with hypoparathyroidism being the most common endocrine cause\. Unlike primary familial cerebral calcification, the underlying disorder is correctable, giving the etiological diagnosis direct therapeutic significance\. Case report: A 61\-year\-old patient with a history of partial thyroidectomy and hypoparathyroidism \(present for 25 years but managed without specialized follow\-up\) and a prior diagnosis of generalized epilepsy, chronic cor pulmonale, and recent pulmonary thromboembolism\. The patient was admitted due to an acute exacerbation of chronic respiratory failure, presenting with a positive Trousseau sign, a QT interval of 609 ms, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis\. PTH levels were &lt; 3 pg/mL, and ionized calcium dropped to 0\.54 mmol/L\. A cranial CT scan revealed bilateral, symmetrical calcifications in the basal ganglia, dentate nuclei, frontoparietal white matter, and cerebellar hemispheres\. Intravenous and oral calcium and magnesium replacement, combined with calcitriol and levothyroxine dosage adjustment, resolved the tetany and allowed for hospital discharge\. Conclusions: Fahr&\#x27;s syndrome should be suspected in patients with long\-standing hypoparathyroidism who present with neurological manifestations; a non\-contrast CT scan is sufficient to document the condition\. In the event of seizures in this context, hypocalcemia must be ruled out before maintaining a diagnosis of epilepsy\. Direct measurement of ionized calcium, monitoring of phosphorus and magnesium levels, spacing out calcium and levothyroxine intake, and interpreting blood gas analysis with altitude adjustment are specific measures that alter clinical management\.

## [Factores de riesgo y protección asociados a demencias corticales: una revisión de alcance](../publications/9db3f68bd58065cd7589.md)

Rafael Bengoa; Carlos Teódulo Siccha Paredes

El envejecimiento poblacional y el incremento de las demencias generan una carga creciente para los sistemas de salud, las familias y los cuidadores\. El objetivo de esta revisión fue identificar los factores de riesgo y de protección asociados a las demencias corticales en adultos mayores\. Se realizó una revisión de alcance de estudios publicados entre 2021 y 2025, siguiendo PRISMA\-ScR y el marco metodológico de Arksey y O’Malley adaptado por el Joanna Briggs Institute\. Se buscaron estudios en PubMed, Scopus y Web of Science\. De 1415 registros identificados, 13 estudios cumplieron los criterios de elegibilidad\. Los factores de riesgo modificables más consistentes se agruparon en componentes cardiometabólicos, psicosociales y de estilo de vida; destacaron hipertensión arterial, diabetes mellitus, enfermedad cerebrovascular, obesidad, tabaquismo, sedentarismo, depresión, aislamiento social y baja escolaridad\. Los factores protectores se concentraron en educación y estimulación cognitiva, actividad física, participación social, bienestar psicológico y control de comorbilidades\. La evidencia mostró heterogeneidad según edad, contexto socioeconómico y características poblacionales, además de una marcada concentración de estudios en países de altos ingresos\. Se concluye que las demencias corticales responden a un entramado multifactorial y que su prevención requiere intervenciones integrales sobre salud cardiovascular, estilos de vida, reserva cognitiva y determinantes psicosociales\. Persisten vacíos importantes de evidencia en América Latina\.

## [A hybrid DistilBERT–LLaMA\-2–BiLSTM model for depression detection from social media texts](../publications/9dbbaea3ebc920bc730a.md)

Meryem Amri; Hanae El Fahfouhi; Khalid Haddouch
