## [Fundamental Rights in the Digital Era: Reinterpreting Liberty, Privacy and Dignity](../publications/a3c8b5adf79568e80748.md)

Disha Bangarva

The rapid expansion of digital technologies has fundamentally altered the manner in which individuals communicate, access information, participate in public life, conduct economic activities, and exercise personal autonomy\. The transition from an analogue to a digitally mediated society has consequently transformed the environment in which fundamental rights operate\. In India, constitutional guarantees contained in Part III of the Constitution were originally formulated in an era preceding the internet, social media, artificial intelligence, biometric identification, algorithmic decision\-making and large\-scale data processing\. Nevertheless, the constitutional framework has demonstrated considerable capacity to respond to technological change through judicial interpretation, particularly by expanding the meaning of liberty, privacy and dignity under Article 21 of Constitution of India\. The Apex Court of India has played an important role in this constitutional transformation\. Land mark judgments such as Maneka Gandhi v\. Union of India, Justice K\.S\. Puttaswamy \(Retd\.\) v\. Union of India, Shreya Singhal v\. Union of India, Anuradha Bhasin v\. Union of India and K\.S\. Puttaswamy \(Aadhaar\) v\. Union of India have contributed to the development of a fundamental rights\-based understanding of digital governance and technological freedom\. At the same time, the emergence of artificial intelligence, facial recognition, pervasive surveillance, data profiling, deepfakes, online harassment, misinformation and platform\-based censorship presents challenges that cannot always be addressed through traditional interpretations of constitutional rights\. This paper examines how fundamental rights and human rights must be understood in the digital era, with particular emphasis on Articles 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India\. As these three articles are golden triangle, stated under Maneka Gandhi v\. Union of India case\. It argues that digital constitutionalism requires the protection of not merely physical freedom but also informational autonomy, decisional freedom, digital expression, anonymity, personal identity and human dignity\. The paper further examines the relationship between privacy and national security, freedom of speech and online regulation, and technological innovation and constitutional accountability\. It concludes that technological advancement must remain compatible with constitutional morality, proportionality, transparency, accountability and the dignity of the individual\.

## [THE EL\-RAKHAWI COMPREHENSIVE BIOLOGICAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FRAMEWORK: UNIFIED MULTI\-OMIC FOUNDATION MODELS FOR CAUSAL DISEASE MODELING AND PERSONALIZED THERAPEUTIC DISCOVERY](../publications/a3cb3cfcfb0fb245b53e.md)

mohamed kamal arafa el\-rakhawi

The El\-Rakhawi Comprehensive Biological AI \(ECB\-AI\) Framework revolutionizes medical research by transcending fragmented, correlational models\. It introduces a Unified Multi\-Omic Foundation Model mapping genomics, proteomics, and clinical data into a topologically protected Riemannian manifold\. Its core innovation, the Causal Biological Dynamics Engine, utilizes Neural ODEs to model disease as continuous trajectories, enabling accurate counterfactual therapeutic simulations\. Coupled with an In\-Silico Personalized Therapeutic Optimizer, it evaluates treatments on patient\-specific digital twins to steer disease states toward health\. To overcome data silos, it employs Privacy\-Preserving Federated Biological Learning with homomorphic encryption, ensuring global collaboration without compromising patient privacy\. Performance is quantified by the El\-Rakhawi Biological Predictive Fidelity Metric \(EBPFM\), yielding bits per Joule to link causal predictive power directly to thermodynamic efficiency\. ECB\-AI accelerates personalized drug discovery for intractable diseases while upholding strict ethical and privacy standards\.

## [Diagnostic capabilities and monitoring the effectiveness of osteoporosis therapy using radiofrequency echographic multispectrometry in comparison with dual\-energy x\-ray absorptiometry](../publications/a3cd7fd7ba89efb65ccf.md)

Natalia Victorovna Sharashkina; Dmitrii Vladimirovich Rodionov; Н\. К\. Рунихина; Olga Nicolaevna Tkacheva

Purpose This study assessed the potential of the radiofrequency echographic multispectrometry \(REMS\) for diagnosing and monitoring of osteoporosis over a 12\-month period in comparison to the most commonly used diagnostic standard – dual\-energy x\-ray absorptiometry \(DXA\) in the Russian population\. Materials and methods 25 women aged from 49 to 88 years were observed with both imaging methods\. Outcomes included lumbar spine and femoral neck bone mineral density \(BMD\) for each method during two visits\. Results REMS showed moderate diagnostic performance in the present sample\. The diagnostic agreement for osteoporosis between DXA and REMS for the two sites was 64% \(k = 0\.28\)\. Sensitivity and specificity of REMS were 0\.63 \(0\.33 \- 0\.94 in 0\.95 CI\) and 0\.64 \(0\.3895 \- 0\.8894 in 0\.95 CI\) respectively\. However, the comparability of BMD data varied depending on the bone region\. Correlation of T\-scores for two bone regions between REMS and DXA based on the first visit were 0\.65 \(P&lt;0\.001\) and 0\.35 \(P = 0\.089\) for lumbar spine and femoral neck respectively\. Moreover, Bland–Altman analysis showed poor agreement, with wide agreement limits\. Also, collected data revealed a weak correlation for measurements of the second visit within the study, which became statistically insignificant after initiation of antiresorptive therapy\. Correlations were 0\.47 \(P = 0\.022\) and 0\.22 \(P = 0\.307\) for the same two bone regions\. Conclusion REMS demonstrated statistically significant diagnostic value in the diagnosis of osteoporosis, but the comparability and agreement of BMD data with DXA in the sample was near low and varied widely depending on the assessed bone region and decreased even more during active antiresorptive therapy, which may be due to both the limitations of this study and the characteristics of the method\. The present results are not sufficiently precise or statistically robust to validate the method for BMD monitoring unequivocally in Russia, but they provide a basis for further research\. A follow\-up study in a larger sample is required and is already underway to better substantiate these findings in the Russian population\.

## [Factores de riesgo asociados al desarrollo de Alzheimer: revisión de la literatura](../publications/a3d15071c07547a0c902.md)

Jazmín Beatriz Salinas Luna; Francisco Vázquez Nava

Background: Alzheimer’s disease \(AD\) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects memory, thinking, and behavior, and is the most common form of dementia\. The majority of cases occur sporadically \(95–99%\), while only 1–5% are hereditary\. The main pathological processes begin decades before they can be clinically detected\. Therefore, interventions targeting risk factors could help prevent or delay the onset of Alzheimer’s disease\. Objective: To identify risk factors associated with the development of Alzheimer’s disease\. Methods: A literature search was conducted using scientific databases including PubMed, WHOSIS, Medline, Scielo, Science Direct, and Google Scholar\. Risk factors were selected based on evidence of their association with increased cognitive decline and dementia risk, or with a reduction in contributing factors for the disease, emphasizing a clinical\-preventive approach\. Results: A total of six randomized clinical trials were included in the review\. These were selected from an initial pool of 712 articles, prioritizing those most relevant to the study’s objective\. Conclusion: Alzheimer’s disease is not solely a neurological phenomenon isolated from other systemic alterations\. This broader perspective allows for a more comprehensive roadmap to prevention, suggesting that timely and sustained interventions may delay, or even reduce, the incidence of AD in the general population\.

## [Cloud Computing in Education: Role of Cloud Computing in Modern Education And E\-Learning](../publications/a3e21ff7126369095946.md)

Sudesh Nagu Kadam

Educational systems throughout the world are experiencing a complete digital transformation which requires schools to abandon traditional teaching methods and adopt digital learning environments that use advanced technology\. Cloud computing serves as the main technology which enables this fundamental transformation because it provides users with instant access to expandable computing power through internet\-based systems without requiring them to install extensive local systems\. The education system underwent a major transformation through the implementation of cloud\-based technologies which provided new methods for teaching and learning\. Educational institutions and their staff members together with students, use cloud\-based platforms to conduct online learning activities and to handle their administrative work while they work together in real time\. The research paper presents a complete examination of how cloud computing functions in modern education through e\-learning delivery by using a descriptive qualitative research method\. The research analyzes data that researchers collected from peer\-reviewed journals and government reports and conference papers and institutional white papers which cover the time period from 2010 until 2025\. The research study uses academic databases which include IEEE Xplore and ScienceDirect and Google Scholar to obtain key data sources while also using institutional reports from UNESCO and the World Bank as data sources\. The research study uses content analysis to extract fundamental themes which include operational cost\-effectiveness and data security and then combines them into a unified system that shows how cloud technology determines both contemporary educational results and institutional procedures\.The research study shows that cloud computing offers multiple significant advantages to educational systems\. The system simplifies access to educational materials through Google Workspace for Education Microsoft 365 Education and Zoom because it eliminates past geographic and infrastructure challenges which restricted student and teacher access to educational materials\. The system delivers high cost savings through its pay\-as\-you\-go pricing structure which enables educational institutions to avoid making expensive upfront expenditures required for establishing their own IT systems\. Students can work together on documents while taking part in virtual classrooms because cloud platforms enable them to stay connected with their classmates\. The system provides essential network expansion capabilities which help educational institutions protect their networks from crashing during periods of high student usage that occur during admission times and final examination periods\. Educational institutions can use cloud computing to deploy various educational applications through two delivery methods known as Infrastructure as a Service \(IaaS\) and Software as a Service \(SaaS\)\. The applications include Learning Management Systems \(LMS\) which use MoodleCloud and Blackboard as well as live virtual classrooms and digital libraries that users can search and Massive Open Online Courses \(MOOCs\) which include Coursera and edX and advanced analytics and artificial intelligence tools that track learner behavior to create customized learning experiences\.The educational sector faces substantial difficulties which prevent it from achieving the complete advantages which cloud computing technology brings to educational institutions\. The primary concern centers around protecting data through implementing security measures and maintaining user privacy throughout the process\. Cloud systems require advanced technological protection measures to safeguard highly sensitive student information and research materials because they store student grades and personal data\. Online learning through cloud platforms requires constant internet access which becomes a major obstacle for students living in rural areas or developing countries with limited internet access\. Cloud services create problems for institutions because they become locked into particular vendors which leads to expensive and challenging vendor transitions due to the need for both system compatibility and institutional software compatibility with existing cloud system standards\.The research demonstrates that cloud computing functions as a both technology and teaching method which transforms conventional classroom instruction into interactive learning experiences\. Cloud technology delivers personalized educational content which matches an individual student’s learning pace while creating equal access opportunities for both students with disabilities and students who learn from distant locations\. Cloud computing serves as the essential technological foundation for contemporary education because it functions as an operational IT system which drives future educational approaches and lifelong learning processes in educational institutions\. The research study determines that educational institutions need to resolve their data privacy issues and internet connectivity problems and technical expertise gaps before they can fully exploit cloud technology benefits which will lead to the formation of hybrid cloud systems that integrate physical and digital educational spaces\.

## [Rethinking User Encoders: Routing Diffusion States for Scenario\-Adaptive User Representation](../publications/a3e3b018a0284e21bc1c.md)

Junru Zhang; Jinyong Wen; Bin Dou; Wuliang Huang; Baokun Wang; Yu Cheng; Weiqiang Wang; Cheng Peng

Existing large language model \(LLM\)\-based user encoders serialize heterogeneous behavioral logs and compress them into static representations through autoregressive \(AR\) prediction\. However, their unidirectional constraint limits bidirectional information flow, hindering cross\-modal interactions and the joint preservation of multi\-source signals\. Consequently, the learned static representations struggle to accommodate the distinct evidence requirements of diverse downstream scenarios\. We address these limitations by unlocking the iterative denoising process of diffusion language models \(dLLMs\) as a multi\-granularity reconstruction space\. Based on this insight, we propose FINDERS \(FactorIzatioN of Diffusion statEs for Routing across Scenarios\), a router\-equipped dLLM framework comprising four operations: denoise, factorize, route, and compress\. Learnable meta\-slots organize complementary denoising states into transferable cross\-modal semantics and modality\-specific behavioral factors\. To provide grounded supervision, we construct BehaviorQA, a large\-scale corpus containing explicit behavioral rationales\. Guided by scenario queries, a lightweight router dynamically emphasizes relevant slot directions via an input\-level residual pathway before cross\-source fusion and final compression\. Extensive experiments and online A/B tests across ten industrial scenarios demonstrate that FINDERS consistently outperforms state\-of\-the\-art methods in both unified and scenario\-adaptive settings\. This work effectively pushes the boundaries of dLLMs beyond language generation, demonstrating their immense potential as powerful user representation learners\.

## [ENHANCING FISCAL EFFICIENCY THROUGH PUBLIC PROCUREMENT IN UZBEKISTAN: COMPETITION, PRICE BENCHMARKING, AND DIGITAL FINANCIAL CONTROL](../publications/a3f9fbfb755babc88751.md)

Nizom Baramovich Majidov

Public procurement is a key mechanism through which public financial resources are converted into goods, works, and services\. Its efficiency directly influences budget expenditure, fiscal discipline, and the quality of public financial management\. This study examines Uzbekistan&\#x27;s public procurement system from the perspective of fiscal efficiency, with particular emphasis on competition, market\-based price formation, digitalization, and risk\-based financial control\. The analysis draws on national legislation and official information available as of March 2026, supplemented by international empirical research on public procurement\. Particular attention is given to the transition from conventional electronic procurement systems to market\-price benchmarking and data\-driven financial control mechanisms\. The findings indicate that Uzbekistan&\#x27;s regulatory framework increasingly integrates procurement procedures with competitive practices, budgetary savings, supplier participation, and price monitoring\. The introduction of an artificial intelligence \(AI\)\-based average market\-price determination mechanism represents an important transition from evaluating procurement savings against administratively established starting prices to assessing procurement prices using market\-based information\. The study concludes that the fiscal effectiveness of this mechanism will depend on the reliability of pricing data, the development of effective competition, and the integration of procurement processes with public financial control systems\.

## [Digital preservation and automated roof damage detection for traditional village heritage in Guangdong using UAV photogrammetry and deep learning](../publications/a40b4f0650ae584922eb.md)

ZHU Zhengyang; Chun\-Ming Hsieh; Xiaodong Liu; LI Xiangsi; Zhengnan Zhong; Ziyuan Chen

Abstract Traditional village cultural heritage \(CH\) in remote areas often lacks public attention and adequate maintenance\. The complex spatial layouts and dense clusters of traditional buildings make manual damage inspection inefficient, delaying repairs and accelerating the loss of rural settlements\. Statistics indicate that approximately two million villages disappeared in China between 1985 and 2025, with numerous rural CH sites worldwide facing similar challenges\. Therefore, an efficient method for digital documentation and damage detection is urgently needed\. Taking five traditional villages in Guangdong Province as case studies, this paper proposes a workflow integrating UAV photogrammetry and deep learning \(DL\)\. A total of 12762 visible\-light images were acquired to construct high\-precision spatial digital archives\. Trained on a dataset of 41213 annotated instances, the YOLOv8\-based model achieved an overall mean average precision \(mAP50\) of 0\.832\. Validation on ultra\-high\-resolution digital orthophoto maps \(DOMs\) and aerial videos demonstrated an average inference time of 5\.77 ms/frame\.

## [مستوى الوعي بأخلاقيات العمل الارشادي في توظيف برامج الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإرشاد النفسي لدى المرشدين](../publications/a40be8ca6b351fb286cf.md)

عرين محمد غزيوات الخوالدة

هدفت هذه الدراسة إلى معرفة مستوى الوعي بأخلاقيات العمل الإرشادي في توظيف برامج الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإرشاد النفسي لدى المرشدين العاملين في وزارة التربية والتعليم وذلك وفقا \(الجنس والخبرة والمستوى التعليمي ونوع المدرسة\) وقد استخدمت الدراسة الحالية المنهج الوصفي التحليلي، ووظفت الدراسة الحالية الاستبانة الإلكترونية ، وقد اشتملت عينة أفراد الدراسة على المرشدين التربويين العاملين في المدارس الحكومية والخاصة التابعة لمديريات التربية والتعليم والبالغ عددهم الكلي \(166\) مرشدًا ومرشدة، وتم تطوير اداه الدراسة لتشمل ثلاثة ابعاد رئيسية \(بعد الوعي بتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي وبعد الوعي بالقضايا القانونية والخصوصية وبعد الوعي بالمساءلة والقيود المهنية\)\. واظهرت نتائج الدراسة ان مستوى وعي المرشدين بتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي جاءت مرتفعة، وان مستوى وعي المرشدين بالقضايا القانونية والخصوصية جاء بدرجة متوسطة وفي بعد بالمساءلة والقيود المهنية جاءت مرتفعة، واظهرت النتائج بمستوى الوعي بأخلاقيات العمل الإرشادي في توظيف برامج الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإرشاد النفسي لدى المرشدين حسب متغير الجنس لصالح الاناث مقارنه بالذكور، وحسب متغير الدرجة العلمية لصالح المرشدين الذين يحملون الدرجات العلمية العليا ولصالح المرشدين الذين تزيد عدد سنوات الخبرة لديهم عن 15 سنه اما فيما يخص متغير نوع المدرسة فجاءت النتائج لصالح المدارس الخاصة\.

## [Morphological Typology and Qualitative Anatomical Variants of the Adult Human Hyoid Bone: Forensic and Clinical Implications](../publications/a419ce6f8da2c8c12f13.md)

Priti Singh; Arun Kumar; Sachin Sachin; Luv Sharma; Aarti Aarti

Background: The human hyoid bone demonstrates substantial macroscopic structural polymorphism\. Although classically described as a uniform U\-shaped structure, its morphological configurations vary considerably across populations\. Recognizing these qualitative anatomical variants is essential for forensic identification, medicolegal trauma interpretation, and surgical planning in head and neck procedures\. Aims &amp; Objectives: To evaluate the distribution and frequency of morphological shape typologies of the adult human hyoid bone, determine their correlation with biological sex and regional demography, and analyze qualitative anatomical variations\. Material &amp; Methods: A prospective post\-mortem anatomical investigation was carried out on 100 excised, cleaned, and dried adult human hyoid bones \(60 males, 40 females; age range: 40–83 years\)\. Specimens were systematically classified into distinct qualitative morphological variants: V\-shaped, U\-shaped, D\-shaped, Boat/B\-shaped, and Horseshoe \(HK\)\-shaped\. Associations between morphological typologies, biological sex, and residential background were evaluated using Pearson’s Chi\-square tests \(𝜒2\) and Fisher’s exact tests \(𝑝 &lt; 0\.05\)\. Results: V\-shaped \(42\.0%\) and U\-shaped \(42\.0%\) geometries predominated, accounting for 84\.0% of the entire sample, followed by D\-shaped \(7\.0%\), Boat/B\-shaped \(4\.0%\), Horseshoe \(HK\)\-shaped \(4\.0%\), and a rare atypical Htype variant \(1\.0%\)\. A highly significant association was identified between hyoid shape typology and biological sex \(𝜒2 = 38\.641,𝑝 &lt; 0\.001\)\. V\-shaped morphology predominated heavily in males \(66\.7% vs\. 5\.0% in females\), whereas U\-shaped morphology predominated in females \(67\.5% vs\. 25\.0% in males\)\. Rural and urban residential backgrounds showed no statistically significant divergence in shape distribution \(𝜒2 = 5\.24,𝑝 = 0\.387\)\. Conclusion: Qualitative macroscopic typology of the hyoid bone exhibits marked sexual dimorphism\. Morphological classification provides a rapid, accessible adjunct for forensic sex screening and offers critical anatomical awareness for head and neck surgeons\.

## [Digital Transformation and Critical Pedagogy: Reimagining Leadership Curriculum inBusiness Schools](../publications/a41bf91cc03f6d876cf2.md)

Dai Yan

The digital transformation of business organizational operational models has radically transformed how we do business as well as posing new demands on leadership curriculum reform in business schools\. Based on theoretical framework of critical pedagogy, this paper explores reconstruction of leadership curriculum in business schools under context of digital transformation, and analyzes key challenges faced by leadership education, including curriculum objectives, teacher\-student relationships, knowledge production and value orientation\. In addition, this paper proposes optimization strategies from perspectives of curriculum objective design, digitally mediated teaching relationships, integration of reflective practice and experiential learning, and curriculum evaluation system, which aims to promote deep integration of digital technology empowerment and value education, thereby cultivating future business leaders with digital literacy, critical thinking and strong sense of social responsibility, while also providing theoretical insights for innovation of leadership education in business schools\.

## [Dynamic evaluation of professional drivers : design of a model for telematics data fusion, real\-world practical assessment, and an AI\-powered decision support system](../publications/a4229334e7846d4db08d.md)

Χρυσή Μπάκα

Η εργασία αφορά την αξιολόγηση της οδηγικής συμπεριφοράς των επαγγελματιών οδηγών σε οργανισμούς που εκτελούν ή αναθέτουν οδικές μεταφορές\. Σήμερα η αξιολόγηση στηρίζεται σε δύο πηγές που δεν συνδυάζονται: την αξιολόγηση επί της οδού από εκπαιδευτή, που καλύπτει στοιχεία που οι αισθητήρες δεν καταγράφουν αλλά επαναλαμβάνεται κάθε δύο έτη, και την τηλεματική, που καταγράφει συνεχώς αλλά μόνο ό,τι μετρούν οι αισθητήρες του οχήματος\. Σκοπός της εργασίας είναι η σχεδίαση ενός μοντέλου που συνθέτει τις δύο πηγές σε έναν δείκτη ο οποίος επικαιροποιείται κάθε μήνα, και ενός συστήματος υποστήριξης αποφάσεων που αξιοποιεί το μοντέλο και τις τεχνολογίες τεχνητής νοημοσύνης\. Η εργασία ακολουθεί το πλαίσιο της έρευνας σχεδίασης\. Από τη σύγκριση πέντε διαφορετικών μεθόδων επιλέχθηκε η θεωρία αξιοπιστίας, σε συνδυασμό με τον εκθετικά σταθμισμένο κινητό μέσο\. Η αξιολόγηση του εκπαιδευτή αποτελεί την αρχική εκτίμηση, και το βάρος της τηλεματικής αυξάνεται με τα χιλιόμετρα που διανύονται μετά από αυτήν, έως ένα ανώτατο όριο\. Ο δείκτης αντιστοιχίζεται σε τέσσερις ζώνες επικινδυνότητας και συμπληρώνεται με κανόνες υπερίσχυσης για κρίσιμα στοιχεία της αξιολόγησης\. Νέα αξιολόγηση επί της οδού ζητείται όταν οι δύο πηγές αποκλίνουν, όταν η αξιολόγηση παλαιώνει ή όταν αλλάζει η ζώνη\. Το μοντέλο εφαρμόστηκε, ως επίδειξη λειτουργίας, σε δέκα συνθετικά σενάρια οδηγών διάρκειας είκοσι τεσσάρων μηνών, και η ανάλυση ευαισθησίας έδειξε ότι οι σαφείς περιπτώσεις δεν εξαρτώνται ουσιαστικά από τις παραμέτρους\. Το σύστημα υποστήριξης αποφάσεων περιγράφεται σε επίπεδο αρχιτεκτονικής, με ντετερμινιστικό πυρήνα και πέντε ρόλους τεχνητής νοημοσύνης γύρω από αυτόν\. Το σύστημα υποδεικνύει ποιον οδηγό θα δει ο εκπαιδευτής, πότε και με ποιο ερώτημα, χωρίς να αντικαθιστά την κρίση του\.

## [From Access to Agency: A Capability\-Based Reconceptualization of Linguistic Equity in Generative AI–Mediated Language Education](../publications/a425880fedc77fe2cb32.md)

Nazik Ahmed

Generative artificial intelligence \(GenAI\) has recently become adopted into language learning environments at unprecedented rates\. Though research has yet to catch up to practice, language educators and researchers are concerned with questions of equity related to GenAI tools\. The bulk of this research has been technocentric, prioritizing access to AI instead of how students convert access into actionable freedoms\. To fill this gap, the current study sought to reconceptualize linguistic equity from a capability perspective\. The researchers utilized a quasi\-experimental mixed\-methods design with 80 EFL learners in experimental and control groups\. Paired and independent sample t\-tests were used to analyze quantitative data, while thematic analysis was used to code qualitative data\. Results showed significant improvement for the experimental group \(pre\-test M = 10\.58, post\-test M = 18\.27; t\(39\) = 15\.63, p &lt; \.001\) over the control group \(pre\-test M = 10\.46, post\-test M = 13\.34; t\(39\) = 5\.42, p &lt; \.001\), with a statistically significant difference between groups at post\-test \(t\(78\) = 11\.48, p &lt; \.001\)\. Quantitative results from questionnaires show a high sense of agency \(M = 4\.18\)\. The results of this study have important implications for reconceptualizing linguistic equity as depending not just on access but on the capability to use artificial intelligence to succeed in language performance environments\. The study adds to theory by providing preliminary work on a capability framework and provides practical application toward equitable GenAI pedagogy Keywords: generative artificial intelligence, linguistic equity, capability approach, learner agency, EFL education

## [Motion\- and Gravity\-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction](../publications/a42770872c0a1a9bbb5a.md)

Shiyao Qian; Yuan Ren; Dongfeng Bai

Feed\-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi\-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance\-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues\. In this work, we introduce a motion\- and gravity\-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information \(LUPI\) paradigm\. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only\. We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed\-forward efficiency\. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion\. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone\-dependent: middle\-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late\-stage integration is more effective for π3\. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed\-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test\-time complexity\.

ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ AI ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು\. ಅದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪು ಅಥವಾ ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ, ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತ, ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ, ಮೂಲಗಳ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆಯಂತಹ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕಾಗಿದೆ\. ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಅರಿವು, ಮನೋಭಾವ, ಬಳಕೆಯ ಅನುಭವ ಮತ್ತು ಅವರು ಎದುರಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ\. ಅಧ್ಯಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ಲಿಂಗ, ವಾಸಸ್ಥಳ ಮತ್ತು ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ವರ್ಷದ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಂಡುಬರುವ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ\. ಈ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿವರಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ\. ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ವಿವಿಧ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳಿಂದ ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಮಾದರಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು\. 2\.0\.0 ಸೈದ್ಧಾಂತಿಕ ಚೌಕಟ್ಟು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ AI ಯ ಬಳಕೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡದೆ, ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು, ಬೋಧನಾ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಕು\. AI ಆಧಾರಿತ ಸಾಧನಗಳು ವಿಷಯ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಿಕಾ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳನ್ನು ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯಗೊಳಿಸುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು; ಆದರೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ, ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂವಹನ ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾನವೀಯ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಶಕ್ತಿ ಅಗತ್ಯವಾಗಿಯೇ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ\. 2\.1\.0 ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ\-ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ\-ವಿಷಯಜ್ಞಾನ Mishra ಮತ್ತು Koehler \(2006\) ವಿವರಿಸಿದ TPACK ಚೌಕಟ್ಟು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಜ್ಞಾನ, ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯಜ್ಞಾನಗಳ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ\. ಇದರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಲು ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದಿರುವುದಷ್ಟೇ ಸಾಕಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ಅದನ್ನು ಯಾವ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ, ಯಾವ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಗುರಿಗಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವ ಬೋಧನಾ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದೂ ಮುಖ್ಯ\. AI ಆಧಾರಿತ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ\. 2\.2\.0 ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ Redecker \(2017\) ರೂಪಿಸಿದ DigCompEdu ಚೌಕಟ್ಟು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವಿಕೆ, ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಬಳಕೆ, ಬೋಧನೆ\-ಕಲಿಕೆ, ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಿಕಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ ಮುಂತಾದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ\. AI ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳ ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ವಿಮರ್ಶಾತ್ಮಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮತ್ತು ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತ ಬಳಕೆ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ\. 3\.0\.0 ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಅವಲೋಕನ Miao Cukurova \(2024\) AI Competency Framework for Teachers ವರದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಜ್ಞಾನ, ಕೌಶಲಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿದರು\. ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯ ಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದರ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅದರ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ನೈತಿಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಅರಿವು ಹೊಂದಿರಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದರು\. ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತ ಬಳಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೋಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಅನ್ವಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆ ನೀಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ಸೂಚಿಸಿದರು\. ಈ ವರದಿಯು ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್‌\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಬಳಕೆಯ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸುವ ಅಗತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥಿಸುತ್ತದೆ\. 20240 Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence Investigating Pre\-service Teachers&\#x27; Artificial Intelligence Perception from the Perspective of Planned Behavior Theory ಎಂಬ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವು ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಗ್ರಹಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುವ ವರ್ತನಾತ್ಮಕ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರುವ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿತು\. ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ತರಬೇತಿ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಅವರ ಗ್ರಹಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಮುಖ್ಯವೆಂದು ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿತು\. ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸುವ ಅಗತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಈ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ\. ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಅಧ್ಯಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಲು ಈ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ\. UNESCO \(2023\) ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರೇಟಿವ್ AI ಬಳಸುವಾಗ ಮಾನವಕೇಂದ್ರಿತ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನ, ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ, ವಯೋಸೂಕ್ತ ಬಳಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೈತಿಕ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಗೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ\. ಇಂತಹ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನಗಳು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ AI ಯ ಉಪಯೋಗಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅದರ ಮಿತಿಗಳ ಅರಿವು ಮೂಡಿಸುವ ಅಗತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ\. Holmes, Bialik ಮತ್ತು Fadel \(2019\) ಅವರ ಕೃತಿಯು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ\. AI ಮೂಲಕ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಅನುಭವಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸುವ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ, ಅದರ ಬಳಕೆಯನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವುದು ಅಗತ್ಯವೆಂದು ಈ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ಚರ್ಚೆಗಳು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ\. Mishra ಮತ್ತು Koehler \(2006\) ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ, ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯಜ್ಞಾನಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ\-ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಬೋಧನೆಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವೆಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ\. ಈ ಚೌಕಟ್ಟು AI ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯನ್ನೂ ಬೋಧನಾ ಗುರಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಅಗತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ\. 4\.0\.0 ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪುರುಷ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಿಳಾ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವುದು\. ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ನಗರ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವುದು\. ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ವರ್ಷದ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್‌\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವುದು\. 5\.0\.0 ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಶೂನ್ಯ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಗಳು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪುರುಷ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಿಳಾ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ\. ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ನಗರ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್‌\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ\. ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ವರ್ಷದ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಅರಿವು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ಮಹತ್ವದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ\. 6\.0\.0 ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ವಿಧಾನ 6\.1\.0 ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಅಧ್ಯಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ\. 6\.2\.0 ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ವಿವಿಧ ಬಿ\.ಎಡ್\. ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ 200 ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಮಾದರಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ\. 6\.3\.0 ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣಾ ಸಾಧನ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಅಧ್ಯಯನದಲ್ಲಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಸಂಶೋಧಕರು ಸ್ವತಃ ಅಭಿವ

## [How do cultural repertoires shape sustainable teacher identity? Confucian striving and Daoist release among Chinese pre\-service teachers](../publications/a43a794d9b2b1d145c8e.md)

Xuefei Lin; Qi Tan; Bin Xiong

Introduction Teacher identity formation is a dynamic process shaped by professional experience, emotion, wellbeing, and culturally available meanings\. This study examines how pre\-service teachers in China drew on Confucian and Daoist repertoires when reflecting on their developing teacher identities\. Methods Participants were 143 pre\-service teachers at one Chinese normal university\. They wrote prompted reflective narratives about coursework, micro\-teaching, lesson planning, educational observation, and imagined classroom responsibilities\. The analysis combined descriptive keyword mapping with reflexive thematic analysis\. Results Four related processes were identified: Confucian striving as a language of perseverance and self\-cultivation; Daoist release as a resource for non\-contention, recognizing limits, and emotional restoration; situational switching between these repertoires in response to changing demands; and sustainable teacher formation as an orientation toward responsibility with limits\. The study proposes cultural identity regulation as an integrative analytic heuristic for understanding how culturally available meanings connect academic experiences, emotional calibration, and imagined teacher selves\. Discussion The findings suggest that Confucian striving and Daoist release provided participants with culturally familiar ways to interpret effort, pressure, and anticipated responsibility during teacher preparation\. Their value lay in helping participants connect perseverance with self\-cultivation and responsibility, while also recognizing limits, reducing destructive comparison, and restoring emotional balance\. Cultural identity regulation captures this narrated negotiation of professional commitment and personal sustainability in the formation of an imagined teacher self\.

## [Perceptually indistinguishable retinal OCT synthesis and objective computational framework for detection of synthetic images](../publications/a4410e2220c8a82696cb.md)

Sandeep Chandra Bollepalli; Sathish Ande; Joshita Bhaviripudi; Nandini Gunnam; Utkarsh Doshi; Nasiq Hasan; Elham Sadeghi; Niroj Kumar Sahoo; Jose\-Alain Sahel; Jay Chhablani; Kiran Kumar Vupparaboina

Generative artificial intelligence \(AI\) is increasingly deployed in medical imaging to mitigate data scarcity, enable scalable model development, and simulate disease progression; however, as synthetic data approaches photorealism, it introduces a critical vulnerability: the inability to reliably distinguish synthetic from authentic clinical data\. In imaging\-centric health systems, undetected synthetic data may erode dataset integrity, obscure provenance, propagate bias, and compromise reproducibility and regulatory auditability\. Despite these risks, rigorous evaluation of synthetic image detectability remains limited\. To this end, we synthesize high\-resolution \(512 × 512\) retinal optical coherence tomography \(OCT\) B\-scans using four representative generative architectures, a Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network \(WGAN\), a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model \(DDPM\), R3GAN, and a Latent Diffusion model \(LDM\) trained on 88,500 images from the AIREADI dataset and systematically evaluate their perceptual realism and structural fidelity\. In particular, perceptual indistinguishability is assessed through two blinded human reader studies involving four retinal specialists, comprising a naïve and post\-familiarization evaluation for WGAN\-generated images and an independent evaluation of DDPM\-generated images\. In parallel, we introduce an objective computational framework predicated on gradient\-derived \(Sobel\) representations, with downstream dimensionality reduction via principal component analysis \(PCA\) and support vector machine based \(SVM\) classifier, to probe latent structural divergences within feature space\. Across both reader studies, retinal specialists demonstrated limited ability to distinguish synthetic from real OCT images\. Classification accuracy remained near chance both before \(59\.5%\) and after familiarization \(56\.5%\) for WGAN\-generated images, while DDPM\-generated images yielded a similar near\-chance accuracy \(50\.3%\), indicating that perceptual indistinguishability was observed for both adversarial and diffusion\-based image synthesis\. In contrast, the proposed objective computational method achieved 99\.93%, 99\.63%, 99\.91%, and 99\.83% classification accuracy for WGAN, DDPM, R3GAN, and LDM\-generated images, respectively on independent test datasets, demonstrating near\-perfect discrimination between real and synthetic images\. These findings delineate a fundamental disjunction between human perceptual judgment and computational detectability of synthetic medical images\. Although generative models yield clinically plausible OCT scans, they encode latent structural signatures that remain imperceptible to expert readers yet are robustly recoverable with objective computational analysis\.

## [Pengaruh Pelatihan Terhadap Produktivitas Karyawan Melalui Kompetensi Pada PT PLN Nusantara Power Up Punagaya \(Kabupaten Jeneponto\)](../publications/a4457439e11a2e6b3efa.md)

Siti Nurhalisa; Nurul Fadilah Aswar; Rezky Amalia Hamka

This study aims to determine the effect of training on employee productivity, with competence serving as an intervening variable, at PT PLN Nusantara Power UP Punagaya, Jeneponto Regency\. The variables employed in this study include training as the independent variable, employee productivity as the dependent variable, and competence as the intervening variable\. A quantitative approach utilizing a survey method was adopted\. The population consists of all employees at PT PLN Nusantara Power UP Punagaya\. Data were collected by distributing questionnaires to the respondents\. The data analysis technique employed is Structural Equation Modeling \(SEM\) based on Partial Least Squares \(PLS\), using the SmartPLS software\. The results indicate that training has a positive and significant effect on employee productivity\. Training also has a positive and significant impact on employee competence\. Furthermore, competence has a positive and significant effect on employee productivity\. Competence is shown to mediate the influence of training on employee productivity at PT PLN Nusantara Power UP Punagaya, Jeneponto Regency\. This suggests that the training provided by the company enhances employees&\#x27; knowledge, skills, and work capabilities, thereby leading to an increase in work productivity\.

## [AI IN DRUG THERAPY OPTIMIZATION: A COMPARATIVE STUDY OF MACHINE LEARNING MODELS FOR GUIDELINE ADHERANT THERAPY PERSONALIZATION IN HYPERLIPIDEMIA](../publications/a44f67790022c193e087.md)

Sean Kurian

Hyperlipidemia is a key contributor to cardiovascular diseases\. While guideline\-based treatment strategies exist, real\-world implementation varies due to patient\-specific complexities, clinician subjectivity, and evolving clinical evidence\. This study evaluates Random Forest \(RF\) Classifier and XG\-Boost models for personalizing hyperlipidemia treatment based on AHA and ACC guidelines with factors like eGFR, Baseline\_LDL\_C, Age, ASCVD\_Risk\_Score, Cost\_Sensitivity, ASCVD, Diabetes, Triglycerides, BMI, and Smoking\_Status, with an emphasis on guideline adherence and performance metrics\. This E\-Poster was presented at Kerala Pharmaceutical Congress 2025, held at Caritas College of Pharmacy, Kottayam, Kerala, India and won the &quot;Best Paper Award&quot; in the General stream\.

## [Artificial Intelligence for Smart Grid and Renewable Energy Management: A Review of Techniques, Applications, and Future Directions](../publications/a4589782239a36ca4c03.md)

Om Zile Udit Vaibhav Pant; Anurag Banerjee Sahil Kumar Singh

Intermittent renewable generation, volatile loads, and concerns over grid stability have become defining features of modern power systems\. Addressing these challenges with Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) and Machine Learning \(ML\) is attracting growing attention, including through better forecasting, automated demand response, optimized energy storage, and smart grid fault detection\. This paper highlights the various AI\-based techniques developed across the smart grid landscape, ranging from solar and wind forecasting to short\-term load forecasting, demand\-side management, electricity price forecasting, energy storage and battery management, grid resilience, and digital twins\. It offers an overview of recently published work, including the major approaches, namely deep learning \(LSTM and Transformer models\), explainable AI, multi\-agent systems, reinforcement learning, and federated learning, together with their strengths and limitations\. The paper also presents a conceptual three\-layer framework comprising edge sensing, federated forecasting and control, and explainable operator support at the distribution\-utility level; the framework is not validated empirically\. Challenges such as data privacy, model interpretability, scalability, and cybersecurity are explored, together with future research directions and the relevance of these technologies to India’s energy transition goals\.

## [Decentralized LLM Workflows via Sequential Auctions](../publications/a466097c94d036a5afca.md)

Ian Gemp; Shubhendu Trivedi; Adam Fisch; Fantine Huot; Michael Kaisers; Mirella Lapata; William W\. Cohen; Alekh Agarwal; Kate Larson; Jacob Eisenstein

We present a scalable framework for solving multi\-step tasks through a decentralized market of self\-interested agents\. Prior theoretical work demonstrated that agents organized through sequential auctions can converge to a globally optimal policy in a Markov decision process \(MDP\), but relied on the restrictive assumption of the existence of perfect clones as a model of perfect competition\. In reality, exact clones drive agent profit to zero, violating the natural risk\-reward incentives of participants\. Conversely, we empirically demonstrate that the opposite extreme, absence of competition, also leads to market failure and value extraction collapse\. Between these two extremes, we investigate how heterogeneous agents can survive in markets that span the critical middle ground of imperfect competition\. To be profitable, agents learn to strategically shade bids to secure positive individual profit margins, while still ensuring that the marketplace functions effectively enough so that collaborative tasks posed by market consumers can still be solved\. We formulate and evaluate four bidding algorithms \(Mirror Descent, Thompson Sampling, Bayes\-Optimal, and PPO\) across three auction protocols \(1st\-Price, 2nd\-Price, and Credit\-Conserving Vickrey\)\. Across a diverse set of domains, we demonstrate that imperfect competition successfully sustains necessary agent profit margins while maintaining high task success rates at low costs\.

## [Strategies for Building Customer Satisfaction at the Aksara Branch of PT Bank Aceh Syariah](../publications/a467f73ee88454a37c0c.md)

M\. Bima Syahputra; Endang Sulistya Rini; Muhammad Anggia Muchtar

Customer satisfaction is a strategic aspect of sustaining relationships between banks and customers, particularly in Islamic banking, which is required to provide quality services, accessible channels, and sustainable customer relationships\. This study aims to analyze the effects of service quality, accessibility, and Customer Relationship Management \(CRM\) on customer satisfaction at PT Bank Aceh Syariah KCP Aksara\. A quantitative survey approach was employed involving 140 customers as respondents\. The data were analyzed using multiple linear regression, supported by validity, reliability, classical assumption, t\-test, F\-test, and coefficient of determination analyses\. The results show that service quality has a positive and significant effect on customer satisfaction \(β=0\.318; p&lt;0\.001\), accessibility has a positive and significant effect \(β=0\.171; p=0\.009\), and CRM has a positive and significant effect \(β=0\.399; p&lt;0\.001\)\. Simultaneously, the three variables significantly affect customer satisfaction \(F=61\.319; p&lt;0\.001\) and explain 57\.5% of its variance\. The synthesis indicates that customer satisfaction is shaped by the integration of service interaction quality, ease of access, and sustainable relationship management, with CRM demonstrating the strongest relative influence\. The policy implication is that the bank should strengthen CRM through personalized communication, post\-transaction follow\-up, complaint management, and customer data utilization, supported by continuous improvements in service quality, facilities, information accessibility, and digital services\.

## [Iron overload disrupts bone homeostasis via dual pathways: inducing ferroptosis of preosteoblastic cells and shaping a proinflammatory immune milieu](../publications/a46c0c330f43109ff922.md)

Yu Pan; Renfeng Zhao; Chengdong Zhang; Feng Shi; Hui Wu; 肖东琴

Iron overload is regarded as an independent risk factor for osteoporosis, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood\. In this study, we systematically investigated the impact of iron overload on bone homeostasis using a combination of in vivo and in vitro models\. An iron overload rat model was established, and investigations were complemented by cellular assays utilizing mouse embryonic osteoblast precursor cells \(MC3T3\-E1\) and macrophages\. The in vivo results demonstrated that iron overload significantly reduced bone mineral density \(BMD\) and disrupted bone microarchitecture\. These structural changes were accompanied by an enhanced inflammatory response within the bone tissue and the aberrant expression of ferroptosis markers\. The in vitro experiments confirmed that iron overload induced ferroptosis and inhibited osteogenic differentiation in MC3T3\-E1 cells by triggering oxidative stress, lipid peroxidation, and mitochondrial damage\. This process was closely associated with the significant upregulation of the ATPase H\+ transporting V0 subunit D2 \( Atp6v0d2 \) gene\. Notably, plasmid\-mediated knockdown of Atp6v0d2 substantially alleviated ferroptosis and rescued osteogenic function in iron\-overloaded preosteoblastic cells\. Furthermore, our study revealed that iron overload drove macrophages toward a pro\-inflammatory M1 phenotype\. Conditioned medium from these polarized M1 macrophages induced apoptosis and cell cycle arrest in preosteoblastic cells while promoting osteoclast differentiation, an effect mediated by the activation of the IL\-17 signaling pathway\. In conclusion, this study revealed a dual mechanism by which iron overload disrupted bone homeostasis: it directly induced ferroptosis in osteogenic cells and indirectly shaped a pro\-inflammatory immune microenvironment\. These findings provide novel insights into the pathogenesis of iron overload\-induced osteoporosis and offer a new perspective for understanding bone metabolic dysregulation under iron overload conditions\.

## [Marking\-based load balancing Weighted Clustering Framework for Mobile ADHOC Network](../publications/a483df7c1791165d358e.md)

Prashant Dixit; Sonia Setia; Ramesh Chandra Sahoo; Manish Sharma; Sameena Pathan

In a mobile ad\-hoc network, it has been observed that the existing weighted clustering algorithm induces high computational overhead on the mobile nodes in the cluster\-head election process and distributes the load among the cluster\-heads unfairly\. Also, the cluster maintenance cost is very high due to the expiration or movement of the cluster\-head\. The purpose of this work is to mitigate the weaknesses of the existing weight\-based clustering algorithm\. The proposed &quot;Marking\-based Load Balancing Weighted Clustering Framework for Mobile ADHOC Network \(MLWCM\)&quot; marks the weak nodes before the beginning of the election process and spares them from massive weight calculation, thus saving the scarce resources of the network\. The concept of inmate affiliation reduces the maintenance cost considerably\. To ensure fair load distribution among the cluster\-heads, a handling factor has been computed, which is the number of nodes that a cluster\-head can handle based on its available battery power\. Also, to minimize the maintenance cost, a new event called inmate affiliation has been introduced\. The simulation outcome reveals that the proposed framework outperforms the existing weighted clustering algorithm\. MLWCM produces healthier and more stable cluster\-heads\. The number of members is fairly assigned to cluster\-heads\. Inmate affiliation allows a displaced node to get attached to an available nearby cluster silently, without inducing clustering in the complete network, which results in lower maintenance costs\. Obtained results: By the simulation, it has been revealed that the MLWCM yields healthy cluster\-heads in terms of battery power at a low computational cost, hence prolonging the life of the network and enabling efficient routing in the mobile ad\-hoc network\. For the proposed framework, MLWCM, the average battery life of the cluster\-head is 73\.8%, whereas for the existing WCA, the average battery life is 41\.8%; hence, MLWCM enhances the stability of the network\.

## [Exploring the transition from traditional museums to digital experiences: implications for online engagement and willingness to pay](../publications/a48617dd861de4b1ebf9.md)

Abid Hussain; Shahida Kanwel; Zhiqiang Ma; Mingxing Li; Bahar Hussain; Weijun Hu

Digital museums offer cultural institutions a new way to reach their audiences online\. This study analyzes the relationship between the digital museum experience, museum loyalty, and visitors’ willingness to pay more\. It also examines perceived value from social media, visitor satisfaction, and cultural identity as explanatory constructs, with age as a moderating variable\. The study sampled 385 respondents using snowball sampling\. The data were statistically analyzed using SPSS and structural equation modeling \(SEM\) in Analysis of Moment Structures \(AMOS\) 24\. The results indicate that the digital museum experience and perceived value from social media significantly impact visitors’ satisfaction, cultural identity, and loyalty to the museum\. Furthermore, increased museum loyalty correlates with a greater willingness to pay higher prices\. Mediation analysis also shows that visitor satisfaction mediates the relationship between the digital museum experience and museum loyalty\. Similarly, cultural identity mediates the relationship between perceived value from social media and museum loyalty\. Multi\-group analysis showed that the proposed relationships did not differ significantly by age\. However, digital engagement levels were consistent across age groups\. These findings have significant implications for enhancing user engagement, fostering loyalty, and improving the sustainability of digital heritage platforms\.

## [Transforming constructivist learning in engineering education through Comnet\-Art: An AI\-driven augmented reality learning environment](../publications/a4959fc72b1ff3e3d92d.md)

Muhammad Akhsan Hakiki; Rani Kartika; Mustofa Abi Hamid; Yahfenel Evi Fussalam; Ade Fricticarani; Resti Utami; Abdul Haris Setiawan; Ridho Dedy Arief Budiman; Arisman Sabir; Tri Wiyoko

The rapid integration of artificial intelligence \(AI\) and augmented reality \(AR\) in educational technology has opened new opportunities for enhancing constructivist learning, particularly in computer network education\. This study aimed to design, develop, and evaluate Comnet\-Art, an AI\-based AR learning application, to improve students&\#x27; understanding and constructivist skills in computer networks\. The research involved 234 undergraduate students and employed the ADDIE model \(Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation\) along with expert validation, practicality testing, and effectiveness assessment\. Validation results indicated strong content and media validity, with average Aiken&\#x27;s V scores of 0\.92 from media experts and 0\.89 from material experts, categorized as very valid\. Practicality assessments revealed high usability and engagement, with educators reporting an average practicality score of 91\.85% and students 90\.71%\. Effectiveness evaluation using pre\-test and post\-test comparisons demonstrated substantial learning gains, with the mean score increasing from 68\.21 to 86\.47 and a relative improvement of 26\.76%, confirming the application&\#x27;s effectiveness in fostering engagement, collaboration, problem\-solving, and constructivist learning outcomes\. These findings highlight that Comnet\-Art successfully integrates AI\-driven interactivity and AR visualization to support active learning, improve conceptual understanding, and enhance higher\-order cognitive skills\. This study provides strong evidence that emerging technologies such as AI and AR can be effectively leveraged to transform engineering education and promote constructivist learning\.

## [Evaluating domain generalization in agricultural deep learning through multi\-seed LOSO validation and explainable AI](../publications/a49a3235802f3437466f.md)

Jesús Rafael Hechavarría Hernández; RUBEN DARIO RAMOS CIPRIAN; Rafael Omar Batista‐Jorge

Abstract Conventional validation schemes may overestimate model robustness in agricultural deep learning when spatial domain shifts are not explicitly considered\. This study evaluated convolutional neural networks for pasture biomass estimation using the CSIRO Image2Biomass dataset within a multi\-seed Leave\-One\-State\-Out \(LOSO\) framework\. A total of 24 experiments combined four Australian geographical domains, two architectures \(ResNet50 and EfficientNet\-B0\), and three random seeds \(42, 123, and 2025\)\. Performance was assessed using WRMSLE, MAE, RMSE, and R 2 \. Seed\-to\-seed training variability was summarized using standard deviations across three random seeds, while 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for test WRMSLE were estimated by resampling the held\-out test samples within each seed\-level LOSO run\. A metadata\-based Random Forest was included as a non\-image baseline\. ResNet50 achieved mean test WRMSLE values ranging from 0\.869 to 1\.460 across held\-out domains, whereas EfficientNet\-B0 ranged from 0\.911 to 1\.519\. The Random Forest baseline outperformed both CNN architectures in New South Wales and Western Australia, suggesting that structured ecological metadata can remain highly competitive when image\-based models are transferred to unseen regions\. To examine the visual basis of prediction errors, a systematic Grad\-CAM audit was conducted using 40 activation maps derived from the five lowest\- and five highest\-error samples in each domain\. The resulting attention patterns suggested domain\-dependent model behavior and provided qualitative evidence consistent with reliance on contextual visual cues; however, the quantitative vegetation\-attention measure should be interpreted as a coarse diagnostic proxy rather than a ground\-truth segmentation metric\. Overall, the combination of multi\-seed LOSO validation, seed\-level variability analysis, baseline benchmarking, and systematic XAI auditing constitutes a pre\-deployment diagnostic framework for identifying generalization risks in agricultural computer\-vision systems operating under spatial uncertainty\.

## [Adaptive Value\-Oriented Order: Institutionalizing Student Discipline in Islamic Higher Education](../publications/a4a4db8b032f6ef6d8c4.md)

Mustafa Mustafa

This study examines how disciplinary order is shaped among Islamic Religious Education \(PAI\) students at STIT Al\-Hilal Sigli through the interaction of institutional structures, student agency, social regulation, and Islamic values\. Using a qualitative case study design, the study focuses on six indicators: attendance consistency, administrative regularity, schedule adherence, organizational activities, punctuality, and procedural habits\. The case was bounded by the PAI study program and the January–May 2026 period\. Data were collected through observation, semi\-structured interviews, and institutional documents and analyzed using an interactive qualitative analysis process supported by triangulation\. The findings show that disciplinary order is neither fully autonomous nor merely rule\-driven\. Institutional schedules, administrative systems, and procedures provide structural support, while student agency, peer regulation, and repeated practices contribute to the gradual formation of disciplinary habits\. Islamic values, particularly istiqamah, reinforce the moral internalization of discipline beyond direct supervision\. The study proposes adaptive value\-based order as a provisional, context\-grounded analytical concept describing disciplinary order produced through the interaction of institutional structure, student agency and social regulation, and Islamic value internalization\. This framework contributes to understanding discipline as a socially reproduced and value\-oriented process in Islamic higher education\.

## [Effects of forest therapy on cognitive and executive functions](../publications/a4b69d185ef1b3e51e1e.md)

Felipe Jerez\-Salas; Valentina Luksic\-Cataldo; Cristal Pavez\-Álvarez

Background: Forest therapy has been proposed as a non\-pharmacological intervention with potential benefits for cognitive functioning, particularly attentional and executive processes\. Objective: To systematically synthesize the available evidence on the cognitive effects of forest therapy in cognitively healthy adults\. Methods: A systematic review was conducted following PRISMA guidelines\. Experimental studies assessing objective cognitive outcomes after forest therapy interventions were included\. Results: Nine studies were included\. Preliminary positive trends were observed in attentional performance, autonomic relaxation, and psychological/affective states\. Evidence regarding processing speed and executive flexibility remains sparse and non\-significant\. Findings were constrained by high risk of bias, small samples, and heterogeneity\. Conclusion: Forest therapy provides preliminary, low\-certainty evidence for attentional recovery and emotional regulation within cognitive\-behavioral frameworks\. Current findings are hypothesis\-generating and require confirmation through rigorous, pre\-registered randomized trials\.

## [Navigating AI Without a Roadmap: Local Journalists’ Pragmatic Adoption and the Institutional Void in Türkiye](../publications/a4c2a9739a2e8fcbaa3b.md)

Taybe TOPSAKAL; Didem Deniz; Şeymanur Özlü

Although research on the impact of Artificial Intelligence \(AI\) on journalism in Türkiye has been increasing, studies focusing on local journalists’ everyday journalistic practices and whether they have institutional guidance in their use of AI remain quite limited\. This study aims to examine local journalists’ perceptions of AI, their forms of use, their evaluations of opportunities and risks, and their views on institutional support\. Within the scope of qualitative research, semi\-structured interviews were conducted with 12 local journalists working in local media organisations in Türkiye’s Aegean Region\. The data obtained were evaluated through thematic analysis\. According to the findings, local journalists use AI as a visual and textual supportive tool in news production\. However, while participants stated that AI provides speed and efficiency, they also expressed concerns about ethical issues and the weakening of professional skills\. It is observed that the adoption process of AI is shaped by individual initiatives without institutional guidance or formal policy\. In addition, the findings draw attention to the need for developing institutional policies, increasing training opportunities, and maintaining human oversight in AI\-supported journalism\.

## [Endocrine resistance in HR\+/HER2− breast cancer: molecular mechanisms and emerging therapeutic strategies](../publications/a4cbe54cd38760601613.md)

Tong Shen; Hui Li; Xubin Zhang; Qin Zhou

Hormone receptor–positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2–negative \(HR\+/HER2−\) breast cancer accounts for the majority of breast cancers and remains highly dependent on endocrine therapy across both early and advanced disease settings\. Although the incorporation of CDK4/6 inhibitors has substantially improved clinical outcomes, endocrine resistance, whether primary or secondary, ultimately limits durable disease control\. Resistance arises through heterogeneous and evolving mechanisms, including ESR1 mutations and fusions, ER transcriptional reprogramming, activation of PI3K/AKT/mTOR and other bypass pathways, cell\-cycle escape, epigenetic remodeling, and metabolic adaptation\. These molecular insights are increasingly being translated into biomarker\-guided therapeutic strategies, including next\-generation oral selective estrogen receptor degraders, PROTAC ER degraders, and PI3K/AKT/mTOR inhibitors; antibody–drug conjugates are considered separately as antigen\-directed options after endocrine resistance\. Importantly, circulating tumor DNA monitoring of emerging ESR1 mutations provides an opportunity to identify molecular progression before radiographic progression and to support earlier treatment adaptation\. This narrative review integrates recent mechanistic and clinical evidence on endocrine resistance in HR\+/HER2− breast cancer, with emphasis on how resistance mechanisms and biomarkers can inform drug selection, treatment sequencing, and dynamic disease monitoring\. A mechanism\-guided approach may therefore help move clinical management from empiric treatment switching toward more individualized, biomarker\-driven, whole\-course care\.

## [Sığır Embriyosu Kalite Sınıflandırmasında Evrişimli Sinir Ağı Mimarilerinin Karşılaştırmalı Değerlendirilmesi](../publications/a4d938fa4989685c2cff.md)

Mevlüt GÜR; Bilal Şenol; Goktug Senturk

Sığır embriyolarının kalite değerlendirmesi, embriyo transferinin başarısını doğrudan etkileyen kritik bir aşamadır; ancak manuel değerlendirmenin öznel doğası, gözlemciler arasında tutarsızlıklara yol açmaktadır\. Bu çalışmada, sığır blastosistlerinin IETS standardına göre dört sınıflı kalite sınıflandırması için altı yaygın evrişimli sinir ağı mimarisi \(VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet\-121, EfficientNet\-B0, Inception\-v3 ve MobileNetV2\) transfer öğrenme yaklaşımıyla karşılaştırılmıştır\. İki farklı kaynaktan elde edilen 1\.098 görüntülük birleşik bir veri seti kullanılmış ve tüm modeller aynı protokol altında eğitilmiştir\. Her mimari için öğrenme oranı, dropout ve yoğun katman nöron sayısı ızgara aramasıyla optimize edilmiş; ayrıca ince ayar sırasında açılan katman sayısının başarıma etkisi ayrı bir çözümlemeyle incelenmiştir\. Modellerin başarımı doğruluk, makro F1 ve makro AUC ölçütleriyle değerlendirilmiş, kararların yorumlanabilirliği Grad\-CAM ile incelenmiştir\. En yüksek başarım, yapısal olarak yalın VGG16 mimarisiyle elde edilmiş \(%69,09 doğruluk; 0,8904 makro AUC\); en karmaşık modellerden biri olan Inception\-v3 ise en düşük başarımı vermiştir\. Tüm mimarilerde ölü/dejenere embriyolar \(Kod 4\) yüksek doğrulukla ayrılırken, komşu canlı kalite dereceleri, özellikle Kod 2, en çok karışan sınıf olmuştur\. Bulgular, sınırlı boyutlu veri kümelerinde model büyüklüğünün tek başına belirleyici olmadığını; mimari seçiminin ve ince ayar derinliğinin başarımı önemli ölçüde etkilediğini göstermektedir\. Elde edilen sonuçlar, transfer öğrenmeye dayalı yaklaşımların embriyo değerlendirmesinde nesnel bir karar destek aracı geliştirilmesi için umut verici bir potansiyel taşıdığına işaret etmektedir; ancak bu potansiyelin klinik kullanıma dönüşmesi için daha geniş ve dengeli veri kümeleriyle dış doğrulamaya ihtiyaç vardır\.

## [Artificial intelligence\-driven reconfiguration of customer experience: A service\-dominant logic framework](../publications/a4e50351e56cc36548c1.md)

Dong‐Young Kim

This study develops a framework explaining how artificial intelligence \(AI\) reconfigures customer experience in hospitality and tourism, drawing on service\-dominant logic\. Co\-citation and content analyses were conducted to synthesize 89 articles and identify the intellectual structure of the literature\. The findings reveal that institutional arrangements condition AI&\#x27;s legitimate participation in service ecosystems\. Three mechanisms explain how AI reconfigures customer experience: the actor role architect, the interaction mediator, and the experience orchestrator\. These mechanisms operate concurrently and recursively rather than as discrete stages within AI\-enabled service ecosystems\. The study makes three contributions to the literature\. First, it positions customer experience reconfiguration as an ecosystem\-level process\. Second, it extends service\-dominant logic from dyadic to triadic human\-AI\-human value co\-creation\. Third, it differentiates AI by functional intelligence, showing that mechanical, thinking, feeling, and multi\-functional types perform distinct roles in this reconfiguration\.
