## [Examining How the Frequency of Artificial Intelligence Use in the Workplace Relates to Employee Self\-Efficacy and Job Satisfaction](../publications/c802fd2af6dd5e75e011.md)

Dalton R Vail

Artificial intelligence is a prominent topic in society\. Its adoption in the healthcare sector has occurred rapidly\. Nonetheless, much existing research focuses on clinical healthcare professionals, thereby overlooking those in non\-clinical roles\. Non\-clinical roles make up a small portion of the healthcare industry, but they account for a large share of burnout in the field\. This quantitative study aimed to explore the relationships among artificial intelligence, job satisfaction, and self\-efficacy\. It posited that these variables are interconnected concerning artificial intelligence in a non\-clinical context\. Furthermore, the study sought to determine whether job satisfaction and self\-efficacy are influenced by how often participants use artificial intelligence\. To empirically test these hypotheses, a total of 119 participants \(61 users and 58 non\-users\) were recruited from rural hospitals\. The participants completed a survey that addressed participant eligibility, sample demographics, artificial intelligence usage, job satisfaction, and self\-efficacy\. The survey data were analyzed with a Mann\-Whitney U test and Spearman’s Correlation\. The results found that non\-clinical healthcare workers who did not use artificial intelligence reported higher job satisfaction\. Furthermore, as participants reported more frequent artificial intelligence use, they reported decreased job satisfaction\. However, there was no relationship between artificial intelligence use and self\-efficacy\. From a practical standpoint, these findings highlight the need for a clear reason for artificial intelligence implementation\. From a theoretical standpoint, these findings contribute to a deeper understanding of artificial intelligence, job satisfaction, and self\-efficacy\.

## [Empowering Pediatric Disaster Resilience at the Edge of the Cliff: A Community\-Based STEM and Role\-Playing Intervention Grounded in the Health Belief Model for Sustainable Development](../publications/c80b9b68eb428744dc80.md)

Dian Puspitaningtyas; Anita Sulistyorini; Mika Vernicia Humairo; Erianto Fanani

Background: In disaster\-prone archipelagic nations, pediatric populations stand at the &quot;edge of the cliff&quot; a critical vulnerability where systemic gaps in non\-structural mitigation meet preventable crises\. Community empowerment and early educational interventions are vital to pull vulnerable demographics back from this precipice and advance Sustainable Development Goals 3, 4, and 11\. Objective: This community service research evaluated a STEM\-integrated, role\-playing simulation program designed to enhance earthquake and fire preparedness, fostering community resilience and social equity among elementary students at SDN Karang Besuki 01, Indonesia, grounded in the Health Belief Model \(HBM\) and Social Cognitive Theory \(SCT\)\. Methods: Adhering to TREND guidelines, a one\-group pretest\-posttest quasi\-experimental design was employed with 34 students \(Grades 1–5\)\. The intervention combined visual socialization, basic STEM concepts \(fire/quake dynamics\), and experiential role\-playing rooted in local wisdom \(gotong royong/peer\-composure\)\. Knowledge acquisition was analyzed via Normalized Gain \(N\-Gain\) and Wilcoxon signed\-rank tests\. Results: The intervention yielded a substantial improvement in disaster self\-efficacy, with the mean correct response rate escalating from 75\.94% to 98\.26% \(a net gain of 22\.32%, p &lt; 0\.001\)\. The average N\-Gain score was 0\.92 \(92\.7%\), indicating a highly effective pedagogical impact, particularly in initial earthquake response \(\+25\.8%\) and safe evacuation identification \(\+25\.7%\)\. Conclusion: The intervention yielded a substantial improvement in disaster self\-efficacy, with the mean correct response rate escalating from 75\.94% to 98\.26% \(a net gain of 22\.32%, p &lt; 0\.001\)\. The average N\-Gain score was 0\.92 \(92\.7%\), indicating a highly effective pedagogical impact, particularly in initial earthquake response \(\+25\.8%\) and safe evacuation identification \(\+25\.7%\)\.

## [Application of computer simulation technology in the optimization and performance evaluation of smart sports teaching systems in universities](../publications/c8208635ec83d77cf577.md)

Yongkang Zhao; Sahar Khayatnezhad

This study proposes a computer\-simulation\-driven framework for optimizing and evaluating smart sports teaching systems in universities\. Using MHEALTH as the main multimodal wearable\-sensor dataset, and UCI HAR Smartphone and Daily and Sports Activities as external validation datasets, the framework integrates wearable\-sensor preprocessing, window\-level feature construction, activity recognition, teaching\-state indicator construction, sensor\-ablation analysis, scenario simulation and optimization, \.\.\.statistical validation, and computational implementation\-feasibility assessment\. Activity Load Index, movement stability, and a sensor\-derived safety proxy were constructed to translate acceleration, gyroscope, magnetometer, and ECG signals into interpretable teaching\-state representations\. To address subject\-dependence and potential overestimation from a fixed train/test split, classification performance was re\-evaluated using leave\-one\-subject\-out validation\. In the realistic MHEALTH setting including the dominant null class, Gaussian Naive Bayes achieved the highest mean Macro F1 of 0\.652, while tuned Extra Trees achieved an accuracy of 0\.819 and a Macro F1 of 0\.563\. In the activity\-only setting, Random Forest and Extra Trees achieved mean Macro F1 scores of approximately 0\.95, indicating strong but not universally perfect subject\-independent recognition\. External validation produced Extra Trees accuracies of 0\.941 on UCI HAR and 0\.964 on Daily Sports\. Sensitivity analyses showed that the principal high\-load activity assignments remained stable under plausible variations in Activity Load Index weights and thresholds\. Formal constrained optimization identified a 25% low, 65% moderate, 8% high, and 2% very\-high state allocation as the utility\-maximizing solution, corresponding to a 13\.7% simulated utility gain over the observed baseline\. These results support the use of the proposed framework as an interpretable, subject\-independent decision\-support approach for evaluating wearable\-sensor\-based sports teaching scenarios\.

## [Persistent regional asymmetry with apparent late\-record convergence in Eurasian\-North American snowmelt trends](../publications/c82af1548392c6946e7c.md)

Caleb G\. Pan; Sydney Baratta; Jorge Gonzalez; Sean Griffin; Kristofer Lasko; Jeremy Johnston; Peter B\. Kirchner; Shad O&\#x27;Neel; Jinyang Du

Abstract Northern Hemisphere snowmelt phenology has shifted earlier over the past 37 years, but Eurasia and North America have followed markedly different trajectories\. Using a random forest framework fusing passive microwave brightness temperatures, ERA5\-Land reanalysis, and static landscape predictors, we produce annual 6\.25 km outputs of main melt onset date \(MMOD\), snow off date, and snowmelt duration \(SMD\) across the Northern Hemisphere seasonal snow domain from 1988\-2025, trained on more than 13,000 in situ observations\. Over the full record, median MMOD and snow off trends are roughly four to five times stronger in Eurasia \(\~\-2 days decade⁻¹\) than in North America \(\~\-0\.4 days decade⁻¹\), while SMD shows little systematic change in either continent, indicating that the dominant signal is a shift in timing rather than melt\-season length\. A 15\-year moving\-window analysis shows that this full\-period contrast obscures a converging trajectory: Eurasia developed a robust earlier\-melt regime by the early 2000s, while North America&\#x27;s trends were weak or even reversed in early decades before becoming more negative in recent windows\. Disaggregating by snow regime reveals that this apparent hemispheric convergence is largely an artifact of buffering within area\-dominant boreal forest and tundra regimes, where trends weaken or stabilize over time, while smaller seasonal snow regimes, including prairie, montane forest, and ephemeral snow, exhibit stronger, often asymmetric, accelerations toward earlier melt, with the most coherent advances concentrated in Eurasia\. These results indicate that hemispheric\-scale convergence in snowmelt timing masks substantial, regime\-dependent asymmetry, with direct implications for runoff timing and water availability in climatically sensitive seasonal snow environments\.

## [Ethical Artificial Intelligence Leadership for Multilingual and Intercultural Language Education in Developing Countries](../publications/c82e090e6e2e94a260f8.md)

Abdul Walid QADIRI; Abdul Wali Sirat; Musawer Hakimi

Artificial intelligence \(AI\) is entering university governance, teaching, and language education across developing countries, yet ethical\-leadership scholarship remains concentrated on well\-resourced, digitally mature institutions\. This paper reports a PRISMA\-informed, PICO\-guided literature review examining how ethical AI leadership can be theorized for multilingual and intercultural language education in developing\-country higher education, with a conflict\-affected higher\-education setting in South Asia as an illustrative case\. Fifty\-six sources met inclusion criteria after a staged identification, screening, and eligibility process conducted by a single reviewer using open academic search engines and publisher platforms rather than subscription\-indexed databases\. Thematic synthesis identified four recurring barrier domains infrastructural access, institutional governance, socio\-cultural capacity, and linguistic/data equity and three leadership theories \(transformational, distributed, and ethical leadership\) that jointly inform a proposed six\-dimension conceptual framework for ethical AI leadership\. The review finds that AI tools trained predominantly on high\-resource languages risk marginalizing low\-resource languages such as Dari and Pashto, and that governance models assuming dedicated oversight offices do not transfer to capacity\-constrained institutions\. The paper contributes a context\-sensitive, evidence\-informed framework and a transparent, reproducible search protocol for future empirical validation in developing\-country and conflict\-affected higher\-education settings\.

## [PELATIHAN PERAWATAN MOTOR TEMPEL KEPADA OPERATOR DAN AWAK KAPAL SUNGAI DI DESA MUARA PADANG KABUPATEN BANYUASIN](../publications/c830d0dc84aa7c97e6a3.md)

Paulina M\. Latuheru; Muhamad Fahmi Amrillah; Siti Nurlaili Triwahyuni; Oktrianti Diani; Dadang Abdul Aziz

Keandalan motor tempel merupakan salah satu faktor penting dalam mendukung keselamatan dan keberlangsungan operasional kapal sungai\. Keterbatasan pengetahuan dan keterampilan operator serta awak kapal dalam melakukan perawatan preventif dapat meningkatkan risiko gangguan mesin selama pelayaran\. Kegiatan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat \(PkM\) ini bertujuan meningkatkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan operator serta awak kapal sungai dalam melakukan pemeriksaan dan perawatan dasar motor tempel\. Kegiatan dilaksanakan oleh Politeknik Transportasi Sungai, Danau, dan Penyeberangan Palembang di Gedung Serba Guna Desa Muara Padang, Kabupaten Banyuasin, pada 29 Mei 2026 pukul 08\.00–13\.00 WIB dan diikuti oleh 20 peserta\. Metode pelaksanaan meliputi identifikasi kebutuhan, penyampaian materi, demonstrasi, praktik langsung, evaluasi keterampilan, pre\-test, post\-test, dan survei kepuasan\. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan peningkatan rata\-rata pengetahuan peserta dari 62,14% pada pre\-test menjadi 88,57% pada post\-test, atau meningkat sebesar 26,43 percentage points\. Evaluasi keterampilan menunjukkan capaian rata\-rata sebesar 85,40% dengan 90% peserta mencapai tingkat kompetensi minimum\. Dari aspek penerimaan program, 43% peserta memberikan penilaian baik dan 47% sangat baik sehingga 90% peserta memberikan respons positif terhadap kegiatan\. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan pelatihan berbasis teori, demonstrasi, praktik, dan pendampingan mampu meningkatkan kapasitas teknis peserta serta mendorong penerapan pemeliharaan preventif\. Kegiatan ini berkontribusi terhadap penguatan kompetensi sumber daya manusia dan mendukung peningkatan keandalan mesin dan keselamatan operasional transportasi sungai\.

## [PREDIKSI KEBUTUHAN OBAT PADA INSTALASI FARMASI RUMAH SAKIT MENGGUNAKAN METODE RANDOM FOREST BERBASIS DATA HISTORIS TRANSAKSI OBAT](../publications/c833473d7b3b4ac2cad9.md)

Ahmad Junaidi; Yeviki Maisyah Putra

Abstract: Effective drug inventory management in hospital pharmacies requires accurate demand planning to minimize the risks of drug shortages and excess inventory\. Historical drug transaction data stored in a Hospital Information System \(SIMRS\) can be utilized as a basis for predicting drug requirements for subsequent periods\. This study aims to develop a drug demand prediction model using the Random Forest Regression method based on historical drug transaction data from a hospital pharmacy\. The dataset consists of drug transaction records from August 2024 to December 2025 obtained from the hospital information system\. The data were processed through preprocessing stages, including data cleaning, missing\-value checking, duplicate detection, transaction validation, and monthly aggregation of drug usage\. Subsequently, feature engineering was performed by generating historical usage features in the form of lag variables and moving averages as model inputs\. The dataset was divided chronologically into training and testing sets to prevent data leakage\. The Random Forest Regression model was employed to predict drug requirements for the subsequent period and evaluated using Mean Absolute Error \(MAE\), Root Mean Square Error \(RMSE\), and Weighted Absolute Percentage Error \(WAPE\)\. The results indicate that a historical transaction\-based approach can be used to estimate drug requirements and provide supporting information for inventory planning in hospital pharmacies\. The integration of the prediction model into SIMRS can further support pharmacy staff in planning drug requirements based on historical usage patterns Keyword: drug demand prediction, Random Forest Regression, hospital information system, hospital pharmacy, machine learning, drug transactions Abstrak: Pengelolaan persediaan obat di instalasi farmasi rumah sakit memerlukan perencanaan kebutuhan yang tepat untuk mengurangi risiko kekurangan maupun kelebihan stok\. Pemanfaatan data historis transaksi obat pada Sistem Informasi Manajemen Rumah Sakit \(SIMRS\) dapat digunakan sebagai dasar untuk memprediksi kebutuhan obat pada periode berikutnya\. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan model prediksi kebutuhan obat menggunakan metode Random Forest Regression berbasis data historis transaksi obat pada instalasi farmasi rumah sakit\. Data penelitian berupa transaksi obat pada periode Agustus 2024 sampai Desember 2025 yang diperoleh dari sistem SIMRS\. Data melalui tahapan preprocessing yang meliputi pembersihan data, pemeriksaan data kosong, duplikasi, validasi transaksi, dan agregasi penggunaan obat secara bulanan\. Selanjutnya dilakukan feature engineering dengan membentuk fitur historis berupa lag penggunaan obat dan moving average sebagai variabel masukan model\. Data dibagi secara kronologis menjadi data pelatihan dan pengujian untuk menghindari data leakage\. Model Random Forest Regression digunakan untuk menghasilkan prediksi kebutuhan obat pada periode berikutnya dan dievaluasi menggunakan Mean Absolute Error \(MAE\), Root Mean Square Error \(RMSE\), dan Weighted Absolute Percentage Error \(WAPE\)\. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan berbasis pola historis transaksi dapat digunakan untuk menghasilkan estimasi kebutuhan obat dan memberikan informasi pendukung bagi perencanaan persediaan pada instalasi farmasi\. Implementasi model pada SIMRS dapat dikembangkan sebagai sistem pendukung keputusan untuk membantu petugas farmasi dalam melakukan perencanaan kebutuhan obat berdasarkan pola penggunaan historis Kata kunci: prediksi kebutuhan obat, Random Forest Regression, SIMRS, instalasi farmasi, machine learning, transaksi obat

## [Reconceptualizing Justice in the Digital Age: A Jurisprudential Study of Digital Courts](../publications/c839eb76294357487e67.md)

Harshit Sharma; Parth Singh Dogra

This paper discusses how judicial procedures are changing under the influence of digitalisation, focusing particularly on the creation of digital courts and placing the analysis in a wider jurisprudential context\. It also examines how the application of information and communication technologies such as e\-filing, virtual hearings and digital case management systems has transformed the way justice is delivered in India\. The paper is critical of how such technological developments can improve or jeopardise the constitutional and judicially approved fundamental legal principles, including access to justice, procedural fairness, equality and transparency, as recognised in Anita Kushwaha v\. Pushap Sudan and Swapnil Tripathi v\. Supreme Court of India\. Using an interdisciplinary approach, the paper engages with major theories of jurisprudence, such as legal positivism, natural law, sociological jurisprudence and legal realism, based on the writings of H\.L\.A\. Hart, Lon L\. Fuller, Ronald Dworkin and Roscoe Pound\. It also considers the consequences of new technologies like artificial intelligence in court decisions\. The paper finds that, although digital courts are much more efficient and more accessible, they also provoke challenges of digital exclusion and loss of procedural protections\. It concludes that digital justice can only be legitimate when technological innovation is balanced with constitutional and jurisprudential norms so as to secure an inclusive and fair legal system\.

## [Sistem Manajemen Logistik Berbasis Web Menggunakan Agile pada Hub Bitung](../publications/c844e6bd249ab88b2d0d.md)

Fadhlan Haikal; Santosa Wijayanto

Pengelolaan logistik PT Jala Niaga Elok Hub Bitung masih bersifat semi\-manual sehingga menimbulkan duplikasi pencatatan, selisih stok, dan keterlambatan laporan\. Penelitian ini bertujuan membangun sistem manajemen logistik berbasis web menggunakan Agile\. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif melalui studi kasus, dengan pengumpulan data berupa observasi, wawancara, dan studi pustaka\. Pengembangan meliputi perencanaan, analisis kebutuhan, perancangan, implementasi, pengujian, dan evaluasi\. Sistem mengintegrasikan data barang, supplier, pengguna, pemesanan, penerimaan, penggunaan, pengembalian, persetujuan, dan laporan dalam basis data terpusat\. Pengujian black box pada 13 kelompok uji terperinci mencakup 61 skenario yang tercatat valid\. Modul Items tercantum dalam rencana pengujian, tetapi tidak memiliki tabel hasil uji tersendiri\. Hasil tersebut mendukung fungsi alur kerja yang terdokumentasi\. Peningkatan efisiensi waktu, akurasi stok, dan biaya operasional masih memerlukan pengukuran lanjutan\.

## [Chrysin\-loaded PCL nanocapsule spray as a topical strategy against cutaneous candidiasis](../publications/c84773aad4ed911b0633.md)

Milena Luiza da Silva; Eric Luiz Domingos; Ahmad Kassem El Zein; Roberto Pontarolo; Marcel Henrique Marcondes Sari; Jéssica Brandão Reolon; Luana Mota Ferreira

Introduction Candida albicans , the most prevalent fungal pathogen in humans, poses increasing therapeutic challenges due to rising resistance to conventional azole antifungals, driving interest in natural alternatives\. Chrysin \(5,7\- dihydroxyflavone\) is a flavonoid with promising biological activities that are limited by poor aqueous solubility and low bioavailability\. This study aimed to develop and characterize chrysin\-loaded poly \(ε\-caprolactone\) \(PCL\) nanocapsules in a spray formulation for topical treatment of cutaneous candidiasis\. Methods Nanocapsules were produced by interfacial deposition of the preformed polymer and characterized for particle size, zeta potential, encapsulation efficiency, and morphology\. Their performance was further evaluated through in vitro release studies, antifungal activity against C\. albicans, antioxidant activity, and spray performance\. Results and Discussion The formulation exhibited nanometric size \(207\.6 ± 4\.63 nm\), low polydispersity \(0\.174 ± 0\.04\), high encapsulation efficiency \(87\.28% ± 0\.77%\), and sustained drug release over 120 h, with antifungal activity substantially superior to free chrysin, requiring 5\- to 8\-fold lower concentrations to achieve equivalent inhibitory and fungicidal effects, and enhanced antioxidant efficacy at lower concentrations\. The spray device delivered consistent and reproducible doses \(118\.5% of theoretical content, RSD 5\.78%\)\. These findings demonstrate that chrysin\-loaded PCL nanocapsules successfully overcome solubility limitations, enhance antifungal and antioxidant activities, and provide sustained release, representing a promising nanotechnology\-based alternative for cutaneous candidiasis treatment with convenient topical application\.

## [INTELLIGENT ANALYSIS OF CADASTRAL DATA FOR SUBSTANTIATING MASTER PLAN DECISIONS](../publications/c850b596de23b16602ab.md)

Egor Nakaryakov; Mihail Lavrenenkov

Cadastral data make it possible to assess territories at the level of individual land parcels, capital construction facilities and established restrictions; however, their analytical potential in master planning is not fully utilized\. The main difficulty lies not in the lack of information, but in the need to simultaneously compare permitted land use, functional and territorial zoning, actual land use, zones with special conditions for the use of territories, existing development and infrastructure\. The purpose of the study is to develop a methodological approach to intelligent cadastral data analysis for the preliminary identification of land parcels requiring additional examination during master plan development and adjustment\. The study employs systems analysis, cadastral interpretation, spatial comparison, classification and multi\-criteria assessment\. A system of attributes grouped into cadastral\-legal, urban planning, actual\-use and infrastructure\-spatial blocks is proposed\. Functional, urban planning, spatial\-legal and infrastructural inconsistencies are identified\. An algorithm is developed that includes source data preparation, formation of a feature description of a land parcel, intelligent detection of atypical combinations of characteristics, classification of identified inconsistencies and ranking of parcels according to the need for expert review\. It is established that artificial intelligence in such a system should not automatically determine the admissibility of land use or substitute professional urban planning decisions\. Its function is the preliminary diagnostics of large cadastral datasets and the identification of objects whose combination of characteristics requires more detailed analysis\.

## [Technology Integration as A Predictor of Utilization of Computer\-Aided Mathematics Tools in Teaching](../publications/c85212a6603a3da5ce2b.md)

Neil Raymond K\. Factor; Lynette P\. Rue

This study examined Technology Integration as a Predictor of Utilization of Computer\-Aided Mathematics Tools in Teaching among mathematics teachers in the Schools Division Office of Valenzuela City\. Specifically, it determined the overall level of ICT Integration based on the SAMR Model; assessed the Extent of utilization of computer\-aided mathematics tools in terms of visualization and exploration, computation and problem\-solving, and practice and assessment; determined the significant relationship between ICT Integration and the utilization of computer\-aided mathematics tools; examined whether ICT Integration significantly predicted the identified dimensions of utilization; and proposed a Capacity Enhancement Plan based on the findings\. The findings showed that the respondents demonstrated a high overall level of ICT Integration, while the utilization of computer\-aided mathematics tools was moderate\. Among the three dimensions, visualization and exploration was the most utilized, followed by computation and problem\-solving, while practice and assessment was the least utilized\. The findings further showed that ICT Integration had significant positive relationships with all three dimensions of computer\-aided mathematics tool utilization and significantly predicted each dimension\. These findings indicated that stronger ICT Integration was associated with greater utilization of computer\-aided mathematics tools in mathematics instruction\. The study concluded that strengthening teachers’ ICT Integration competencies could support more purposeful and effective use of computer\-aided mathematics tools\. Accordingly, a Capacity Enhancement Plan was proposed to enhance teachers’ ICT competencies and promote more purposeful integration and utilization of computer\-aided mathematics tools in mathematics instruction\.

## [Case Report: Long\-lasting adrenal insufficiency following successful osilodrostat therapy with subsequent recurrence of Cushing’s syndrome](../publications/c85ba68fa6fec70e97d4.md)

Wiktoria Suchy; Ewelina Rzepka; Mari Minasyan; Aleksandra Gamrat\-Żmuda; Alicja Hubalewska–Dydejczyk; Aleksandra Gilis‐Januszewska

Osilodrostat is an effective steroidogenesis inhibitor used in the treatment of Cushing’s syndrome \(CS\)\. One of the clinically significant adverse events associated with this therapy is adrenal insufficiency \(AI\)\. Here, we report a patient with CS who developed delayed\-onset AI during osilodrostat therapy, that persisted for four years despite drug discontinuation and was followed by recurrence of hypercortisolism\. A 52\-year\-old female was admitted with suspicion of CS\. Diagnostic evaluation suggested pituitary CS\. Ketoconazole was initiated as a preoperative treatment, however, transsphenoidal surgery \(TSS\) proved non\-radical\. The patient declined reoperation, and was therefore treated with metyrapone within a clinical trial \(NCT02297945\), followed by transition to osilodrostat after the trial’s completion\. After two years of successful treatment with a stable dose of osilodrostat the patient developed AI\. The drug was discontinued, however AI persisted for the next 4 years\. The symptoms suggestive of CS recurred, which led to another TSS, that resulted in remission\. After 10 months of remission, hypercortisolism recurred again\. This case highlights the need for careful long\-term monitoring in patients receiving adrenostatic therapy\. It is particularly notable for delayed onset of AI, despite long\-term treatment with a stable, relatively low dose of osilodrostat\. The prolonged persistence of AI and the subsequent late recurrence of hypercortisolism further distinguish this case from previously reported cases\. Overall, this case underscores the need for continued clinical vigilance during long\-term osilodrostat treatment\.

## [Building Geometry and Operational Energy Performance: A Comparative Study of Residential Building Shapes in Esenyurt, Istanbul](../publications/c85e658acc69840fa71d.md)

Modupe Odemakin; Seyhan YARDIMLI; Melody Safarkhani

Building geometry represents a fundamental design parameter that can substantially influence operational energy demand without requiring additional construction materials or advanced technologies\. Optimizing building form may therefore provide a cost\-effective, high\-impact approach to improving thermal efficiency in affordable housing, particularly in climatic regions requiring both heating and cooling\. This study investigates the influence of building geometry on the operational energy performance of affordable residential housing in Esenyurt, Istanbul, representing Türkiye’s mild\-humid climatic region\. It aims to determine how different residential building typologies influence annual heating, cooling, and overall energy consumption under comparable operating and climatic conditions\. Architectural drawings of five representative residential building typologies, namely U\-shaped, L\-shaped, rectangular, H\-shaped, and triangular buildings, were obtained from the Esenyurt Municipality and modelled using DesignBuilder with the EnergyPlus simulation engine\. All simulation models employed identical material properties, occupancy schedules, HVAC operation, and climatic inputs so that the influence of building form could be examined under comparable operating conditions\. Because representative real\-world buildings were analysed rather than idealized prototypes, differences in building size were addressed by reporting energy performance as energy use intensity \(kWh/m²/year\)\. Simulations were performed using a 20\-year hourly weather dataset obtained from the Turkish State Meteorological Service to capture long\-term climatic conditions representative of Istanbul\. The U\-shaped building demonstrated the lowest overall annual energy use, at 174\.65 kWh/m²·year, indicating an 11\.8% decrease relative to the rectangular baseline\. The superior performance of the U\-shaped configuration is consistent with passive design principles that associate compact building forms and courtyard layouts with improved thermal performance under mild\-humid climatic conditions\. These characteristics collectively decreased heating loads by 9\.5% and cooling loads by 17\.6%\. Conversely, the H\-shaped and triangular configurations demonstrated the lowest levels of efficiency owing to high envelope exposure and insufficient shading, leading to increases of 8\.3% and 14\.5% in total energy consumption, respectively\. The findings contribute to the growing body of knowledge on climate\-responsive residential design by demonstrating how building geometry influences operational energy performance under standardized simulation conditions\. Although the results are specific to Istanbul’s mild\-humid climate and the selected residential typologies, they may assist architects, planners, and housing authorities in incorporating geometry\-based passive design strategies into future affordable housing developments\.

## [Synthetic Strategies Toward Naturally Occurring α\-Pyrones: A Review of Total Syntheses and Methodological Advances](../publications/c85f51306941f5cce26d.md)

Marcilio Wagner Fontes Silva; Jonatas Tavares da Silva; Alécia Regina Andresa Silva; Juliano Carlos Rufino de Freitas; João R\. de Freitas Filho; Clécio Souza Ramos

α\-Pyrones constitute an important class of natural products widely distributed in plants, fungi, bacteria, and marine organisms, exhibiting diverse biological activities, including antimicrobial, anticancer, anti\-inflammatory, antiparasitic, and phytotoxic effects\. Their structural diversity and pharmacological potential have stimulated extensive efforts toward the development of efficient synthetic methodologies\. This review provides an overview of the total syntheses of naturally occurring α\-pyrones reported between 1984 and 2026, covering structurally diverse subclasses, including styrylpyrones, meroterpenoids, macrocyclic α\-pyrones, fused polycyclic systems, and other complex α\-pyrone\-containing natural products\. Particular emphasis is placed on the principal synthetic strategies employed for α\-pyrone construction and target assembly, including aldol condensations, crossmetathesis reactions, transition\-metal\-catalyzed couplings, biomimetic cascade processes, radical cyclizations, Claisen rearrangements, and asymmetric methodologies\. The review compares these approaches in terms of synthetic efficiency, stereochemical control, and methodological innovation\. Key advances in stereoselective and total synthesis are highlighted, demonstrating how modern synthetic methods have enabled access to increasingly complex α\-pyrone architectures with high levels of chemo\-, regio\-, and stereoselectivity\. The review also discusses the contribution of total synthesis to structural confirmation, biological evaluation, and the preparation of analogues for structureactivity relationship studies\. Current challenges, including lengthy synthetic sequences, low overall yields, and scalability limitations, are critically assessed\. Finally, future perspectives are presented, focusing on emerging technologies such as biocatalysis, flow chemistry, C\-H functionalization, electrochemical synthesis, sustainable methodologies, and artificial intelligence\-assisted retrosynthetic planning, which are expected to further advance α\-pyrone synthesis and facilitate drug discovery efforts\.

## [Formation of a culture of academic integrity of future teachers in the process of professional training](../publications/c87288ff4f08e3c58cda.md)

Anna Helesh; Andrii Zinoviiovych Ozarkiv

The purpose of the study is to substantiate the structural components of the culture of academic integrity of future teachers and to determine the pedagogical conditions for its formation in the process of professional training\. The study employed a structured theoretical review of scientific publications and regulatory sources, thematic content analysis, comparative analysis, systematization, and pedagogical modelling\. The analytical corpus consisted of 15 sources, including 5 Ukrainian and 10 international publications, with the majority published between 2022 and 2026\. The results clarify the concept of the culture of academic integrity of a future teacher as an integrative professional and personal characteristic and identify four interrelated structural components: value\-motivational, cognitive, activity\-behavioural, and reflective\. Seven pedagogical conditions for its formation were substantiated: cross\-curricular integration of integrity principles into educational programmes; practice\-oriented teaching of academic writing and information literacy; problem\-based, case\-based, and situational learning; transparent and fair assessment; teachers&\#x27; personal example and institutional consistency; development of critical thinking and responsible use of generative artificial intelligence; and formative assessment combined with reflective practices\. The scientific novelty of the study lies in improving the structural representation of future teachers&\#x27; integrity culture by combining value\-based, cognitive, behavioural, and reflective dimensions and in systematizing pedagogical conditions in response to contemporary challenges associated with generative artificial intelligence\. The practical significance of the results lies in their potential use in developing teacher\-education programmes, course syllabi, learning tasks, assessment criteria, and institutional recommendations for the ethical use of digital technologies\. The proposed framework may also serve as a basis for further empirical diagnostics of the level of formation of the identified components among future teachers\.

## [АКСІОЛОГІЧНІ ВИМІРИ МОРАЛЬНО\-ПРАВОВОЇ ПРОБЛЕМАТИКИ ЦИФРОВОГО СОЦІУМУ](../publications/c875d7e953935e99bb30.md)

Кочетов Л\. Г\.

У статті здійснено філософсько\-правовий аналіз трансформації ціннісних орієнтирів сучасного суспільства в умовах інтенсивної цифровізації\. Автор обґрунтовує тезу, що цифрова трансформація не є лише технічним процесом, а виступає фундаментальним онтологічним викликом, що спричиняє глибоку аксіологічну кризу\. Основна увага приділяється виявленню та аналізу колізій між статичною природою законодавства та динамічним характером цифрової моралі, що особливо гостро проявляється в українському соціокультурному контексті\. Досліджено еволюцію концепту «свобода» у віртуальному просторі – від раннього цифрового лібертаріанства до формування «цифрового Левіафана», де механізми алгоритмічного контролю та тотального моніторингу вступають у суперечність із моральною автономією особистості\. Деталізовано дилему між приватністю та прозорістю, де впровадження концепції «держави у смартфоні» створює ризики об’єктивації людини та перетворення її на «цифровий ресурс», що корелює з ідеями М\. Гайдеґґера про сутність техніки як «поставу»\. Особливий акцент зроблено на питанні справедливості в добу панування алгоритмів штучного інтелекту\. Виявлено моральну колізію, пов’язану із розмиванням суб’єктності та відповідальності у правовому полі, коли автоматизовані системи приймають рішення, що мають доленосний вплив на індивіда\. Аналізується феномен «цифрової солідарності» в Україні як позитивний прояв мережевої етики в умовах війни, який, водночас, межує з деструктивними явищами кібер\-булінгу та «цифрового самосуду»\. Автор стверджує, що правова система України має еволюціонувати в бік «етичного дизайну», де людська гідність виступає головним аксіологічним критерієм оцінки будь\-якої технологічної інновації\. У висновках підкреслюється, що розв&\#x27;язання окреслених колізій можливе лише через утвердження принципів цифрового гуманізму\. Запропонована концептуальна основа для побудови діалогу між законодавцями, розробниками технологій та громадянським суспільством задля гармонізації морально\-правових відносин у цифрову епоху\. Перспективи подальших досліджень пов’язуються з необхідністю розробки нової теорії «цифрових прав» людини, які б гарантували збереження її суб’єктності в умовах тотальної алгоритмізації соціального простору\.

## [Geopolitical risk, green finance, and corporate environmental performance: evidence from global uncertainty shocks](../publications/c876e18e8a9de9001f39.md)

vidura perera

Introduction The growing importance of sustainable finance has intensified interest in understanding how green finance contributes to corporate environmental performance \(CEP\)\. However, prior studies have largely assumed a stable relationship between green finance and environmental outcomes, giving limited attention to the disruptive effects of geopolitical uncertainty\. This study examines the effect of green finance on CEP and investigates whether geopolitical risk alters the effectiveness of green finance across different institutional and industrial contexts\. Methods The study uses a global panel dataset comprising 15,872 firm\-year observations across multiple countries and industries\. The empirical analysis applies fixed\-effects estimation, moderation analysis, System Generalized Method of Moments \(System GMM\), and panel threshold regression\. Industry heterogeneity and governance effects are also examined\. In addition, machine learning techniques, including Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Regression Trees \(GBRT\), XGBoost, and SHAP analysis, are employed to assess predictive performance and identify the relative importance of key determinants of CEP\. Results The findings show that green finance significantly improves corporate environmental performance, while geopolitical risk has a significant negative effect on environmental outcomes\. The interaction between green finance and geopolitical risk is negative and statistically significant, demonstrating that geopolitical uncertainty weakens the environmental effectiveness of green finance\. Panel threshold analysis identifies a critical geopolitical risk threshold of τ = 142\.8, beyond which the positive effect of green finance declines substantially\. Energy\-intensive industries are found to be more vulnerable to geopolitical shocks than non\-energy\-intensive sectors\. Governance quality strengthens the positive environmental effects of green finance and serves as an important resilience mechanism under uncertain conditions\. Among the machine learning models, XGBoost achieves the highest predictive accuracy \(R 2 = 0\.72\), while SHAP analysis identifies green finance, geopolitical risk, and governance quality as the most influential predictors of CEP\. Discussion The results demonstrate that the effectiveness of green finance is conditional rather than uniform across geopolitical and institutional environments\. The study contributes to the sustainable finance literature by introducing and empirically validating the Geopolitical Adaptive Green Finance Effectiveness Theory \(G\-AGFET\), which proposes that the environmental effectiveness of green finance depends on geopolitical stability, governance quality, and institutional resilience\. The findings suggest that policymakers should strengthen governance frameworks and design adaptive green finance mechanisms that remain effective during periods of geopolitical uncertainty\. Investors and corporate managers should similarly incorporate geopolitical risk and institutional quality into sustainable investment and environmental strategy decisions\.

## [Short\-Term Photovoltaic Power Forecasting under Extreme Weather Conditions Based on Feature Mode Decomposition and Adaptive Sparse Self\-Attention](../publications/c8779edba9c53990add3.md)

Xianyong Zha; Yanxu Wang; Hanyang Guo; Tingkai Sun; Tianyu Zhang

Abstract Aiming at the strong non\-stationarity, pronounced abrupt changes, and error accumulation that characterize photovoltaic power series under extreme weather conditions, this paper proposes a shortterm photovoltaic power prediction model, FMD\-LSTM\-ASSA\-Transformer\. First, feature mode decomposition \(FMD\) is employed to perform multiscale decomposition of the original power sequence, and effective modes are selected by combining correlation kurtosis and correlation coefficient, thereby reducing the impact of trend, periodic, and disturbance component aliasing on prediction performance\. Second, long short\-term memory \(LSTM\) is used to extract local temporal features, and an adaptive sparse self\-attention \(ASSA\) mechanism is introduced to improve the model&\#x27;s responsiveness to key abrupt segments such as power dips and rapid recovery\. Finally, Transformer is used to model long\-term dependencies and improve the stability of multi\-step prediction\. Based on measured power and meteorological data from a photovoltaic power station collected during 2020\-2021, extreme\-weather scenarios in four seasons are constructed for validation\. The results show that the proposed model outperforms the comparison models in spring, summer, autumn, and winter\. Taking spring as an example, the model achieves an RMSE of 1\.725 and an MAE of 1\.150, which are 39\.13% and 43\.49% lower than those of LSTM, respectively, while the R² reaches 0\.963\. Decomposition comparison and ablation experiments further demonstrate that FMD and ASSA can effectively improve prediction accuracy and stability\.

## [AUTHENTIC LEADERSHIP AND SDG 16: THEORETICAL EVOLUTION, CRITICISMS, AND FUTURE AVENUES FOR RESEARCHERS](../publications/c87bca948cd2e4e3374d.md)

Jorge Salcedo; Franco Gandolfi; Astrid Garza; Siti Khadijah Mohd Nasrah

Objective: This article critically examines the theoretical evolution, empirical contributions, and principal criticisms of authentic leadership, exploring its relevance to Sustainable Development Goal 16 \(SDG 16\)\. Theoretical Framework: The review traces authentic leadership’s historical origins and conceptual development, examining foundational contributions by George, Luthans and Avolio, Gardner and colleagues, and Walumbwa and colleagues\. It considers integrity, ethical responsibility, and commitment to core values as central elements of the construct\. Method: An integrative literature review synthesizes foundational and contemporary scholarship on authentic leadership, including its theoretical foundations, measurement approaches, empirical contributions, and critical debates\. Results and Discussion: The review examines the formalization of authentic leadership and the development, validation, and widespread use of the Authentic Leadership Questionnaire \(ALQ\)\. It identifies persistent debates concerning conceptual clarity, measurement, and normative assumptions\. It also examines authentic leadership’s potential contribution to SDG 16 through ethical leadership and accountable, transparent, and inclusive institutions\. Research Implications: Future research should strengthen conceptual precision, address measurement limitations, and examine authentic leadership across diverse cultural and institutional contexts\. Further investigation is needed to assess its contribution to institutional accountability and the objectives of SDG 16\. Originality/Value: The article integrates theoretical development and critical perspectives with an explicit focus on SDG 16, offering a foundation for advancing authentic leadership research and examining its institutional relevance\.

## [Institutional student support and psychological well\-being in Chinese vocational colleges: a two\-institution cross\-sectional study](../publications/c87e6effcf4f01261ed9.md)

Wang Hui; Huang Huifeng

Institutional student support is a potentially modifiable feature of the educational environment, but its relationship with distinct forms of positive psychological functioning remains underexamined in vocational higher education\. This two\-institution cross\-sectional study examined associations between perceived quality of institutional student\-support services and the six dimensions of Ryff’s psychological well\-being among 383 students from public vocational colleges in Fujian Province, China\. Students completed an 18\-item Ryff\-based well\-being measure and a contextualized 50\-item service\-quality questionnaire covering accessibility, reliability, responsiveness, assurance, and empathy\. Descriptive analyses addressed students’ well\-being and service\-quality profiles, and six multiple linear regression models examined associations between observed composite scores\. Students reported comparatively stronger positive relations with others and purpose in life, whereas self\-acceptance and personal growth were less favorable\. Support services were generally rated favorably; accessibility was the lowest\-rated service\-quality domain and showed positive adjusted associations with all six well\-being dimensions, whereas the other service\-quality domains showed outcome\-specific patterns\. The models explained 53\.3%–71\.3% of outcome variance\. These large R 2 values should be interpreted cautiously because predictors and outcomes were collected through same\-session self\-report measures and may be affected by common\-method variance or response\-style effects\. The findings identify service access and other service\-quality domains as candidate priorities for institutional assessment, not as evidence that improving accessibility will directly improve well\-being\. Prospective, multi\-source studies with validated measurement models are needed\.

## [Individualized and Platform\-Designated Gene\-Editing Studies in the Registered Clinical Record: A Case\-by\-Case Census Against 148 Eligible Studies](../publications/c8884d1cd9615bd35acf.md)

Oscar Mingtian Li; Yijiang Li

Introduction In February 2025, a single infant with carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1 deficiency received a customized base\-editing therapy, and individualized gene editing has since been discussed as an emerging category of care\. No one has yet counted whether this category exists in the registered study record\. Methods We conducted a cross\-sectional census of interventional studies of human gene\-editing agents registered on ClinicalTrials\.gov\. Records were retrieved through the ClinicalTrials\.gov application programming interface, version 2, with a verbatim, intervention\-scoped query and a fixed census date of 17 September 2026\. Eligibility was verified from each record&\#x27;s own fields, and every exclusion is supported by the field value that justifies it\. Two independent screening passes classified each eligible record as single\-participant or n\-of\-1, multi\-variant umbrella or platform\-designated, or conventional cohort\. Agreement was quantified with Cohen&\#x27;s kappa and a 95% confidence interval \(CI\)\. Records in the individualized and platform classes were re\-verified against their complete registry entries and version histories\. We also searched public US Food and Drug Administration \(FDA\) records for the regulatory route of each census record\. Reporting follows the Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology \(STROBE\) statement\. Results Of 212 retrieved records, 64 were excluded, and 148 were eligible\. Four eligible records were single\-participant or n\-of\-1 designs, and three were multi\-variant umbrella or platform\-designated designs, giving a census of seven studies\. Of the remainder, 140 were conventional cohorts, and one was an editing arm inside a non\-editing platform trial\. Version histories confirmed the four single\-participant designs; one of them reached an enrolment of one through a revision made before enrolment began\. The same histories showed that three other records had an enrolment of one or two only because of termination or under\-enrolment\. Only two of the 148 eligible records describe a construct designed for the individual participant\. No publicly verifiable platform technology designation was located for any census record, and the census query returned no expanded\-access record\. Of 23 studies completed more than 12 months before the census, five had posted results \(21\.7%, Wilson 95% CI: 9\.7%\-41\.9%\); because this interval is wide, the figure is reported as context only\. Agreement on design class was moderate \(kappa, 0\.540; 95% CI, 0\.264\-0\.815\)\. Conclusions Nineteen months after the first individualized CRISPR treatment, the registry contains seven individualized or platform\-designated gene\-editing studies, and only two records describe an individualized construct\. The regulatory pathway used by the index case was not retrievable from the registry, and no regulatory route could be verified from public records; this is an absence of public evidence, not evidence that no route existed\. These counts describe the ClinicalTrials\.gov record, not the prevalence of individualized gene editing, and the design\-class counts are provisional given moderate agreement\.

## [ТРЕХМЕРНАЯ РЕКОНСТРУКЦИЯ И МУЛЬТИМОДАЛЬНЫЙ АНАЛИЗ ДНИЩА ТРАНСПОРТНЫХ СРЕДСТВ](../publications/c893daf65ea452b554df.md)

Е\.Н\. Белкин

При досмотре днища нужно отличать посторонний предмет от штатного рельефа, несмотря на загрязнение, затенение и перемещение узлов подвески\. Обзор посвящен выбору технологий, которые позволяют дополнить изображение метрическими данными и использовать их для обнаружения изменений\. Библиографическая база обзора включает 46 научных публикаций 1992–2026 гг\. Методы сопоставлены по принципу измерения, размерности данных, доступности поверхности для наблюдения и условиям эксплуатации\. Рассмотрены стереоскопия, структурированный свет, лазерная триангуляция, времяпролетные и радиолокационные датчики, дополнительные оптические и тепловые каналы\. Анализ охватывает также совмещение облаков точек, формирование доверенного эталона и поиск аномалий\. Отдельно разобрано ограничение напольной съемки: один ракурс описывает только видимые поверхности, а не полную геометрию днища\. Для стационарного прототипа предложено сочетать несколько лазерных профилометров с линейной RGB/NIR\-съемкой и измерением скорости\. Радар и тепловизор отнесены к подтверждающим каналам\. Составлены классификация представлений и матрица применимости датчиков, определены принципы сравнения с эталоном и показатели натурных испытаний\. Дальнейшие исследования связаны с созданием профильного открытого набора данных, оценкой наблюдаемости, компенсацией движения подвески и регламентированным обновлением эталона\.

## [Source\-Aware Dynamic Pricing with Strategic Buyers](../publications/c89730c1d60efe72254e.md)

Jinjiang Zou; Yang Li; Zemin Zheng

In modern commerce, firms and platforms typically use customer features from different sources to personalize prices: some features are verified using seller records or third\-party data, while others are self\-reported and may be strategically manipulated by buyers seeking lower prices\. We therefore introduce a novel source\-aware framework for contextual dynamic pricing with strategic buyers in a high\-dimensional semiparametric setting, where buyer valuations follow a sparse linear model with an unknown noise distribution\. To account for differences in manipulability across feature sources while enabling effective valuation learning, we develop the Source\-Aware Localized exploration and calibrated Exploitation \(SALE\) pricing policy, which draws on verified features to localize price exploration and combines verified and reported features to correct for strategic manipulation during exploitation\. Our localized exploration design allows converting binary purchase feedback into unbiased signals of conditional mean valuations, yielding a new population equation that supports consistent sparse estimation despite non\-i\.i\.d\. buyer arrivals\. Building on this estimate, we develop a localized empirical\-process analysis that exploits intrinsic sparse geometry to establish uniform guarantees for nonparametric estimation of the noise distribution in the high\-dimensional setting\. With these estimation guarantees, we establish SALE&\#x27;s self\-recovery property, which keeps localized exploration valid with high probability and leads to a sublinear expected regret bound\. Both simulation studies and real\-data experiments demonstrate the appealing performance of SALE\. To the best of our knowledge, our study is the first to provide a theoretical and practical framework for incorporating information provenance into dynamic pricing with strategic buyers\.

## [Machine Learning Versus Deep Learning in Macroeconomic Forecasting: A Global GDP Growth Application](../publications/c89df91ed64b101c4a43.md)

Fazale Naeem; Muhammad Naveed; Muhammad Fayez; Santosh Prasad Sah

This study compares regularized linear, tree\-based ensemble, boosting, and feed\-forward neural\-network approaches for forecasting country\-level annual GDP growth using a global panel covering 213 countries from 2010 to 2023\. A chronological out\-of\-sample evaluation is employed, with models trained on observations through 2021 and tested on 401 country\-year observations from 206 countries during 2022–2023\. Ridge regression, Random Forest, Histogram\-Based Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, and a multi\-layer perceptron \(MLP\) are evaluated using root mean squared error \(RMSE\)\. Ridge regression records the lowest observed test RMSE \(5\.50\), followed by Histogram\-Based Gradient Boosting \(6\.28\), Random Forest \(6\.75\), AdaBoost \(7\.13\), and the MLP \(8\.12\)\. AdaBoost is treated as a classical boosting\-based machine\-learning method, whereas the MLP serves as the neural\-network benchmark\. The baseline models use one\-year lags, while AdaBoost and the MLP use one\-to\-three\-year lag windows\. Consequently, the observed ranking reflects differences in both model specifications and information sets and should not be interpreted as a strictly like\-for\-like comparison or evidence of statistical superiority\. Within this annual panel, predictor set, and 2022–2023 evaluation period, greater model complexity is not associated with lower forecast errors\. The findings highlight the practical importance of regularization, model parsimony, and chronological evaluation in country\-level macroeconomic forecasting\.

## [Electron‐Withdrawing Crystalline Pd/Amorphous PdS Drives Dynamic Electron Buffering and Sulfur Locking for Stable CO 2 ‐to‐Formate Reduction](../publications/c8b05a3cf6fa33b4c795.md)

Manli Wang; Hang Zhao; Jinhua Lei; Jiahui Deng; Lulu Hao; Jinfeng Zhang; Zelin Chen; Haozhi Wang; Changjiu Li; Xuerong Zheng; Yida Deng

ABSTRACT Sulfur leaching from metal sulfide electrocatalysts undermines formate intermediate stability during CO 2 reduction, yet existing protection strategies remain static\. Here, we introduce an interfacial dynamic locking mechanism that actively stabilizes sulfur under reaction conditions\. By constructing a crystalline‐amorphous Pd‐PdS heterostructure, the interface triggers electron redistribution from the crystalline Pd core to the amorphous PdS shell\. This electron‐withdrawing effect continuously extracts electrons from the Pd core, creating an interfacial electron deficiency that drives dynamic electron buffering\. This electronic buffering effect transforms the Pd core into a dynamic electron reservoir, reinforcing Pd–S bonds under operating conditions\. Using crystalline Pd/amorphous PdS \(c‐Pd/a‐PdS\) nanowires as a model system, we demonstrate that this strategy suppresses sulfur dissolution and creates electronically optimized Pd sites favorable for formate production\. At an optimal 2 nm shell thickness, the catalyst retains 90% of its initial sulfur and delivers a formate Faradaic efficiency of 77\.5% at −0\.6 V versus reversible hydrogen electrode, with far less sulfur leaching than a pure amorphous counterpart\. Density functional theory calculations confirm this interfacial locking lowers the \* OCHO formation energy by 0\.35 eV while suppressing CO and H 2 pathways\. This work shifts sulfur stabilization from static defense to dynamic electrochemical buffering, offering a general design principle for durable CO 2 reduction electrocatalysts\.

## [Taylorism reloaded?](../publications/c8bed2cedefa6d23ce96.md)

Sander Junte; Óscar Molina Romo

The diffusion of artificial intelligence, data analytics and digital technologies in manufacturing has revived debates about the impact of technological change on work and employment relations\. This article examines the implementation of Industry 4\.0 technologies in a Spanish train manufacturing company and analyses their implications for workers and their representatives\. Drawing on Labour Process Theory and industrial relations literature, the study is based on a qualitative case study including interviews with workers, works council members and technical staff\. The findings show that the transition to Industry 4\.0 primarily involved the implementation of a Manufacturing Execution System \(MES\), which digitalised production processes and data collection\. Rather than increasing worker autonomy, the system reinforced Taylorist principles through greater standardisation, monitoring and performance measurement\. The study also finds that worker representatives played a limited role in regulating technological change despite the existence of formal information and consultation rights\. The article argues that technological opacity, institutional constraints and the prioritisation of traditional bargaining issues limit the capacity of worker representatives to influence the governance of workplace technologies\.

## [NoveltyScope: A Multi\-Agent Research Assistant for Evidence\-Grounded Novelty Assessment of Scientific Papers](../publications/c8c9d80263741db4bcca.md)

Yueran Tian; Huizhi Liang

NoveltyScope is a prototype that compares a scientific paper with retrieved prior work and produces a structured report and a five\-level novelty score\. The system extracts the core task and at most two author\-claimed contributions, then searches a closed local corpus using BM25 and dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion\. Contribution comparisons request paired passages for potential refutations, and quotations are checked against cached source text\. Four scoring roles \(Prosecutor, Defender, Judge, and Critic\) use the resulting evidence, with at most one revision of the Judge&\#x27;s score\. Evaluation uses 50 class\-balanced RINoBench samples whose idea\-level labels are retained for full\-paper input\. Mean absolute error is 1\.48 and 1\.26 for single\-LLM and multi\-agent scoring with Gemini, respectively, and 1\.22 and 1\.16 with Qwen3\. The vector\-similarity baseline has an error of 1\.68\. A HiCLIP case study illustrates the contribution comparisons and paired evidence passages\. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of evidence\-grounded novelty assessment and show that the multi\-agent configurations achieve lower scoring errors than their single\-LLM counterparts across both evaluated models\.

## [Data\-Driven Marketing Analytics](../publications/c8ca0d8e816a9462a5d5.md)

Selçuk Burak Haşıloğlu

Data ‑ Driven Marketing Analytics: Research Methods and Analytical Tools bridges the gap between traditional marketing research and modern big data analytics, offering a step‑by‑step guide to transforming data into actionable insights\. Readers will gain practical skills to design and manage research projects, predict customer behavior, and uncover hidden patterns in purchasing data\. This book delivers these benefits through hands‑on exercises, shareable datasets, and visual workflows, ensuring accessibility for users without coding experience\. Key features include real‑world case studies, interactive examples, and tools for segmentation, forecasting, and strategic decision‑making\. This book is tailored for postgraduate students, researchers, and marketing professionals seeking to master data‑driven decision‑making\. It is ideal for advanced courses in Marketing Analytics, Management Information Systems, and Business Statistics\. This book is supported by a comprehensive online repository containing over 100 ready\-to‑use files, including datasets, Excel solutions, SPSS files, and Orange workflows\.

## [SEED\-DERIVED ACTIVATED CARBONS FOR SUSTAINABLE SUPERCAPACITORS: STRUCTURE\-PERFORMANCE RELATIONSHIPS AND EMERGING OPPORTUNITIES](../publications/c8d4310316831495d453.md)

Abdulmalik Yusuf; Lawal Sa’adu; Maduka Nosike C\.; Isa I Ajibade; Saifullahi Abdulwahab; Kamal Hassan Sarkinpawa; Abdullahi Lawal Maidoki

The search for sustainable and low\-cost electrode materials has accelerated interest in biomass\-derived activated carbons for electrochemical supercapacitors\.Seeds and seed\-processing residues form a particularly promising precursor class because they combine renewable carbon, naturally evolved microstructures and, in many cases, protein\-or oxygen\-rich chemistry that can influence heteroatom content after carbonisation\.This mini\-review critically examines seed\-derived activated carbons with emphasis on synthesis, activation chemistry, pore development, surface functionality and the relationships between material structure and electrochemical response\.Recent examples from Lapsi, jackfruit, lotus, Eucalyptus, date, Terminalia chebula, peach, Zanthoxylum armatum, Chaenomeles cathayensis, mango and Albizia lebbeck seeds show that well\-engineered carbons can deliver gravimetric capacitances above 300 𝐹𝑔 \!&quot; under laboratory three\-electrode conditions, together with strong rate capability and long cycling life\.The literature also shows that Brunauer\-Emmett\-Teller surface area alone is not a sufficient predictor of performance: accessible microporosity, mesoporous transport pathways, pore\-size/electrolyte matching, electrical conductivity and surface functional groups act jointly\.Particular attention is given to Mucuna urens\(bull\-eye\), whose high carbohydrate and protein content provides a plausible carbon and heteroatom\-rich precursor\.Current searches reveal very limited peer\-reviewed electrochemical literature on M\. urens\-derived supercapacitor carbons, although recent work has begun to examine its conversion to high\-surface\-area activated carbon\.The review therefore identifies M\. urens as an emerging research opportunity and proposes a precursor\-toperformance framework for its systematic study\.Key needs for the field include greener activation, standardised electrochemical reporting, realistic mass loading, two\-electrode device validation, reproducibility, life\-cycle assessment and scale\-up\.

## [Information literacy as an epistemic negotiation of the utilization of artificial intelligence at Institut Pertanian Stiper Library](../publications/c8dc83f94aec8c0f97ec.md)

Helmi Afroda; \- Ayuna Meilawati

Purpose\. This study aims to examine and conceptually explain how information literacy functions as an epistemic negotiation mechanism in AI\-mediated academic environments\. Methods: This qualitative case study was conducted at the Institut Pertanian Stiper \(INSTIPER\) Yogyakarta Library using semi\-structured interviews with lecturers and students, supported by institutional documents on information literacy and AI\-related academic policies\. The data were analyzed thematically through transcription, coding, categorization, and interpretative analysis\. Findings\. The findings demonstrate that information literacy functions as an epistemic negotiation mechanism through which lecturers, researchers, and students critically evaluate, verify, and justify AI\-generated knowledge before integrating it into academic practice\. The study further reveals that the INSTIPER Yogyakarta Library has evolved beyond its conventional role as an information service to an institutional actor that strengthens AI literacy, mediates institutional AI governance, promotes data ethics and digital information security, and supports responsible knowledge production\. Implications\. The principal contribution of this study lies in conceptualizing information literacy as an epistemic negotiation mechanism that connects the institutional epistemic role of academic libraries with AI governance and individual scholarly judgment\. This conceptual framework extends current discussions beyond AI adoption and AI literacy, providing a foundation for developing evidence\-based information literacy programs and institutional AI governance that strengthen academic integrity in higher education\.

## [Reconstructing the Pesantren\-Based Madrasah Curriculum for Character Development](../publications/c8de671503c68c968a83.md)

Ainun Napisa; Muhammad Ansori; Muhammad Rusydi

Contemporary Islamic education continues to face challenges in strengthening students&\#x27; character development through integrated educational systems\. This study aimed to analyze \(1\) the reconstruction of a pesantren\-based madrasah curriculum, \(2\) student management, and \(3\) character habituation at MTs Unggulan Al\-Qodiri 1 Jember\. A qualitative approach with a single\-case study design was employed\. The study was conducted from July to September and involved 10 informants, consisting of the madrasah principal, vice principal for curriculum, vice principal for student affairs, ustadz and ustadzah \(teachers\), pesantren administrators, mudabbir/mudabbirah \(dormitory supervisors\), and students\. Data were collected through semi\-structured interviews, participant observation, and document analysis and analyzed using the interactive model of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña\. The findings indicate that curriculum reconstruction was implemented through the integration of the national and pesantren curricula, the alignment of school and dormitory regulations, and the establishment of the Organisasi Pelajar Pondok dan Madrasah \(OPPM\) within a unified institutional system\. Student management involved integrated planning, 24\-hour supervision, and continuous character assessment supported by monitoring books, integrated report cards, and joint graduation\. Character habituation was fostered through religious practices, discipline, honesty, and social etiquette reinforced by the hidden curriculum, teacher role modelling, dormitory life, and continuous supervision\. The study concludes that integrating curriculum reconstruction, student management, and character habituation within a unified pesantren\-based educational system effectively strengthens students&\#x27; character development\. These findings contribute to the development of an integrated curriculum reconstruction model for strengthening character education in pesantren\-based madrasahs\.

## [Segmentasi Semantik Biner Banjir pada Citra UAV: Evaluasi Multi\-Seed dan Studi Ablasi dengan Attention U\-Net](../publications/c8e222eba20163d2720b.md)

Singgih Arya Mahendra; Ricardus Anggi Pramunendar

Latar belakang: Deteksi area banjir dari citra Unmanned Aerial Vehicle \(UAV\) menghadapi tantangan class imbalance, batas genangan yang tidak beraturan, dan biaya kesalahan yang asimetris antara false negative dan false positive\. Pada situasi bencana, kegagalan mendeteksi area tergenang \(false negative\) berisiko jauh lebih fatal dibandingkan alarm palsu \(false positive\)\. Namun, model yang secara sistematis memprioritaskan recall sekaligus terbukti stabil secara berulang masih jarang dieksplorasi\. Tujuan: Penelitian ini mengusulkan pendekatan segmentasi semantik biner yang memadukan arsitektur Attention U\-Net, backbone ResNet50 pra\-latih, dan perhitungan Focal Tversky Loss \(α = 0,3; β = 0,7; γ = 1,33\) untuk menekan angka kegagalan deteksi\. Metode: Metode ini divalidasi pada Flood Semantic Segmentation Dataset \(FSSD\) melalui evaluasi berulang tiga kali \(multi\-seed\) dan uji statistik studi ablasi 2x2\. Hasil: Hasilnya membuktikan kinerja yang tinggi dan stabil dengan F1\-score 95,91%, IoU 93,67%, serta recall 97,09% yang konsisten melampaui presisi sebesar 95,36%, dengan simpangan baku F1\-score maupun IoU yang sangat kecil yaitu 0,17%\. Studi ablasi menegaskan bahwa Focal Tversky Loss \(FTL\) merupakan penggerak utama tingginya recall\. Kesimpulan: Metode usulan terbukti stabil dan dapat direproduksi pada berbagai proses pelatihan\. Penelitian ini berkontribusi pada pengembangan kerangka segmentasi berorientasi recall yang divalidasi secara ketat—mengintegrasikan studi ablasi 2×2, evaluasi multi\-seed, dan pengujian statistik—sehingga cocok untuk sistem peringatan bencana yang tidak mentoleransi kegagalan deteksi \(false negative\)\.

## [Assessing adherence and identifying barriers to breast cancer screening among females in the central region \(Riyadh\) of Saudi Arabia: a cross\-sectional study](../publications/c8efb7953368fdf0aa42.md)

Jehad A\. Aldali

Background Breast cancer is a frequent female malignancy worldwide\. Central Saudi women can benefit from breast cancer screening\. This study examines adult women’s adherence to breast cancer screening standards and the main impediments to participation\. Methods A cross\-sectional online survey was conducted in the Central Region \(Riyadh\) of Saudi Arabia from 13 September 2025 to 28 February 2026\. Results 404 people took the survey\. The majority of participants were younger than 30 years \(37\.9%\), followed by participants aged 40–49 \(23\.8%\)\. Most participants \(96\.5–99\.5%\) endorsed the listed benefits of breast cancer screening, whereas 66\.1% reported knowing how to screen for breast cancer\. Most participants supported screening even in the absence of symptoms \(86\.4%\) and reported that they would follow a doctor’s recommendation \(84\.9%\)\. Regular mammography was reported by 21\.5% of the full sample and by 43\.1% of participants aged ≥40 years\. The most frequently reported barrier was believing that screening was unnecessary in the absence of symptoms \(69\.8%\), followed by fear of examination \(55\.2%\), time constraints \(49\.0%\), and fear of the results \(48\.8%\)\. Conclusion Participants generally recognized the importance of breast cancer screening, but screening practices remained limited\. Commonly reported concerns included the belief that screening was unnecessary without symptoms, fear of examination and results, and time constraints\. These findings suggest that awareness alone may not be sufficient to improve screening uptake\.

This article examines the clinical\-psychological determinants of cognitive development in children aged 8–11, focusing on diagnostic criteria and the relationships between cognitive functioning and psycho\-emotional well\-being\. The main components of cognitive development, including voluntary attention, working memory, executive functions, inhibitory control, and non\-verbal reasoning, are considered from neuropsychological and developmental perspectives\. The diagnostic framework described in the research material includes Raven’s Coloured Progressive Matrices, the Bourdon Cancellation Test, the Digit Span subtest of the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children, the Stroop Color–Word Interference Test, and Goodman’s Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire \(SDQ\)\. The empirical data presented in the source material are used to examine associations among cognitive performance, emotional symptoms, hyperactivity, and inattention\. The reported findings suggest that emotional distress and difficulties in attentional regulation may be associated with working\-memory performance and cognitive control\. The article emphasizes that learning difficulties should not be interpreted solely in terms of intellectual ability\. A comprehensive clinical\-psychological assessment should also consider emotional, behavioral, and social factors\. Practical recommendations are proposed for the integrated assessment of cognitive development, early identification of potential risk factors, and the development of individualized psycho\-corrective interventions\. The reported statistical results should be interpreted in accordance with the quality and verifiability of the underlying empirical data\.
