## [The dynamics of psychomotor development in children from the Rostov region during the first year of life with borderline TREC and KREC marker values based on neonatal screening results](../publications/e71bbd291a4a6b6d479a.md)

Gyuzyal Sh\. Gafiyatullina; Galina B\. Evdokimova; Пузикова Олеся Зиновьевна; Elena Kizhevatova; Karina S\. Karakhanyan; V\. P\. Evdokimov

The aim of the study: To study the timing of psychomotor development indicators in the first year of life among clinically healthy children from the Rostov region with borderline\-low TREC and KREC values based on neonatal advanced screening\. Research methodology: A retrospective assessment of outpatient records of 294 children who underwent advanced neonatal screening at the Medical and Genetic Center of Rostov State Medical University was carried out\. In all children TREC and KREC values exceeded the thresholds for the diagnosis of primary immunodeficiency, while 55 people had both of these indicators below the reference values \(group 1\), 76 children had only a decrease in TREC levels \(group 2\), 73 subjects had only a decrease in KREC levels \(group 3\), and in 90 children, both of these markers were within the reference values \(control group\)\. The timing of psychomotor development assessment was carried out at 1, 3, 6, 9, and 12 months\. Statistical analysis included calculation of Odds Ratio \(OR\) and 95 % Confidence Intervals \(CI\)\. The results of the research: Specific characteristics of psychomotor development rates depending on the initial TREC and KREC indicators have been detected\. Children in Group 1 showed statistically significant advanced motor functions \(gaze fixation at 1 mo: OR = 0\.045; 95 % CI: 0\.003–0\.798; independent walking at 12 month: OR = 0\.22; 95 % CI: 0\.05–0\.97\) and delayed formation of neuropsychic functions \(a delay in the formation of a revival complex at 1 month and active speech at 12 mo: OR = 3\.78; 95 % CI: 1\.22–11\.7\) compared to the control group \(p 0\.05\)\. In groups 2 and 3 the indicators occupied an intermediate position \(p 0\.05\)\. Conclusions: Borderline decreased values of TREC and KREC at birth are associated with the peculiarities of psychomotor development of children in the first year of life\. Consequently these markers of functional maturity of the lymphocytic link can serve as predictors of individual developmental trajectories\.

## [Geçici Organizasyonlarda Koordinasyonun Çok Boyutlu Yapısı: Yapısal, İlişkisel ve Dijital Modeller Üzerine Bir İnceleme](../publications/e72cf962cf5d648bfb4b.md)

Ali Görgün

Örgütler, ortak hedeflere ulaşmak için bir araya gelen bireylerden oluşur; örgütsel yapı ise bu hedeflere yönelik faaliyetlerin uyum ve koordinasyonunu sağlamak üzere gelişir\. Yapı, iş bölümü ve uzmanlaşmayla verimliliği artırırken koordinasyon ihtiyacını da doğurur\. Hiyerarşik yapılar bu dengeyi sağlayan klasik bir mekanizma olsa da günümüzde merkezileşme–merkezsizleşme ayrımını aşan hibrit ve esnek modeller öne çıkmaktadır\. Günümüzde geçici organizasyonlar, kalıcı örgüt anlayışını dönüştürerek karmaşık görevleri sınırlı süreli iş birlikleriyle yerine getiren yapılar hâline gelmiştir\. Bu yapılarda karşılıklı bağımlılık, eş zamanlı öğrenme ve koordinasyonu zorunlu kılar; etkin koordinasyon, yenilik ve adaptasyonun ön koşuludur\. Geçici organizasyonlar özgün yapılar ve koordinasyon mekanizmaları geliştirirken, proje yönetim sistemleri bileşenler arası uyum ve etkileşimle değer üretir\. Kurumlar arası projelerde merkezî veya ağ temelli yapılar öne çıkarken, profesyonel topluluklar ve sosyal ağlar koordinasyonu destekler\. Geçici organizasyonların etkinliği; koordinasyon, motivasyon, çatışma yönetimi ve ortak hedeflere bütünleşme kapasitesine bağlıdır\. Ancak farklı çıkarlar ve kurumsal geçmişler gerilim yaratarak koordinasyonu zorlaştırır\. Bu çalışma, geçici organizasyonlarda koordinasyonun yapısal, ilişkisel, süreç, ağ ve dijital boyutlarını kuramsal olarak inceleyerek farklı modellerin hangi koşullarda daha etkili olabileceğini tartışmaktadır\.

## [An innovative UBFEM–ANN approach for slope stability evaluation and slip surface prediction of frictional soil slopes](../publications/e7323031a1611d70ea05.md)

Feng Yang; Mengtian Peng; Lianheng Zhao; Qi Peng; Taizhong Zhang; Zhanheng Ding

To address the limitations of existing machine learning approaches in simultaneously predicting slope stability and failure characteristics, this study proposes an efficient framework for slope failure characteristic prediction by integrating upper\-bound finite element limit analysis \(UBFEM\) with an artificial neural network \(ANN\)\. A local six\-node, sixfold\-path discontinuous triangular mesh is employed to exploit the complementary advantages of plastic elements and velocity discontinuities in critical slip surface identification\. The sliding body is subsequently identified based on velocity discontinuities, enabling the construction of a high\-fidelity dataset of primary slope failure characteristics\. A dataset comprising 1008 parameter combinations of classical homogeneous frictional soil slopes is used to train the machine learning models\. The results demonstrate that the optimized model maintains excellent predictive performance across different slope geometries and soil strength conditions, achieving an 𝑅 2 of 0\.999 and an RMSE of 0\.356 for critical unit weight prediction, while the mean relative error MRE of the sliding body area prediction is only 0\.036\. Furthermore, the Hausdorff distance is employed to quantify error propagation during the reconstruction of the critical slip surface, while permutation feature importance \(PFI\) and SHapley additive explanations \(SHAP\) are combined to quantitatively evaluate the effects of input parameters on slope stability and slip surface geometry\. The proposed UBFEM–ANN framework therefore provides an effective and interpretable approach for predicting slope stability, critical slip surface geometry, and sliding body area\.

## [Impact of malnutrition and nutritional support on infectious complications in critically ill infants and children](../publications/e737d874f424a6032320.md)

Jason S\. Kerstein; Julia K\. Weld; Daniel T\. Mulhall; Jennifer J\. Lee; Anastasia E\. Allfather; Sarah U\. Morton; Enid E\. Martinez; Kimberly I\. Mills

Children with critical illness are vulnerable to nutritional deficits, which may contribute to increased susceptibility to infection, impaired immune function and delayed recovery\. Optimizing nutritional support during acute illness is therefore essential to improving clinical outcomes\. The complex interplay between critical illness, nutrition and infection is nuanced and requires careful consideration to minimize morbidity and mortality\. In this narrative review, we synthesize current evidence and considerations regarding optimizing nutritional management to minimize infectious complications across neonatal and pediatric intensive care settings\.

## [Teacher\-guided Pseudo\-supervised Dance Human Video Segmentation via Open\-vocabulary Localization and SAM2 Masklet Propagation](../publications/e737da5ecf76f5012270.md)

Li Dongze; G\. Barbaatar

Dance videos combine rapid non\-rigid motion, limb crossings, deformable costumes, and changing illumination, which make human segmentation vulnerable to boundary loss, identity switches, and temporal flicker\.We present DanceMask\-SAM, a teacher\-guided pseudo\-supervised framework that constructs dance pseudo supervision without frame\-wise masks from target training videos\.Offline, open\-vocabulary localization provides global\-human and local\-structure prompts, and overlapping bidirectional SAM2 masklets provide redundant candidates\.Prompt credibility, dance\-aware reliability, and disagreement arbitration assign candidates to hard supervision, weak consistency, or rejection\.Online, a fixed MobileNetV3\-Large\-FPN student uses single RGB frames only and therefore requires no text prompt, SAM2, or pose estimator at deployment\.On the manually reviewed test protocol, the complete student obtains 0\.872 mIoU, 0\.875 J&amp;F, and 0\.061 MFR; across three seeds, the corresponding means are 0\.874, 0\.877, and 0\.061\.The final student is close to, but does not exceed, the teacher\-fused pseudo\-label quality reported for reliability plus arbitration \(0\.874 mIoU and 0\.876 J&amp;F\)\.Video\-level, Bonferroni\-corrected tests support the reported comparisons within the stated split\.External validation on Zhuang ethnic dance videos yields 0\.824 J&amp;F, confirming transfer under domain shift\.Threshold\-frozen protocol details, baseline interaction budgets, reliability sensitivity, risk\-coverage bands with video\-level confidence intervals, teacher compute cost and failure boundaries are reported in Section IV\.The contribution is limited to pseudo\-supervision construction and training decisions under teacher\-guided pseudo\-labels, rather than a new foundation model, a new student architecture, or a self\-supervised representation\-learning result\.

## [STUDY OF THE ROLE OF SERVICE QUALITY AND CUSTOMER SATISFACTION IN FORMING CUSTOMER LOYALTY](../publications/e738f3d2bdeb5cc2deba.md)

Serma Serma; Setriana Setriana; Rahmadani Hidayat

Customer loyalty is one of the foundations of long\-term business sustainability, particularly in the service sector, which relies on interpersonal relationships and quality service processes\. This study examines in\-depth the role of service quality and customer satisfaction in shaping customer loyalty through a comprehensive literature review approach\. The theoretical study was conducted by examining models of relationships between variables from national and international literature, as well as relevant previous research published in the last ten years\. The method used was a qualitative library research approach, examining key theories from books, indexed journals, and other scientific sources that describe the interaction between service quality, customer satisfaction, and loyalty\. The results concluded that service quality is the dominant factor determining customer satisfaction, while customer satisfaction plays a key mediator in shaping long\-term loyalty\. This study contributes to the literature by presenting a theoretical and empirical synthesis that can serve as a basis for further research and the development of strategies to increase customer loyalty\.Loyalitas pelanggan merupakan salah satu fondasi keberlanjutan bisnis dalam jangka panjang, terutama pada sektor jasa yang mengandalkan hubungan interpersonal dan kualitas proses layanan\. Penelitian ini mengkaji secara mendalam bagaimana peran kualitas layanan dan kepuasan pelanggan dalam membentuk loyalitas pelanggan melalui pendekatan kajian pustaka yang komprehensif\. Kajian teori dilakukan dengan menelaah model hubungan antarvariabel dari literatur nasional maupun internasional serta penelitian terdahulu yang relevan dan dipublikasikan dalam sepuluh tahun terakhir\. Metode yang digunakan adalah metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan library research, mengkaji teori\-teori utama dari buku, jurnal terindeks, dan sumber ilmiah lainnya yang mendeskripsikan interaksi antara kualitas layanan, kepuasan pelanggan, dan loyalitas\. Hasil penelitian menyimpulkan bahwa kualitas layanan merupakan faktor dominan yang menentukan kepuasan pelanggan, sementara kepuasan pelanggan berperan sebagai mediator penting dalam membentuk loyalitas jangka panjang\. Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi literatur dengan menyajikan sintesis teoritis dan empiris yang dapat dijadikan landasan penelitian selanjutnya maupun penyusunan strategi peningkatan loyalitas pelanggan\.

## [Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of CO2 Solubility in Physical Absorbents Based on Sequential Models](../publications/e739d8d37e2f90b7586c.md)

Yijia Shao; Lei Wang; Ruxing Gao; KiWon Jun; Chundong Zhang

Abstract Methanol\-based physical absorption processes for industrial decarbonization usually require harsh low\-temperature conditions, highlighting the need for screening efficient absorbents under mild conditions\. Machine learning has accelerated solvent screening; however, challenges in prediction accuracy and interpretability still remain\. To this end, sequential models \(RNN and GRU\) were developed by treating the temperature and pressure as ordered inputs to capture the thermodynamic dependence of CO2 solubility\. Compared with baseline models \(multilayer perceptron \(MLP\) and XGBoost\), the sequential models exhibit excellent performance in the high\-CO2 solubility region, particularly the GRU model, which achieved a high R2 of 0\.9866\. To better understand the structure governing CO2 solubility, Shapley additive explanation \(SHAP\) analysis based on molecular descriptor \(MD\) and group contribution \(GC\) representations was conducted, which revealed negative contributions from hydroxyl groups and positive effects from carbonyl groups and ether bonds\. Furthermore, we identified several promising absorbents \(e\.g\., methyl acetate, dimethoxyethane, and acetylacetone\) under relatively mild conditions, providing a reliable framework for absorbent screening\.

## [ВІЙНА ТА АЛГОРИТМІЧНЕ ЗАМІЩЕННЯ ПРИСУТНОСТІ: СОЦІАЛЬНО\-ФІЛОСОФСЬКИЙ АНАЛІЗ ОСВІТНЬОГО ДОСВІДУ СТУДЕНТІВ](../publications/e73c1eb32332395f712f.md)

ВІТАЛІЙ ЯКИМЧУК

У статті обґрунтовано, що війна та поширення систем штучного інтелекту утворюють для українського студента не два паралельні контексти, а одну умову освітнього досвіду\. Мета статті полягає в тому, щоб обґрунтувати розуміння війни та епохи штучного інтелекту як єдиної умови освітнього досвіду українського студента і розкрити, яким чином алгоритмічне заміщення інституційної присутності змінює структуру освітнього відношення\. Показано, що після 2022 року незакритими залишилися чотири функції освітнього відношення, які раніше забезпечувалися самим фактом інституційної присутності: функції місця, часу, доступності відповіді та авторитетного свідчення\. Дві перші досить швидко отримали технічні розв’язки, тоді як дві останні технічного еквівалента не мають, і саме в них увійшла алгоритмічна інстанція\. Виявлено, що таке входження змінює не обсяг, а модальність освітнього відношення: відношення, яке раніше було ризикованим і могло не відбутися, стає гарантованим, проте гарантія купується усуненням тієї непевності, завдяки якій відношення й було освітнім\. Запропоновано поняття воєнного імперативу як третьої дискурсивної фігури поряд з імперативом неминучості та обіцянкою покращення навчання\. На відміну від них, воєнний імператив вимагає зберегти освітній процес за будь\-яку ціну, чим надає технологічному заміщенню моральне виправдання і робить його критику соціально незручною\. Уточнено поняття штучної освіти стосовно українських обставин, де вона постає не наслідком недбалості, а побічним продуктом сумлінного намагання втримати навчання, через що потребує структурного, а не морального критерію розпізнавання\. Таким критерієм запропоновано збереження скінченності: технічне посередництво залишається посередництвом доти, доки крізь нього проступає той, хто може не зрозуміти, помилитися й відповісти за помилку\. Обґрунтовано три нормативні орієнтири освітньої політики воєнного та повоєнного часу, а саме критерії скінченності, свідчення та оборотності, які конкретизують етику стриманостей у сфері співжиття людини з технічними системами\. Окремо аргументовано, що надія як освітня інфраструктура потребує свідка, здатного ризикувати власним майбутнім, і що алгоритмічна інстанція такого свідчення не забезпечує\.

## [Long Noncoding RNA: An Uncharted Territory in Plant Diseases and Immunity](../publications/e745dc161fe2937b9b6b.md)

B\. Jeevan; Satyaki Biswas; Raghu Shivappa; Sarkar Subrata; Meera Kumari Kar; Kutubuddin A\. Molla

Long noncoding RNAs \(lncRNAs\) are a class of transcripts longer than 200 nucleotides with little or no protein\-coding capacity\. They represent a substantial fraction of eukaryotic genomes and function as molecular architects that coordinate diverse biological processes and physiological plasticity, including multilayered plant defence systems, through versatile regulatory interactions at multiple levels of gene regulation\. Recent advances in high\-throughput RNA sequencing technologies have greatly expanded the identification of plant lncRNAs, revealing their diverse roles as scaffolds, decoys, guides, and regulatory molecules\. These lncRNAs are increasingly recognised as integral components of plant immune systems, contributing critically to host defence mechanisms\. This review highlights recent progress in lncRNA identification using computational pipelines as well as emerging artificial intelligence \(AI\) and machine learning \(ML\) based approaches\. We further explore current insights into the regulatory functions of lncRNAs during host\-pathogen interactions\. Notably, we discuss a paradigm\-shifting discovery in lncRNA biology, the finding that many lncRNAs, once presumed to be non\-coding, contain small open reading frames \(sORFs\) that encode functional micropeptides\. Modern predictive modelling has been crucial to identify these sORFs and their peptide products and to show that lncRNAs have multiple functions as regulatory transcripts and peptide precursors in plant immunity\.

## [Boosting Vocabulary Mastery: ChatGPT’s Role in Advancing EFL Learners’ Language Skills](../publications/e755c5fc5d48034a5cb1.md)

Ali Al Ghaithi; Behnam Behforouz

This study attempted to implement artificial intelligence in language learning using the well\-known ChatGPT\. This study focused on measuring the effects of ChatGPT on vocabulary size and depth of knowledge\. To collect the required data, 60 Omani intermediate EFL learners were divided equally into control and experimental groups\. An updated vocabulary level test \(UVLT\), developed by Webb et al\. \(2017\), and a Word Associate Test \(WAT\) developed by Read \(1998\) were used as the pretests to ensure the homogeneity of students’ vocabulary knowledge\. Although both groups continued the traditional face\-to\-face training, the experimental group had the opportunity to use ChatGPT as a facilitator of vocabulary learning with the chance of tailored and personalized activities\. The UVLT and WAT were administered again as posttests to compare learners’ performance after the treatment\. The findings revealed that both groups showed increases in the posttest regarding vocabulary size, but the experimental group outperformed the control group remarkably\. Although no progress was made in the depth of vocabulary by the control group, the experimental group performed significantly better\. The findings are insightful for teachers, curriculum designers, students, researchers, institutions, and policymakers\.

## [Broadening the understanding of affect: a critical review of the embodied and social aspects of affect in information behaviour and practices](../publications/e75c2d1dc61809199502.md)

Aira Huttunen

Introduction\. The concept of affect has been discussed in information behaviour and practice research as an ongoing research trend from 2000s\. However, the definitions of affect remain vague\. This critical review extends the current use of the concept for making sense of people’s affective models in empirical research in library and information science\. Method and analysis\. Nine studies focusing on affect in information practice or behaviour research are introduced and analysed with the aim of understanding how the concept has been defined, empirically studied, and its relation to embodiment and social aspects\. Results\. In the selected studies, affect is understood either as a personal phenomenon or as a social phenomenon\. The role of embodiment in these studies is discussed to understand the connections between affect and embodiment\. This paper discusses selective strands of the concept of affect and the nuances of prior understandings, discussing them through a gender studies lens\. Conclusions\. This conceptual paper suggests that affect theory, following the feminist strand that highlights the embodiment, social structures, and power imbalances, would benefit empirical research on information behaviour or practice research as it enables understanding the complexity of lived experiences in social reality\.

## [Born, Rainer \(ed\.\): Artificial Intelligence: The Case Against](../publications/e765a98399f2f3a8418d.md)



The purpose of this book, originally published in 1987, was to contribute to the advance of artificial intelligence by clarifying and removing the major sources of philosophical confusion at the time which continued to preoccupy scientists and thereby impede research\. Unlike the vast majority of philosophical critiques of AI, however, each of the authors in this volume has made a serious attempt to come to terms with the scientific theories that have been developed, rather than attacking superficial &\#x27;straw men&\#x27; which bear scant resemblance to the complex theories that have been developed\. For each is convinced that the philosopher&\#x27;s responsibility is to contribute from his own special intellectual point of view to the progress of such an important field, rather than sitting in lofty judgement dismissing the efforts of their scientific peers\. The aim of this book is thus to correct some of the common misunderstandings of its subject\. The technical term Artificial Intelligence has created considerable unnecessary confusion because of the ordinary meanings associated with it, and for that very reason, the term is endlessly misused and abused\. The essays collected here all aim to expound the true nature of AI, and to remove the ill\-conceived philosophical discussions which seek answers to the wrong questions in the wrong ways\. Philosophical discussions and decisions about the proper use of AI need to be based on a proper understanding of the manner in which AI\-scientists achieve their results; in particular, in their dependence on the initial planning input of human beings\. The collection combines the Anglo\-Saxon school of analytical philosophy with scientific and psychological methods of investigation\. The distinguished authors in this volume represent a cross\-section of philosophers, psychologists, and computer scientists from all over the world\. The result is a fascinating study in the nature and future of AI, written in a style which is certain to appeal and inform laymen and specialists alike\. has created considerable unnecessary confusion because of the ordinary meanings associated with it, and for that very reason, the term is endlessly misused and abused\. ## [The Impact of Big Data Analytics on Audit Evidence: The Moderating Role of Cyber Security](../publications/e77599f8d3b33f7cbeea.md)

بسام بقيله

هدفت الدراسة التعرف إلى أثر تحليلات البيانات الضخمة بأبعادها \(التحليلات الوصفيّة، والتحليلات التشخيصية، والتحليلات التنبؤية، والتحليلات الارشادية\) في أدلة التدقيق بأبعادها \(كفاية أدلة التدقيق، ومناسبة أدلة التدقيق\)، والدور المعدل للأمن السيبراني بالاعتماد على المنهج الوصفي التحليلي، اشتمل مجتمع الدراسة على \(343\) مدققاً قانونياً في \(138\) مكتب تدقيق في الأردن، ولجمع البيانات تم استخدام الاستبانة وُزعت على عينة شملت \(210\) مدقق قانوني تم اختيارهم بأسلوب العينة العشوائية الطبقية التناسبية، استُرجع \(177\) استبانة صالحة للتحليل، ولمعالجة البيانات تم استخدام البرنامج الإحصائي \(SPSS\)\. توصلت الدراسة إلى ارتفاع مستـوى الأهمية النسبية لتحليلات البيانات الضخمة، وأدلة التدقيق، والأمن السيبراني من وجهة نظر مكاتب التدقيق في الأردن، ووجود أثر ذو دلالة إحصائيّة لتحليلات البيانات الضخمة بأبعادها في أدلة التدقيق بأبعادها مجتمعة \(كفاية أدلة التدقيق، ومناسبة أدلة التدقيق\) بقوة تفسيرية بلغت \(69\.7%\)، ووجود أثر ذو دلالة إحصائيّة للأمن السيبراني في تحسين أثر تحليلات البيانات الضخمة بأبعادها في أدلة التدقيق بأبعادها مجتمعة من وجهة نظر مكاتب التدقيق في الأردن بنسبة \(3%\)\. قدم الباحث مجموعة من التوصيات أهمها توسيع نطاق استخدام تحليلات البيانات بما يضمن مساهمتها المستمرة في مناسبة وعمق نتائج التدقيق وتحسين عملية اتخاذ القرار، ومواصلة الاهتمام بأدلة التدقيق والممارسات التي تعزز كفاية ومناسبة الأدلة من خلال وضع معايير جودة واضحة للأدلة الرقمية مدعومة بتقنيات التدقيق المتطورة للحفاظ على أعلى مستـوى من المصداقية والتأكيد في تقارير التدقيق، علاوة على ذلك، الاستمرار بإعطاء الأولوية للأمن السيبراني كمتطلب امتثال وضرورة استراتيجية مع تدريب المدققين على تقييم ضوابط الأمن السيبراني للعملاء كجزء من عملية التدقيق، ودمج تقييم المخاطر السيبرانية في ممارسات التأكيدات الشاملة\. الكلمات المفتاحية: تحليلات البيانات الضخمة، أدلة التدقيق، الأمن السيبراني، مكاتب التدقيق، الأردن\.

## [The Impact of Perceived Online Review Inauthenticity on Consumer Information Vigilance: Evidence from Regression, Correlation and Parallel Mediation Analysis](../publications/e77a400b1bbcbf1325ce.md)

Pothula Prashanth; Dr\.Vimal Raj\.L

Online reviews are a dominant source of pre\-purchase information, but fake, paid, exaggerated and AI\-generated reviews have made review authenticity a central concern for consumers and platforms\. Most research addresses the algorithmic detection of fake reviews, while few studies examine how a consumer’s own perception of inauthenticity shapes information\-search and verification behaviour\. This study examines the impact of perceived online review inauthenticity \(ORI\) on consumer information vigilance \(CIV\), directly and through two proposed parallel mediators, review skepticism \(RS\) and perceived information uncertainty \(PIU\)\. A quantitative, cross\-sectional survey was conducted with a structured five\-point Likert questionnaire \(four constructs, five items each\), and 270 valid responses from online shoppers who read reviews before purchase were analysed in jamovi using Cronbach’s alpha, descriptive statistics, Pearson and Spearman correlation, simple and multiple linear regression, and a parallel mediation model with 5,000 bootstrap resamples\. The sample was young \(72\.6% aged 18–25\), mostly male \(68\.5%\) and habitual review readers \(77\.4% always or often\)\. All scales were reliable \(α = \.704–\.832\) and all construct means were well above neutral \(3\.93–4\.14\)\. ORI significantly predicted CIV \(B = 0\.360; β = \.394; R² = \.156; F\(1, 268\) = 49\.4; p &lt; \.001\) and correlated strongly with RS \(Pearson r = \.507; Spearman ρ = \.536; p &lt; \.001\)\. RS \(β = \.251\) and PIU \(β = \.424\) jointly explained 36\.9% of the variance in CIV \(F\(2, 267\) = 78\.1; p &lt; \.001\)\. Both indirect effects were significant \(via RS = 0\.0908; via PIU = 0\.1481\) and the direct effect remained significant \(0\.1213; p = \.018\), indicating partial mediation\. All four hypotheses were supported\. The study extends the Persuasion Knowledge Model to online reviews and supports visible authenticity signals and incentive\-free reviews as ways of reducing consumers’ verification burden\. Because the design is cross\-sectional and self\-reported, the findings describe association and statistical pathways rather than causation\. KEYWORDS: Online review inauthenticity, Review skepticism, Perceived information uncertainty, Consumer information vigilance, Parallel mediation, Consumer behaviour\.

## [Bringing Organization Back In: Rethinking Technology–Organization Nexus in Digital Government](../publications/e78b8661660858a8e78b.md)

Yinhao Yang

Digital government scholarship has become increasingly sophisticated about technology, yet surprisingly thin about organization\. Recent studies have shown how algorithms shape administrative discretion, how artificial intelligence changes public decision\-making, and how digital systems affect frontline work, accountability, and public values\. These advances matter\. But they also reveal a conceptual imbalance\. Too often, digital transformation is treated as the introduction of a new technology into an otherwise stable administrative setting\. When performance changes, the technology receives the explanatory credit; when implementation fails, organizational capacity is added as a contextual condition\. This perspective argues for a different starting point: digital government should be understood as a process of organizational transformation produced through the interaction between technology and organization\. Put simply, we need to bring organization back into digital government research\.

## [La responsabilidad empresarial derivada del uso de sistemas de inteligencia artificial: análisis de la suficiencia del marco jurídico Colombiano frente al modelo de la Unión Europea](../publications/e78ee51941d9968c1311.md)

Santiago Andrés Núñez Fajardo

El artículo analiza la problemática que Colombia tiene con la implementación de sistemas de IA en el ámbito empresarial y como poder regular la responsabilidad derivada de su uso\. Para entender la problemática se realizará un estudio comparativo entre Europa y Colombia en materia de los ejes de deber de diligencia, protección de derechos fundamentales e imputación de daños\. El estudio demuestra que el marco jurídico colombiano no cuenta con un sistema especializado para regular la responsabilidad derivada del uso de IA\. Basado lo anterior, se concluye que el modelo Europeo funciona como referente normativo para que Colombia diseñe su propio marco jurídico especializado\.

## [The analysis of intelligent university performance cost accounting driven by big data](../publications/e791f69ddefa8ac04f38.md)

Anqi Jia; Yuan Chao; Li Zou; Wei Liu

The traditional performance cost accounting model of higher education shows obvious lag in dealing with the dynamic allocation of resources and multidimensional performance evaluation, so it is necessary to integrate data intelligence to improve accounting accuracy and management efficiency\. Firstly, based on the data set related to education finance published by the Education Economics Laboratory, a heterogeneous graph modeling mechanism is designed to reconstruct the relationship between multiple node types, including teachers, courses, funds and outputs, and form a dynamic knowledge graph sequence\. Secondly, by combining the Graph Attention Network \(GAT\) with the transformer architecture, a cross\-time and cross\-type performance cost representation model is constructed to support the teaching expenditure prediction and performance fitting analysis\. Finally, an anomaly detection mechanism combining Autoencoder and Local Outlier Factor \(AE \+ LOF\) is introduced, and a closed\-loop system is formed by optimizing budget allocation based on reinforcement learning strategy network\. The results show that the prediction accuracy of the GAT model is better than that of the four baseline methods\. In the annual scenario, the Root Mean Square Error \(RMSE\) and the mean absolute percentage error \(MAPE\) are reduced by 1\.52% and 1\.63% respectively, which has stronger error stability\. In anomaly detection, the average F1 score of AE \+ LOF framework reaches 0\.907, the false positive rate is controlled within 4\.3%, and the sample fluctuation of adaptive institutions is less than 3\.6%\. In budget optimization experiments, the reinforcement learning policy achieved a ΔPerf/ΔCost of 0\.178, with a performance improvement rate of 21\.5% under high\-performance preference conditions\. System tests showed end\-to\-end latency below 200 ms and self\-learning convergence within 18 epochs, with the highest user satisfaction rating in “interactivity\.” Under the constraints of the data and simulation conditions of this study, graph\-structured modeling and intelligent embedding mechanisms hold the potential to enhance the level of intelligence in performance\-based cost accounting\.

## [Ferroptosis in drug\-resistant epilepsy: Molecular mechanisms, evidence, and therapeutic targets](../publications/e795c285927cf03a5b10.md)

Michael Oghenetega Afighor; Chidi Emmanuel Ezerioha; Odafe Adhekegba; Samuel Obo\-Saka

Drug\-resistant epilepsy \(DRE\) affects approximately one\-third of people with epilepsy and is associated with persistent seizures, progressive neuronal injury, cognitive comorbidity, and increased mortality\. Current antiseizure medications primarily modulate neuronal excitability and do not directly address the cellular injury mechanisms that may sustain epileptogenesis and pharmacoresistance\. Objective: This narrative review evaluates the evidence linking ferroptosis an iron\-dependent, lipid\-peroxidation\-driven form of regulated cell death—to epilepsy and DRE, and identifies potential therapeutic targets\. Evidence from experimental seizure models, human temporal lobe epilepsy tissue, and mechanistic studies was synthesized around iron dysregulation, the system xc−/glutathione peroxidase 4 \(GPX4\) axis, lipid peroxidation, oxidative stress, Nrf2/Keap1 signalling, and drug\-transport mechanisms\. Ferroptosis\-related changes, including iron accumulation, GPX4 downregulation, glutathione depletion, and increased 4\-hydroxynonenal and malondialdehyde, have been reported in kainate, pentylenetetrazole, pilocarpine, ferric\-chloride, and human temporal lobe epilepsy settings\. Ferroptosis inhibitors, iron chelation, Nrf2/Keap1 activation, and selected repurposed compounds reduce seizures or neuronal injury in experimental models\. Ferroptotic injury may converge with transporter\- and target\-mediated mechanisms of pharmacoresistance, although the direction and clinical importance of this relationship remain uncertain\. Ferroptosis is a plausible and experimentally tractable contributor to neuronal injury and pharmacoresistance in DRE\. Biomarker validation, mechanistic bridging studies, and carefully designed early\-phase trials particularly of repurposable agents such as deferoxamine are needed before ferroptosis\-directed treatment can be translated to clinical epilepsy care\.

## [AMY\-SA\-XGBoost: A Machine Learning Model to Predict Amylase Specific Activity](../publications/e7988ddae29c7a92b2e7.md)

Zhonghua Yang; Weibo Qi; Chunxiao Li; Ao Jiang; Ying Huang; Jiaqi Xia

Abstract Amylase is an important enzyme preparation, and its enzyme activity directly determines its catalytic efficiency in starch hydrolysis\. However, current experimental methods for determining amylase specific activity are time\-consuming and costly, and experimentally measured specific activity data are sparse and noisy, with limited experimental data currently available\. We developed AMY\-SA\-XGBoost, a machine learning\-based approach for predicting amylase specific activity\. We systematically constructed a high\-quality dataset comprising 178 samples suitable for studying amylase catalytic efficiency by collecting and screening amylase activity data from enzyme databases and literature\. The XGBoost\-based model exhibited strong predictive performance for amylase activity, with an R2 of 0\.9378 and an RMSE of 0\.4329\. The AMY\-SA\-XGBoost can capture specific activity changes in mutated enzymes and identify amino acid residues with substantial impact on specific activity\. In addition, we screened 14 amylase mutants with the highest predicted increases in specific activity and experimentally validated each mutant\. Experimental results confirm that AMY\-SA\-XGBoost accurately predicts the specific activity of amylase mutants based on their amino acid sequences, successfully identifying variants with higher activity\. Among the tested mutants, S359N demonstrated the most significant improvement, achieving a specific activity of 9573 ± 21\.30 U/mg\. This work provides both theoretical foundation and practical insights for enhancing the catalytic efficiency of amylase in pharmaceutical and food industry applications\.

## [Tropicalisation of rocky shore gastropod communities along the Baja California Peninsula](../publications/e7b698ed84ea78b64f47.md)

Karolina Zarzyczny; David A\. Paz‐García; Suzanne Elizabeth\. Williams; Marc Rius; Moira MacLean; Phillip B\. Fenberg

Abstract Tropicalisation is restructuring marine communities globally\. Despite extensive research in subtidal habitats, the extent of tropicalisation and its impact on rocky intertidal communities remains poorly understood\. Here we integrated contemporary field surveys with genetic barcoding, historic surveys, museum collections, and fossil records to document changes in the rocky shore gastropod communities along approximately 3,120 km of the Baja California Peninsula coastline\. We detected poleward range expansions of 30 tropical and subtropical species, and trailing\-edge retractions of 13 temperate species\. Some range shifts occurred across long\-standing biogeographic boundaries\. Fossil evidence revealed that several range\-extending species previously occupied latitudes beyond their modern distributions during Pleistocene warm periods, suggesting that contemporary expansions echo historical responses to climatic warming, albeit under accelerated rates\. Using Lottia gigantea as a case study, we demonstrated early range retractions can be marked by shifts in size\-frequency distributions demonstrating declines in abundance, and loss of small individuals or reduced recruitment\. We showed that rocky intertidal systems are sensitive to climate\-driven range shifts, and highlighted the importance of integrating historical, palaeontological and contemporary data to detect ecological and evolutionary consequences of tropicalisation\. Continued monitoring combined with molecular approaches is crucial for predicting and managing biodiversity responses under ongoing climate change\.

## [Zhou, Chang\-Peng &amp; Fonseca, Anderson: The Boundary Problem for Group Minds: A Possible Answer at the Physical Level](../publications/e7d7ed9b3ab7e8f69aed.md)



Groups can coordinate, process information, and behave as cognitive agents without thereby constituting a conscious subject\. This paper approaches group consciousness through the problem of conscious individuation: what sustains the boundary between one subject and another? It argues that subject boundaries are partly grounded in the architectural asymmetry between communication within a system and communication across its boundary\. Communication architecture, rather than information volume alone, helps explain why systems remain separate, partially overlap, become nested, or potentially fuse\. We develop this argument through cases involving Block&\#x27;s Nation\-Brain, craniopagus twins, colonial invertebrates, and split\-brain patients, and relate it to existing accounts of subject combination\. The proposal does not explain why consciousness exists or establish that any group is conscious\. Its more limited claim is that the organization of communication is relevant to where the boundaries of conscious subjects are drawn\.

## [Topology\-Inspired Fine\-Tuning for Wind\-Field Super\-Resolution](../publications/e7db944b4fbbe8b84028.md)

Arjun Dadhwal; Brian Summa

Scientific super\-resolution \(SR\) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure\. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind\-field SR models\. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence\-diagram \(PD\) distance, and merge\-tree \(MT\) distance favor the CNN, whereas order\-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties\. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine\-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology\-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high\-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed\-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground\-truth persistence\-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit\. A loss study of 16 fine\-tuning configurations, each compared with a matched standard fine\-tuning control that uses only the original reconstruction loss, on a fixed 168\-field benchmark \(with topology evaluated on a fixed 160 by 160 subregion of each field\), shows that, among the scalar\-field losses, gradient supervision provides the strongest PD improvement but does not improve mean MT distance, whereas fixed\-pair supervision gives the largest and most consistent joint improvement in PD and MT distances\. The final objective combines these two signals\. Relative to the pretrained CNN, it lowers mean bottleneck, $W\_\{2,\\infty\}$, and $W\_\{2,2\}$ distances by 31%, 25%, and 27% \(and by 32\-35% relative to the control, which on its own worsens all three\), lowers all three on 150 of 168 fields, and gains 1\.30 dB PSNR, about half the gain of standard fine\-tuning\. Mean MT distance also improves, but on only 91 of those 150 fields, indicating that PD and MT capture complementary structure\.

## [Kültürel Diplomasi ve Kamu Diplomasisi Kesişiminde Stratejik İletişim: Türk\-Rus Uçak Krizi Örneği](../publications/e7e384654e8ffa45d42f.md)

Birol DEMİRCAN

Bu çalışma, kültürel diplomasiyi kamu diplomasisinin tamamlayıcı bir boyutu olarak ele almakta ve uluslararası kriz dönemlerinde sivil toplum aktörlerinin stratejik iletişim ve algı yönetimi süreçlerindeki rolünü incelemektedir\. 24 Kasım 2015 tarihinde yaşanan Türk\-Rus uçak krizi, devletlerarası diplomatik kanalların büyük ölçüde tıkandığı, sert güç söylemlerinin öne çıktığı bir kriz ortamı yaratmıştır\. Bu süreçte, sivil toplum kuruluşları, kültür\-sanat aktörleri ve iş dünyası temsilcileri tarafından yürütülen kültürel diplomasi faaliyetleri, halklar arası iletişim kanallarının tamamen kopmasını engelleyen alternatif bir kamu diplomasisi alanı oluşturmuştur\. Çalışma, nitel araştırma yaklaşımı çerçevesinde vaka incelemesi yöntemiyle tasarlanmış; doküman analizi ve nitel söylem analizi teknikleri birlikte kullanılmıştır\. Kriz döneminde medyada yer alan kültürel diplomasi faaliyetleri, yalnızca betimleyici bir olay dökümü olarak değil, halk–devlet ayrımı, dostluk, barış ve ortak değerler söylemleri bağlamında analiz edilmiştir\. Elde edilen bulgular, sivil toplum aktörlerinin kriz dönemlerinde kültürel diplomasi yoluyla algı yumuşatma, güven inşası ve anlam üretimi işlevleri üstlendiğini göstermektedir\. Çalışma, kültürel diplomasinin yalnızca kültürel etkileşim değil, aynı zamanda stratejik bir siyasal iletişim pratiği olduğunu ortaya koyarak, kamu diplomasisi literatürüne iletişim bilimi perspektifinden katkı sunmayı amaçlamaktadır\.
