## [ON THE TRADE\-OFF BETWEEN BIAS MITIGATION AND UTILITY: FROM SINGLE\- TO MULTI\-TASKING](../publications/f7eb815fa3314dd47a7b.md)

Junyi Chai

Bias mitigation is a central objective in trustworthy machine learning, yet improving model trustworthiness may come at the cost of predictive utility\. This tension arises because bias\-mitigation objectives often restrict statistical information that is useful for prediction but undesirable from the perspective of trustworthiness\. This thesis studies the trade\-off between bias mitigation and model utility across different learning settings, progressing from algorithmic fairness in single\-task learning to spurious dependencies in multi\-task learning\.We first consider the in\-distribution single\-task setting, where bias is characterized using conventional group fairness criteria\. We propose an adaptive reweighting method that mitigates between\-group distributional disparities while assigning greater emphasis to error\-prone samples\. We further study fairness when sensitive attributes are unavailable during training through two complementary approaches: a self\-supervised fair representation learning framework and a knowledge\-distillation framework that implicitly reweighs samples through soft labeling\. Beyond algorithmic contributions, we characterize model\-specific Pareto frontiers between fairness and predictive utility\. Our analysis demonstrates that the nature of the fairness\-utility trade\-off depends on the fairness notion: improving Equalized Odds does not necessarily incur a substantial loss in accuracy, whereas increasingly stringent Demographic Parity constraints can lead to a more pronounced utility cost\.We then extend this perspective to the out\-of\-distribution setting by studying fairness under adversarial perturbations\. We characterize the relationship between adversarial attacks against fairness and accuracy and identify conditions under which fairness robustness and accuracy robustness are aligned\. Based on this connection, we develop fair adversarial training methods that improve robustness to fairness attacks while preserving predictive utility and can additionally benefit robustness against accuracy attacks\.Finally, we move beyond single\-task learning to multi\-task learning, where undesirable information may arise from spurious dependencies between task labels\. While correlations between related tasks can improve predictive performance, incidental correlations between training labels can become shortcuts that impair generalization\. We develop a framework for identifying such spurious inter\-task correlations through changes in task\-label correlations under class\-wise resampling and mitigate the identified dependencies through debiased adversarial training\. Across these settings, the thesis provides a unified perspective on bias mitigation as the problem of reducing reliance on undesirable statistical information while preserving the predictive structure that contributes to model utility\.

## [Pressure Ulcer Detection and Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks: Development of a Mobile Clinical Support Tool](../publications/f7ee27db4fe249a10761.md)

Ana Huamani\-Huaracca; Brigitte Torres\-Pinedo; Juan Morales; Sebastián Ramos\-Cosi

The aim of this study is to develop a mobile application for the automated detection and classification of pressure ulcers \(PU\) using convolutional neural networks \(CNNs\)\. The methodology of this study was developed using a deep detection approach for the identification and classification of PU from clinical imaging\. CNN methods were used to classify PU images according to their degree of damage\. To evaluate its effectiveness, various CNNs architectures were compared and the model with the best classification accuracy was selected\. The results showed that YOLOv11\-CLS managed to achieve the highest overall comparative accuracy at 97\.1%\. Regarding the PU detection task, the model obtained a recall of 96\.1%, a precision of 98\.3%, an F1\-score of 97\.2%, and an accuracy of 98\.1%\. Likewise, for the multiclass severity classification, it managed to achieve a recall of 95\.7%, a precision of 97\.6%, an F1\-score of 96\.9%, and an accuracy of 97\.9%, which guarantees a high efficiency of the application\. In conclusion, the proposed mobile system represents a promising tool for the early detection of PU and can be used as a complement to improve the effectiveness of initial medical follow\-up\.

## [Oncolytic virotherapy for cancer: biological mechanisms, clinical advances, and future perspectives](../publications/f7efbc759294014916b4.md)

Esraa M\. Halawa; Sherihan G\. AbdelHamid; Mahmoud ElHefnawi

Oncolytic virotherapy has emerged as a promising cancer treatment that combines selective tumor destruction with potent stimulation of antitumor immunity\. Unlike conventional therapies, oncolytic viruses \(OVs\) preferentially infect and replicate within malignant cells while sparing normal tissues, leading to direct tumor lysis and the release of tumor\-associated antigens, pathogen\-associated molecular patterns, and damage\-associated molecular patterns that activate both innate and adaptive immune responses\. Advances in molecular virology and genetic engineering have transformed naturally occurring viruses into programmable therapeutic platforms capable of delivering immunomodulatory payloads that enhance antitumor efficacy and remodel the tumor microenvironment\. Multiple DNA\- and RNA\-based viral platforms, including herpes simplex virus, adenovirus, vaccinia virus, reovirus, measles virus, Newcastle disease virus, vesicular stomatitis virus, and coxsackievirus, are currently under clinical investigation, with regulatory approval of talimogene laherparepvec \(T\-VEC\) and G47Δ providing important proof of clinical feasibility\. Increasing evidence indicates that OVs can convert immunologically &quot;cold&quot; tumors into &quot;hot&quot; tumors, thereby improving responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors and other therapeutic modalities\. Consequently, oncolytic virotherapy has become an attractive component of combination strategies involving immunotherapy, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted therapies, and cellular therapies\. Nevertheless, several challenges continue to limit its broader clinical application, including antiviral immune clearance, inefficient systemic delivery, restricted intratumoral spread, tumor heterogeneity, manufacturing complexity, and the lack of robust predictive biomarkers\. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the biological foundations of oncolytic virotherapy, viral engineering strategies, mechanisms of tumor selectivity, direct oncolysis, immunogenic cell death, and immune remodeling of the tumor microenvironment\. It further summarizes the major oncolytic virus platforms, recent preclinical and clinical advances, emerging combination strategies, current translational challenges, and future directions expected to advance precision oncolytic virotherapy and expand its role in modern cancer treatment\.

## [Applications of flow cytometry in equine medicine: current clinical and research perspectives](../publications/f7fe1d2e8be8e6e2ae26.md)

Agnieszka Żak; Daria Lorek; Agnieszka Partyka; Natalia Siwińska

Flow cytometry is a powerful analytical technique that enables rapid, quantitative, and multiparametric assessment of individual cells in suspension\. Owing to its ability to evaluate cellular morphology, viability, and the expression of specific surface and intracellular markers, it has become an indispensable tool in biomedical research and clinical diagnostics\. Over the past two decades, significant advances in cytometric technologies and the increasing availability of species\-specific reagents have expanded the applicability of flow cytometry in equine medicine\. This review highlights the predominantly research\-based applications of flow cytometry in horses and their potential to address diagnostic gaps and complement conventional diagnostic methods\. Particular attention is given to its principal applications in equine clinical immunology, including peripheral blood lymphocyte immunophenotyping; oncology, through the characterization of hematopoietic and lymphoid neoplasms; internal medicine, via cytometric evaluation of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid; and andrology, where flow cytometry serves as a valuable tool for the assessment of stallion semen quality\. The article also highlights recent developments and discusses the growing role of flow cytometry as a diagnostic and research platform in contemporary equine medicine\.

## [Gradient boosting machine for survival prediction in studies with general failure\-time outcome\-dependent sampling design](../publications/f814c12c038ad535cf3b.md)

Haolin Li; Haibo Zhou; Jianwen Cai

Outcome\-dependent sampling \(ODS\) designs are widely used in epidemiological and biomedical research as cost\-effective alternatives to full cohort studies\. While existing research has focused on parameter estimation and inference under specific models, survival prediction in ODS settings remains underexplored\. In this paper, we propose a gradient boosting machine tailored for survival prediction in studies conducted using general failure\-time ODS designs\. Our approach integrates a weighting scheme to correct for sampling bias and improves predictive accuracy\. We introduce a weighted empirical risk based on the integrated Brier score for hyperparameter tuning and establish its convergence to the corresponding integrated Brier\-score risk\. The proposed method is evaluated through extensive simulations and applied to the Cancer Incidence and Mortality of Uranium Miners Study, and is shown to have improved effectiveness in survival prediction\. This work advances machine learning methods for ODS studies, offering valuable insights for personalized medicine and clinical decision\-making in failure\-time ODS settings\.

## [ПРОБЛЕМА ПОБУДОВИ НАУКОВОЇ МОДЕЛІ ВІЙСЬКОВОГО ПЕРЕКЛАДУ](../publications/f81b2e4d608e7064441b.md)

Балабин Виктор Витальевич; Volodymyr Lisovskyi

Стаття продовжує висвітлення наукової проблематики теорії військового перекладу, започатковане на сторінках цього видання у 2018 році\. За час, що минув, успішно розроблено й науково апробовано теоретико\-концептуальні умови для побудови моделі військового перекладу, що є предметом статті\. Проаналізовано вихідні умови й основні труднощі на цьому шляху, теоретичні аспекти моделювання як методу наукового пізнання, визначено методологічні параметри моделі військового перекладу: універсальність, концептуальність, інформаційність, системність, бага\- торівневість, індуктивність, дедуктивність, статичність, динамічність, адаптивність\. Перспективна наукова модель військового перекладу має бути універсальною, ґрунтуватися на апробованих в Україні теоретико\-концептуальних засадах військового перекладу, діалектично й гармонійно поєднувати якості теоретико\-концептуальних і функціо\- нально\-алгоритмічних моделей та усі елементи, частини й складові структурованого й гармонізованого знання про свій об’єкт – перекладацький супровід у системі лінгвістичного забезпечення військ\. За підсумками аналізу модель військового перекладу постає як складна теоретична, знакова, лінгвістична \(психолінгвістична\), недетермінована \(стохастична\) система, що адекватно презентує динамічну взаємодію головного суб’єкта – військового перекла\- дача з об’єктом – військовим текстом, з метою передавання інваріантної денотативної, конотативної, сигніфікатив\- ної інформації в процесі комунікативно\-посередницької, трансляційно\-інтерпретативної діяльності, з урахуванням впливу інших суб’єктів лінгвістичного забезпечення військ та екстралінгвальних чинників у звичайних та екстре\- мальних умовах військової служби\. Концептуальний апарат теорії військового перекладу поповнено дефініціями спеціальних термінів «моделювання» і «модель військового перекладу»\.

## [OmniTFT: an EHR\-driven multi\-target forecasting model for ICU clinical decision support systems](../publications/f81dbf5b0359d1296699.md)

Wanzhe Xu; Yutong Dai; Yitao Yang; Zhenhua Zhang; Martin Loza; Weihang Zhang; Yang Cui; Xin Zeng; Sung\-Joon Park; Kenta Nakai

Background Accurate multivariate time\-series forecasting of vital signs and laboratory results is crucial for electronic health record \(EHR\)–driven clinical decision support systems in intensive care units \(ICUs\)\. However, vital signs are susceptible to noise and exhibit rapid fluctuations, while laboratory results are characterized by missing values and measurement lags, making it challenging to forecast heterogeneous ICU variables within a common framework\. Methods We introduce OmniTFT, a Temporal Fusion Transformer\-based multi\-target forecasting model for ICU EHR time series\. OmniTFT combines state\-balanced sliding\-window sampling with three training regularizers: frequency\-aware embedding shrinkage, historical group\-entropy regularization, and shock\-alignment regularization\. A shared backbone with target\-specific heads enables multiple forecasting tasks within a common training and inference framework while preserving target\-specific temporal resolutions and forecast horizons\. OmniTFT was trained on MIMIC\-IV \( n = 13,277\) and independently validated on two cohorts: the MIMIC\-III CareVue cohort \( n = 4,188\) and the eICU cohort \( n = 23,238\)\. Component ablation and sampling sensitivity analyses were conducted using a fixed patient partition and ten different training seeds\. Results On the MIMIC\-IV test set, OmniTFT achieved the lowest MAE for five of eight targets, ranked second for creatinine and respiratory rate, and ranked third for temperature\. In a retrospective analysis in eICU, adding the OmniTFT forecast of the subsequent unobserved 24 h to the complete observed record improved discrimination for incident moderate\-to\-severe acute kidney injury compared with the observed record alone \(AUROC 0\.763, 95% CI: 0\.674–0\.852 vs\. 0\.693, 0\.598–0\.787, ΔAUROC \+ 0\.070, DeLong p = 0\.009\), and identified 73\.3% vs\. 57\.8% of subsequent events when 30% of patients were flagged for review\. Conclusions OmniTFT provides a shared\-backbone framework for forecasting heterogeneous ICU variables while preserving target\-specific temporal configurations\. Retrospective results in disease\-enriched cohorts support broader external validation and suggest its potential as an EHR\-integrated forecasting component for clinical decision support\.

## [Beyond Success Rate: Interventional Evaluation of Memory in Vision\-Language\-Action Systems](../publications/f82f1ba927c1ac45cf88.md)

Keyuan Luo; Yi Xie; Wanyun Ling; Yuanzhe Li; Ziyue Li; Zhuoqi Zeng

When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success\-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task\-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses\. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol \(IMEP\) for vision\-language\-action \(VLA\) systems to address four questions: \(1\) Does memory provide a net benefit? \(2\) Under what conditions does memory help? \(3\) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? \(4\) Are these effects specific to task\-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target\-fact substitutions with fact\-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success\. We evaluate within\-episode, cross\-episode, and agentic memory\. In cross\-episode learned\-bank experiments, a one\-unit\-in\-the\-last\-place \(ULP\) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11\.9% of seed\-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact\-preserving replacements\. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations\. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39\.1% to 74\.3%, matching the oracle\-decision condition under shared recorded executions\. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact\-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates\.

## [Prevalence and determinants of cesarean section delivery among Somali women: a multivariable analysis of a nationally representative survey](../publications/f8332da1c29543f4770a.md)

Farhat Ahmed

Background Cesarean section is a life\-saving obstetric intervention when medically indicated, yet access remains severely limited in Somalia, where maternal morbidity and mortality are high\.Objective\(s\) To determine the magnitude of cesarean section delivery and identify factors associated with its utilization among Somali women using nationally representative survey data\.Methods A secondary analysis of the 2020 Somali Health and Demographic Survey was conducted using data from 23,445 women aged 15–49 years\. Odds ratios \(ORs\) with 95% confidence intervals \(CIs\) were reported, with statistical significance set at p &lt; 0\.05\.Results The prevalence of cesarean section was 0\.3% \(61/23,445\)\. Compared with women aged ≥ 35 years, those aged 25–34 years \(OR = 6\.483; 95% CI: 2\.160–19\.458; p = 0\.001\) and &lt;25 years \(OR = 6\.293; 95% CI: 2\.422–16\.351; p &lt; 0\.001\) had statistically significantly higher odds of cesarean delivery\. Rural residence \(OR = 0\.177; 95% CI: 0\.091–0\.346; p &lt; 0\.001\) and low household wealth \(OR = 0\.243; 95% CI: 0\.097–0\.611; p = 0\.003\) were statistically significantly associated with lower odds of cesarean delivery\. Women with ≥6 children had statistically significantly higher odds of cesarean delivery \(OR = 3\.960; 95% CI: 2\.072–7\.569; p &lt; 0\.001\)\. Breastfeeding was not significantly associated with cesarean delivery \(p = 0\.079\)\.Conclusions Cesarean section utilization in Somalia remains extremely low, indicating substantial inequities in access to emergency obstetric care\. Maternal age, parity, place of residence, and household wealth were associated with cesarean delivery\.

## [Understanding Stability of Outer Nesterov Momentum on Stochastic Pseudo\-Gradients](../publications/f833f1d4b92b31222548.md)

Nishant Sharma; Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez; Ganesh Talluri; Sarath Chandar; Hiroki Naganuma

Large neural networks are commonly trained across many workers, and communication between them is a major cost\. Workers therefore take several local optimization steps before sending their net parameter displacements, or pseudo\-gradients, to an outer optimizer, which often applies Nesterov momentum\. We study how the outer momentum, the number of local steps and the averaging over workers control the training dynamics, and in particular their stability\. For random quadratics, we derive an exact mean\-square stability criterion in any dimension, which reveals that the inner batch size determines whether increasing the number of local steps eventually stabilizes or destabilizes the outer iteration\. Moreover, while averaging the pseudo\-gradients of independent workers can make larger outer momentum values admissible, the number of workers required for stability can grow exponentially with the number of local steps\. Finally, we show that the mean\-square dynamics governing stability can be probed directly at intermediate neural\-network checkpoints using shared\-minibatch perturbations\. We test our theoretical findings across networks, and measure their consequences for training loss\.

## [REALITY AS A QUANTUM MIST OF NODES OF OSCILLATING FIELDS THROUGH INTERACTION Toward a Copernican Revolution in the Ontology of Science](../publications/f835a40b2587cb1df22f.md)

Alessandro Cerboni

Abstract This White Paper proposes a Copernican revolution in the ontology of science\. The central thesis is that reality is not composed of discrete entities located in a neutral spatiotemporal container, but is a quantum mist of nodes of oscillating fields through interaction\. What we perceive as space, time, matter and norms are patterns of resonance that emerge at different interaction scale factors\. Reality is not a collection of things: it is a symphony of resonances\. The work integrates three converging developments in contemporary science: quantum physics \(time emerges from correlations; space emerges from entanglement\), cognitive neuroscience \(temporal perception is a retroactive narrative; spatial perception is an enactive construction\) and complex systems theory \(emergent properties are not reducible to components; the topology of interactions is constitutive\)\. The White Paper formalizes the ontology of the mist through operational definitions \(mist, node, oscillation, interaction, resonance, scale factor, shimmering, resonance belly\), develops a generalized Kubo\-Martin\-Schwinger evolution equation, and proposes a research programme with testable predictions in physics, neuroscience, social science and law\. Ten main criticisms are addressed and discussed \(vagueness, panpsychism, non\-falsifiability, reductionism, ambition, incompatibility with the scientific method, arbitrariness of the scale factor, causality, consciousness, theory of everything\)\. For each, a structured reply is offered\. The conclusion is that reality is not an object but a harmonic process, and science is not a description of things but a score of resonances\. The Copernican revolution consists in recognizing that it is not the observer who adapts to a pre\-existing space\-time, but it is space\-time that emerges from the interaction between observer and system\. ────────────────────────────────────────────────── Keywords Relational ontology; emergence; quantum mist; resonance; scale factor; shimmering; emergent space\-time; narrative; heuristics; complex adaptive systems; ecological jurisprudence; compliance; Copernican revolution\.

## [Suspect and nontargeted screening for arsenic speciation: Advances, challenges, and opportunities](../publications/f845a3bd02a6a2d562a2.md)

Juanjuan Fu; Mason D’Souza; Tingting Zhao; Qiming Shen; Xiufen Lu; Xing‐Fang Li; X\. Chris Le

Arsenic is a ubiquitous metalloid whose toxicity is dependent on chemical species\. Targeted analytical approaches have facilitated the quantification of selected arsenic species; however, structural characterization of previously unrecognized arsenic species remains challenging, particularly when reference standards are unavailable\. Suspect and nontargeted screening \(NTS\) approaches provide opportunities for the discovery of novel arsenic species\. This review discusses recent advances in NTS as applied to arsenic speciation\. Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry \(ICPMS\) and electrospray ionization high\-resolution mass spectrometry \(ESI\-HRMS\), in combination with high performance liquid chromatography \(HPLC\), serve complementary roles in arsenic speciation analysis\. The use of ICPMS for specific detection of arsenic complements ESI\-HRMS detection that provides molecular and structural information\. Preservation of arsenic species and efficient extraction of arsenic from real\-world samples are paramount for quantitative speciation analysis\. Challenges related to simultaneous ICPMS and ESI\-HRMS detection from the same HPLC separation include compatibility of solvents and HPLC mobile phases, limited number of authentic standards, and complexity of data acquisition and analysis\. Future research should explore new approaches, assisted by machine learning, that facilitate high\-throughput analysis of complex MS and tandem MS data, which will contribute to establishing a NTS framework for arsenic speciation\.

## [Graphlet\-based Decentralized Finance Transaction Method Classification](../publications/f8599ae5e6a831035945.md)

Célestin Coquidé; Alessio Brini; Natkamon Tovanich

Decentralized Finance \(DeFi\) transactions involve complex interactions among accounts, smart contracts, and tokens\. We investigate whether network topology can identify transaction methods that describe DeFi operations\. We extract directed graphlet features to classify the 30 most frequent methods\. Our results show that graphlet features complement event log counts in improving classification performance\. Using SHapley Additive exPlanations \(SHAP\), we further derive model explanations that reveal method\-specific graphlet structural patterns\.

## [Artificial Intelligence Disruption and Structural Enrollment Decline in Economics and Business Higher Education: Longitudinal Evidence from Indonesia](../publications/f8665af5ef5b57196c5e.md)

Yohanes Sugiyanta

The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence \(AI\), digital transformation, and technology\-driven economic systems has fundamentally reshaped global higher education dynamics, particularly within conventional economics and business programs\. This study investigates the phenomenon of structural enrollment decline in economics and business higher education during the artificial intelligence era through a longitudinal institutional analysis of the Accounting and Management study programs at STIE Mulia Pratama, Indonesia, over the 1998–2025 period\. Employing a quantitative longitudinal approach, the study utilizes institutional enrollment data obtained from the Indonesian Higher Education Database \(PDDIKTI\)\. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, trend analysis, linear regression, forecasting analysis, and interpretative analysis to identify long\-term enrollment transformation and institutional sustainability challenges\. The findings reveal three major enrollment phases consisting of growth, fluctuation, and persistent structural decline\. Regression analysis confirms statistically significant negative enrollment trends within both study programs\. The Accounting program experienced an average annual decline of 3\.356 students, while the Management program demonstrated a stronger annual decline of 5\.056 students, indicating higher vulnerability to technological disruption and changing educational preferences\. The study further reveals that AI disruption, employability orientation, digital economic transformation, and competency\-based educational preferences substantially influence educational decision\-making among younger generations\. Consequently, conventional economics and business education increasingly faces sustainability challenges associated with declining institutional attractiveness and labor market transformation\. This study contributes to the higher education literature by positioning declining enrollment as a manifestation of structural transformation rather than temporary institutional fluctuation\. The integration of longitudinal institutional evidence, AI disruption perspectives, and sustainability analysis provides a broader analytical framework for understanding the future challenges of higher education within the digital economy era\.

## [Spatial, spatiotemporal, and epidemiological patterns of animal bites in the population covered by Torbat Heydariyeh University of Medical Sciences, Iran, 2015–2025](../publications/f867013a2840f5daab13.md)

Zahra Maleki; Alireza Dehghani; Mohammad Reza Etesamirad; Zahra Yazdansetad; Reza Khatibi

Animal bites pose a significant public health concern due to rabies risk and associated health and economic burdens\. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, spatial, and spatiotemporal patterns of animal\-bite cases among the population covered by Torbat Heydariyeh University of Medical Sciences, Iran, from 2015 to 2025\. This retrospective registry\-based epidemiological study included all recorded animal\-bite cases \( n = 12,079\) at rabies prevention and treatment centers in Torbat Heydariyeh County, Razavi Khorasan Province, Iran, over a 11\-year period\. Data on demographics, animal type, incident location, and anatomical site were analyzed using SPSS 26\. Independent t\-tests, chi\-square tests, one\-way ANOVA, and the Cochran–Armitage trend test were used to assess incidence trends\. The Significance level was set at 0\.05\. The crude incidence rate of animal bites showed an overall increasing trend during 2015–2025, with fluctuations over the study period\. After a decline during 2020–2021, the incidence rate increased substantially, reaching its highest level in 2024 \(513\.36 per 100,000 population\), followed by a slight decrease in 2025 \(475\.83 per 100,000 population\)\. Dogs accounted for 83\.70% of bites, followed by cats \(15\.70%\)\. Seasonal incidence peaked in spring \(31\.80%\), followed by summer \(29\.80%\), and was lowest in winter \(17\.20%\)\. Thighs and legs were the most common anatomical sites \(57\.50%\), and single injuries accounted for 59\.60% of cases\. Males accounted for 78\.00% and rural residents for 65\.60% of the cases\. Among 11,469 animal\-bite cases, six deaths \(0\.10%\) were recorded\. Annual incidence increased by 16\.33 cases per 100,000 population per year \(β = 16\.33; 95% CI: 7\.13–25\.53; p = 0\.003\)\. Animal bites remain an important public health concern, with an overall increasing trend in incidence during the study period\. Males and rural residents accounted for a higher proportion of reported cases, and dogs were the main biting animals\. These findings highlight the need for sustained preventive strategies, public education, and targeted interventions to reduce the burden of animal bites\.

## [Reversible Ferroelastic Strain Engineering Enables Stabilization of a Hidden Ga2O3 Polymorph](../publications/f8883f7ec45138fece19.md)

Zijun Qi; Zhanpeng Sun; Rui Li; Qijun Wang; Jingyuan Ni; Sheng Liu; Wei Shen; Gai Wu

Abstract Understanding the formation, transformation, and stabilization of metastable polymorphs in functional compounds is a central challenge in materials science and has a profound impact on phase engineering and property control\. Ga2O3 is an ultrawide bandgap semiconductor whose rich polymorphism underpins diverse electronic and optoelectronic functionalities, motivating continued exploration of its metastable phases\. Among the known Ga2O3 polymorphs, the P1̅\-phase has been predicted to have the closest energy to the thermodynamically stable β\-phase; however, its existence has not been definitively identified experimentally, and feasible preparation routes remain unclear up to now\. Here, combining large\-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a high\-accuracy machine learning potential, we reveal a reversible strain\-induced ferroelastic β–P1̅ phase transition in Ga2O3 and further investigate the origin of instability of P1̅\-Ga2O3\. Our work not only explains the absence of experimental observations of P1̅\-Ga2O3 from the perspectives of mechanical stability and crystallization kinetics but also extends the application of strain engineering in phase transitions of wide\-bandgap semiconductor single\-crystal materials\.

## [Changes in general and physics\-related professional competence facets of early childhood educators](../publications/f89764d1032730c327bb.md)

Michaela Gelewski; Simone Lehrl; Stefanie Schnebel

Introduction Play\-based science learning opportunities are considered a promising approach to strengthening science education in early childhood\. Professional development \(PD\) is increasingly recognized as important in this context, yet empirical evidence on play\-based physics PD remains limited\. In particular, there is a lack of PD programs addressing play\-based science learning, and empirical evidence remains limited regarding how play\-based physics PD programs support early childhood educators&\#x27; general and domain\-specific professional competencies\. Addressing this gap, the present study examines self\-reported pre\-post changes in selected professional competence facets within the PhysikSPIEL PD program\. Methods Participants \( N = 42\) were early childhood educators from Germany and kindergarten teachers from Switzerland, enrolled in the 2024 or 2025 program cycle, each lasting approximately three months\. Using a pre\-post design and a standardized self\-report questionnaire, the study assessed motivational orientations \[self\-efficacy expectations \(including those related to SST\), self\-concept, enthusiasm\] and pedagogical beliefs \(co\-constructive teaching and learning beliefs\)\. Results Analyses indicated self\-reported pre\-post increases in domain\-specific self\-efficacy expectations \(including those related to SST\), academic self\-concept, and enthusiasm, whereas co\-constructive teaching and learning beliefs remained stable\. Discussion Given the pre\-post design, the relatively small and self\-selected sample, and the reliance on self\-report measures, these findings should be interpreted cautiously\. Overall, the study provides preliminary evidence that participation in a play\-based physics PD program may be associated with changes in selected self\-reported motivational competence facets\.

## [Global Research Trends in Tick\-Borne Diseases of Livestock: A Bibliometric Analysis](../publications/f8a481ddf0e9fe6e0088.md)



Tick\-borne diseases \(TBDs\) are a critical limitation of livestock health and productivity on the international arena as they result in huge economic losses and emerging challenges due to changing environmental conditions\.The objective of the current study was to examine the current trends in the world in terms of the research on tickborne livestock diseases through the use of bibliometric methodology\.A structured search strategy was used to retrieve publications indexed in PubMed database between 2020 and 2026 and 2,405 records were included in the analysis\.The place of bibliometric analysis was conducted with the help of Bibliometrix \(R 4\.5\.2\) and VOSviewer to assess the trends of publications, top contributors, collaboration networks, and theme development\.The findings revealed a more or less fluctuating but generally speaking increasing pattern in scientific production with the highest production expected in 2025\.China, Brazil and the United States were found to be the most prolific nations with some of the most renowned research institutions like Obihiro University of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine and Universidade Federal de Goiás in the center stage\.Through co\-authorship analysis, it was found that there is a strongly collaborative and interconnected international research network, but there was low participation of lowincome regions\.Thematic mapping and co\-occurrence of keywords gave common areas of research, which were pathogen detection, epidemiology, and host vector interactions, with a rising trend of molecular diagnostics and genomic techniques\.New areas of study associated with climate change and ecological conditions pointed to the changing priorities of research\.The research, in general, indicates a tendency toward multidisciplinary and technology\-related studies of the topic of tick\-borne livestock diseases\.Although much has been done, there are still gaps in the research of the endemic regions and the establishment of sustainable control measures\.The results obtained are useful in understanding the state of research in the global arena and can be used in conducting further research ## [Algorithms of agricultural navigation](../publications/f8abf579e739c1d8dd29.md)

Anatolii Kaliuhnyi

Rationale\. Automation of self\-propelled agricultural machines and machine\-tractor units \(MTU\), which ensures round\-the\-clock performance of field work without tractor driver&\#x27;s participation, can improve the efficiency of crop production and increase food production\. The obstacle is the lack of formed agricultural navigation as an independent scientific direction on instrumental methods and technical means of controlling the movement of unmanned MTU\. Research objective\. Formation of the theory of agricultural navigation of tilled MTU\. Research methods\. The research is exploratory, aimed at using theoretical knowledge to solve the applied problem of determining the trajectory control error of unmanned MTU\. The methods used are analogies, full\-scale and thought experiments, mathematical modeling, intuition, comparisons, etc\. Information from navigation, electrodynamics, mechanization, automation, instrumentation, etc\. were used as initial information\. The methods of analogies, natural and mental experiments, mathematical modeling, intuition, comparisons and were used\. Information from navigation, electrodynamics, electro\-exploration geophysics, agronomy, mechanization of mobile crop production processes, automatics, instrumentation, agricultural engineering, etc\. was used as initial information\. Results\. Programming of MTU trajectories is carried out in coordinate systems rigidly “tied” to the terrain by physical landmarks\. There are only three ways of specifying coordinate systems: two points, one point and a direction, a line along the entire trajectory\. The location of the MTU is defined either in the same coordinate system or in a mobile coordinate system defined by the location of the “leading” point of the tractor and the directions of its axes\. In both cases, the location of the MTU is determined by the distance between the MTU and the landmarks of the stationary coordinate system\. Point landmarks are hundreds of meters and more distant, linear landmarks \- on units of meters\. Therefore, it is easier to determine the MTU location by the distance to linear landmarks than to point landmarks\. It is advisable to use stationary underground current\-carrying wires as linear reference points\. The currents of the wires create navigational magnetic fields that allow to determine the location of MTU with high accuracy\. Programming of trajectories in the magnetic fields of current\-carrying wires is carried out by “guiding surfaces”, which represent the geometric location of points, when the leading point of the tractor is aligned with them, there is no trajectory control error signal formed by the navigation device of location determination\. The trajectories are programmed by setting the planned values of the “electric” and “mechanical” navigation parameters of the positioning device\. The first parameter determines the lateral displacement of the leading point relative to the current carrying wire, the second parameter determines the lateral displacement of the leading point relative to the longitudinal axis of the tractor\. The planned value of one or both of these parameters can be zero\. The maximum accuracy is possessed by positioning devices with zero planned electrical parameter\. The article considers algorithms of formation of trajectory control error signals by less accurate but structurally simpler devices with zero value of mechanical parameter\. Conclusion\. For programming the required and determining the actual trajectories of unmanned MTAs, including tilled ones, it is advisable to use the systems of coordinates set by stationary landmarks in the form of underground current\-carrying wires\. Key words: agricultural navigation; navigation inductor; location algorithm; unmanned agricultural technologies\.

## [Glaucoma neurodegeneration: targeted modulation of intraocular immune pathways – a review of novel therapeutic advances](../publications/f8af553fecc169f68ec1.md)

Yunyun Sun; Keyun Xue; Congqin Wen; Xinyan Ma; Xiaojie Hu

Glaucoma is the leading global cause of irreversible blindness, with its pathogenesis extending far beyond elevated intraocular pressure\. Dysregulation of the intraocular immune system plays a central role in the progressive death of retinal ganglion cells\. This review systematically examines the research progress on key intraocular immune pathways in glaucomatous neurodegeneration, with a primary focus on immune\-inflammatory responses mediated by microglia, astrocytes, and T cells\. It delves into the molecular mechanisms of various immunoregulatory networks, including the TLR4/nuclear factor kappa B \(TLR4/NF\-κB\), Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription \(JAK/STAT\), mitogen\-activated protein kinase \(MAPK\), complement, and T\-cell receptor signaling pathways\. The review analyzes potential therapeutic strategies targeting these pathways\. By integrating the latest evidence from basic research and translational medicine, this article aims to provide a theoretical foundation and directional guidance for developing neuroprotective immunomodulatory therapies that go beyond intraocular pressure reduction\.

## [ALEX\-GWO: Reinforcement\-learning\-driven Adaptive Grey Wolf Optimization with Landscape\-aware Local\-optima Escape for Large\-scale Global Optimization](../publications/f8b431dcfb507cd108cf.md)

Rajpreet Kaur; Rupali Dhir

Large\-scale global optimization exposes a structural weakness of the grey wolf optimizer: its convergence coefficient follows a schedule fixed in advance, the three leading wolves collapse into a single attraction basin long before the budget is spent, and that loss of diversity is neither detected nor repaired\.Published variants answer the symptoms with fixed remedies applied on a schedule rather than on evidence, so their cost is paid whether or not the population is trapped\.This paper presents ALEX\-GWO \(Adaptive Learning\-driven EXploration Grey Wolf Optimizer\), which closes the loop between observation and control\.A six\-component search\-state vector summarises progress, diversity, success rate, improvement, stagnation and leader dispersion; population\-level parameter control, per\-wolf success memory and an epsilon\-greedy Q\-learning selector consume it at three time scales; and a composite landscapetrapping score releases a targeted escape only when several independent indicators agree\.On CEC&\#x27;2013 and CEC&\#x27;2010 at 1000 dimensions under an equal budget of 3\.0 x 10^6 evaluations, ALEX\-GWO obtains the best average Friedman rank of the ten algorithms compared on the first suite \(2\.00\) and of the nine on the second \(1\.85\)a set including ADSL\-GWO, RL\-LGWO and IAGWO re\-implemented under an identical protocoland improves on canonical GWO by a median of four orders of magnitude\.It reaches a lower mean error than SHADE\-ILS on 13 of the 15 CEC&\#x27;2013 functions \(Wilcoxon p = 0\.048\) but is not separated from MOS, CC\-RDG3 or IAGWO after Holm correction, so the evidence supports competitive consistency rather than dominance\.ALEX\-GWO costs 11\.3% more runtime than canonical GWO, and removing landscape detection alone drops the escape success rate from 0\.68 to 0\.31\.A binary variant reaches 90\.32\-93\.75%accuracy under nested cross\-validation on four feature\-selection datasets while discarding 65\-97% of the features\.Code and raw results: https://github\.com/Rajpreet\-kaur1989/ALEXGWO\.

## [Correlation between students’ motivation skill and students’ academic achievement in senior secondary school biology in Anambra State Nigeria](../publications/f8b43a02b64d3ba1fa66.md)

Obioma Henrietta Nnalue; Ejezube Uchechukwu Maximus Henry; Nwanneka Oluchukwu Christian\-Ike; Gloria Tobechuukwu Aguofia

Science achievement in Nigerian secondary schools, particularly in Biology, remains an important educational concern\. This study examined the relationship between students’ motivation skills and academic achievement in Senior Secondary School \(SS 2\) Biology in Anambra State, Nigeria\. A correlational survey design was employed, involving 637 students from 18 public secondary schools selected through multistage sampling across six Local Government Areas in the Awka and Otuocha education zones\. Data were collected using the motivation skill cluster of the Students’ Self\-Regulatory Skills Scale \(SSRSS\) and students’ third\-term Biology achievement scores obtained from official school records\. The instrument demonstrated acceptable internal consistency \(Cronbach’s α = 0\.80\)\. Data were analyzed using Pearson’s product\-moment correlation and linear regression with SPSS version 23 at a 0\.05 significance level\. The findings revealed a very weak positive but statistically insignificant relationship between motivation skills and Biology achievement \(r = \.024, R² = \.001\)\. Regression analysis also indicated that motivation skills did not significantly predict academic achievement \(F\(1, 635\) = 0\.364, p = \.546\)\. Thus, the null hypothesis was retained\. These findings suggest that motivation skills alone may be insufficient to explain students’ academic achievement in Biology\. Improving science learning outcomes may require a comprehensive approach integrating science process skills, self\-regulatory strategies, innovative instructional methods, and a supportive school environment\. Biology teachers and other educational stakeholders should incorporate motivation strategies, cognitive strategy training, and interactive learning tools to support students’ academic performance\.

## [Görsel Kültür ve Edebiyat: Karikatürlerde Klasik Türk Edebiyatı Temsilleri Üzerine Bir İnceleme](../publications/f8e17242deda040baa24.md)

Hakan SÖNMEZ

Klasik edebiyat geleneği, “eski\-yeni” tartışmaları ekseninde sıklıkla eleştirilmiş ve toplum nezdinde zaman zaman mesafeli bir algının konusu olmuştur\. Klasik edebiyata yönelik bu tutuma yalnızca ilmî ve edebî çevrelerde değil, farklı kültürel mecralarda da rastlamak mümkündür\. Bu mecralardan biri de görsel kültürün önemli unsurlarından olan karikatürdür\. Bu çalışmada, klasik Türk edebiyatının çağdaş ve popüler kültürde nasıl algılandığı; özellikle karikatürlerde hangi biçimlerde temsil edildiği ve ne şekilde mizahın nesnesi hâline getirildiği incelenmiştir\. Çalışmanın temel amacı, klasik şiirin esas bileşenlerinin günümüz mizah anlayışına nasıl yansıdığını ve bu yansımaların hangi eleştirel söylemleri barındırdığını ortaya koymaktır\. Bu çerçevede, çeşitli mizah dergilerinde yayımlanmış ve klasik Türk edebiyatına doğrudan ya da dolaylı göndermeler içeren karikatürler tespit edilmiştir\. Yapılan incelemeler sonucunda, klasik edebiyata karşı eleştirel bir tutum sergileyen 19 karikatür belirlenmiştir\. Bu karikatürler, nitel araştırma yöntemlerinden tematik analiz yöntemi ile değerlendirilmiştir\. Analizler neticesinde, klasik edebiyatın üç ana eksen etrafında mizahî bir temsil konusu edildiği görülmüştür\. Bu temalar: dilin anlaşılmazlığı, aruz vezni ve idealize edilmiş sevgili tasavvurudur\. Çalışmanın sonucunda, karikatürlerin klasik Türk edebiyatını popüler kültür bağlamında eleştirel bir yaklaşımın nesnesi hâline getirdiği tespit edilmiştir\. İncelenen örneklerde, klasik edebiyatın dili, vezni ve hayal dünyasının olumsuz bir çerçevede ele alınarak mizahî söylemle eleştirildiği ortaya konmuştur\.

## [Perancangan Model Sistem Informasi Untuk Pengelolaan Dokumen Pada Sub Bagian Umum di Kantor Pencarian dan Pertolongan Kelas A Medan](../publications/f8ff284224952b4bde17.md)

Siti Nurjanah; Saiba Siregar

Pengelolaan dokumen pada Sub Bagian Umum Kantor Pencarian dan Pertolongan Kelas A Medan, yang meliputi surat masuk, surat keluar, dan pengarsipan, masih dilakukan sebagian secara manual menggunakan kertas\. Cara ini kurang praktis dan berisiko karena dokumen fisik dapat hilang atau rusak sehingga informasi administrasi terputus\. Penelitian ini bertujuan merancang model sistem informasi pengelolaan dokumen berbasis web yang diberi nama SIPEDOM\. Metode pengembangan yang digunakan adalah Waterfall yang meliputi analisis kebutuhan, perancangan sistem, implementasi, dan pengujian\. Perancangan dimodelkan menggunakan use case diagram dan Entity Relationship Diagram \(ERD\), sedangkan implementasi menggunakan PHP, MySQL, dan Bootstrap\. Hasil perancangan berupa sistem dengan fitur login, dashboard, pengelolaan surat masuk, pengelolaan surat keluar, serta arsip dokumen digital dengan unggah dan akses berkas\. Basis data terdiri dari empat tabel, yaitu pengguna, surat masuk, surat keluar, dan arsip\. Sistem ini diharapkan membantu proses pencatatan, pencarian, dan penyimpanan dokumen menjadi lebih terstruktur dan aman\. Penerapan SIPEDOM memberikan solusi praktis dalam meminimalisasi hambatan birokrasi serta mempercepat respons alur distribusi informasi internal organisasi\. Pengujian sistem menunjukkan bahwa seluruh fitur berfungsi secara optimal dan mampu mengakomodasi kebutuhan operasional staf dalam mengelola arsip harian\. Keberadaan penyimpanan digital tersentralisasi ini juga memudahkan pengawasan serta penelusuran rekam jejak dokumen secara real\-time tanpa perlu bergantung pada penataan berkas fisik di lemari arsip\. Dengan efisiensi yang ditawarkan, sistem ini berkontribusi signifikan terhadap peningkatan akuntabilitas kerja, transparansi data, dan efektivitas pelayanan administrasi secara keseluruhan di lingkungan Kantor Pencarian dan Pertolongan Kelas A Medan\.

## [Integrating HSE Governance with Intelligent Leakage Detection Systems for Sustainable Industrial Development in Saudi Arabia](../publications/f9067bea28e7ca00b346.md)

Muhammad Ashfaq

Saudi Arabia’s industrial expansion under Vision 2030 increases the strategic importance of preventing loss of containment across oil and gas, petrochemical, water, utilities, and infrastructure assets\. This review examines how health, safety, and environment \(HSE\) governance can be integrated with intelligent leakage detection so that sensing technologies become part of accountable risk management rather than isolated technical tools\. An integrative review of peer\-reviewed literature published during 2020–2025 synthesizes evidence on acoustic sensing, pressure and flow analytics, Industrial Internet of Things \(IIoT\), machine and deep learning, digital twins, risk\-based inspection, dynamic risk analysis, human factors, and safety governance\. The synthesis shows that intelligent systems can improve detection speed, localization, and predictive integrity assessment, but technical accuracy alone does not ensure safer outcomes\. Governance quality determines whether alerts are validated, escalated, translated into barrier actions, documented, and learned from\. The paper proposes an HSE\-integrated architecture linking sensor assurance, contextual analytics, dynamic risk ranking, human authorization, emergency response, maintenance, and sustainability metrics\. It argues that Saudi industrial operators should treat leakage intelligence as a safety\-critical decision system with defined ownership, cybersecurity controls, model assurance, and lifecycle verification\. Research priorities include Saudi field datasets, explainable and uncertainty\-aware models, cross\-asset interoperability, human–AI decision protocols, and evidence connecting intelligent detection to measurable reductions in environmental releases and major\-accident risk\.

## [Vertical Gate‐All‐Around SiGeSn/GeSn/SiGeSn Nanowire Transistors for Energy‐Efficient Electronics](../publications/f907a2e10a95e9610571.md)

Kenta Moto; Yannik Junk; Marvin Frauenrath; Florian Bärwolf; Jean‐Michel Hartmann; Andreas Mai; Detlev Grützmacher; Joachim Knoch; Dan Buca; Qing‐Tai Zhao

ABSTRACT Conventional Si Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor \(CMOS\) technologies face increasing challenges in improving energy efficiency while maintaining device performance\. Here, SiGeSn/GeSn heterostructures are employed as a unified Group‐IV platform for complementary vertical nanowire gate‐all‐around \(GAA\) MOSFETs and tunnel field‐effect transistors \(TFETs\) fabricated on Si wafers\. The wider‐bandgap SiGeSn source/drain regions introduce band offsets to the GeSn channel, enabling heterostructure band engineering for leakage suppression and tunneling‐pathway control\. Compared with all‐GeSn reference devices, the SiGeSn source/drain architecture suppresses drain‐induced barrier lowering and off‐state leakage without modifying the GeSn channel\. The same heterostructure platform also enables complementary TFET operation, where the n‐TFET exhibits a subthreshold swing of 60 mV dec − 1 and a two‐order‐of‐magnitude enhancement in on/off current ratio\. The performance difference between p‐ and n‐TFETs provides experimental evidence of the different efficiencies of indirect Γ‐to‐L and direct Γ‐to‐Γ tunneling processes\. These results demonstrate that SiGeSn/GeSn heterostructures can be used to suppress leakage currents and engineer tunneling pathways, establishing SiGeSn/GeSn heterostructures as a unified Group‐IV platform for future energy‐efficient CMOS technologies beyond conventional Si\.

## [Tıbbı ve Aromatik Bıtkılere Ekonomik Bakış: Değer Belirlemede Hangi Yöntemler Nasıl Kullanılabilir?](../publications/f9097e72055eb4b1ce70.md)

Ufuk Demirci; Atakan Öztürk

Bu çalışmada tıbbi ve aromatik bitkilerin değer bileşenlerinin neler olduğunu tespit etmek, ekonomik değerinin nasıl belirlendiğini ortaya koymak ve değer belirlemekte kullanılan yöntemleri irdelemek amaçlanmıştır\. Tıbbi ve aromatik bitkilerin; sağlık ve tıbbi, ekonomik, ekolojik, çevresel, turizm, kültürel ve bilimsel değerlerinin olduğu, ayrıca doğrudan kullanım değerinin yanı sıra dolaylı kullanım, seçenek, varlık ve miras değer bileşenlerine sahip olduğu görülmektedir\. Doğrudan kullanım değerine sahip olan ve ticareti yapılan tıbbi ve aromatik bitkilerin ekonomik değerleri, pazar fiyatları üzerinden belirlenirken, seçenek, varlık ve miras değerlerin ise koşullu değer belirleme ve seçim modelleme yöntemleri gibi farklı yöntemlerden istifade edilerek tahmin edilmeye çalışılmaktadır\. Ayrıca maliyete dayalı yöntemler de değer tahminlerinde kullanılabilmektedir\. Ekonomik değer belirleme, tıbbi ve aromatik bitkilerin sürdürülebilir yönetimine ve koruma\-kullanım dengesinin sağlanmasına katkı sağlayacağından, değer belirleme çalışmalarının teşvik edilmesi, bu konuda pilot çalışmaların desteklenmesi ve yaygınlaştırılması faydalı olacaktır\. Ekonomik değer belirleme sonuçlarının yönetim planlarına entegre edilmesi, karar vericilerin seçenekler arasında doğru seçim yapmasına ve alanın daha etkili ve verimli bir şekilde yönetilmesine de katkı sağlayacaktır\.

## [THE EL\-RAKHAWI PHYSICO\-CHEMICAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FRAMEWORK: AI\-DRIVEN DISCOVERY OF ECO\-FRIENDLY CATALYSTS AND ADVANCED SUSTAINABLE MATERIALS](../publications/f909b8abd4e16e4807b3.md)

mohamed kamal arafa el\-rakhawi

The El\-Rakhawi Physico\-Chemical AI \(EPC\-AI\) Framework revolutionizes sustainable material discovery by transcending the limitations of trial\-and\-error experimentation and computationally prohibitive Density Functional Theory\. Addressing industry&\#x27;s dependency on scarce, toxic rare\-earth metals, EPC\-AI integrates four novel modules: a Physics\-Informed Generative Material Model \(PIGMM\) using equivariant Graph Neural Networks constrained by quantum mechanical symmetries to generate thermodynamically stable structures; an AI\-Accelerated Reaction Pathway Mapper \(AARPM\) employing Machine Learning Potentials to predict catalytic mechanisms with near\-quantum accuracy; an Integrated Green Chemistry and Lifecycle Evaluator \(IGCLE\) that embeds the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry directly into the loss function as mathematical penalties, ensuring sustainability by design; and an Autonomous Closed\-Loop Validation Interface connecting AI predictions to robotic self\-driving laboratories\. Performance is quantified by the El\-Rakhawi Sustainable Material Discovery Metric \(ESMDM\), yielding bits per Joule to link discovery power directly to thermodynamic and ecological efficiency\. EPC\-AI accelerates the discovery of earth\-abundant, non\-toxic catalysts for critical applications like CO2 reduction and green ammonia synthesis, democratizing access to advanced materials while eliminating environmental harm\.
